title: Software Engineer, Content Safety
description:
Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience with software programming in Python, Java, or C\+\+.
* 1 year of experience in a core ML domain, such as generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), computer vision, speech/audio, reinforcement learning, recommendation systems, or ML infrastructure.
* 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model training, model inference, model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in safety\-adjacent domains, including factuality, product policy, or broader responsible AI frameworks.
* Experience managing safety for UGC or GenAI products, with a deep understanding of adversarial incentives, abuse vectors, and distribution dynamics like virality.
* Experience designing and deploying global\-scale defensive architectures and pipelines capable of meeting rigorous Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Solid high\-level understanding of Machine Learning and Large Language Model (LLM) architecture, specifically transformers, activations, and the requirements for efficient, large\-scale training and deployment.
* Demonstrated accountability for managing technical debt, reducing bug counts, and mitigating SLO breaches to maintain high operational standards.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.



Our mission in the Content Safety organization is to protect Google’s users and the internet as a whole from exposure to offensive, sensitive or potentially harmful content. We achieve this by contributing directly to our foundational models and collaborating closely with DeepMind.


Beyond keeping users safe at scale, we also play a key role in accelerating Google's product launches by providing product teams with the right tools to explore new ideas and products following our Responsible AI principles. Our team combines unique subject matter expertise in the content safety domain, ML and high\-throughput infrastructure.
  

  

In this role, you will keep society safer. You will work on problems like transformer architecture, and find comfort in an ever\-changing landscape, anticipating threats that don't exist yet.


The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, build, and scale content safety systems including classifiers, vector databases, and multimodal models to protect business\-critical products and GenAI experiences.
* Develop and maintain production\-grade distributed systems and content processing pipelines optimized for high throughput and reliability across server\-side and on\-device environments.
* Model training, evaluation, and productionization workflows, incorporating feedback loops and automation to continuously improve model quality and performance.
* Implement agentic workflows and advanced heuristics for deep threat understanding, enabling the proactive detection of complex abuse patterns.
* Drive agile engineering efforts to identify and mitigate novel abuse patterns, ensuring Google’s products remain engaged and safe in a shifting threat landscape.

Support the technical execution of the Liquids / Dry Parts Value workstream through a strong automation engineering skillset across BMS, ERP, MES, Batch, PLC, and SCADA systems. The role requires a solid understanding of process mechanical and electrical systems within the plant and acting as a subject matter expert in at least one area of the plant control system architecture.


The Automation Engineer will support and optimize automated production systems operating in a 24/7 manufacturing environment. This includes a working knowledge of MES, ERP, and PLC\-controlled machines and processes associated with food and beverage production, Clean\-in\-Place (CIP), process water systems, wastewater treatment systems and energy management systems. He/she is collaborative, customer\-centric, and outcome\-driven, with strong stakeholder management, communication, and executive presence to influence senior leaders and operational teams alike. title: Chief Product & Technology Officer(CPTO)
description:
**Position Summary**

TheChief Product \& Technology Officer (CPTO) will define and lead Alpha X’sproduct and technology strategy as the Company expands from its semiconductorheritage into broader industrial sectors. The role is accountable foridentifying the right product positioning, translating market needs into afocused product portfolio and roadmap, and directing the R\&D team to buildscalable, commercially viable industrial software solutions.


WithAlpha X’s existing capabilities in manufacturing software and automation, the CPTOwill determine where the Company can compete and win, convert project\-basedknow\-how into repeatable products, and ensure that technology investmentssupport sustainable revenue growth.


**Key Responsibilities**

**1\.Product Strategy \& Market Positioning**

* **Define Product Direction:** Assess AlphaX’s existing software and automation capabilities and establish a clear product visionfor expansion beyond the semiconductor sector.
* **Identify Priority Markets:** Evaluateindustrial sectors, customer pain points, market attractiveness and competitivegaps to determine where Alpha X should focus its product investments.
* **Build the Product Portfolio:** Define theCompany’s product portfolio, value propositions, target customers, deploymentmodels and differentiation strategy.
* **Market Validation:** Engage customers,commercial teams and industry partners to validate product assumptions beforecommitting significant development resources.

**2\.Product Roadmap \& Commercialisation**

* **Own the Product Roadmap:** Translatebusiness strategy into a prioritised product roadmap with clear milestones,investment requirements and commercial outcomes.
* **Drive Productisation:** Convertcustomer\-specific solutions and project experience into configurable, reusableand scalable software products.
* **Balance Standardisation and Customisation:** Establishclear principles for standard product features, configurable modules andcustomer\-specific development.
* **Commercial Readiness:** Ensure productsare designed for effective implementation, integration, support, maintenance,upgrading and repeatable sales.

**3\.Technology Strategy \& Architecture**

* **Set Technology Direction:** Define thetechnology architecture, platforms, engineering standards and developmentprinciples required to support the product strategy.
* **Industrial Software Architecture:** Guidethe development of secure, reliable and interoperable industrial software,including MES, automation, data integration and related manufacturingapplications.
* **Scalability and Integration:** Ensureproducts can integrate with industrial equipment, enterprise systems andcustomer environments while remaining scalable across different sectors andoperating models.
* **Technology Evaluation:** Assess emergingtechnologies pragmatically and adopt them where they create measurable customeror business value.

**4\.R\&D Leadership \& Execution**

* **Lead the R\&D Function:** Provideclear direction to the software development and technical teams, ensuring thatresources are aligned with agreed product priorities.
* **Execution Accountability:** Own productdevelopment delivery, including scope, timeline, technical quality, testing,release readiness and post\-launch improvement.
* **Engineering Excellence:** Implementdisciplined development practices covering software design, code quality,DevOps, CI/CD, quality assurance, documentation and technical debt management.
* **Team Capability:** Build the technicalleadership, product thinking and engineering capabilities required for theCompany’s next stage of growth.

**5\.Customer, Commercial \& Stakeholder Partnership**

* **Executive Technical Leadership:** Act asthe senior technology and product representative in strategic customerdiscussions, solution positioning and key commercial opportunities.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partnerclosely with the CEO, Sales, Delivery and other business leaders to alignproduct development with market demand and operational realities.
* **Customer Feedback Loop:** Establish astructured process for converting customer and implementation feedback intoproduct decisions and roadmap priorities.
* **Business Cases and Investment:** Developclear business cases for major product and technology investments, includingexpected market impact, resource requirements, risks and returns.

**6\.Governance, Risk \& Intellectual Property**

* **Technology Governance:** Establishgovernance for architecture, software releases, data management, cybersecurity,system reliability and business continuity.
* **Cybersecurity and Compliance:** Ensureproducts meet appropriate security, privacy and industrial customerrequirements.
* **Intellectual Property:** Protect theCompany’s source code, proprietary know\-how, product designs and otherintellectual property through appropriate controls and, where relevant, patentor registration strategies.
* **Budget and Resource Management:** Manageproduct and technology budgets, resource allocation, external vendors anddevelopment investments with clear accountability for outcomes.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree inComputer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Engineering or arelated discipline. A postgraduate qualification is an advantage but notmandatory.
* **Leadership Experience:** Typically 12–15years of relevant experience, including senior leadership responsibility forproduct, technology, software engineering or R\&D in an industrial software,enterprise software, automation or manufacturing technology business.
* **Product Strategy:** Demonstrated successin defining product direction, prioritising markets and translating customerproblems into commercially viable software products.
* **Productisation:** Proven experienceconverting project\-based or customer\-specific solutions into scalable,repeatable and configurable products.
* **Technical Depth:** Strong understandingof enterprise and industrial software architecture, software developmentlifecycles, systems integration, data platforms, cybersecurity and modernengineering practices.
* **Industrial Domain:** Good understandingof manufacturing operations, MES, factory automation or adjacent industrialtechnology environments.
* **Commercial Orientation:** Ability toevaluate technology decisions through customer value, market potential,implementation practicality and commercial return.
* **Leadership:** Able to set direction, makeclear trade\-offs, challenge assumptions and lead technical teams from strategythrough execution.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience taking an industrial or enterprise software product from conceptthrough launch, adoption and scale.
* Experience expanding a technology business from one industry vertical intoadjacent industrial sectors.
* Priorexposure to semiconductor manufacturing is advantageous, but broader industrialsoftware and product leadership experience is equally relevant.
* Experience working with enterprise customers in mission\-critical manufacturingenvironments.
* Experience leading organisational or business transformation from customisedsolutions toward a product\-led model.

TheCompany may assign other responsibilities that are reasonably related to thescope and seniority of the position.

Responsibilities
  
  

About the team
  
The Cross\-Issue and Product Policy (CIP) team's mission is to define the fundamental principles that guide policy work, ensuring policies are aligned and operable across issue areas and product surfaces.
  
  

About the role
  
In this role, you will help develop a durable policy base for TikTok’s global Trust \& Safety ecosystem. You will lead and support strategic policy initiatives and priorities, including ensuring human rights are embedded in the policy development process and that we are effectively communicating our principles to external audiences through our Community Guidelines. You will partner closely with policy subject\-matter experts, product teams, enforcement and operations partners, legal, public policy, data science, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure policy decisions are clear, consistent, implementable, and aligned with broader platform safety goals.
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines principled thought, strong policy judgment, excellent writing, structured problem\-solving, and the ability to bring clarity to ambiguous, fast\-moving, cross\-functional issues.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Draft and refine policy materials so they are clear, consistent, defensible and operationally useful for downstream teams.
* Support strategic cross\-policy and product\-policy initiatives, including work related to emerging harms, new product features, AI\-generated content, human rights, spam, account integrity, appeals, and other high\-priority policy areas.
* Partner with policy subject\-matter experts and product/XFN teams to translate complex safety, product, and societal issues into practical policy frameworks and decision logic.
* Advise on policy alignment for new features, product launches, and cross\-functional initiatives, ensuring risks, ownership, review paths, and launch\-readiness considerations are clearly understood.
* Develop and maintain foundational policy documentation, including policy principles, frameworks, taxonomies, glossaries, templates, and style guides.
* Build reusable tools and self\-serve resources that help policy and partner teams develop, update, and apply policy more consistently.
* Provide structured feedback on policy drafts, enforcement guidance, and related materials to ensure they reflect policy intent and can be interpreted and implemented consistently.
* Support leadership visibility into major cross\-policy initiatives, unresolved decision points, and areas where policy fragmentation or governance ambiguity may create risk.


Qualifications
  
  

Minimum Qualification(s)
  
* 5\+ years of experience in Trust \& Safety, platform policy, product policy, public policy, law, human rights, technology policy, academia, or a related field.
* Excellent writing, editing, and executive communication skills, with the ability to turn complex and ambiguous topics into clear, structured, and actionable materials.
* Strong policy judgment and the ability to reason across multiple issue areas, product contexts, stakeholder perspectives, and risk trade\-offs.
* Experience developing policy frameworks, principles, standards, guidance, or governance documentation.
* Exceptional ability to work cross\-functionally with partners such as product, legal, comms, operations, enforcement, public policy, and data science.
* Self\-starter with strong organizational skills, able to manage multiple workstreams while thriving in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and delivering high\-priority projects with both speed and rigor.
* Strong understanding of online safety, content policy, platform governance, social media, or technology policy issues.


Preferred Qualification(s)
  
* A degree in law, with experience working on cross\-policy, product\-policy, or governance initiatives in a global technology company. Experience drafting public\-facing community guidelines is a plus.
* Experience with Trust \& Safety policy development, enforcement systems, escalation processes, or operational policy implementation.
* Familiarity with one or more relevant issue areas, such as AI\-generated content, spam, human rights, account integrity, appeals, civic integrity, or emerging product safety risks.
* Experience advising product teams on safety, policy, governance, or launch\-readiness considerations.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to use qualitative and quantitative evidence to inform policy recommendations.


Job Information
  
  

Trust \& Safety
  
  

Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every\-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis.
  
  

​
  
  

​
  
  

TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining.
  
  

​
  
  

​
  
  

We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence\-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person\-centred, innovative and integrated approach.
  
  

​
  
  

About TikTok
  
  

TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.
  
  

​
  
  

Why Join Us
  
  

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day.
  
  

​
  
  

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.
  
  

​
  
  

​
  
  

Diversity \& Inclusion
  
  

​
  
  

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

Supported by evidence\-informed practice and data from wearables and lifestyle inputs, MORROW Health helps members recognise patterns, build consistency, and stay accountable—turning insight into everyday action that supports long\-term vitality, strength, and clarity, without medical diagnosis or treatment.


Location: Singapore


Reports To: Chief Technology Officer


The Product Manager is accountable for the end\-to\-end product lifecycle of the company's digital health products. The PM will drive 0\-to\-1 product building, owning discovery, roadmap, delivery and growth, while working hands\-on with engineering, design, clinical and business teams on\-site.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap of assigned digital products, aligned with the company's mission and business goals.
* Drive 0\-to\-1 product building: problem discovery, user research, rapid prototyping, MVP scoping, launch and iteration based on real usage data.
* Design and continuously improve user engagement, grounded in behavioural science and evidence\-based health practices.
* Translate clinical protocols, health programmes and domain expertise into intuitive digital experiences, in close collaboration with clinical and operational teams.
* Define, instrument and track product KPIs (activation, retention, engagement, NPS) and run experiments (A/B tests) to improve them.
* Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria; prioritise the backlog and run agile ceremonies with engineering and design.
* Leverage AI tools hands\-on across the product lifecycle, including LLM\-based prototyping and AI\-assisted research and analysis, and shape AI\-powered features within the products.
* Connect physical and digital touchpoints into one coherent user journey, including booking, check\-in and feedback flows where relevant.
* Manage integrations with third\-party services, devices and data sources as required by the product roadmap.
* Ensure product decisions comply with healthcare data privacy and security requirements (PDPA and relevant regulations), working closely with the Cybersecurity \& IT and Compliance teams.
* Manage release cycles and product quality across platforms (iOS, Android, web) together with engineering and QA.
* Gather and synthesise user feedback continuously (interviews, surveys, support tickets, reviews) into actionable product improvements.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Requirements Analysis \& Documentation:** Work closely with stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business requirements. Translate these into clear process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specifications that the development team can build from without ambiguity.
* **Process Modelling:** Produce and maintain Business Process Documents (BPDs) covering end\-to\-end workflows — including swimlane diagrams, decision flows, and entity relationship overviews — to ensure shared understanding across product, engineering, and operations.
* **QA Planning \& Test Design:** Design test plans, test cases, and test scripts covering functional, regression, integration, and UAT scenarios. Ensure every feature is tested against documented acceptance criteria before release.
* **Testing:** Execute manual testing across web and mobile platforms.
* **Defect Management:** Identify, document, and track defects through their full lifecycle — from discovery to closure — using structured bug reports with clear reproduction steps, severity classifications, and root\-cause categorisation.
* **API \& Integration Testing:** Validate backend services and third\-party integrations through API testing, ensuring data integrity, correct behaviour across service boundaries, and compliance with agreed interface contracts.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with developers, product managers, and operations stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment — participating in sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and UAT sessions.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify gaps in documentation, test coverage, or process clarity and proactively propose improvements to reduce requirements misinterpretation and defect rates across the delivery lifecycle.

**Required Skills**

* **Business Analysis:** Proven experience understanding and documenting requirements, producing process flows, and writing acceptance criteria for software products. Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **QA \& Testing:** Hands\-on experience in manual testing across web and mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and integration testing. Familiarity with structured defect tracking and test case management tools.

* **Agile Delivery:** Comfortable working within Agile/Scrum teams. Experience participating in sprint ceremonies and managing work items.

description:
Ever wondered how companies figure out "what could go wrong" *before* it actually goes wrong? That's basically what a Risk Business Analyst does. You'll be the person connecting the dots between data, business decisions, and "hey, maybe we shouldn't do that" moments — but backed by numbers, not just gut feeling.

If you're a curious problem\-solver who likes spreadsheets a little too much, enjoys asking "why" five times in a row, and wants a front\-row seat to how real business decisions get made — this one's for you.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Digging into data to spot risks before they become problems (financial, operational, you name it).
* Helping build and maintain risk models, dashboards, and reports that actual humans can understand (no jargon soup).
* Working closely with different teams — finance, ops, compliance — to understand how the business runs.
* Documenting processes and flagging where things could break down.
* Supporting audits and compliance checks (less scary than it sounds, promise).
* Turning messy data into clear insights and recommendations for decision\-makers.
* Keeping an eye on industry trends and regulations that might affect the business

**What we’re looking for**

* Diploma and Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or something similar — but we care more about how you think than your GP.

* Certifications like **FRM**, **PRM**, or even progress toward a **CFA** are a plus — but definitely not required if you're just starting out.
* Someone naturally curious — you like understanding *why things* work the way they do.
* Comfortable with numbers, but not necessarily a math genius (we'll teach you the technical stuff).
* Good communicator — you can explain a risk in plain English, not just analyst\-speak.
* Detail\-oriented but not a perfectionist who never ships anything.
* Eager to learn — this role grows fast if you're hungry for it.
* Team player who's not afraid to ask questions (seriously, ask away).

* Demonstrated success in supporting complex enterprise sales pursuits and large\-scale business transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of SAP and enterprise business processes, with the ability to align technology solutions to strategic business objectives.

* Experience facilitating workshops, conducting requirements analysis, and translating business needs into strategic solution roadmaps.
* Broad understanding of enterprise architecture, integration, cloud, analytics, data platforms, and hybrid technology environments.
* Commercially minded with experience supporting solution estimation, proposal development, business case creation, and deal shaping.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience leading cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and helping organizations realize value from AI\-led transformation initiatives.
* Willingness to travel within the region as required.

------------------------------------------


Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades \- join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. With over 51,000 employees worldwide across Europe, North America and Asia, the Group supports organizations in driving their digital transformation and delivering sustainable business value.  

  

In Asia Pacific, Singapore serves as the regional headquarter for Sopra Steria’s Infrastructure, Cloud and Cybersecurity services.

 **Job Description** **Description:**


For this position, we are looking for a **Senior Application Support Engineer** who can assist one of our clients \- a leading technology provider for private banking and wealth management, serving financial institutions across Europe and Asia.


As part of the continued growth of the Application Support team in Singapore, we are looking for a Senior Application Support Engineer specialized in Payments to support, operate, and continuously improve its payment platform ecosystem.


The successful candidate will act as the technical expert for VolPay (VolPay by Volante Technologies), working closely with the Service Bureau team, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and external partners, including SWIFT.


This role covers production support activities, Level 2/Level 3 incident management, payment flow analysis, platform monitoring, and participation in strategic payment\-related projects.

**Responsibilities:**


Application Support \& Production Operations

* Provide functional and technical support for the VolPay platform.
* Investigate and resolve production incidents and service disruptions.
* Ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs).
* Communicate effectively with stakeholders throughout incident management activities.
* Participate in on\-call support rotations.
* Monitor recurring issues and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Manage Docker container operations, including start, stop, restart, and configuration through Ansible Tower.
* Manage Docker upgrades, deployments, and version tracking.


Payments \& SWIFT Expertise

* Analyze and troubleshoot SWIFT messaging and payment flows, including:
	+ MT103
	+ MT202
	+ MT940
	+ MT950
	+ ISO 20022 messages (pacs, camt, pain)
* Work closely with the Service Bureau team on incident resolution and system enhancements.
* Investigate payment failures, rejections, duplicates, delays, and reconciliation issues.


Technical Administration \& Troubleshooting

* Perform advanced troubleshooting on Unix/Linux environments.
* Analyze and resolve issues involving:
	+ IBM MQ / MQ Series
	+ PostgreSQL databases
	+ MongoDB databases
	+ Batch processing
	+ File transfers and system integrations
* Develop and maintain scripts to automate operational tasks and investigations.
* Implement and maintain Splunk monitoring alerts to proactively detect application, infrastructure, and payment\-processing issues.


Change \& Release Management

* Participate in application releases and deployments.
* Prepare and execute implementation and rollback plans.
* Perform post\-deployment validation and production checks.
* Contribute to CAB activities and ITIL change management processes.


Continuous Improvement

* Identify automation opportunities and operational efficiencies.
* Reduce recurring incidents through proactive improvements.
* Enhance monitoring, alerting, and reporting capabilities.
* Maintain comprehensive technical and operational documentation.


 Deployment \& RUN Operations

* Execute Volpay deployment
* Manage Docker container lifecycle (start/stop/restart) via Ansible Tower.
* Management of Dockers.
* Develop new Ansible templates
* Administer and monitor supporting infrastructure: Kafka, Zookeeper, MongoDB
* Maintain and improve deployment scripts and procedures (Docker\-based)

  

**Qualifications**  

Payments (Mandatory)

* Strong expertise in VolPay or similar payment applications, with hands\-on experience managing Docker\-based deployments and operations.
* In\-depth knowledge of international payment processing
* Solid understanding of SWIFT messaging standards
* Good knowledge of ISO 20022


Systems \& Middleware

* Strong Unix/Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Docker management.
* Shell scripting (Bash, Korn Shell)
* IBM MQ / MQ Series
* APIs and integration technologies


Databases

* MongoDB

Production Support

* Incident and problem management
* Log analysis and troubleshooting
* Batch scheduling and processing

* Autonomous and accountable.

Job Summary
  
  

The Role is responsible for the credit risk management of the credit exposure in respect of SME Banking. Specifically, he/ she will be managing both programme lending and discretionary lending (i.e. double hat as Senior Credit Officer (“SCO”), Medium Enterprises (“ME”) for the respective cluster. This role also will have responsibility for SME portfolio for ASEAN.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Strategy
  
* Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.
* Inform the development of business plans with the provision of cost and impairment forecasts and a balanced judgment on the external environment.


Business
  
* Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates
* Communicate the strategic intent and collective agenda for the Function.
* Maintain and develop the Function's risk capabilities, and skills to meet ongoing needs and plans


Processes
  
* Supervise all processes where a member of the Function is the identified first line process owner.
* Ensure effective management of the operational risks within the Function and compliance with applicable internal policies, and external laws and regulations.
* Continuously improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the Function’s risk management processes.


People \& Talent
  
* Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
* Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
* Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles
* Responsibility to review team structure / capacity plans


Risk Management
  
* Act as the Credit Risk Type owner under the Group’s Risk Management Framework (including relevant Operational Risk Framework ownership for credit risk). Ensure a full understanding of the risk and control environment in area of responsibility.


Leadership on Discretionary Lending
  
* Ensuring that the quality of Business Credit Applications (BCAs) meets Group standards, particularly with regards to the completeness and depth of risk analysis.
* Approving breaches of Local Portfolio Standards, to the extent permitted by Credit Policy.
* Formulating and obtaining approval of Portfolio Standards which is supportive (from credit risk perspective) of the business strategy of various segments.
* Ensuring Risk Committee meets on a regular basis to review credit related issues in compliance with Group Policy governing such matters and actively participating on that Committee.
* Ensuring timely submission and accuracy of Medium Enterprises credit portfolio data to the Portfolio Quality Review Forum/ Credit Issues Committee/ relevant Risk Committee. These include, but may not be limited to, the following:


o Risk MI reports
  
o All approved exposures in Medium Enterprises (as required by local regulator Reporting)
  
o Details of approved portfolio breaches of Group and Local Credit Policy (including details of mitigating circumstances)
  
o Country Risk exposure
  
* Monitoring compliance with credit policy and Portfolio Standards on a monthly basis at least and reviewing any divergence thereof with the Risk Head/Segment Heads to ensure credit quality targets are achieved.
* Ensure EAR process is adhered to and lead monthly EAR discussions. Assisting relationship managers in identification and managing up or out of accounts exhibiting signs of deterioration and assist TWC Stressed Asset Management, where appropriate, in managing accounts to maximise recoveries and minimise losses.
* Ensure compliance to the Operational Risk framework including the effective application of risk toolkit (self\-assessments, KRIs, KCSs, etc) and reporting.
* Initiate portfolio review (with stress test) / portfolio scans, stress tests as required by internal and external factors and review results and assess their implications
* Uphold the integrity of risk/return decisions, by challenging business to demonstrate that risk origination and control decisions are properly informed and consistent with strategy
* Direct appropriate response to material events or other risk issues that come to the SCO's attention
* Exercise risk control responsibility for Credit Risk, Wealth \& Retail Banking (“WRB”)
* Ensure that material risk exposures and related issues are reported to the responsible governance committees and to Group and business\-level committees as appropriate
* Ensure appropriate judgement is applied in the discharge of risk authorities assigned to the jobholder
* Maintain a good understanding of the requirements of key external stakeholders in respect of risk management and ensure these are well understood internally and reflected in internal procedures
* Maintain delegated authorities in line with internal policies and ensure that delegations are in line with individual capabilities.
* Actively participate in key committees through standing membership
* Ensure first line process owners understand and accept their risk management responsibilities
* Maintain an open and cooperative relationship in dealings with regulators (if applicable)
* Co\-ordinating local resources to ensure that credit systems are installed in accordance with Group standard. Provide a reference point for collating and passing on to Group Technology and Operations problems and proposed enhancements. Ensure that new users are trained on all credit systems.
* Increasing working profits through effective management of the loan asset portfolio in order to help develop the franchise in a sustainable way and minimise provisions.
* Maximizing Economic Revenue through effective management of the risk/reward relationships.
* Maintaining credit quality and standards of professionalism for the risk function.
* Ensure effective implementation of Group Policies / Circulars / Procedures.
* Undertake regular customer visits to better understand the business environment


Leadership on Programme Lending
  
* Ensure full compliance with Group Credit Policies and Process Standards. Dispensations or any gaps must be well supported and approved on a timely basis. CADs and CCPMs are renewed on timely basis.
* Design, maintain and effectively communicate risk control parameters for Business Banking including policies, control standards, risk exposure limits and other control levers in order to maintain the business’s risk profile in line with the Group's risk appetite
* Assess the credit risk profile of Business Banking and maintain alignment with risk appetite by rebalancing of risks or controls that may be required in response to internal and external factors \- initiate, at least annually and with guidance from Group specialists, a stress test and scenario programme, review the results and assess their implications
* Ensure that effective management response plans are in place to respond to extreme but plausible scenarios
* Direct appropriate response to material events or other risk issues that come to the role holder’s attention
* Ensure appropriate judgement is applied in the discharge of risk authorities assigned to the jobholder, taking account of concentration risk across sectors, geographies and markets where applicable. Assign risk authorities to suitable named individuals in line with their skills and judgement
* Lead with the support of RRS Hub to


o Timely report of material risk events, breach of risk triggers, material shift in portfolio shape / threshold, and portfolio performance in RCO deck. Ensure that material risk exposures and related issues are reported to the responsible governance committees
  
o Ensure risk identification, measurement and modelling capabilities are objective, consistent and compliant with applicable regulations
  
* Work with product team to


o Ensure business and product heads understand and accept their credit risk management responsibilities
  
o Uphold the integrity of risk/return decisions, by challenging business and control function heads to demonstrate that risk origination and control decisions are properly informed and consistent with strategy and risk appetite
  
o Support acquisition and portfolio programmes by effective managing programme risks and profitability
  
Cooperate with regulators to
  
  

o Maintain a good understanding of the requirements of key external stakeholders in respect of credit risk management and ensure these are well understood internally and reflected in internal procedures
  
o Maintain an open and cooperative relationship in dealings with regulators
  
o Obtain assurance regarding the effectiveness of credit controls and compliance with applicable laws \& local regulations
  
  

Governance
  
* Responsible for assessing the effectiveness of the Group’s arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the business and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework, in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
* Responsible for delivering ‘effective governance’; capability to challenge fellow executives effectively; and Willingness to work with any local regulators in an open and cooperative manner.


Regulatory \& Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


Key stakeholders
  
Internal
  
* Chief Executive (in country)
* Chief Risk Officer (in country)
* Business Heads, Country Segment Heads, Senior Bankers, Credit/Marketing group (Country and Group)
* Head, Regional \& Group Risk of SME Lending (in or outside country)
* Head TWC Stressed Asset Management (Country, Regional and Global)
* Country Head of SME Banking Risk of other countries
* Head, Group Audit (in country)
* CMPS Sales (in country)
* Head, Legal Affairs, Compliance (in country)
* Credit Risk Control (in country)
* GBS Hub – ME Governance (outside country)
* CIB Credit (in country)


External
  
* Executives (including equivalent CRM Units) of other banks
* Key Corporate and Institutional relationships in country
* Members of the legal professions
* Directors/Key contacts in the business community
* Accountants/Consultants
* Auditors / Government regulators


Other Responsibilities
  
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Singapore and ASEAN];
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.
* Multiple functions (double hats)


Our Ideal Candidate
  
20\+ year of experience as Senior Credit Risk leader in SME / Business Banking lending, covering both discretionary lending and portfolio/program lending risk management
  
  

Proven track record as a Senior Credit Officer (SCO) or equivalent senior credit approver, with strong underwriting judgment and delegated credit authority
  
Relevant credit risk qualifications such as Credit Risk Certification Curriculum (“CRCC”) OR Enhanced Competence Framework – Credit Risk Management (“ECF\-CRM”)
  
Role Specific Technical Competencies
  
Deep expertise in credit risk management, portfolio governance, stress testing, early alert management, policy formulation, and risk appetite oversight.
  
Strong understanding of the Singapore and ASEAN SME lending landscape, including regulatory requirements and market dynamics.
  
Experienced people leader with the ability to build high\-performing teams, develop talent, and foster a strong risk culture.
  
Confident stakeholder manager who can effectively challenge business decisions while maintaining strong partnerships with senior executives, regulators, and control functions.
  
Demonstrated ability to balance business growth objectives with prudent risk management, driving sustainable portfolio performance and profitability.
  
Strategic thinker with strong decision\-making capability, sound commercial judgment, and the courage to make difficult risk decisions.
  
High degree of integrity, credibility, and influence, with excellent communication and relationship\-building skills across diverse stakeholder groups.
  
About Standard Chartered
  
  

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  

**Together we:**

What we offer

Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.

title: Client Onboarding Specialist
description:
**Role Summary**  

The Client Onboarding Specialist is a dedicated onboarding specialist responsible for coordinating and driving the end\-to\-end client onboarding process across private wealth client structures, including individual, joint, corporate, trust, family office and VCC\-related accounts.  



  

The role supports and co\-ordinates the Front Office onboarding activities, acting as the key liaison between Relationship Managers/Assistants and internal onboarding, operations and compliance teams and other relevant internal and external stakeholders to ensure required documentation and inputs are provided on time and operational handovers can be completed in line with internal and regulatory standards.  



  

While the RM and RMA remain the primary client contacts and owners of the client relationship, this role provides specialist onboarding expertise, structure and execution discipline to improve turnaround times, reduce operational risk and deliver a smoother client onboarding experience.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**  

**Client Onboarding Management**  

* Manage end\-to\-end onboarding for individual, joint, corporate, trust, family office and VCC\-related client structures, covering documentation preparation and coordination of the account opening and mandate setup process.
* Review onboarding packs for completeness and accuracy before submission to Onboarding and Lifecycle Management Department.
* Track onboarding progress, manage outstanding items and provide timely status updates to relevant stakeholders.
* Support the preparation of client meetings and onboarding materials, including direct client follow\-up to obtain further clarification, information or required documentation where appropriate.
  

**KYC, AML \& Due Diligence**  

* Act as the first line of defence for KYC, AML/CFT and CDD requirements, supporting timely and compliant client onboarding.
* Collect, review and validate KYC, AML/CFT, FATCA, CRS and client due diligence documentation to support timely onboarding.
* Conduct preliminary checks on ownership structures, source of wealth/source of funds and beneficial ownership requirements.
* Escalate documentation gaps, compliance issues and onboarding risks in line with internal policies.
  

**Variable Capital Company (VCC) Support**  

* Support onboarding and administration of Singapore VCC structures, including shareholders, directors, authorised signatories, related entities and sub\-fund account structures.
* Coordinate VCC\-related requirements with fund administrators, company secretaries, custodians, legal counsel and internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate VCC records and monitor documentation, corporate actions and regulatory submissions where applicable.
  

**Client Servicing \& Relationship Support**  

* Partner with RMs and RMAs on onboarding\-related client servicing activities, while the RM and RMA remain the primary client contacts and owners of the client relationship.
* Provide specialist onboarding coordination across internal teams to support accurate, timely and risk\-controlled client onboarding.
  

**Account \& Portfolio Administration**  

* Support ongoing account maintenance, including static data updates, mandate changes and documentation refreshes.
* Assist with periodic reviews and ensure account records and documentation remain aligned with regulatory, suitability and internal conduct requirements.
**Qualifications / Requirements**  

* Minimum 5 years’ experience in client onboarding, client servicing, client administration or operations within private wealth, asset management, private banking or related financial services.
* Good understanding of KYC/AML, client due diligence, suitability, conduct and documentation standards, with strong attention to detail.
* Working knowledge of investment products, account structures and portfolio administration processes.
* Strong organisational, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities under time pressure.
* Proficient in common office systems, CRM tools and client or portfolio platforms, with a practical and process\-oriented mindset.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Able to operate effectively within a well\-established framework while contributing to practical improvements in day\-to\-day procedures and ways of working.
* Self\-directed and able to plan own workload against changing priorities, business needs and external events.
* Comfortable making routine, well\-precedented judgments independently, with sound judgment to escalate complex, unusual or higher\-risk matters.

title: Senior Lead Engineer (100% Onsite)
description:
**Senior Lead Engineer** 

*at Singapore’s leading AI training provider*

**Full\-time \| Singapore \| Technology \| Onsite**

The opportunityVertical Institute is looking for a Senior Lead Engineer to own the technical direction of a small, high\-output engineering team building the systems that power our learning platform and internal operations. This is a hands\-on leadership role \- you will still write and review code, but your primary contribution is making the team's technical decisions sound, the architecture scalable, and the engineering culture strong.You will work closely with the CEO and cross\-functional stakeholders across admissions, sales, finance, and operations to translate business priorities into a technical roadmap \- and then lead the team to execute against it. The systems you design and the standards you set will shape how the company's technology function grows from here.

*This is not a role for someone who wants to step back from the code and into meetings. We are looking for a lead who is credible in both directions \- technical enough to make the right architecture calls and lead by example, and clear\-headed enough to set priorities, unblock the team, and communicate trade\-offs to non\-technical leadership. If you have done this before in a lean, fast\-moving environment, we want to talk.*

**What you will own**Technical leadership and architecture

* Set the technical direction for the engineering team \- making architecture decisions, defining standards, and ensuring the systems we build are scalable, secure, and maintainable.
* Own the technical roadmap in partnership with the CEO, translating business requirements into a coherent build sequence with clear trade\-offs articulated.
* Lead design and code reviews that raise the quality bar for the whole team, not just catch errors.
* Identify and address technical debt before it becomes a constraint on the company's ability to move fast.

Hands\-on engineering

* Design, build, and maintain core systems supporting the learning platform and internal business operations \- remaining an active, contributing engineer, not just a technical director.
* Develop internal tools and automation workflows that meaningfully improve efficiency across sales, admissions, finance, and student operations.
* Design and implement integrations across LMS, CRM, payment gateways, and third\-party SaaS platforms with an eye on long\-term maintainability, not just short\-term delivery.

AI and workflow innovation

* Lead the identification and implementation of AI\-powered features, agents, and automation workflows that reduce operational overhead and improve decision\-making across the business.
* Stay ahead of the practical applications of AI in an education and operations context, bringing ideas to the team before the business asks for them.

Team development and engineering culture

* Mentor and develop the engineers on the team \- helping them grow technically and building a culture where good engineering is the expectation, not the exception.
* Set and enforce engineering best practices around documentation, testing, deployment, and system reliability.
* Build a team environment where engineers take genuine ownership of their work and feel accountable for outcomes, not just outputs.

Stakeholder communication and cross\-functional collaboration

* Communicate technical decisions, constraints, and trade\-offs clearly to the CEO and non\-technical stakeholders \- making the invisible visible without overwhelming people with detail.
* Work closely with teams across the business to understand operational pain points and translate them into technical solutions that actually solve the problem.
* Be the person technical and non\-technical stakeholders trust equally \- credible with engineers and accessible to everyone else.

**What we look for**We are looking for someone who has already operated at this level \- not someone who is ready to try it for the first time. Beyond that:

* Strong experience in full\-stack or backend web application development, with a proven track record of designing and operating production systems independently.
* Demonstrated experience leading or mentoring a team of engineers \- setting direction, reviewing work, and raising the technical standard around you.
* Solid command of system design, scalability, and performance optimisation \- you make architecture decisions you can defend under scrutiny.
* Experience with APIs, databases, and modern web frameworks. Familiarity with Ruby on Rails is an advantage.
* Strong ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders \- you translate, not just report.
* A pragmatic, delivery\-oriented mindset \- you ship things that work and improve them iteratively, rather than waiting for the perfect solution.

Nice to have

* Experience with Learning Management Systems or EdTech platforms.
* Experience integrating SaaS tools across CRM, payments, and analytics.
* Experience building AI workflows using modern AI APIs or automation frameworks.
* Prior experience in a Lead Software Engineer or engineering leadership role at a startup or scale\-up.

**Why this role**Genuine technical authority

* You set the architecture, the standards, and the direction. The technical decisions are yours to make and yours to stand behind.

Direct CEO access

* You work directly with the CEO on the technical roadmap. Your input shapes business decisions, not just engineering backlogs.

AI at the core

* You are building AI\-powered systems for an AI training company. The subject matter and the tools are genuinely aligned in a way most tech roles cannot offer.

Build the function

* The engineering team is lean and the scope is large. What you build here \- technically and culturally \- will define how technology operates at Vertical Institute as the company scales.

About Vertical InstituteVertical Institute is Singapore's leading AI and technology training provider. We are a SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) Registered Training Provider and IBF\-accredited institution. Over 50,000 professionals have trained with us across individual programmes and enterprise engagements, including partnerships with government agencies, MNCs, and financial institutions. We are headquartered at the Lifelong Learning Institute, Paya Lebar.

description:
RealVantage is a MAS\-licensed, technology\-enabled private equity real estate investment platform, providing curated cross\-border investment opportunities to retail, accredited and institutional investors. The platform invests across multiple countries and real estate strategies with a strong emphasis on alignment, governance, and disciplined underwriting.

As RealVantage continues to scale, we are strengthening our finance, governance, and operating infrastructure to support institutional growth. The Assistant Finance Manager / Finance Manager will play a key role in delivering accurate financial reporting, maintaining strong controls, and supporting the firm's expanding regional platform.

**Role Overview**  
Reporting to the Finance Director, the Finance Manager will be responsible for the day\-to\-day finance operations across the Group's corporate entities, investment funds, and SPVs. The role requires a hands\-on finance professional with strong technical accounting capabilities, sound commercial judgement, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, multi\-jurisdictional environment.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Investment, Operations and Legal teams, as well as external auditors, fund administrators, banks and tax advisors.

**Key Responsibilities**  
1\. Financial Reporting \& Control

* Manage the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close across corporate entities, funds and SPVs.
* Prepare financial statements, management reports, ACRA filings, escrow reconciliations and statutory reporting schedules.
* Ensure accurate, timely and consistent financial reporting across multiple jurisdictions.
* Maintain strong internal controls, accounting policies and financial governance processes.

2\. Fund Finance \& Transaction Support

* Manage the finance and accounting activities for investment funds and SPVs.
* Coordinate with fund administrators to ensure accurate NAV reporting, capital accounting and financial reporting.
* Support financial due diligence, transaction execution and funding activities alongside the Investment team.
* Liaise with banks, lenders and professional advisors on financing arrangements and transaction execution.

3\. Treasury \& Cash Management

* Monitor group cash flow, liquidity and intercompany funding requirements.
* Process capital calls, distributions, fund transfers and payments across funds and SPVs.
* Manage banking relationships, payment controls and cash management processes.
* Monitor foreign exchange exposures and support treasury activities where required.

4\. Audit, Tax \& Regulatory Compliance

* Coordinate statutory audits and manage relationships with external auditors.
* Support corporate tax filings, GST (where applicable), and tax compliance across jurisdictions.
* Ensure compliance with MAS requirements and other applicable regulatory obligations.
* Maintain proper documentation, audit trails and financial records to support governance and compliance.

5\. Process Improvement \& Systems

* Drive continuous improvements in finance processes, controls and reporting.
* Support the implementation and enhancement of finance systems and workflow automation.
* Contribute to the development of scalable finance infrastructure to support the Group's growth.

6\. Stakeholder Management

* Partner closely with the Investment, Operations, Legal and Management teams on finance\-related matters.
* Build effective working relationships with auditors, fund administrators, tax advisors, banks and other external service providers.
* Support the preparation of financial information and analysis for management, investors and Board reporting.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification preferred (CA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent).
* Approximately 4–8 years' experience (Assistant Manager) or 6–10 years' experience (Finance Manager) in audit, private equity, real estate, fund management or financial services.
* Experience with investment funds, SPVs and cross\-border structures is highly desirable.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS and Singapore financial reporting requirements.
* Experience working with regulated financial institutions or fund managers is an advantage.

**Key Attributes for Success**

* Strong technical accounting and analytical skills.
* High level of accuracy with excellent attention to detail.
* Hands\-on, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Collaborative team player with a continuous improvement mindset.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic, entrepreneurial and fast\-growing environment.

**Why Join RealVantage**

* Gain exposure to cross\-border investments, institutional fund structures and regulated entities.
* Work across corporate finance, investment funds and international SPV structures.
* Join a collaborative, entrepreneurial team committed to building an institutional\-quality investment platform.

description:

Technical Engineer PM – DC Technology Infrastructure / White Space \& Grey Space
  
**Service Line:** Data Center Services
  
**Role Type:** Full\-time
  
**Areas of Interest:** Data Centers, Digital \& Technology/Information Technology, Engineering/Maintenance, Project Management
  
  

Job Title
  
Technical Engineer PM – White Space \& Grey Space / Technology Infrastructure
  
Business Sector
  
Data Center Services
  
Reports To
  
APAC Operations Manager
  
**Please note:** To be considered for this role, please attach your CV with your application.
  
  

Position Overview
  
Jones Lang LaSalle is seeking a Technical Engineer PM to lead the delivery and oversight of Whitespace and Technology Infrastructure projects across all business units within the North America \-AMER – Europe – EMEA – and Asia Pacific – APAC – regions, including Grey Space (M\&E Infrastructure) Capital Projects with full support from CSE team in Hong Kong DC. This role combines strategic project delivery with active client relationship management, serving as a trusted advisor and project leader to expand JLL's Data Center offerings.
  
Working closely with the Project Director, you will assume full responsibility for all aspects of project delivery, including financial trackers, regular status reporting, while contributing to the business development and marketing strategy for the Projects Business. The position requires ensuring seamless alignment between account organizations and other JLL departments to maximize value creation and deliver excellence in project execution. You will provide strategic direction and oversight that enables business unit and account teams to comprehensively fulfill JLL's commitments to clients.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Business Development \& Market Intelligence
  
The Technical Engineer will build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders at all staffed and unstaffed (POP sites) data centers globally. You will participate in management team meetings, briefings, consultation forums, and contribute to monthly and ad\-hoc reporting. Acting as an expert in JLL's Data Center business, culture, and strategy, you will proactively contribute to business improvement initiatives. Working in conjunction with the procurement team, you will develop and manage all bids, tenders, and proposals.
  
Project Management, Planning \& Value Creation
  
Excellence in project delivery defines this role. You will ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the complete satisfaction of all stakeholders, with the expectation of exceeding client expectations wherever possible. Identifying, reducing, and managing all risks—whether technical, statutory, health and safety, or commercial—associated with every project fall within your remit.
  
You will build strategic relationships with industry manufacturers and distributors, ensuring compliance with JLL project management policies and procedures. The provision of healthy and safe working conditions is paramount; you will ensure that both client and JLL health and safety policies are effectively implemented across JLL and subcontractor activities, with regular project reviews. This includes timely delivery of Health and Safety documentation and full compliance with local regulations.
  
Building strong relationships with subcontractors, particularly preferred suppliers, enables cost\-effective solutions that meet JLL's quality expectations while managing risk through back\-to\-back terms and conditions. You will establish and execute resource and people strategies, and ensure positive cash flow through upfront agreement of payment schedules and timely invoice submission. Debt control below 60 days is a key performance indicator.
  
Delivering projects within agreed budget requirements while maximizing profit through cost reductions and strategic procurement of subcontractor services represents a critical success factor. You will ensure appropriate control systems guarantee that statutory, policy, and contractual commitments are consistently met. As a strategic interpreter of client needs, you will identify new value\-added services and ensure opportunities for strategic project development are exploited to increase turnover and profitability.
  
Collaborative development of the projects business through effective teamwork and colleague support, combined with maintaining a customer focus across all operational activities, ensures sustained success. You will maintain effective relationships with key client contacts and JLL site teams and managers to identify and win project opportunities while promoting and upholding JLL's core values.
  
Client Relationship Management \& Development
  
Demonstrating credibility and leadership, you will influence project outcomes and manage global client relationships at the project level, acting as an advisor to the Data Centre Solutions management team. Creating alignment between customer needs and project delivery, along with managing issue escalation and resolution, forms the foundation of client satisfaction and retention.
  
Leadership \& Team Development
  
You will provide direct support to account teams and may have both direct and matrix reporting responsibilities. Managing effectively in a diverse environment with potential multi\-regional responsibilities requires adaptability and cultural awareness. Providing direct technical support to the entire Global Project Team.
  
P\&L, Contract Management \& Governance
  
Supporting the financial performance of Data Centre Services, you will take full responsibility for project delivery and manage scope interpretation as required. Leading the sponsorship essential to deliver projects and ensuring fulfillment of JLL's commitment to customers sets the tone and culture for service delivery excellence. You will engage executive involvement as needed to leverage JLL's broader portfolio, introducing new scope and business opportunities as part of delivering an integrated suite of services.
  
Qualifications \& Experience
  
Required Experience
  
Candidates must demonstrate a minimum of five years proven project management experience in the Technology/ICT sector, specifically in structured cabling environments. An additional five years of experience developing new project opportunities is essential. You must provide demonstrable evidence of having managed teams successfully and possess experience creating, presenting, and managing bids, tenders, and proposals. Experience running a P\&L is required.
  
Required Skills \& Knowledge
  
Project management skills at contract management level with the ability to manage a portfolio of projects are essential. Strong commercial awareness combined with robust financial acumen enables effective decision\-making. You must possess strong influencing, and negotiation skills, present with confidence, and understand commercial and financial metrics thoroughly.
  
Knowledge of the structured cabling and construction market, along with specific knowledge of the data center market and industry, is required. Understanding of project management methodology, construction health and safety law and legislation, and general financial terminology provides the foundation for effective project execution. Excellence in internal and external customer management, networking skills, and marketing capabilities round out the required skill set.
  
Qualifications
  
A recognized technical qualification in ICT or structured cabling is required, along with business\-standard written and verbal literacy and above\-average numeracy skills. A recognized qualification in project management is essential. Qualifications such as PRINCE II, CNIDP (Certified Network Infrastructure Design Professional), CDCDP (Certified Data Centre Design Professional), or CTPM (Certified Technology Project Manager) are highly valued.
  
Personal Attributes
  
Highly developed interpersonal and communication skills enable you to build excellent relationships and inspire confidence across all stakeholder groups. The ability to challenge the status quo with a high degree of integrity, combined with being highly motivated, self\-aware, and organized with exceptional attention to detail, defines success in this role. A results\-focused approach, innovative thinking, and the ability to handle high levels of information from diverse sources are essential. The ability to travel within the North America region where your presence and expertise are required onsite to meet project delivery commitments is required.
  
  

About JLL
  
Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL) is a leading professional services firm specializing in real estate and investment management. Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. JLL is seeking an accomplished Executive Director to lead and expand our Capital Markets Logistics \& Industrial practice in Singapore. This senior role requires a proven transaction leader with extensive experience originating, structuring, and executing capital markets transactions across logistics, industrial, and warehouse assets throughout Singapore and the APAC region. Manage transaction pipelines, forecast quarterly performance, and report results to senior leadership.
  
Ensure appropriate fee structuring and commercial terms on client mandates.
  
Control expenses and resource allocation to maintain profitability targets.
  
Qualifications \& Experience
  
  

**Required:**  

Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business, or related field; Master's degree or MBA preferred.
  
Minimum 12\-15 years of progressive experience in real estate capital markets, investment banking, institutional real estate, or private equity with demonstrated focus on transaction origination and execution.
  
Proven track record of closing significant capital markets transactions across logistics, industrial, or warehouse assets.
  
Established network of relationships with institutional investors, logistics operators, family offices, developers, and corporate clients in Singapore and APAC.
  
Deep understanding of Singapore's logistics and industrial real estate fundamentals including supply\-demand dynamics, specification requirements, tenant profiles, and market cycles.
  
Strong leadership experience building and managing high\-performing teams.
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional Asian languages advantageous.
  
  

**Preferred:**  

Experience working for a leading international real estate advisory firm, investment bank, or institutional investor.
  
Knowledge of cross\-border investment structuring, tax considerations, and international capital flows.
  
Established relationships with sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurance companies, and global real estate investors active in APAC logistics markets.
  
Experience with build\-to\-suit transactions, large\-scale logistics portfolios, sale\-leaseback structures, or development sites for logistics/industrial use.
  
Core Competencies
  
Strategic \& Commercial Acumen
  
Exceptional business judgment with ability to identify opportunities, assess risks, and structure complex transactions.
  
Strong financial and analytical capabilities including valuation, investment analysis, and return modeling.
  
Understanding of capital markets dynamics, investor motivations, and competitive positioning strategies.
  
Commercial negotiation skills with ability to achieve optimal outcomes for clients while maintaining relationships.
  
Leadership \& Interpersonal Skills
  
Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and develop talent at various career stages.
  
Executive presence and credibility to engage with C\-suite executives and institutional decision\-makers.
  
Collaborative leadership style that builds consensus across internal teams and external stakeholders.
  
Strong emotional intelligence, cultural sensitivity, and ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics.
  
Client Service Excellence
  
Client\-centric mindset with commitment to delivering exceptional advisory and execution services.
  
Ability to understand client objectives, anticipate needs, and provide proactive solutions.
  
Strong project management capabilities to handle multiple transactions simultaneously.
  
Reputation for integrity, professionalism, and discretion in handling confidential matters.
  
Technical Expertise
  
Advanced knowledge of transaction structuring, legal documentation, financing arrangements, and closing mechanics.
  
Expertise in logistics and industrial real estate including building specifications, operational considerations, tenant requirements, clear heights, loading facilities, and modern logistics infrastructure.
  
Understanding of emerging trends such as automated warehousing, cold chain logistics, e\-commerce fulfillment centers, last\-mile distribution hubs, and modern ramp\-up facilities.
  
Proficiency in financial modeling, market analysis, and investment underwriting.
  
Personal Attributes
  
Entrepreneurial mindset with strong drive to build business and achieve results.

Strong work ethic with ability to perform under pressure and meet demanding deadlines.

What JLL Offers

Access to JLL's extensive client relationships, research capabilities, and integrated service offerings.
