title: Global Banking and Markets - Operations, Prime Brokerage, Executive Director, Singapore
description:
**OPERATIONS**


Operations is a dynamic, multi\-faceted division that partners with all areas of the firm to deliver banking, sales and trading and asset management capabilities to clients around the world. Alongside this vital service delivery role, Operations provides essential risk management and control, preserving and enhancing the firm's assets and its reputation.


Operations spans all product lines and markets, serving as internal business partners who develop the processes and controls, and help to specify the systems that deliver accuracy, timeliness and integrity to our business.


The Prime Brokerage (PB) Operations team operates in a dynamic environment where you will be required to lead and prioritise across multiple workstreams in order to support a fast\-paced business environment.


**PRIME BROKERAGE**


Prime Brokerage (PB) within Global Markets provides a suite of services to hedge funds and other professional investors. Middle office initiatives are focused on increasing STP to drive scale across the Securities business, with an emphasis on high STP rates and quick query resolution to provide a seamless client experience. This is to be achieved in part by a multi\-year system and flow convergence programme, as well as consolidating functions across Operations to form a broader Equity middle office.


**Responsibilities**


* Review, approve and provide oversight of cash transactions including payments \& journals, with accountability for escalation and control frameworks
* Lead resolution of complex cash queries from internal stakeholders and external clients, ensuring timely and accurate outcomes
* Maintain deep understanding of internal and external regulations, and drive adherence across the team
* Analyse and resolve exceptions in a timely manner, implementing root cause fixes to reduce recurrence
* Evaluate, escalate and own risk items in partnership with management and the business
* Drive continuous improvement of process efficiencies \& controls, including sponsoring automation and re\-engineering initiatives
* Maintain and develop senior relationships with multiple internal teams, including treasury, account management and risk management functions
* Lead regional coordination with global counterparts to ensure follow\-the\-sun / pass\-the\-book coverage is maintained and optimised

As Policy Manager, Interactions, you will drive the day\-to\-day execution of safety standards across our highest\-engagement communication surfaces: Comments and Direct Messaging (DMs). Reporting to the Global Head of Policy – Interactions, you will operate as an individual contributor with cross\-workflow scope, translating strategic direction into disciplined, on\-time delivery.
  
You will be a trusted operator, program lead, and policy subject matter expert, driving priority work\-streams from concept through implementation and ensuring that safety standards are consistently applied across both Comments and DMs. You will bridge policy intent and technical execution, working closely with Product and Engineering partners to convert policy standards into actionable requirements for AI\-first moderation.
  
This is a product policy and program management role, not a purely compliance function. You will bring the rigor and structure of a strong program manager together with deep Trust \& Safety policy expertise, ensuring the pillar's roadmap is delivered with precision and that policy intent is preserved as it moves through models, tooling, and human moderation workflows.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
* Program Management \& Delivery: Run the end\-to\-end prioritization, intake, and delivery cadence for Interactions work\-streams across Comments and DMs. Translate a broad set of requests from Product, Legal, Ops, and regional partners into a clear plan with owners, milestones, and dependencies. * Policy Ownership: Own priority policy projects across Comments and DMs from problem framing through drafting, review, enforcement design, and launch. Make defensible calls independently on ambiguous cases, document the reasoning, and align regional and functional stakeholders. Support regulatory and compliance execution (e.g., UK OSA and EU DSA) by turning legal requirements into concrete policy language and enforcement changes.
* Product \& AI Integration: Partner with Product, Engineering, and AI/ML to translate policy intent into technical, model, and tooling requirements. Contribute to labelling guidelines, calibration reviews, and prompt/AI governance for LLM\-based moderation. Represent policy in product reviews and technical design discussions so that safety considerations are built in rather than bolted on.
* Metrics \& Feedback Loops: Build and maintain the measurement layer for Interactions policy, including coverage, precision and recall signals, appeals, and user\-impact indicators. Run root cause analysis on enforcement gaps and quality issues, and close the loop back into policy updates, model iteration, and tooling improvements so that learnings are systematically captured.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Act as the go\-to policy partner for Product, Engineering, AI/ML, Legal, and Ops across regions. Bridge the Comments and DMs workflows through knowledge sharing, cross\-training, and consistent operating standards.

Month\-end close. Full ownership across our entities. Journals, accruals, reconciliations, intercompany, and a close calendar people actually hit.


Statutory reporting and audit. Preparing the statutory accounts, running the audit process with our auditors, and being the person who knows where every number came from.


Consolidation. Group consolidation across three jurisdictions, including FX translation.


Transactional finance. AR, AP, billing and collections. Invoicing currently runs manually out of one person's inbox. You'll own it and you'll automate it.


Tax and compliance. Singapore GST returns, corporate tax coordination, and supporting the Head of Finance as required..


Systems implementation. You'll be hands\-on in selecting and rolling out an accounting system and integrating it with billing and CRM. This is a build, not a maintenance job.


Controls and process. Documenting what we do, putting proper controls in place, and closing the gaps that come with having grown fast on manual processes.


Payroll coordination. Working with the People Function on payroll accounting across our entities.

Qualified accountant. CA Singapore, ACCA, CPA or equivalent.


Around 8 to 12 years of progressive finance experience, including full\-set accounting and management reporting; startup, fintech, or high\-growth environment


Demonstrated experience managing outsourced accounting/payroll vendors and holding them to deliverables


Working knowledge of Singapore tax and statutory requirements; exposure to India compliance (GST, TDS, ROC, statutory audit) highly advantageous


Statutory accounts preparation and audit management.


Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with cloud accounting platforms (e.g. Xero, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zoho)


Multi\-entity consolidation.


Comfortable as a sole finance operator: pragmatic, detail\-oriented, able to prioritise across two jurisdictions with limited supervision


Strong communication skills; able to translate finance matters for non\-finance stakeholders and senior leadership

As SLNG’s primary commercial interface with MOL, the role leads cross\-functional alignment on relevant workstreams with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Marine, Engineering, HSSE, Legal, Finance, Throughput Scheduling, Portfolio Management and Analytics, as well as external agencies such as the Energy Market Authority of Singapore (EMA) and other relevant government bodies to ensure successful delivery and commercial operations of Singapore's Second LNG Terminal.

  


**Key Responsibilities – Pre\-Delivery of FSRU**


**1\. Lead and develop the Commercial Contract Management team responsible for establishing and governing the commercial administration framework for the Time Charter Party throughout its lifecycle.**

  


* Ensure commercial readiness prior to FSRU delivery and commencement of operations.
* Lead implementation of relevant commercial aspects of the TCP following contract execution.

\+ Charter hire administration, Off\-hire management, Performance monitoring, Contractual notices, Change management, Claims administration, Commercial reporting and Document control.

  


* Develop commercial Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) supporting charter management.
* Develop communications and interfacing procedures for the integrated commercial operations of the FSRU and existing land\-based terminal (S1T)
* Support Throughput analytics team to develop the optimisation efforts between S1T and FSRU, and provide guidance on FSRU operational considerations.

  


**2\. Coordinate and Oversee Development of Commercial Interface with MOL**

  


* Act as SLNG's commercial focal point for all TCP matters. Build and maintain a collaborative long\-term partnership with MOL. Coordinate contractual implementation activities between both organisations.
* Lead commercial activities relating to mobilisation, commissioning and acceptance testing, and commencement of charter. Ensure alignment between project schedules and contractual milestones.
* Manage contractual communications and notices. Coordinate periodic management meetings and commercial governance forums with key stakeholders.

  


**Key Responsibilities – Post\-Delivery of FSRU**


**1\. Support Reliable Terminal Operations**



Drive cross\-functional alignment with Terminal Operations and Marine teams to ensure:

  


* FSRU availability; Safe regasification operations; Efficient LNG storage management; Optimise send\-out capability; Effective planned maintenance activities and accurate determination of Annual Delivery Plans; Minimal operational interruptions; Robust business continuity planning.

  



Ensure commercial implications arising from operational events are appropriately managed under the TCP.

  


**2\. LNG Scheduling \& Throughput Portfolio Optimisation Coordination**



Lead and oversee SLNG Throughput Commercial teams to:


* Ensure reliable regasification services; Ensure commercial obligations align with terminal operating requirements; Assess contractual impacts arising from changes in cargo schedules or terminal utilisation; Coordinate commercial support for planned outages and maintenance windows; Minimise commercial exposure arising from operational disruptions; Co\-optimise integrated commercial operations of FSRU and S1T.

  


**3\. FSRU Performance Monitoring and Management**



Develop and operationalise a comprehensive performance management framework covering:

  


* Vessel availability; Regasification availability; Reliability metrics; Operational KPIs; Service level compliance; Charter performance; Contractual obligations; Regulatory compliance; Continuous improvement initiatives.

  



Lead regular performance review meetings with MOL and internal stakeholders.

  


**4\. Financial \& Commercial Management**



Lead the development and implementation of a comprehensive financial and commercial management framework in collaboration with Finance and Risk teams:


* Oversee charter hire administration, including invoice certification, off\-hire validation and contractual adjustments; Lead annual budget planning, expenditure forecasting and long\-term financial projections relating to the TCP; Monitor commercial risks, financial exposure and cost performance; Support negotiations relating to contractual amendments and commercial settlements.

  


**5\. Claim \& Risk Management**

Drive cross\-functional alignment with SLNG Legal, Finance and Risk teams to develop and operationalise a comprehensive TCP claim and risk management framework covering:


* Commercial management of contractual claims; Coordinate investigations into charter\-related disputes; Negotiate commercial settlements where appropriate; Maintain comprehensive contractual records; Develop mitigation strategies for contractual and commercial risks; Support dispute avoidance through proactive stakeholder engagement.

  


**6\. Governance \& Regulatory Compliance**

Coordinate and oversee SLNG Legal and Risk teams to develop and operationalise a comprehensive governance and regulatory management framework to:


* Ensure compliance with the TCP; Ensure contractual obligations are fulfilled within agreed timelines; Maintain contract governance processes; Support internal and external audits; Ensure compliance with SLNG policies and applicable maritime regulations and ensure regulatory compliance with EMA, MOM, MPA and other relevant parties.

  


**7\. Continuous Improvement**

Drive cross\-functional alignment with relevant teams in SLNG to:


* Identify opportunities to improve charter administration processes; Benchmark industry best practices in LNG shipping and FSRU operations; Recommend contractual and operational improvements; Support future terminal expansion and optimisation initiatives.

  


**8\. Relationship Management**

* Front and maintain effective commercial relationship with MOL; Conduct regular performance review meetings; Lead commercial discussions relating to operational issues; Support continuous improvement initiatives.

  


**9\. Management Reporting**

* Prepare management reports covering:



\+ Charter performance; Commercial risks; Contract compliance; Budget performance; KPI achievement; Claims status.

  


**Summary of Key Deliverables**

  




**Pre FSRU Delivery:**


* Successful commercial operationalisation of the TCP.


* Track and close out post\-execution TCP matters, including any variation orders or TCP provisions.


* Commercial readiness for commencement of charter.


* Establish governance and administration framework.


* Complete commercial procedures and SOPs.


* Fully implement contract management system.

  


**Post FSRU Delivery:**

* Effective commercial administration of the TCP, consistent with the co\-optimisation of integrated operations of FSRU and S1T.


* Accurate charter payment administration.


* Timely management of contractual claims and notices.


* Achievement of contractual performance objectives.


* Strong commercial relationship with MOL.

  


**Stakeholder Management**


* Incumbent is expected to lead and drive cross\-functional alignments of relevant deliverables with SLNG internal and external stakeholders:



\+ EMA/MTI, S2T Project Development Team, Marine Operations, Terminal Operations, Legal, Finance, MOL commercial and operational teams.

  


**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Maritime Studies, Business, Law, Supply Chain or a related discipline.


* A postgraduate qualification (MBA, Master's degree or equivalent) will be advantageous.


* Professional certifications in commercial contract management, maritime law or project management are desirable.

  


**Experience**


* Minimum 8 years' relevant experience in LNG, shipping, offshore or maritime commercial operations.


* Demonstrated experience managing Time Charter Parties or long\-term maritime service agreements.


* Experience with FSRUs, LNG carriers, LNG terminals or offshore energy projects is highly desirable.

customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As an Amazon Field Engineer, you will provide full life\-cycle support to AWS Data Centers from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. * Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers in your region.
* Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.

You will operate with high autonomy owning engineering reviews, bar\-raising initiatives, and root cause analyses for infrastructure products. description:
**Ready to make your next big professional move? Join us on our journey to achieve our big dream of building the most loved restaurant brands in the world.**

Restaurant Brands International Inc. is one of the world's largest quick service restaurant companies with nearly $45 billion in annual system\-wide sales and over 32,000 restaurants in more than 120 countries and territories.


RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.


RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

**Our opportunity**


The Senior Manager, Field Sales is the primary partner to franchisee CMOs, and the engine behind sales growth, brand relevance, and marketing execution across APAC.


Owning the commercial agenda in their markets: the marketing calendar, the innovation pipeline, the promotional mechanics, and the brand positioning that drives long\-term guest love and transaction growth. They operate with the mindset of a Chief Marketing Officer for a smaller territory — going deeper into the market's sales dynamics and competitive landscape than any other team member, and converting that insight into plans that actually move the needle.


Working in close partnership with AFLs, functional marketing specialists, and franchisee teams, the Field Sales Senior Manager builds the plans, secures the alignment, and drives the execution that turns Burger King into a brand guests choose first.

 **RBI follows a 5 day, in\-office work schedule to support collaboration. Candidates should be comfortable working onsite 5 days per week.**

**Your roles \& responsibilities**

**1\. Franchisee CMO Partnership \& Commercial Influence**


The primary commercial relationship with each franchisee CMO — building the credibility, trust, and influence needed to shape how franchisees invest, plan, and execute their marketing agenda.

* Serve as the primary RBI partner to franchisee CMOs and marketing leads, building relationships grounded in insight, commercial credibility, and genuine value\-add.
* Influence franchisee adoption of brand, pricing, promotional, and innovation strategies — translating global and regional direction into locally executable plans.
* Secure alignment on marketing plans, budget allocation, and Ad Fund investment priorities — ensuring resources are deployed behind the right initiatives at the right time.
* Navigate competing franchisee priorities with confidence, finding alignment that serves both the brand and the business.
* Establish the cadence, agenda, and discipline of the commercial relationship — structured business reviews, clear accountability, and fast course\-correction when plans go off track.
**2\. Sales Performance Analysis \& Diagnosis**


Own the commercial analytics for each market — understanding performance deeply enough to anticipate issues before they surface, diagnose root causes with precision, and build business cases that secure franchisee action.

* Analyze same\-store sales, traffic, product mix, promotional performance, and channel dynamics with rigor and regularity.
* Build and maintain accurate sales models — pre/post analysis, seasonal adjustments, and delivery channel contribution — and take full accountability for data quality.
* Identify root causes of underperformance using structured problem\-solving (5\-Why analysis, root cause mapping) and develop clear, time\-bound action plans.
* Track the competitive and pricing landscape in each market — understanding how Burger King is positioned relative to key competitors on value, quality, and brand perception.
* Build forward\-looking views of sales performance, proactively surfacing risks and opportunities before they become issues.
**3\. Brand Positioning \& Market Competitiveness**


Build a brand that earns guest love in each market — grounded in local consumer insight, competitive clarity, and globally consistent positioning.

* Champion Burger King's brand positioning in each market — ensuring messaging, creative, and media investment are aligned to a clear, locally resonant brand story.
* Monitor brand health metrics (awareness, consideration, love scores, key equity attributes) and diagnose structural issues in the brand's competitive position.
* Ensure all consumer\-facing communications — in\-restaurant, digital, delivery platforms, and media — meet brand standards and reflect the brand's strategic direction.
* Lead or commission consumer and market research that generates actionable insight — from campaign concept testing to U\&A studies and competitive benchmarking.
* Stay close to consumer trends, cultural moments, and competitive moves that could affect the brand's relevance and market share.
**4\. Calendar Management, Innovation \& Promotional Execution**


Own the marketing calendar end\-to\-end — ensuring every initiative is guest\-tested, operationally feasible, well\-funded, and executed with discipline.

* Build and manage a sharp, well\-sequenced annual marketing calendar — balancing core equity work, seasonal promotions, LTO innovation, and value mechanics.
* Lead or coordinate the innovation process for market\-specific new product development and ensure regional innovation projects progress with the right pace and rigor — including concept testing, CLT, and operational feasibility.
* Ensure promotional mechanics are sound — well\-tested consumer propositions with clear pricing strategy, sufficient media weight, and in\-restaurant execution plans.
* Partner cross\-functionally with Analytics, Brand \& Innovation, Digital, and Field Operations to ensure full alignment before activations go live.
* Track and report on calendar initiative performance in a structured, consistent way — using results to sharpen future planning and build a library of what works.
**5\. Digital, Delivery \& Channel Growth**


Accelerate Burger King's digital and delivery performance as key structural drivers of sales growth and guest engagement across the portfolio.

* Drive digital adoption, app engagement, and loyalty program penetration as long\-term levers for sustainable sales growth.
* Optimize the delivery channel — platform presence, menu architecture, pricing strategy, and promotional mechanics — to maximize contribution and profitability.
* Ensure strong digital brand presence across owned and paid channels: app, social, search, and third\-party delivery platforms.
* Identify and pursue channel\-specific growth opportunities — including drive\-thru conversion, kiosk adoption, and contactable sales growth — in partnership with the Field Operations team.
**Your skills \& experience**

* At least 7 years of experience in commercial, brand, or marketing roles in QSR, FMCG, retail, or food and beverage — with a consistent focus on driving sustainable sales growth.
* Proven track record of influencing franchisee or partner organizations to adopt and execute commercial recommendations.
* Strong analytical capability — comfortable building sales models, conducting pre/post analysis, and translating data into clear commercial narratives.
* Deep understanding of the APAC consumer landscape — category dynamics, competitive structure, media environment, and consumer behaviour.
* Fluency across the marketing mix: innovation, communication, promotions, pricing, media, and digital channels.
* Structured problem\-solver with strong PMO discipline — able to manage a complex, multi\-market calendar with rigor and pace.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills — able to influence internally and externally, build trust with senior franchisee leadership, and present with clarity and conviction.
* At least a bachelor's degree in business, marketing, management or similar.
* Comfortable traveling across the APAC region up to 40%.

title: Senior Category Manager, Logistics - APAC
description:
The **Senior Category Manager, Logistics \- APAC** is a senior strategic logistics procurement leadership role with accountability for end\-to\-end logistics category strategy, sourcing, supplier management, and value delivery across the Asia Pacific region.  

  



Based in **Singapore** or **Sydney** , this role owns the development and execution of multi\-year logistics category strategies covering container freight, ocean freight forwarding, airfreight, express and parcel, regional road and domestic transportation, warehousing, customs brokerage, trade\-related services, and strategic 3PL/4PL partnerships.  

  



The role is designed for top\-tier global procurement talent with deep APAC logistics, Global Ocean and Airfreight and supply chain expertise, a proven track record in category management and high\-value negotiations, and the ability to operate credibly at executive level across a complex, matrixed organization. Container freight and airfreight are critical focus areas, given APAC trade lane complexity, market volatility, capacity dynamics, and the need to balance cost, service, resilience, and compliance.  

  



This position plays a critical role in enabling business growth, margin improvement, service excellence, supply chain resilience, and sustainability across APAC while contributing directly to ResMed's Next Generation Supply Chain transformation.  

  



**Let's Talk About Responsibilities**
-------------------------------------

* **End\-to\-End Category Ownership:** Own the end\-to\-end APAC logistics category strategy with full accountability for regional logistics spend, supplier strategy, sourcing roadmap, and annual value delivery. Translate global logistics category strategies into APAC\-executable commercial models while actively shaping global strategy through APAC market intelligence, performance data, risk insights, and supplier innovation.
* **Container Freight, Airfreight and International Transportation Strategy:** Lead the global category strategy for containerized ocean freight and airfreight, including FCL, LCL, freight forwarding, NVOCC and carrier models, consolidations, import/export lanes, express and critical shipment solutions, and mode optimization between air, ocean, parcel, and ground transportation. Build robust lane\-level commercial strategies covering rate structures, capacity commitments, peak season planning, spot versus long\-term contracting, and service differentiation.
* **Strategic Sourcing and Commercial Governance:** Design and govern high\-value RFI, RFP, RFQ, and negotiation processes for global and regional logistics providers, including freight forwarders, ocean carriers, integrators, customs brokers, warehouse operators, and 3PL/4PL partners. Use total cost of ownership, should\-cost analysis, freight benchmarking, demand modelling, and market intelligence to deliver competitive and sustainable commercial outcomes.
* **Negotiation and Contracting Leadership:** Establish strong commercial frameworks including rate cards, indexation mechanisms, fuel and accessorial governance, airfreight surcharge structures, demurrage and detention controls, service credits, liability and claims provisions, minimum volume or capacity commitments, performance\-based agreements, and risk\-sharing models aligned to market dynamics and business needs.
* **Supplier Relationship Management and Risk Leadership:** Own the strategic supplier portfolio for APAC logistics, including segmentation, partnership models, executive business reviews, performance management, corrective action plans, and innovation pipelines. Lead supplier governance forums with credibility and commercial authority, creating clear expectations on service, cost, resilience, quality, compliance, working capital, and sustainability.
* **Resilience, Compliance and Trade Risk Management:** Identify, assess, and mitigate logistics\-related risks across APAC, including capacity constraints, port and airport disruption, geopolitical exposure, customs and trade compliance, regulatory changes, carrier financial health, labor constraints, climate events, cybersecurity exposure, and business continuity. Develop alternative lanes, escalation paths, and contingency sourcing models to protect service and supply continuity.
* **Business Partnership and Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Partner closely with regional and global Distribution, Logistics, Trade Compliance, Quality, Planning, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Procurement teams to ensure sourcing decisions support network design, inventory strategy, customer service requirements, regulatory compliance, and cost\-to\-serve objectives. Act as a trusted commercial advisor to senior operations and supply chain leaders, translating logistics complexity into clear, fact\-based business decisions.
* **Digital Procurement, Analytics and Transformation:** Support procurement and supply chain transformation through adoption of e\-sourcing platforms, TMS, freight benchmarking tools, spend analytics, contract repositories, supplier scorecards, and performance dashboards. Use data to improve visibility, decision quality, negotiation preparation, and ongoing supplier governance.
* **Sustainability and Continuous Improvement:** Integrate sustainability into APAC logistics category strategies, including emissions visibility, modal optimization, supplier sustainability commitments, packaging and consolidation opportunities, and lower\-carbon logistics alternatives where commercially and operationally viable.

This role directly influences the cost structure, service performance, resilience, and scalability of the APAC supply chain. Decisions made by the Senior Category Manager, Logistics \- APAC shape logistics network economics, supplier partnerships, lane strategy, service reliability, and the company's ability to adapt and compete in volatile and regulated markets.  



  

Success in this role is measured by sustained value delivery, improved logistics service outcomes, stronger supplier performance, reduced risk exposure, improved commercial governance, and closer alignment between logistics sourcing strategies and business growth objectives.  



**Let's Talk About Qualifications and Experience**
--------------------------------------------------

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in supply chain, Logistics, Business, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* 10 to 15\+ years of progressive experience in logistics procurement, category management, strategic sourcing, freight procurement, or supply chain commercial leadership.
* Proven ownership of large, complex regional or global logistics spend, ideally across APAC and including container freight, airfreight, express/parcel, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, warehousing, domestic transportation, and 3PL/4PL services.
* Demonstrated track record in category management, including category strategy development, market analysis, spend analytics, supplier segmentation, sourcing pipeline management, supplier governance, and measurable value delivery.
* Proven success leading complex, high\-value negotiations with logistics providers, including freight forwarders, carriers, integrators, warehouse operators, customs brokers, and strategic 3PL partners.
* Strong commercial acumen with hands\-on experience in contract structuring, freight rate models, indexation, accessorial and surcharge governance, should\-cost analysis, total cost of ownership, service credits, claims, liability provisions, and performance\-based agreements.
* Strong understanding of APAC logistics market dynamics, international transportation lanes, Incoterms, customs and trade requirements, capacity cycles, and operational drivers of cost, service, and risk.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and executive levels, influencing senior stakeholders while balancing cost, service, resilience, quality, compliance, working capital, and sustainability.
* Experience working in global, matrixed organizations with strong cross\-regional and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Strong analytical capability and confidence using e\-sourcing platforms, TMS, freight benchmarking tools, Excel/Power BI or similar analytics, and supplier performance dashboards.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; ability to work across cultures, time zones, and APAC markets. Willingness to travel regionally and occasionally globally as required.

  

**Preferred**

* MBA, Master's degree, or equivalent professional procurement certification.
* Direct experience with global container freight and airfreight sourcing across major trade lanes, including Singapore, Australia, Southeast Asia, China, Trans\-Pacific, Europe and broader Asia Pacific markets.
* Experience in healthcare, medical technology, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other regulated supply chain environments.
* Exposure to customs brokerage, trade compliance, bonded warehousing, and cross\-border logistics requirements across APAC.
* Experience contributing to procurement or supply chain transformation initiatives, including digital tools, analytics, standardization, supplier governance, and sustainability programs.

**Leadership Expectations**
---------------------------

* **Accountability and Value Creation:** High accountability mindset with a clear bias for measurable outcomes, disciplined execution, and sustained value delivery.
* **Executive Communication:** Ability to distill complex logistics, freight market, and commercial topics into clear, actionable decisions for senior stakeholders.
* **Commercial Leadership:** Confident and credible negotiator who can challenge supplier positions, structure balanced agreements, and protect the business without damaging strategic partnerships.
* **Change Leadership:** Comfort operating in ambiguity, leading change, and challenging legacy logistics models to unlock structural improvement.
* **Collaboration with Edge:** Collaborative but firm leadership style, capable of engaging senior internal stakeholders and global logistics partners with credibility, curiosity, and authority.
* **Global Mindset:** Ability to work across cultures, functions, and regions while keeping APAC business needs aligned with global category direction.

**Location and Reporting Context**
----------------------------------

* This role is based in Singapore or Sydney, Australia, and operates as a member of the Global Logistics Procurement leadership community.
* The Senior Category Manager, Logistics \- APAC reports into the Director, Global Category Management \- Logistics and works in close partnership with regional and global category teams, logistics and distribution leadership, trade compliance, operations, finance, legal, quality, and supply chain executives across APAC.
* The role requires regional APAC engagement and occasional global collaboration outside standard local working hours, reflecting the global nature of logistics markets, supplier negotiations, and supply chain operations.

**Why ResMed?**
---------------

ResMed operates in a healthy, high\-growth business environment with significant supply chain transformation underway. This role offers the opportunity to shape and professionalize logistics procurement across APAC, strengthen strategic partnerships with global logistics providers, and directly influence the performance, resilience, and sustainability of a global healthcare supply chain.

Where a culture driven by excellence helps you not only meet your goals, but also create new ones. We focus on creating a diverse and inclusive culture, encouraging individual expression in the workplace and thrive on the innovative ideas this generates. If this sounds like the workplace for you, apply now! We commit to respond to every applicant.

Mentor and grow a high\-performing AI \& Data team, fostering innovation and capability development in emerging AI technologies.

Familiarity with orchestration tools like LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or crewAI is highly valued.

**AI Model Ops and Lifecycle Management:** Experience with full model lifecycle—training, monitoring, retraining, and scaling—using MLOps platforms such as MLflow, Azure ML, Vertex AI Pipelines, or AWS SageMaker Pipelines.
  
**Data Readiness \& Governance for AI:** Deep expertise in data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA, DCAM), metadata management, master data management (MDM), and data privacy/security best practices that ensure high\-quality, trustworthy data for AI use.

At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI\-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.


### **Available Location: Singapore**


### **About the Department**



The Technical Account Team plays a crucial role in ensuring a seamless experience for Cloudflare users, ranging from individual developers to Fortune 500 enterprises. By providing expert technical guidance, proactive support, and complex issue resolution across multiple channels, the team enhances customer satisfaction, strengthens customer trust, and drives product improvement.



At Cloudflare, Technical Account Managers serve as trusted advisors to our top Enterprise customers. TAMs deliver high\-touch technical guidance, customer advocacy, and operational support across the customer lifecycle. Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, TAMs capture valuable customer insights and work closely with internal teams to influence service enhancements and future product development.


### **What You'll Do**



As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the post\-sales technical support experience for Cloudflare's largest Enterprise customers . You will serve as the primary technical point of contact for assigned customers, helping them operate Cloudflare solutions successfully, resolve complex issues, and continuously improve the security, reliability, and performance of their environments.



You will act as an architectural governance partner, continuously mapping customer environments against industry best practices and Cloudflare's Well\-Architected framework. By proactively identifying security gaps, single points of failure, configuration drift, and performance bottlenecks, you will help prevent incidents before they impact production.



Working closely with Customer Success, Account Teams, Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Partners, and Customer Support, you will align technical solutions with customer roadmaps and business objectives. This role requires a strong mix of technical expertise, customer service excellence, executive communication, and strategic problem\-solving to ensure high customer satisfaction, retention, and long\-term success.



For TAMs specializing in Network Services, you will focus on optimizing customer Cloudflare configurations and ensuring the reliability, performance, and security of their network infrastructure.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Serve as the primary technical support and escalation contact for assigned Enterprise customers.
* Build trusted technical relationships with customer stakeholders, including technical teams, operational leaders, and senior executives.
* Collaborate with global Product, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Account Teams, Professional Services, and Partners.
* Own and drive the post\-sales technical support experience, ensuring timely, high\-quality support outcomes.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues across Cloudflare products and customer environments.
* Manage support interactions, drive escalations, coordinate internal response, and ensure clear customer communication during incidents.
* Provide clear written and verbal updates, including technical recommendations, incident summaries, escalation updates, RCA follow\-ups, and post\-incident reports.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of customer environments, architectures, and Cloudflare deployments to support proactive issue resolution and long\-term optimization.
* Develop and maintain a rolling Technical Risk \& Gap Register for each enterprise account, tracking architectural drift, legacy configurations, operational risks, and emerging security threats.
* Prioritize remediation plans with customer stakeholders and help customers align their environments with security, reliability, and performance best practices.
* Conduct Quarterly Support Reviews, including SLA adherence, incident reviews, ticket trend analysis, top support drivers, resilience planning, capacity planning, and proactive feature adoption.
* Partner with the account team to support strategic customer engagements, including technical planning, roadmap alignment, renewal support, and incident response.
* Provide actionable customer feedback to Product and Engineering teams to help shape product improvements.
* Partner with Cloudflare's Threat Intelligence and Product teams to proactively evaluate customer environments against newly discovered vulnerabilities, zero\-days, and emerging DDoS vectors.
* Ensure defensive configurations and recommended mitigations are deployed ahead of potential exploits where appropriate.
* Establish continuous drift\-detection workflows to ensure customer configurations do not deviate from established security baselines, compliance standards, or optimal performance thresholds.
* Leverage AI\-driven tools and workflows to optimize daily operations, including incident summarization, case prioritization, support trend analysis, and automated handover documentation.
* Utilize AI\-powered analytics to conduct proactive configuration health checks and architectural reviews, identifying systemic risks and strategic infrastructure optimization opportunities.
* Streamline the creation of technical documentation, including HLDs, LLDs, technical recommendations, customer\-facing summaries, and post\-incident reports.
* Deploy AI\-assisted incident management workflows to improve communication precision, including impact assessment, automated status updates, and rapid synthesis of complex technical event details.
* Act as a point of escalation during business hours and provide backup support for global TAMs in other time zones when required.
* Work one weekend per month as part of the TAM coverage model.
* Travel up to 25% of the time to support customer engagements.

### **What We're Looking For**



We are seeking a highly motivated, customer\-focused technical expert who can combine deep technical knowledge with strong customer advocacy, communication, and business judgment.


### **Technical Expertise**


* Strong understanding of networking concepts, including Layer 7 technologies and routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, IPSec, and GRE.
* Experience with security technologies, including Firewalls, IPS, DDoS mitigation, WAF, and application security controls.
* Experience with cloud, SaaS, CDN, edge networking, or security platforms.
* Knowledge of system integration, multi\-vendor environments, and data center deployments.
* Proficiency with diagnostic and troubleshooting tools, including traceroute, Wireshark, dig, cURL, logs, packet captures, and browser developer tools.
* Familiarity with the OSI Model, proxies, HTTP, DNS, TLS/SSL, application security, and network security.
* Ability to analyze complex technical issues, identify root causes, and provide practical remediation guidance.
* Passion for Cloudflare's products and a strong desire to help customers succeed.

### **Customer \& Business Acumen**


* Minimum 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing technical support, technical account management, solutions engineering, customer success engineering, or account management role.
* Proven ability to work with Enterprise and Fortune 500 customers.
* Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong customer\-facing written communication skills, including the ability to produce incident summaries, technical recommendations, executive updates, and post\-incident follow\-ups.
* Ability to manage multiple customer priorities, escalations, and internal workstreams at the same time.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast\-moving environment.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong ownership mindset, customer empathy, and commitment to delivering high\-quality outcomes.

### **Why This Role Matters**



This role is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of Cloudflare's Enterprise customer experience. As a Technical Account Manager, you will help some of the region's most important businesses improve their network performance, security posture, resilience, and operational maturity while directly influencing the future of Cloudflare's products and services.

**What Makes Cloudflare Special?**



We're not just a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large\-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.


**Project Galileo**: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers\-at no cost.


**Athenian Project**: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.


**1\.1\.1\.1**: We released 1\.1\.1\.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy\-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use \- it is the first consumer\-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal \- we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.



Sound like something you'd like to be a part of? We'd love to hear from you!

description:
**About Mixpanel**



Mixpanel turns data clarity into innovation. Mixpanel delivers insights that customers trust. Visit mixpanel.com to learn more.

**About the Team**
------------------



The Partnerships team at Mixpanel is responsible for acquiring, activating, and growing a global ecosystem of Certified, Sales, Reseller, Agency, Consulting, System Integrator, and Technology Partners.



We help extend Mixpanel's reach by building partner motions that create new pipeline, accelerate deal cycles, improve customer outcomes, and allow Mixpanel's go\-to\-market teams to scale more effectively. Our goal is to make Mixpanel the go\-to product intelligence platform for partners and customers across APAC and globally.



This is a highly cross\-functional team that works closely with Sales, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Professional Services, Enablement, Deal Desk, and regional leadership to turn partner relationships into measurable business impact.


**About the Role**
------------------



Mixpanel is in a stage of high growth, and partnerships are a critical lever in how we multiply pipeline, expand regional coverage, and scale revenue across APAC. This is not a passive partner management role — it is a commercial, builder's position at the centre of that motion.



As Partner Sales Manager, SEA and India, you will report directly to the Senior Manager, Channel \& Alliances, APAC, and will own and grow our Solution Partner and Channel ecosystem across South East Asia and India. You will be responsible for recruiting the right organisations, enabling their teams, driving account alignment, creating joint go\-to\-market plans, and generating partner\-sourced and partner\-influenced pipeline.



You will work closely with regional Account Executives and Sales leadership to embed partners into target account planning, source new opportunities, support active sales cycles, and accelerate deals through trusted partner relationships. You will bring a deep understanding of the ANZ partner landscape and how to generate pipeline through local resellers, agencies, consultancies, and systems integrators.



You will be accountable for building a regional partner business plan with clear targets, partner coverage, pipeline goals, activation milestones, and forecasted revenue contribution. Success in this role will be measured by the quality and quantity of partner\-sourced pipeline, partner\-influenced revenue, active co\-selling motions, and the strength of the partner ecosystem across South East Asia and India.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Own and grow a defined portfolio of Solution, Channel, and Reseller partners across SEA and India, with a clear focus on generating partner\-sourced pipeline, partner\-influenced pipeline, and resell revenue
* Define Mixpanel's Ideal Partner Profile for the SEA and Indian markets and lead structured outreach to recruit against it — including Regional System Integrators, Digital Agencies, Product Development Agencies, Consultancies, and specialist analytics partners
* Build partner\-specific business plans that define target accounts, revenue goals, pipeline targets, sales plays, marketing activity, enablement needs, executive relationships, and quarterly milestones
* Develop joint GTM plans with partners — including shared value propositions, co\-sell motions, investment commitments, and defined outcomes
* Negotiate partnership agreements including terms, co\-sell commitments, and revenue expectations
* Create repeatable partner motions that multiply Mixpanel's reach, including account mapping, referral generation, co\-selling, reseller motions, services\-led opportunities, regional campaigns, and event\-based demand generation
* Work directly with Account Executives and Sales leaders to align partners to priority accounts and ensure partner involvement is captured correctly in Salesforce and PartnerStack
* Enable partner sales, consulting, and technical teams so they can confidently identify Mixpanel opportunities, position the platform, and support early\-stage sales conversations
* Develop and maintain partner enablement materials including sales playbooks, co\-branded collateral, and onboarding resources
* Partner with Marketing to plan and execute campaigns, webinars, roundtables, executive dinners, customer events, and MDF\-funded activities that create measurable pipeline
* Own the day\-to\-day management of Mixpanel's PRM system, ensuring partner communications, deal registrations, onboarding workflows, and programme content are accurate and consistently managed
* Maintain accurate reporting on partner pipeline, forecasted revenue, partner activity, account mapping, campaign performance, and quarterly progress against plan
* Evangelise Mixpanel at industry events, partner summits, and customer briefings across ANZ
* Champion the partner value proposition internally across Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering
* Act as a commercial operator — not just a relationship manager — by constantly looking for ways to turn partner relationships into measurable growth for Mixpanel

**We're Looking For Someone Who Has**
-------------------------------------


* 7\+ years of experience in a high\-growth SaaS environment, with 3\+ years building Agency, Consulting, or Channel Partner GTM motions
* Direct experience building, managing, or scaling partner relationships across the Southeast Asian and Indian markets, with a strong understanding of the local partner landscape and how to generate pipeline through resellers, agencies, consultancies, and systems integrators
* Demonstrated track record of driving partner\-sourced pipeline and running effective co\-sell programmes
* Strong commercial instincts and a clear understanding of pipeline creation, opportunity progression, forecasting, partner\-sourced revenue, and deal acceleration
* Experience structuring and negotiating partnership agreements, including terms, co\-sell commitments, and commercial incentives
* Familiarity with partner tiering, incentive design, and programme frameworks
* The ability to translate partner relationships into practical sales activity — account mapping, joint prospecting, opportunity qualification, co\-selling, and executive alignment
* Confidence working cross\-functionally with Account Executives, Sales Managers, Solutions Engineers, Marketing, Customer Success, and senior stakeholders
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value and craft compelling joint value propositions
* An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to build structure, create momentum, and operate effectively in a fast\-moving environment
* A data\-driven approach to managing partner performance, with the ability to track activity, inspect pipeline, identify gaps, and take action quickly
* Proficiency with partner and revenue tooling (Salesforce, Clari, Crossbeam, PartnerStack or equivalent)
* Active use of AI tools to work smarter — this isn't optional, it's how we operate
* A genuine interest in product intelligence, customer data, digital products, and how companies use behavioural insights to build better customer experiences

**Bonus Points For**
--------------------


* Experience working with the SEA technology ecosystem, including local SIs, digital consultancies, and cloud service providers
* Familiarity with broader APAC markets beyond SEA (e.g., ANZ, Japan, Korea)
* Speaking multiple languages relevant to the APAC region
* Background in analytics, data, martech, or developer tools partner ecosystems
* Experience working in high\-growth environments (Series B–E or beyond)


\#PC\-LI

 **Benefits and Perks**

  

* Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
* Mental Wellness Benefit
* Generous Vacation Policy \& Additional Company Holidays
* Enhanced Parental Leave
* Volunteer Time Off
* Additional US Benefits: Pre\-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break


*\*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary\**


**Culture Values**


* **Make Bold Bets:** We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
* **Innovate with Insight:** We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment \- combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
* **One Team:** We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
* **Candor with Connection:** We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
* **Champion the Customer:** We seek to deeply understand our customers' needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
* **Powerful Simplicity:** We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.


**Why choose Mixpanel?**



We're a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M raised from prominent investors: like Andreessen\-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel's pioneering event\-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever\-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you'll be helping the world's most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.



Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ\+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. description:

 Contract
**Job Purpose**


The **Accountant** plays a key role in supporting Haworth's finance function by delivering timely, accurate, and relevant financial information to business leaders. This role contributes to informed decision\-making, financial compliance, and the overall performance of the business through effective financial reporting, analysis, and control.

  

  

  

**A glimpse of your daily mission**


General Accounting and Reporting


* Support the monthly financial closing process and ensure timely completion of month\-end reporting.
* Perform balance sheet reconciliations and resolve outstanding items.
* Coordinate intercompany settlements and vendor payments.
* Review and submit quarterly GST F5 returns and monthly withholding tax filing in compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Distribute the monthly sales commission statements to sales team members based on calculations prepared by the Shared Service Centre (SSC).

Financial Reporting and Analysis


* Assist in the review and analysis of SG\&A expenses and prepare variance and bridge analysis.
* Prepare prototype cost listings and advise SSC on related journal entries.
* Prepare monthly cash flow reports.
* Monitor collections and manage working capital performance.
* Generate ad hoc financial reports and analyses using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools.

General


* Respond to routine finance\-related requests from internal and external stakeholders.
* Support internal and external auditors, tax agents, and regulatory reviews.
* Support documentation and approvals relating to contracts, purchase orders, bank guarantees, export documentation, and notarization services where required.
* Liaise with banks, customers, and business partners on matters relating to performance bonds and letters of credit.

  

  

**Job Requirements**


* Degree in Accountancy, Finance, or a related discipline; professional accounting qualifications (e.g., CA, ACCA, CPA) are advantageous.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant finance and accounting experience, preferably within a trading, manufacturing, or multinational environment.
* Fresh graduates with relevant internship experience are welcome to apply.
* Experience in handling banking\-related matters, including Letters of Credit (LCs) and Bank Guarantees (BGs), would be advantageous.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and financial reporting tools.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is advantageous.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with local, regional, and global teams.
* Able to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
* Able to commence employment within a mutually agreed timeframe.

  

  

**About Us**


Haworth is one of the world's largest manufacturers of office furniture, providing solutions for tomorrow's customers worldwide. At the centre of our work is the human being: What does a person need to work, what pushes them, motivates them and what makes people feel comfortable at work? Only if we can answer that question, we are able to introduce designs to our customers that will make them achieve their goals. To stay one step ahead, we invest in our own research, have a worldwide network of interesting partners and are part of think tanks around the world who are trying to think ahead. The family\-owned company, headquartered in Holland, Michigan/United States, employs more than 8,000 people and is represented in more than 150 countries in Asia, Europe and America with subsidiaries and partners.

title: ClickHouse Engineer
description:
**ClickHouse Engineer**
=======================

**Singapore (Office\-based) or Remote (UK\-based) \| Full\-Time**

**About Us**
------------


Reactive Markets is the **2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year** (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40\+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.


We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high\-performance systems.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a ClickHouse Engineer to share ownership of our data plant: a multi\-datacentre, multi\-AZ ClickHouse cluster ingesting billions of rows a day, underpinning compliance, billing, and a growing family of real\-time and historical analytics.


This is a core\-platform engineering role, not a DBA role. You'll work across the full engineering scope of a serious ClickHouse estate: cluster operations and upgrades, schema and sorting\-key design, materialised views, ingestion performance, query optimisation, workload isolation, capacity planning, storage tiering, backup and recovery, monitoring and alerting, and production support. You'll also work on the data pipelines around the plant — our capture services are Go, and our analytics foundation is Python.


You don't need years of ClickHouse specifically — deep experience with another columnar or large\-scale time\-series database qualifies you, and a strong columnar engineer learns our estate quickly. What we do need is genuine operational depth: you have run a production data platform, owned its capacity plan and its recovery procedures, and stayed calm when it mattered.


This hire completes a **follow\-the\-sun** team — based in Singapore (office\-based) or London — so the platform is supported across time zones rather than by heroics. On\-call is a shared, contracted responsibility, planned and paid — not goodwill.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

* **Cluster operations at scale** — running, upgrading and evolving a multi\-AZ ClickHouse estate on Kubernetes, with rehearsed backup and recovery
* **Schema and query engineering** — table and sorting\-key design, partitioning, materialised views, and query optimisation against multi\-terabyte datasets
* **Capacity and observability** — a measured capacity model, storage tiering and retention, and the Grafana monitoring and alerting that keeps the plant's health visible
* **Ingestion and data quality** — correctness and completeness gates on the pipelines feeding the plant; reconciliation that proves nothing was dropped
* **Workload isolation** — keeping ingest, operations, reporting and ad\-hoc analytics from treading on each other as read load grows
* **AI\-assisted operations** — modern tooling (including MCP\-based AI access to the estate) that lets a small team run a large platform well

**What We Need**
----------------

**Technical:**

* **Columnar/OLAP database engineering** — ClickHouse strongly preferred; deep experience with another columnar or large\-scale time\-series store (BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, kdb\+ or similar) also works
* **SQL depth** — execution plans, query optimisation, and schema design for very large datasets
* **Operational/SRE experience** — you have carried production responsibility for a data platform: monitoring, capacity, incidents, recovery
* **Linux and Kubernetes** — comfort with the operational layer beneath the database
* A **programming language** — one of Python, Go, R, or MATLAB (Python preferred)
* **Engineering discipline** — you write proposals, strategies, and architectural documents and diagrams well, and you manage change properly
* **Git** — excellent version\-control practice
* Distributed\-systems fundamentals — replication, consistency, failure modes
* Financial services experience is a plus but not essential — domain knowledge can be learned; operational instinct cannot

**How you work:**

* **You own production.** Calm in an incident, rigorous in a post\-mortem, honest about what nearly went wrong
* **You measure first.** Topology, storage and optimisation decisions follow observed load and cost — not fashion
* **You write things down.** Runbooks, schema documentation and clean handovers are part of the craft
* **You share knowledge deliberately.** The goal is a platform supportable by a team, not a specialist
* **You communicate across time zones.** Follow\-the\-sun only works with clear, proactive handovers
* **You embrace AI as a tool.** You use it to amplify your own effectiveness and help shape how it operates safely around production data

**What You Get**
----------------

* **A serious estate** — genuine scale, genuine criticality: the system of record for a live trading network, not a reporting sidecar
* **Real ownership** — shared responsibility for a business\-critical core platform from day one, working directly with the platform's lead engineer
* **An excellent team** — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards
* **Sustainable operations** — follow\-the\-sun coverage by design; on\-call is shared, contracted and planned, not heroics
* **Competitive package** — competitive compensation and benefits aligned to your local market
* **Modern tooling** — AI\-assisted operations and investigation tooling that removes toil rather than adding process
* **Growth** — the estate is scaling to multiples of today's volume; the role grows with it


We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher\-value work.

**Our Hiring Process**
----------------------


We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

**Stage 1: Initial Conversation** with Talent Acquisition  

Format: Video call, \~30\-45 minutes

**Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation** with the relevant team lead or hiring manager  

Format: Video call, \~60 minutes

**Stage 3: Technical Interview** with two members of the relevant engineering team  

Format: Video call, interactive session, \~60 minutes


What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

* Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

**How to Apply**
----------------


Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 **Right to Work:** Candidates must have the existing right to work in the country associated with the location advertised for this role (UK or Singapore, as applicable). We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any location.

**Equal Opportunities:** Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

**Reasonable Adjustments:** If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

**Data Protection:** By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

Hotel technology is complex — integrations, data flows, pricing logic, and the real\-time demands of a live revenue management platform all create technical challenges that require genuine analytical depth to resolve. As Technical Support Specialist at Duetto, you'll own cases end\-to\-end: investigating data discrepancies, diagnosing integration issues, identifying software defects, and building the knowledge base that helps customers and colleagues resolve issues faster. It's a role that rewards curiosity, critical thinking, and a genuine understanding of how hotels operate — and it sits at the heart of the customer experience we deliver every day.


**What Makes Us Different?**



Duetto is the hospitality industry's leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world's first Revenue \& Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability. Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we've been named the \#1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the \#1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025\. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we're accelerating our investment in AI — and we're genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we're proud of, for customers we care about.


**What You'll Be Doing**


* You'll own cases from initial contact through to resolution — investigating a wide range of product inquiries including data discrepancies, integrations, and user interface behaviours, applying critical thinking to diagnose root causes rather than just treating symptoms.
* You'll actively create and update knowledge base articles using the KCS methodology — going beyond consuming existing articles to building the shared knowledge that enables customer self\-service and raises the capability of the whole support team.

Symrise is a global supplier of fragrances and flavors, cosmetic active ingredients as well as functional ingredients. Its customers include perfume, cosmetics, food and beverage manufacturers, the pharmaceutical industry and producers of dietary supplements and pet food.



With sales of around €4\.9 billion in the 2025 financial year, the company is one of the world's leading providers. The Group, headquartered in Holzminden, Germany, has more than 100 locations in Europe, Africa and the Middle East, Asia, the USA and Latin America.



Together with its customers, Symrise develops new ideas and market\-ready concepts for products that form an indispensable part of everyday life. Economic success and corporate responsibility are inextricably linked.



Symrise – always inspiring more...

 **Senior Cost Accountant, Singapore**  

As a Senior Cost Accountant, you will be responsible for leading costing, inventory and related financial reporting processes for Singapore, SEA and Oceania operations. As a trusted senior member of the Singapore Finance team, you will provide analysis, review and business partnering support to ensure accurate product costing, robust inventory controls, timely month\-end reporting and continuous improvement of costing processes and systems.



Reporting to the Costing Manager, the role works closely with Supply Chain, Operations, Regional Finance and internal and external stakeholders. This is a critical Singapore\-based role, providing time\-sensitive and seamless support to operations given Singapore’s high cross\-border transaction volumes. The role covers Singapore costing activities as well as selected regional costing and reporting responsibilities across SEA and Oceania.

 **The Position:**  

Singapore Trade Compliance


* Act as the key on\-ground representative liaison for Free Trade Agreement (FTA) compliance matters in Singapore.
* Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of existing FTA schemes and related compliance requirements
* Lead and support system implementation or enhancement projects related to trade compliance including user testing, issue tracking, process updates and documentation.
* Proactively identify opportunities for process improvement, standardisation and alignment across trade compliance activities

SG Costing \& Inventory

* Drive improvements in costing processes, controls, reporting quality and system reliability through proactive review, documentation and stakeholder engagement

* Maintain material master data including new product cost releases and conduct periodic checks to ensure accuracy and completeness of system setup
* Execute and drive cost roll\-up and inventory revaluation processes including analysis, reporting and stakeholder communication.

SEA Costing \& Inventory


* Provide shared service support to SEA and Oceania on costing, inventory and related reporting activities
* Guide and collaborate with local Finance costing team members by providing senior\-level costing advisory support on ad\-hoc business matters
* Support product cost analysis, toll product cost analysis, QC point change impact assessments and operational cost improvement initiatives
* Partner with local Finance, Supply Chain, Operations and Regional Finance teams to ensure costing matters are reviewed accurately and aligned with business requirements.

  

**The Ideal Candidate:**  

* Degree in Accountancy, Finance or related discipline
* 6\-8 years of relevant working experience, preferably within the Singapore manufacturing industry
* Strong experience in costing, inventory management, financial reporting and manufacturing variance analysis
* Hands\-on experience with SAP is required
* Prior experience in FTA management/trade compliance would be an added advantage
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and business partnering skills
* Ability to interpret complex operational and financial data and translate findings into clear management insights
* High attention to detail with strong ownership mindset and the ability to manage multiple deadlines independently
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills across functions, countries and levels of seniority
* Continuous improvement mindset with the ability to identify control gaps, streamline processes and support change management
* Team player with a positive working attitude, strong learning agility and the ability to perform well in a fast\-paced environment

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932\. How? By taking the time to truly understand people.
