description:
**JOB DETAILS:**



POSITION TITLE: Sales Development Manager / Business Development Manager



RELEASE DATE: 07/01/2026



REPORTS TO: Sr. Vice President of Global Sales \& Marketing



DEPARTMENT: Sales \& Marketing



CLASSIFICATION: Exempt



LOCATION: International Remote Singapore

  

**POSITION SUMMARY**



A Sales Development Manager (SDM) at the Center for Aquaculture Technologies (CAT) is a proactive and goal\-oriented sales professional with 2–5 years of experience driving revenue growth in aquaculture and/or life sciences markets. The candidate will be skilled in managing full sales cycles, from lead generation to closing, while nurturing long\-term client relationships. The SDM is adept at analyzing market trends, consultative selling with strategic negotiation to maximize CAT’s customer value and business profitability, delivering persuasive presentations, and leveraging CAT’s HubSpot CRM system to meet and exceed quarterly targets. The position works together with the lab operations, genetic scientists and marketing departments to utilize your assigned portfolio and geography to bring CAT’s Next Generation Breeding™ solutions and sustainable aquaculture to CAT’s growing customer base and prospects.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Act as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring their needs and expectations are met. Foster loyalty and retention as you manage your territory of existing and new clients. Perform business reviews with clients to align strategic goals for each fiscal year
* Works their list of prospects, qualified leads, expanding awareness of CAT. Leads prospecting initiatives to create new leads in focus areas (specific species, geographies, etc.).
* Utilizes Marketing sourced MQLs and SQLs from various channels such as website inquiries and research/intelligence to contact and qualify possible clients, establish relationships, and convert them into sales\-qualified leads.
* Identifies strategic opportunities of the SQLs and presents CAT portfolio solutions by giving technical presentations and preparing quotes and proposals illustrating CAT’s solutions.
* Identify opportunities for upselling and cross\-selling services to CAT’s existing clients. Actively seek new business opportunities and develop strategies to grow the client portfolio.
* Organizes sales activities collecting and sharing notes in HubSpot CRM.
* Collects and reports on market intelligence into the Marketing Dept.
* Project Coordination: Oversees the implementation of projects and campaigns, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of services. Facilitate communication between clients and internal teams to manage expectations and project progress.
* Performs routine reporting such as the number of 1\) qualified leads created, quotes/proposals made, new customers created, and opportunities closed; 2\) execution of initiatives; 3\) commercial case studies, etc.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including sales, marketing, and customer success, to ensure a cohesive approach to client management.

  


**ESSENTIAL SKILLS:**


* Time management: Shall have exceptional ability to organize tasks, meet deadlines, and effectively manage time to maintain productivity.
* Prospecting: Candidate has a hunter mentality and can identify, contact and engage potential customers. Candidate shows abilities for social selling and active listening.
* Strategic Selling – Utilizes inputs from the sales process to strategically plan out and execute future steps to close the opportunity by managing the entire decision making group, leveraging CAT strengths and mitigating client objections towards a win\-win solution.
* Services/Product Presentation/Demonstration: Perform product demonstrations and presentations to prospective clients. Delivering engaging and clear solutions that demonstrate CAT’s competencies and build trust during the sales process. Candidate shows ability for speaking in public forums.
* Aquaculture Industry and Product Knowledge: Provide prospective clients with all the information they need about the company’s offerings, showing prospects the value of doing business with CAT and aids their decision\-making.
* Value\-Based Selling: Highlighting the benefits and outcomes of a product or service rather than just its features or price.
* Closing and Negotiation Skills: Has the ability to navigate difficult scenarios with prospects and clients, by applying effective techniques to close complex sales. Can confidently ask for the sale and move opportunities through the funnel with maximum velocity.
* Personal Traits: Including active listening, effective communication, anticipating customer needs, understanding and anticipating customer needs, public speaking, relationship builder, persuasiveness, honesty, empathy, conflict management, and adaptability.

  


**QUALIFICATIONS FOR THE POSITION:**


* Previous Sales Experience: 2\-5 years AND
* Fluent in English as a first or second language AND
* Currently holds a position within the Aquaculture/Fisheries industry (Operations, Feed, etc.) OR
* Science background including animal sciences, biology, molecular biology, or related science. (5\-10 yrs)

  


**WORKING CONDITIONS (CAL/OSHA–ALIGNED)**



Physical Demands


* Prolonged periods of sitting/keyboard work (frequent 4–6 hours/day), with intermittent standing, walking, and stair climbing during site visits.
* Occasional bending, reaching, and twisting when reviewing equipment, samples, or records.
* Lifting/Carrying: up to 10 lbs. frequently (laptop, documents, small equipment) and up to 25 lbs. occasionally (samples or materials). Requests exceeding these limits require assistance or mechanical aid.
* Ability to don, doff, and work in PPE (e.g., lab coat/coveralls, gloves, safety glasses, hearing protection, boots) for extended walkthroughs.


Work Environment \& Exposure


* Office/Remote: typical indoor environment; ergonomic workstation expected.
* Laboratory/Hatchery/Processing Sites (periodic):
	+ Wet/slippery surfaces, humidity, and variable temperatures; potential odors typical of aquaculture settings.
	+ Intermittent exposure to disinfectants/cleaners, routine lab reagents, and biological materials; work follows Company IIPP, Hazard Communication, Biosafety/Biosecurity SOPs, and posted site rules.
	+ Noise: usually quiet to moderate; maybe elevated near pumps, blowers, or processing equipment—hearing protection required per site protocols.
	+ Possible allergen exposure related to aquatic species or feed; appropriate controls and PPE provided.

The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron's growth, delivering best\-in\-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills\-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron's Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.


As a Senior AI Data Strategist within Global Procurement, you will lead the reimagination of the procurement data landscape so that agentic AI can execute Source\-to\-Pay work reliably, safely, and at scale. This is a hands\-on strategy and design role for a **solid problem solver** who thrives on untangling complex, cross\-system data challenges. You will translate business intent into a data operating model where agents detect, enrich, route, and maintain data, and where humans focus on exception handling, governance, and continuous improvement.


Data readiness is the single largest constraint to unlocking agentic AI value in procurement. Success in this role is defined by whether prioritized agentic workflows actually run on trusted, agent\-consumable data, and whether the data foundation continues to strengthen itself through automated feedback loops rather than manual clean\-up cycles.


**This is not an IT role** , but you will work alongside IT, Data Excellence, Security, and Compliance groups. You will help ensure the data strategy aligns with enterprise data platforms, Enterprise Resource Planning readiness, approved connectors, and enterprise data governance standards.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


A core expectation is to move the procurement data function from reactive clean\-up to an agent\-embedded, self\-improving operating model.


**Data Strategy and Reimagined Operating Model**

* Reimagine the Data Governance and Excellence operating model with agents embedded. Redefine how policies, data quality monitoring, lineage, stewardship, and lifecycle management operate when agents handle detection, enrichment, routing, and maintenance, and where human roles shift to exception handling and governance.
* Define the target working model, the agentic patterns that apply to data governance (for example, data quality agent, lineage agent, maintenance agent, steward copilot), and a getting\-started roadmap sequenced against Enterprise Resource Planning and transformation milestones.

**Data Readiness for Agentic Workflows**

* Partner with agent build leads to define exactly what data elements, quality thresholds, and validation rules each agent needs to operate reliably, and map every business requirement to a data source, owner, and readiness action.
* Close gaps in master data element coverage so that lineage, definitions, and ownership are complete and agent\-consumable, and stand up a searchable data dictionary and glossary that both humans and agents can query.
* Design the feedback loop between agent, source system, and steward so that data validation, correction, and prevention happen without manual human touch wherever feasible.

**Data Lineage, Mapping, and Technical Foundations**

* Build the working\-level technical foundations that make the agentic model possible: data lineage, relationships, schema, and cross\-system mapping so that downstream impact is traceable before a change lands.
* Establish documentation, versioning, change history, and downstream impact analysis designed so that agents can consume and update them as first\-class users of the data catalog.
* Define control points at the point of entry, and prioritize Critical Data Elements that drive downstream procurement value.

**Governance, Policy, and Enterprise Partnership**

* Partner with IT, Data Excellence, Security, and Compliance to align the data strategy with enterprise controls, sensitivity labels, data loss prevention requirements, and approved connectors so that agents can access the data they need without breaking guardrails.
* Contribute to lightweight, machine\-readable policies and standards that agents can enforce automatically, shifting governance from static documents to executable rules.
* Establish data quality key performance indicators, service level agreements, and monitoring so quality is measurable and managed, not assumed.

**Innovation, Experimentation, and Reusable Assets**

* Run rapid experiments on agentic data patterns (data quality agent, lineage agent, maintenance agent, steward copilot, and similar), validate impact, and turn the best into reusable building blocks for broader reuse.
* Pilot AI\-based data validation and cleansing tools and assess fit against Micron's data landscape.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership and Enablement**

* Coach data stewards, custodians, category managers, and business owners on how to work with data in an agent\-embedded operating model, including how to author machine\-readable policies and how to interpret data quality signals.
* Coordinate closely with automation, agent build, and AI strategy teams, since agentic data workflows sit at the intersection of all three, and represent the data agenda in program reviews and executive readouts.

**Minimum****Requirements**


* **Education:**Master's degree in Information Systems , Data Science, Computer Science, Data/Information Management, or a related quantitative field.
* **Experience:**10\+ years in enterprise data management, including 6\+ years leading data governance, master data management (MDM), or data quality programs in a large, multi\-region SAP environment.
* **Procurement data:**Hands\-on experience with procurement, sourcing, or supply\-chain data.
* **Data foundations:**Demonstrated experience with data lineage, cross\-system mapping, data dictionaries, and business glossaries, plus working SQL proficiency .
* **AI / agentic data:**Direct experience defining data requirements for production AI/ML or agentic workflows, including data readiness, quality thresholds, and validation or feedback rules.
* **Cross\-functional leadership:**Proven ability to influence IT, Security, and business stakeholders without direct authority.
**Preferred Requirements**


* Prior experience reimagining a data governance operating model with AI or agents embedded , including agentic patterns such as data quality agents, lineage agents, maintenance agents, and steward copilots.
* Experience in Source\-to\-Pay, Procure \-to\-Pay, or Supply Chain data domains (Vendor Master, Material Master, Spend, Category Taxonomy, Contracts).
* **Governance model delivered:**Designed and operationalized an enterprise data governance operating model (roles, decision rights, policies, KPIs, stewardship) with measurable adoption.
* **MDM / data catalog platform:**Hands\-on implementation experience (not just usage) with Informatica, Collibra, or Ataccama .
* Familiarity with Enterprise Resource Planning migration data readiness, machine\-readable policies, and data loss prevention and sensitivity\-label impacts on AI connector access.
* Additional certifications in data management (for example, Certified Data Management Professional), AI and analytics, or procurement transformation.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Ariba procurement data (sourcing, contracts, or spend).
* Hands\-on experience with cloud data platforms (Snowflake) and enterprise BI tools (Power BI or Tableau).
* Comfort collaborating across US and Asia time zones, with regular overlap with US\-based stakeholders.

About Goda

The Role


You'll be handling outbound customer calls for Goda — post\-purchase follow\-ups, proactive order and fulfillment updates, review acquisition outreach, and retention\-focused conversations. You'll also support inbound escalations when needed.


This is not a scripted cold call role. You'll be working off structured call frameworks, but the job requires you to think, read the customer, and adapt in real time. Our customers are passionate about our products — when something's off, they want to talk to someone who actually cares and can fix it.


You'll report to the CS Manager and be held to clear daily call targets, resolution quality benchmarks, and CSAT standards. If you're the type to hide behind a script and move on, this isn't the right fit.




What You'll Be Doing


Outbound Call Management


Making outbound calls to existing customers for post\-purchase follow\-ups, proactive delivery updates, and satisfaction check\-ins \[Approximately 50\+ calls per day]


The main goal is: Executing review acquisition campaigns — reaching out to verified purchasers and guiding them through leaving a review on our Trustpilot page, compliantly and naturally


Following call scripts and frameworks precisely while using good judgment when conversations go off\-script


Logging every call outcome accurately in our CRM/helpdesk \[Aircall]


Quality \& Reporting


Hitting daily and weekly call volume targets as set by the CS Manager


Maintaining CSAT and call quality scores within defined benchmarks


Surfacing recurring complaint patterns and call objections to the CS Manager for SOP and messaging improvements


Flagging any compliance concerns, sensitive customer situations, or escalation risks immediately

 **Requirements**  


Must\-Haves* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a customer support role — call center or outbound phone experience strongly preferred; DTC or e\-commerce experience is a significant advantage
* Fluent, clear, confident American English — spoken and written. Customers are US\-based; your accent and phrasing must be comfortable and natural for an American audience. This is non\-negotiable.
* Strong phone presence — you sound engaged, warm, and professional, not robotic or scripted
* Proven ability to handle difficult conversations calmly — complaints, frustrated customers, cancellation intent — without losing composure or matching their energy
* Comfortable working within structured call frameworks while adapting naturally when the conversation requires it
* Detail\-oriented with CRM and logging discipline — every call outcome documented accurately: resolution, sentiment, issues, follow\-up required
* Proactive and self\-directed — you hit your call targets without being chased and you flag problems before they land on someone else's desk


Nice to Have* Experience in retention or winback calling (subscription brands, DTC)
* Familiarity with helpdesk or CRM tools (Commslayer, RichPanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, or similar)
* Prior experience with review outreach or NPS/CSAT follow\-up calling
* Comfort navigating fulfillment\-related conversations (order status, reshipments, tracking disputes)


Instant No's* Heavy or unclear accent that creates friction in US customer conversations
* Relying on scripted lines when the customer has clearly gone off\-script — the ability to pivot naturally is required
* Low call volume output or unlogged outcomes — accountability on every call is not optional
* Treating outbound CS as cold sales — the goal is resolution and relationship, not pressure tactics
* Slow escalation of sensitive or high\-risk situations

 **Benefits**  

* Competitive salary based on market and experience
* Fully remote, working within your assigned market's timezone (must overlap with US business hours)
* Clear growth path within our CS team and retention function
* Structured call frameworks, proper tooling, and a CS team being built to the right standard

* Develop, document, and maintain business processes, accounting policies, and internal control procedures to support a strong control environment.
* Ensure compliance with group accounting policies, delegated authority frameworks, and internal control requirements.

As a **Business Development Manager** at Biohackk, your primary responsibility is to guide prospects through their initial health journey phase. Submit end\-of\-day report summarizing connections made, actions taken, and outcomes achieved.

Explain Results: Clearly interpret and communicate analysis findings to prospects, helping them understand their health status and how Biohackk’s programs can address their unique needs and goals.
  

Build Reports: Create detailed and accurate Body Composition and Health Analysis reports for each client during consultations, ensuring all relevant health data is captured.

Demo Process: Execute an engaging demo process for invited prospects, which includes a Body Composition Analysis, a comprehensive health assessment, and a structured presentation (PPT) of Biohackk’s solutions.

Demonstrate Value: Articulate the transformative benefits of Biohackk’s solutions, aligning them with each prospect’s specific health goals and challenges.
  

Show Personalized Value: Highlight how Biohackk’s offerings are uniquely tailored to their journey, presenting a strong value proposition that builds trust and resonates deeply.
  

Inspire Action: Position Biohackk as the best solution for their health transformation, fostering trust, enthusiasm, and a sense of urgency to commit.
  

Rise Above Objections: Empathetically address concerns and questions, providing clarity and reassurance to overcome hesitation.
  

Maintain Connection: Engage prospects consistently until they sign up, ensuring they feel supported and confident in their decision to embark on their Biohackk journey.

Excellent Handoff: Provide comprehensive notes and insights to the Client Journey team, ensuring a seamless transition for new clients and continuity in their experience.
  

Data Privacy: Strictly adhere to data privacy regulations and Biohackk’s confidentiality standards to protect prospect and client information.

Join the Commercial and Investment Bank(CIB) Treasury APAC team to help shape balance sheet strategy across Asia. As a Vice President within Commercial and Investment bank Treasury APAC, you will lead key initiatives impacting legal entity balance sheets, deliver analytical insights, and support business activity while helping minimize financial resource and balance sheet risks.

* Assess the financial resource management implications of new business initiatives.

* Lead local projects and contribute to global initiatives impacting APAC balance sheets.
* Drive analysis to identify balance sheet risks, optimization opportunities, and actionable insights for senior stakeholders.

* SQL knowledge and experience working with large datasets.
* Experience developing practical technology solutions, including use of Python and AI\-assisted development tools to automate workflows, build analytics tools, or prototype applications.

Job Summary
  
  

The purpose of the role is to
  
  

* Support the growth and day\-to\-day management of our Discretionary Portfolio Management platform. The role requires strong Fixed Income portfolio construction and implementation skills, the ability to engage confidently with clients and front\-line teams, and a disciplined governance mindset. The successful candidate will contribute across investment management, client pitches, portfolio reviews, performance analysis and product capability development.


Key Responsibilities
  
  

Portfolio Management
  
* Support the design, construction and implementation of customized Fixed Income portfolios for UHNW / Family Office clients, aligned with client objectives, risk tolerance, investment guidelines and long\-term requirements.
* Manage and implement Fixed Income portfolios with single\-line securities, including rebalancing, trade implementation and ongoing portfolio monitoring. Strong focus on credit selection across global fixed income markets.
* Support the development and management of CIO Fixed Income Portfolio Strategies, including model portfolios, portfolio positioning and investment implementation.
* Conduct performance attribution and risk analysis to support investment decisions, client reviews and portfolio improvements.
* Collaborate with the Chief Investment Office, Product Specialists and internal stakeholders to translate investment views into scalable DPM solutions and portfolio capabilities.
* Contribute investment insights and portfolio feedback into internal investment discussions, including CIO and DPM forums where relevant.
* Ensure portfolios remain aligned with mandate objectives, internal investment guidelines, risk limits and applicable governance requirements.


Sales \& Marketing Support
  
* Support client pitches, portfolio reviews and after\-sales discussions, explaining portfolio strategy, performance drivers and risk considerations clearly and confidently.
* Partner with RMs, Investment Advisors and DPM specialists to support pipeline conversion, client engagement and growth of DPM mandates.
* Prepare client\-ready materials, including pitchbooks, portfolio reviews, investment commentary and performance updates.
* Translate portfolio positioning and market developments into clear, commercial and compliant messaging for clients and front\-line teams.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of scalable marketing and review materials in line with internal standards and regulatory requirements.


Product Management \& Governance
  
* Participate in the development and enhancement of the DPM product offering, with a focus on Fixed Income capabilities and scalable portfolio solutions.
* Conduct performance attribution, risk analysis and portfolio diagnostics to identify areas for improvement.
* Adhere to DPM governance procedures, including investment guideline monitoring, mandate restrictions, documentation standards and escalation requirements.
* Support the preparation of materials for governance, fiduciary oversight and investment committee meetings.
* Work with relevant control functions to ensure portfolio activity, materials and client engagement remain aligned with applicable internal and regulatory standards.


Regulatory \& Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


Key stakeholders
  
* Senior Portfolio Managers within DPM team
* DPM Middle and Back\-office teams
* Advisory \& Managed Investment Teams
* Front Office (Relationship Managers, Investment Advisors)
* Risk, Governance and Compliance functions


Our Ideal Candidate
  
  

* 5\+ years of experience in portfolio management within a private bank, asset manager or wealth manager with a preference for Fixed Income experience
* Strong understanding of Fixed Income portfolio construction across single\-line securities.
* Confident and credible in front of clients, RMs and Investment Advisors, with the ability to explain portfolio strategy, performance and risk in a clear, commercial and compliant manner.
* Strong analytical capability, including performance attribution, risk analysis, portfolio monitoring and investment commentary.
* Detail\-oriented, diligent and able to operate effectively in a fast\-paced and growing business.
* Commercial mindset, with the ability to support business growth while maintaining portfolio quality, suitability and governance discipline.
* Strong Bloomberg AIM and portfolio analytics skills; quantitative experience with automation or workflow improvement is an advantage.
* Strong accountability, governance orientation and attention to detail.
* CFA designation preferred.


Role Specific Technical Competencies
  
  

* Portfolio Management
* Client Communication / Investment Communication
* Performance Attribution \& Reporting
* Market \& Economic Analysis
* Data Handling \& Automation (Excel, Bloomberg, VBA)


About Standard Chartered
  
  

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. At Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, we bring deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.

**What****You Will Do**

As a new joiner at Oliver Wyman, you will have the opportunity to work on challenging projects for large clients worldwide, developing your expertise quickly and making an immediate impact. You'll work alongside senior colleagues and clients, working as one to help to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.


We believe in providing our consultants with the freedom and support they need to succeed in their own way. We provide an apprenticeship model for learning on the job, supplemented by formal training to help you rapidly develop your communication, presentation, and client management skills.  



**Why****J** **oin****U** **s**

Come aboard if you *e* njoy solving interesting problems and at ease working across different cultures . You will step out of your comfort zone, finding stretch opportunities along every step of the journey. You will also find genuine colleagues who speak their minds and measure success not by the number of hours worked but by what gets accomplished.  



**Immediate impact, continuous challenge**


* You’ll work on challenging projects that have a significant impact on clients, industries, and societies from day one
* We’ll ask you to challenge the norm and constantly strive to build something new to shape our firm and the world around us
* You’ll be a contributing team member from the start, working with senior colleagues and clients to build trust\-based relationships and deliver breakthrough impact

* There’s no corporate mold to fit and hierarchy doesn’t get in the way
* Many of your colleagues will become life\-long friends

Candidates who graduate after June 2027 and require visa application, will be considered for a March 2028 intake.


Language requirements:


**Fluency in English (written and spoken)** is required for positions in all Oliver Wyman offices. Other highly desirable languages for all Asia Pacific offices include: Japanese, Indonesian, Mandarin, Malay, Korean, Thai and Vietnamese.

Please apply by **Thursday, 10 September** **2026** ( 6:00 pm Singapore time). Interviews are expected to take place in October. Further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you a technical leader who can set the deep\-dive data strategy for a multi\-billion\-dollar business and build and run the team that executes it? Do you have the technical depth across storage, database, and analytics and the leadership skills to guide a team of Specialist Solutions Architects, sponsor our largest customers, and act as the trusted technical advisor to a GTM leadership team? Do you want to help customers across Asia Pacific, Japan and China get their data estates ready for the AI and agentic era? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Data \& AI team as a Sr Manager, Solutions Architecture for Data.  

  

This role leads the Specialist SA function across the full APJC data portfolio including storage, database, and analytics services and is the senior technical leader for the APJC data business. You will guide, coach, and develop a geographically distributed team of Specialist SAs spanning six geos (ASEAN, Korea, Japan, ANZ, Taiwan and India), and you will be the executive technical sponsor and top escalation point for our customers, partners, and AWS service teams. Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated customer experiences; every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role owns the technical strategy that makes our customers' data foundations cloud\-native, resilient, and AI/agentic\-ready. You will dive deep on data strategy, find ways to make the team's impact felt at scale, and operate as the technical advisor the CTO to the CEO of the APJC data business.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Hire, on\-board, train, and develop Specialist Solutions Architects across Storage, Database, and Analytics, building a high\-performing distributed team across APJC's six geos and time zones
* Own the technical data strategy for APJC, define reference architectures, best practices, and the technical narrative that gets customers' data estates AI/agentic\-ready
* Act as executive technical sponsor and top escalation point on the most strategic and complex customer opportunities
* Serve as the technical advisor ("CTO") to the Head of Data, translating customer signal into strategy
* Act as technical liaison between customers, service teams, and support carrying roadmap feedback and competitive gaps back to product leadership
* Drive impact at scale through mechanisms, reusable assets, and enablement that multiply the team beyond one\-to\-one engagements

  

A day in the life  

One morning you're coaching an SA through a complex analytics modernisation architecture; midday you're the executive sponsor in a CxO briefing making the technical case to migrate a legacy estate ahead of an AI initiative. The afternoon you're unblocking an escalated deal, reviewing a reusable reference architecture your team built, and feeding APJC customer signal back to a service team to shape the roadmap. You move fluidly between leading the team, diving deep on data strategy, and advising the business, measuring success by the technical health and collective growth of the APJC data business.  

  

About the team  

This role leads the Specialist SA function on the APJC Data GTM team, working as an integrated unit with GTM Specialists, area SA teams, account teams, and partners to drive data adoption. We operate in a collaborative model where BD, Sales Specialists, and Specialist SAs bring unique strengths in concert. We value leaders who are deep technologists and effective people managers who bridge local market needs with global priorities. If you thrive building the team and setting the technical strategy, and measure success by the collective growth of the team, this is the role for you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8\+ years of managing a technical team of solution architects, sales engineers or similar technical roles experience
* Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
* 10\+ years of technology solutions architecture, technical sales, or technical consulting experience, with significant depth across one or more data domains: storage, database, or analytics.
* Experience across large\-scale data workloads, including database, data warehouse / analytics, and storage architectures.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience managing large teams across multiple locations and languages
* Deep technical breadth across storage, database (relational and NoSQL), and analytics/data warehousing, able to dive deep in at least one and lead across all three
* Experience positioning data foundations for AI/ML and agentic workloads (data readiness, modernisation, purpose\-built services as the context layer for AI)

* Cloud certifications and advanced degree (MBA or MS in CS/Engineering) preferred

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud growing. We support all AWS data centers critical infrastructures, power and cooling equipment supporting all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety, security and quality while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning Processes? Amazon Data Center Commissioning (ACx) is looking for a dynamic High Voltage Commissioning Engineer (CxE) to support the delivery of AWS Substations and Data Centers. As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer, you will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems, building, retrofitting and improving AWS owned critical infrastructures within the APJC and globally. We understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction and equipment quality in accordance to engineering design specifications. Working backwards from our customers, we innovates and is committed to deliver with customers' satisfaction.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The responsibilities of the ACx High Voltage Commissioning Engineer (CxE) include, but are not limited to, oversight and coordination of multi\-discipline division of work related to pre\-commissioning and commissioning of Amazon critical infrastructure construction and special projects. You possess advanced electrical knowledge of substations and power management/controls systems for critical infrastructure.
  

  

You are responsible for managing and supporting commissioning vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems including high, medium and low voltage power systems, Generators, UPS, HVAC, Chilled Water, BMS and EPMS systems. You will provide multi\-discipline input into scheduling, designing, planning of project execution and innovation projects. In addition, you will be required to review all multi\-discipline integrated systems testing and commissioning documents to ensure they are compliant with the basis of design, project specifications and standards.
  

  

In this role, you will have APJC and global presence, this will include traveling to sites located in\-country, across APJC and globally. You will be responsible to ensure that all commissioning procedures follow the appropriate safety practices, policies and procedures. You participates in all project and company safety programs with enthusiasm and also audit commissioning activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. You will report to the ACx Regional Manager and ensure that the applicable test documents are created in accordance with all commissioning requirements. You are responsible for weekly reporting of commissioning progress and metrics for assigned projects. You will work in a high velocity environment, on multiple strategics initiatives, continuous improvement projects and deliver projects simultaneously under tight deadlines and according to prescribed metrics.
  

  

Systems Analysis  

* Understand the design concept and intent by reviewing mechanical and electrical construction documentation, including drawings, specifications, vendor submittals and sequences of operations.
* Provide recommendations and feedback regarding the design, equipment selection, pre\-functional checklists, startup and functional test scripts developed by others, maintainability, construct\-ability and commission\-ability.
* Review documentation for compliance with Amazon standards, industry standards, and design specifications.
* Assess the capability of commissioned systems to match the design and find opportunities for improvements.

  

Systems Validation  

* Verify the system’s performance, including establishing acceptance criteria, obtaining and reviewing completed reports, performing verification and validation.
* Validates in as\-built documentation and review for accuracy and completeness.
* Communicates commissioning issues, questions and concerns through proper channels in a timely manner.
* Partners internal and external teams to ensure commissioning regime has sufficient depth and breadth.
* Supports commissioning audits

  

Project Management  

* Managing and executing of commissioning of critical infrastructure to validate installation, operation and performance of mechanical, electrical and controls systems.
* Acting as the point of contact for commissioning vendors’ escalations, developing mitigation plans to unblock obstacles.
* Managing vendors via audits of deliverables and setting expectations with commissioning vendors to work in accordance with Amazon requirements.
* Developing project schedules and plans, not limited to project deliveries, strategic initiatives and innovation projects.
* Representing ACx in projects coordination meetings with external vendors and contractors and internal stakeholders.
* Maintaining quality of commissioning documentation
* Managing concurrent projects across multiple geographical regions and time zones.

  

A day in the life  

As a high voltage commissioning engineer, you blend strong technical aptitude with project management. You will review commissioning scripts against design intent and coordinate with contractors on\-site or resolving issues. You stay ahead of project risks, proposing solutions before problems escalate. Your stakeholder management skills shine as you bridge internal teams and external vendors, and you're always looking for ways to improve processes.  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

  

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

title: ClickHouse Engineer
description:
**ClickHouse Engineer**
=======================

**Remote (UK\-based) or Singapore (Office\-based)\| Full\-Time**

**About Us**
------------


Reactive Markets is the **2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year** (Risk.net). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40\+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.


We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high\-performance systems.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a ClickHouse Engineer to share ownership of our data plant: a multi\-datacentre, multi\-AZ ClickHouse cluster ingesting billions of rows a day, underpinning compliance, billing, and a growing family of real\-time and historical analytics.


This is a core\-platform engineering role, not a DBA role. You'll work across the full engineering scope of a serious ClickHouse estate: cluster operations and upgrades, schema and sorting\-key design, materialised views, ingestion performance, query optimisation, workload isolation, capacity planning, storage tiering, backup and recovery, monitoring and alerting, and production support. You'll also work on the data pipelines around the plant — our capture services are Go, and our analytics foundation is Python.


You don't need years of ClickHouse specifically — deep experience with another columnar or large\-scale time\-series database qualifies you, and a strong columnar engineer learns our estate quickly. What we do need is genuine operational depth: you have run a production data platform, owned its capacity plan and its recovery procedures, and stayed calm when it mattered.


This hire completes a **follow\-the\-sun** team — based in Singapore (office\-based) or London — so the platform is supported across time zones rather than by heroics. On\-call is a shared, contracted responsibility, planned and paid — not goodwill.

**What You'll Work On**
-----------------------

* **Cluster operations at scale** — running, upgrading and evolving a multi\-AZ ClickHouse estate on Kubernetes, with rehearsed backup and recovery
* **Schema and query engineering** — table and sorting\-key design, partitioning, materialised views, and query optimisation against multi\-terabyte datasets
* **Capacity and observability** — a measured capacity model, storage tiering and retention, and the Grafana monitoring and alerting that keeps the plant's health visible
* **Ingestion and data quality** — correctness and completeness gates on the pipelines feeding the plant; reconciliation that proves nothing was dropped
* **Workload isolation** — keeping ingest, operations, reporting and ad\-hoc analytics from treading on each other as read load grows
* **AI\-assisted operations** — modern tooling (including MCP\-based AI access to the estate) that lets a small team run a large platform well

**What We Need**
----------------

**Technical:**

* **Columnar/OLAP database engineering** — ClickHouse strongly preferred; deep experience with another columnar or large\-scale time\-series store (BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, kdb\+ or similar) also works
* **SQL depth** — execution plans, query optimisation, and schema design for very large datasets
* **Operational/SRE experience** — you have carried production responsibility for a data platform: monitoring, capacity, incidents, recovery
* **Linux and Kubernetes** — comfort with the operational layer beneath the database
* A **programming language** — one of Python, Go, R, or MATLAB (Python preferred)
* **Engineering discipline** — you write proposals, strategies, and architectural documents and diagrams well, and you manage change properly
* **Git** — excellent version\-control practice
* Distributed\-systems fundamentals — replication, consistency, failure modes
* Financial services experience is a plus but not essential — domain knowledge can be learned; operational instinct cannot

**How you work:**

* **You own production.** Calm in an incident, rigorous in a post\-mortem, honest about what nearly went wrong
* **You measure first.** Topology, storage and optimisation decisions follow observed load and cost — not fashion
* **You write things down.** Runbooks, schema documentation and clean handovers are part of the craft
* **You share knowledge deliberately.** The goal is a platform supportable by a team, not a specialist
* **You communicate across time zones.** Follow\-the\-sun only works with clear, proactive handovers
* **You embrace AI as a tool.** You use it to amplify your own effectiveness and help shape how it operates safely around production data

**What You Get**
----------------

* **A serious estate** — genuine scale, genuine criticality: the system of record for a live trading network, not a reporting sidecar
* **Real ownership** — shared responsibility for a business\-critical core platform from day one, working directly with the platform's lead engineer
* **An excellent team** — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards
* **Sustainable operations** — follow\-the\-sun coverage by design; on\-call is shared, contracted and planned, not heroics
* **Competitive package** — competitive compensation and benefits aligned to your local market
* **Modern tooling** — AI\-assisted operations and investigation tooling that removes toil rather than adding process
* **Growth** — the estate is scaling to multiples of today's volume; the role grows with it


We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher\-value work.

**Our Hiring Process**
----------------------


We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

**Stage 1: Initial Conversation** with Talent Acquisition  

Format: Video call, \~30\-45 minutes

**Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation** with the relevant team lead or hiring manager  

Format: Video call, \~60 minutes

**Stage 3: Technical Interview** with two members of the relevant engineering team  

Format: Video call, interactive session, \~60 minutes


What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

* Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

**How to Apply**
----------------


Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 **Right to Work:** Candidates must have the existing right to work in the country associated with the location advertised for this role (UK or Singapore, as applicable). We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any location.

**Equal Opportunities:** Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

**Reasonable Adjustments:** If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

**Data Protection:** By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

**Job Summary**
---------------


As a Global Commodity Manager (Individual Contributor), you will act as the strategic owner for cost, supply continuity, and supplier performance across assigned commodities.


This role is accountable for developing and executing global commodity strategies, driving should\-cost excellence, and ensuring resilient supply in a complex, fast\-moving environment.


As an individual contributor role, success depends heavily on your ability to influence across a highly matrixed global organization—working closely with Engineering, Operations, Planning, and external suppliers to align priorities, resolve trade\-offs, and deliver outcomes without direct authority.


Candidates who excel in this role combine strong analytical and technical capability with superior influencing skills, enabling them to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and build alignment across diverse stakeholders.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------


1\. Cost \& Commodity Strategy Ownership

* Act as the custodian of cost, supply, and supplier performance across assigned commodities
* Lead BOM analysis, should\-cost / clean\-sheet modeling, and cost benchmarking vs. actuals
* Define and execute worldwide (WW) commodity strategies aligned to product and business needs
* Partner with Finance to manage standard cost and cost\-reduction initiatives


2\. Demand–Supply Alignment

* Collaborate with Supply Planning and Operations on demand\-supply coverage and forecast alignment
* Ensure material readiness and inventory optimization across NPI and sustaining programs
* Monitor market conditions impacting pricing, lead times, and availability


3\. Strategic Sourcing \& Technical Engagement

* Lead end\-to\-end sourcing activities including RFQs, cost analysis, negotiations, and supplier selection
* Execute technical sourcing in partnership with Engineering, influencing design\-to\-cost decisions
* Evaluate suppliers across cost, capability, capacity, and technology readiness


4\. Supplier Relationship Management

* Own and manage global supplier relationships, balancing performance, cost, and long\-term collaboration
* Lead Supplier Business Reviews (QBRs) and drive performance improvements
* Navigate negotiations by balancing commercial objectives with supply assurance and relationship sustainability


5\. Risk Management \& Supply Continuity

* Identify and mitigate supply risks (geopolitical, capacity, technology, single\-source exposure)
* Develop multi\-sourcing and contingency strategies
* Support supplier qualification, audits, and compliance processes


6\. Matrix Leadership \& Influence (Critical Success Factor)

* Operate effectively across a matrixed global organization, aligning stakeholders without direct authority
* Influence cross\-functional decisions by balancing data, business priorities, and stakeholder perspectives
* Navigate and resolve conflicting objectives (e.g., cost vs. supply, NPI vs. operations)
* Build strong working relationships to secure commitment and execution from internal teams and external partners

1\. Supply Chain \& Procurement Expertise: Strong foundation in cost modeling, BOM analysis, procurement analytics, demand\-supply planning, forecasting, and end\-to\-end supply chain management — with proven experience in contracts, negotiations, and supplier management.


2\. Technical Sourcing \& Domain Knowledge: Ability to collaborate closely with Engineering on technical sourcing decisions, with familiarity in CAD/3D drawing interpretation. Experience in battery packs and/or mechanical assemblies is highly advantageous.


3\. Analytical \& Digital Proficiency: Highly proficient in Excel, PowerPoint, and ERP systems, with exposure to data\-driven and AI\-enabled procurement tools considered a strong advantage.


4\. Stakeholder Influence \& Cross\-Functional Leadership: Proven ability to lead complex sourcing initiatives, navigate cross\-functional dynamics, and drive alignment across matrixed teams — influencing outcomes without direct authority while managing competing priorities with clarity and composure.


5\. Mindset, Character \& Interpersonal Effectiveness: A transformational, self\-starting leader with the courage to challenge the status quo and drive process improvements. Builds trust and credibility quickly, communicates with executive presence, and thrives in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments with strong ownership and adaptability.


6\. Qualifications, Work Arrangement \& Availability: A Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field is required, with a minimum of 15 years of experience in procurement or supply chain and a proven track record in technical sourcing and cross\-functional collaboration. The role operates on a hybrid model (minimum 3 days in\-office per week), requiring flexibility to engage across multiple time zones, with periodic international travel expected. Fluency in English is essential, with proficiency in an additional language being a plus.


At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in\-office and/or in\-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

Nomura's IT department provides technology solutions to support the company's business activities. Nomura's IT team specializes in software development, infrastructure management, cybersecurity, and data analytics and is known for providing exceptional service to clients. With a strong track record and commitment to innovation and global reach, Nomura's IT department is well\-positioned to continue driving growth and success in the financial industry.  

**Role Description**
Reporting to Senior Principal Business Analyst, the Principal IT Risk \& Control Officer will be required to support the continued growth of its International Wealth Management (IWM) business in Asia, overseeing IT audit readiness and conducting reviews of all internal IT controls, frameworks, policies, and standards.  

The role will serve as the central coordination point between technology teams and internal/external stakeholders on IT risk, controls, and compliance matters. While the primary focus will be on IWM, the scope may expand to other business lines in the future.  

**Responsibilities**
* Overseeing IT audit readiness and conducting reviews of all internal IT controls, frameworks, policies, and standards.
* Managing engagement with external reviewers, including Financial Auditors, SOX assessors, and regulatory bodies (MAS, SFC, JFSA).
* Interpreting regulatory requirements — in particular the MAS Technology Risk Management (TRM) Guidelines, HKMA/SFC requirements, and JFSA standards — and translating them into operational actions, processes, and sustainable controls within the technology environment.
  

*IT Controls \& Governance*
* Review and ensure that IT controls and processes adhere to the standards and procedures established by the bank.
* Facilitate gap analyses for applications and systems that do not comply with internal standards, and drive remediation actions through to closure.
* Track process improvements and maintain a register of control enhancements, providing regular status updates to senior management.
* Document solutions, control decisions, and risk acceptances in a clear and auditable manner.
  

*Project Assurance*
* Perform internal due diligence checks across all technology projects based on the SDLC lifecycle, ensuring adherence to required procedures and successful completion of quality gates.
* Challenge and advise project teams on control requirements at each stage of delivery.
  

*Audit \& Regulatory Engagement*

* Liaise with Internal Audit, External Audit, and regulatory inspection teams, ensuring timely and accurate responses to information requests.
* Support the preparation and execution of SOX, MAS, SFC, and JFSA audits and inspections.
  

*Reporting \& Stakeholder Management*
* Produce regular senior management reporting covering the IT risk and control landscape, including open issues, remediation progress, and areas for improvement.
* Engage proactively with business and technology stakeholders to promote a strong control culture and awareness of regulatory expectations.

* Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.

* Excellent communication, presentation, and advisory skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical matters to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver under pressure in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and detail\-oriented with strong organisational skills.

description:
***About Sleek***

Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back\-office easy for micro SMEs.

We operate 3 business segments:


* **Corporate Secretary** : Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with \~5% market share of all new business incorporations
* **Accounting \& Bookkeeping:** Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
* **FinTech payments:** Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses
Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.


We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of \>70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.


Backed by world\-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech\-enabled unicorns based out of Singapore.


We are seeking highly collaborative penultimate year students to join our Community Team as Intern. Fresh Graduates are welcomed to apply.


**Mission:**

We’re on the lookout for a passionate and motivated individual.


***Community intern***

to elevate Sleek’s vibrant entrepreneur community to the next level. If you love building connections and driving engagement, we’d love to have you on board!


**Outcomes:**

**Community Management \& Growth**

* Moderate, manage and expand Sleek’s online entrepreneur communities.
* Develop and execute a regional community strategy to build and nurture the communities aligned with Sleek’s overall business goals.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and growth, launching bold initiatives to enhance engagement.

**Engage \& Empower**

* Build meaningful relationships with members and keep the conversation alive and buzzing.
* Create opportunities for members to connect, collaborate, and learn from each other
* Design and implement a community engagement strategy to encourage meaningful interactions among members.
* Be the go\-to support for members; respond to queries, solve challenges, and nurture trust.

**Create Impactful Experiences**

* Design and execute exciting online as well as offline events, campaigns, and sessions that resonate with our community.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to create valuable and engaging content.

**Measure \& Optimise**

* Use analytics to evaluate what’s working (and what’s not).
* Regularly analyse community growth, engagement, and feedback, producing actionable reports.
* Continuously refine strategies to drive community growth aligned with organisational objectives.

**What We’re Looking For?**

* A people\-first mindset with exceptional communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience in community management, marketing, or a related field.
* Proven ability to plan, execute, and measure the success of events and campaigns.
* Analytical skills with a data\-driven approach to decision\-making

***Requirements***

To be applicable for this role, you will need to be located in Singapore


***6\-month*** internship period.


* Bachelor's Degree and above (final year or fresh graduates).
* Familiarity with social platforms: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube.
* Ability to create simple creatives using Canva, CapCut, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of social media analytics and insights.
* **Using AI tools** to create content and videos.
* Willingness to learn and a curious mindset.
* Be highly collaborative, as the role will work closely with other department members on cross\-functional projects.
* Strong teamwork, organisational and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently; can prioritise and adjust tasks in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment.
* Good to have prior experience in community management, marketing, or a closely related field.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:


**Ownership and reliability:**

We take full responsibility for our work and outcomes. Ownership means proactively stepping up, following through on commitments, and seeing tasks through from start to finish without needing constant direction. Reliability is about being someone others can depend on—delivering consistently, meeting deadlines, and maintaining high standards. Together, this mindset builds trust within the team and ensures the community experience is always well\-supported and dependable.


**Humility:**

There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open\-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.


**People\-first mindset:**

We believe communities are built around people, not platforms. A people\-first mindset means genuinely caring about the experiences, needs, and growth of our members. It’s about listening actively, creating value for others, and always considering how our actions improve the community experience. This mindset helps build trust, belonging, and long\-term engagement.


**Analytical and data\-driven:**

We make decisions based on insights, not assumptions. Being analytical and data\-driven means using community metrics, feedback, and trends to understand what’s working and what isn’t. It helps us continuously improve engagement, optimise initiatives, and create more meaningful impact for our members and the business.


**Collaborative:**

We believe the best outcomes are achieved together. Collaboration means working openly across teams, sharing ideas, and leveraging diverse perspectives to build stronger communities. It encourages transparency, alignment, and collective ownership in delivering the best experience for our members.


**Can have tough conversations in a positive way:**

It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness build empathy, trust and great working relationships.


The interview process


The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.


Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.


**TA Introduction**

A \~30 minute chat with members of the HR Team, where they will give you some real\-life challenges that this role faces, and will ask for your approach to solving them.


**Soft Skills Assessment**

A \~45 minute chat with the hiring manager, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.


**Offers**

We’ll make a non\-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or video calls with references that you provide to us.


\+\+\+\+\+


**Requirement for background screening**

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.


This may include using external vendors to verify the below:


* Your education
* Any criminal history
* Any political exposure
* Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

title: APAC Partner Development Manager
description:
**About Supabase**
------------------


Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.  

  



**About the Role**
------------------


Supabase's Partnerships function spans several sub\-functions — Integration Partners, Solution Partners, Cloud, Marketplace, and Startups — each of which owns a global strategy for their area. We're looking for a Partner Development Manager, APAC to give those strategies a real presence in the region.


This is a generalist, region\-first role covering **all partner types**. Rather than owning a single function end\-to\-end, you'll work across all of them — combining new partner development with the activation of partnerships that already exist globally, wherever the region needs it most.


You'll join an established global partnerships team, working day\-to\-day with our function leads and APAC colleagues and reporting to the Head of Partnerships. You are the connection point between global partner strategy and the commercial, regulatory, and market realities of APAC.


This role is based in Singapore. Much of the work happens in person — building senior partner relationships, being present in the market, and capitalising on co\-selling and co\-marketing opportunities across the region. As regional partner volume grows, we expect the role to evolve and eventually specialise; you'll help shape what that looks like.  

  



**What You'll Own**
-------------------


**Regional Partner Development**


* Identify, prioritise, and close new partners across Integration, Solution, Cloud, Marketplace, and Startup motions where APAC coverage does not yet exist — including smaller regional solution partners and resellers where they open up the market.
* Build and maintain a regional pipeline of prospective partners across all functions.

**Partner Activation \& Enablement**


* Localise and activate globally\-sourced partnerships for the APAC market, including regional enablement, co\-selling, co\-marketing, and commercial terms where needed.
* Ensure existing partner programs and benefits translate correctly to APAC customers, partners, and startups.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**


* Work alongside each sub\-function lead to translate global strategy into regional execution.
* Flag where global partnership strategy does not fit APAC market conditions, and adapt it together with function leads.
* Represent Supabase at APAC partner and developer events, and build relationships with regional partner organisations.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* 5–10 years in partnerships, business development, or channel roles, with direct experience onboarding and running partnerships within APAC specifically.
* Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple partner motions — technology integrations, solution/SI, and startup ecosystem — without a single specialist playbook to rely on.
* Experience building a regional function within a company that was previously concentrated in another region.
* Strong commercial judgement across varied partner types and counterparties.
* Comfortable operating independently across a significant timezone gap from the core team, with clear judgement on what requires synchronous alignment.
* Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication — including the ability to make a clear case when regional realities diverge from global strategy.
* Background in developer tools, databases, or infrastructure software.
* An established, senior\-level network of partner connections in APAC — across technology vendors, systems integrators, and/or the startup ecosystem — that can be activated quickly, with the credibility to engage senior counterparts from day one.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Established relationships within AWS's APAC partner organisation (strongly preferred), or GCP/Azure equivalents.
* A second language relevant to the region (e.g. Mandarin, Japanese, Korean, or Bahasa Indonesia).

### **What We Offer**


* **Fully Remote**


We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co\-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
* **ESOP**


Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
* **Tech Allowance**


Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
* **Health Benefits**


Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
* **Annual Off\-Sites**


Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
* **Flexible Work**


We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
* **Professional Development**


Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

### **About the Team**


Supabase was born\-remote and open\-source\-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.


* \~400 team members
* 60\+ countries
* 20\+ languages spoken
* Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
* 540,000\+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open\-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

Much of the work happens in person — building senior partner relationships, being present in the market, and capitalising on co\-selling and co\-marketing opportunities across the region. As regional partner volume grows, we expect the role to evolve and eventually specialise; you'll help shape what that looks like.  

  



**What You'll Own**
-------------------


**Regional Partner Development**


* Identify, prioritise, and close new partners across Integration, Solution, Cloud, Marketplace, and Startup motions where EMEA coverage does not yet exist — including smaller regional solution partners and resellers where they open up the market.
* Build and maintain a regional pipeline of prospective partners across all functions.

**Partner Activation \& Enablement**


* Localise and activate globally\-sourced partnerships for the EMEA market, including regional enablement, co\-selling, co\-marketing, and commercial terms where needed.
* Ensure existing partner programs and benefits translate correctly to EMEA customers, partners, and startups.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**


* Work alongside each sub\-function lead to translate global strategy into regional execution.
* Flag where global partnership strategy does not fit EMEA market conditions, and adapt it together with function leads.
* Represent Supabase at EMEA partner and developer events, and build relationships with regional partner organisations.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* 5–10 years in partnerships, business development, or channel roles, with direct experience onboarding and running partnerships within EMEA specifically.
* Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple partner motions — technology integrations, solution/SI, and startup ecosystem — without a single specialist playbook to rely on.
* Experience building a regional function within a company that was previously concentrated in another region.
* Strong commercial judgement across varied partner types and counterparties.
* Comfortable operating independently across a significant timezone gap from the core team, with clear judgement on what requires synchronous alignment.
* Background in developer tools, databases, or infrastructure software.
* An established, senior\-level network of partner connections in EMEA — across technology vendors, systems integrators, and/or the startup ecosystem — that can be activated quickly, with the credibility to engage senior counterparts from day one.
* Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication — including the ability to make a clear case when regional realities diverge from global strategy.

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Established relationships within AWS's EMEA partner organisation (strongly preferred), or GCP/Azure equivalents.
* A second language relevant to the region (e.g. French, German, Spanish, Arabic).

### **What We Offer**


* **Fully Remote**


We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co\-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
* **ESOP**


Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
* **Tech Allowance**


Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
* **Health Benefits**


Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
* **Annual Off\-Sites**


Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
* **Flexible Work**


We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
* **Professional Development**


Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

### **About the Team**


Supabase was born\-remote and open\-source\-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.


* \~400 team members

### **Role Summary**

The Project Engineer is responsible for leading the planning, coordination and execution of network construction and deployment activities for large\-scale data centre fit\-out projects.
  

  

Reporting to the Project Manager, this site\-focused role combines construction delivery with hands\-on network deployment expertise. The Project Engineer provides technical leadership and guidance to Site Engineers, Site Supervisors, subcontractors and installation teams, ensuring network infrastructure is installed in accordance with approved designs, industry best practices and project quality standards.
  

  

The ideal candidate will come from a network installation contractor, structured cabling contractor, telecommunications contractor or systems integrator background with practical experience delivering network infrastructure projects.  

  



**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead construction delivery of structured cabling, fibre optic infrastructure, rack and cabinet installation, cable containment and network equipment deployment.
* Develop construction execution plans, installation methodologies, daily work plans and weekly look\-ahead schedules aligned with the project master schedule.
* Manage construction execution across the 4M (Manpower, Materials, Methods and Machinery).
* Lead Site Engineers, Site Supervisors and subcontractors to deliver works safely, efficiently and to programme.
* Review construction drawings, rack elevations, fibre routing plans, cable schedules, port maps and technical documentation to ensure buildability.
* Manage RFIs, technical queries, design clarifications and field changes.
* Monitor construction productivity, quality, safety, schedule and cost performance.
* Coordinate inspections, testing, commissioning support and project handover activities.
* Prepare progress reports, risk registers, recovery plans and management updates.
* Coordinate interfaces with Network Engineering, MEP, Civil, Architectural, Security, BMS/DCIM and Operations teams.

Technical Leadership


* Act as the primary technical authority for network installation activities during construction.
* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to Site Engineers, Site Supervisors and installation teams.
* Interpret network drawings, rack elevations, cable routing plans and installation standards for field execution.
* Review installation methodologies and ensure deployment complies with OEM and project standards.
