**About Supabase**
------------------


Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.


Start in minutes with a fully managed, scalable Postgres database and a suite of tools that eliminate the complexity of backend development. Use one or use all—Supabase gives teams the flexibility of open source with the speed and simplicity of a modern platform, so they can move fast without sacrificing control.


**About the Role**
------------------


We’re looking for a **Strategic Partner Manager** to join our team to build and scale Supabase's integration partner ecosystem, including AI Builder partnerships.


You'll own a focused portfolio of high\-impact partners across developer tooling, AI builders, and adjacent infrastructure categories. This role is highly execution\-oriented: you'll work directly with partners to ship integrations, launch joint GTM motions, and drive measurable adoption, pipeline, and revenue.


This is a high\-visibility IC role with direct impact on product adoption, ecosystem expansion, and revenue. You'll be expected to operate with a lot of ownership and little process at the start. If you enjoy writing the playbook and running it in\-market, this role will be a good fit.


**What You’ll Be Responsible for**
----------------------------------


### **Partner Strategy \& Ownership**


* **Own and grow** a portfolio of strategic technology and platform partners.
* **Develop and execute** joint GTM plans with defined KPIs (0 to 1 in wins, ARR, pipeline, integrations, adoption).
* **Execute expansion opportunities** including co\-marketing events, co\-sell motions, and joint GTM initiatives.

### **Revenue \& Pipeline Development**


* **Drive sourced and influenced pipeline** through partner relationships.
* **Enable Sales teams** with partner positioning, playbooks, and introductions.
* **Collaborate with partners** on co\-selling opportunities and enterprise deals.

### **Cross\-Functional Execution \& Management**


* **Work closely with Product and Engineering** on integration roadmaps and technical alignment.
* **Coordinate co\-marketing initiatives** with Marketing (launches, webinars, hackathons, case studies, events).
* **Support partner enablement** through training, documentation, and ongoing engagement.
* **Build strong relationships** across all levels within the partner organization (from Product/Eng to SA to executives).
* **Track and report** on partner performance metrics (ARR, usage, activation, pipeline) while maintaining accurate forecasting and partnership health dashboards.

**You Might Be a Good Fit If You**
----------------------------------


* Have **\~5 years of experience** in partnerships, business development, or platform strategy at a developer tools, cloud, or infrastructure company.
* Possess a **strong understanding** of developer ecosystems and modern data / infra stacks.
* Have **demonstrated experience shipping integrations** and growing them post\-launch.
* Have experience **owning partners end\-to\-end**: sourcing, technical alignment, negotiation, launch, and growth.
* Are **commercially minded** and comfortable with deal structures, revenue models, forecasting, and KPIs.
* Are a **clear, concise communicator** who can align Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.
* Are a **highly organized operator** who can build programs from scratch and iterate quickly.
* Are **data\-driven, outcome\-oriented**, and comfortable operating in ambiguity within a fast\-moving, open\-source\-first startup environment.

### **What We Offer**


* **Fully Remote**


We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co\-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
* **ESOP**


Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
* **Tech Allowance**


Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
* **Health Benefits**


Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
* **Annual Off\-Sites**


Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
* **Flexible Work**


We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
* **Professional Development**


Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

### **About the Team**


Supabase was born\-remote and open\-source\-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.


* \~400 team members
* 60\+ countries
* 20\+ languages spoken
* Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
* 540,000\+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open\-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

description:
**About us**
------------


At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world's largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.


The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.


We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society's evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together.

**ExxonMobil in Singapore**
---------------------------


ExxonMobil is one of Singapore’s largest foreign manufacturing investors with over S$25 billion in fixed asset investments.

  

  

We have manufacturing facilities that include an integrated world\-scale refining and petrochemical complex in Jurong and Jurong Island, a network of service stations under the Esso brand, operate a lubricant plant and are a supplier of cylinder cooking gas. ExxonMobil provides customers and commercial markets in the region with ground transportation, industrial, aviation and marine fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals and liquefied natural gas (LNG).

  

As Singapore serves as the AP hub for some of our businesses, we employ about 3,500 people across positions in operations, projects, commercial, corporate support functions and others.

  

ExxonMobil also contributes to community programs in Singapore that support the arts, education, health and the environment.

  

For more information, visit **www.exxonmobil.com.sg** or follow ExxonMobil Singapore on LinkedIn and Instagram.

ExxonMobil Global Trading is where we trade oil, natural gas, and energy products safely and responsibly around the world. We leverage our expertise in analytics, logistics, origination, and knowledge of energy markets to maximize the value of our global assets and deliver industry\-leading results.

  

This is an exciting time to join our growing trading team and be an integral part of ExxonMobil.

**What role you will play in the team**

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic team within Global Trading at ExxonMobil. The ideal candidate will possess a robust understanding of both front\-end and back\-end development, with a strong emphasis on creating and maintaining scalable, high\-performance applications. This role requires a professional who can seamlessly integrate into our team, contributing to the development of innovative solutions that drive our trading operations.

* Develop and maintain web applications using modern frameworks and technologies
* Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

* Experience with database management systems such as SQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB.
* Familiarity with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external customers
* Innovative and analytical thinking
* Ability to manage workload under time pressure and changing priorities
* Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and methodologies

 **Preferred Qualifications/ Experience**

* Experience in the oil and gas industry, particularly within trading operations, is highly desirable.
* Understanding of market data, trading systems, and financial instruments related to oil and gas.
* Certifications in relevant technologies or methodologies.
* Proven experience in building, operating, and supporting robust and performant databases and data pipelines
* Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with database management systems
* Solid understanding of data modelling, indexing, and query optimization techniques
* Proficient in at least one programming language (Python preferred)
* Experience with front\-end frameworks/libraries (React preferred)
* Familiarity with database systems. Full\-stack development experience is helpful
* Experience with Databricks and Snowflake
* Solid understanding of web performance optimization, security, and best practices.


**Your benefits**
-----------------


An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last and we provide job rotations throughout your career with us. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance, and life.  

  

Currently our employees benefits include: Long Term Savings Allowance, dental reimbursement, annual health checkups and Home Ownership Assistance Plan amongst others and these are updated from time to time.

--------------------------

* Learn more at our website
* Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram
* Like us on Facebook
* Subscribe our channel at YouTube

Lead risk and incident management across the region—establishing processes that enable early identification, clear ownership, timely escalation, and effective remediation.
  
Financial \& Resource Stewardship
  
Own regional financial management and governance, including accurate forecasting, financial transparency, and robust budget oversight.
  
Ensure effective resource alignment and capability deployment across the region, coordinating cross\-location delivery to meet account objectives efficiently.
  
Process Standardization \& Transparency
  
Drive structured process management discipline—ensuring SOPs, reporting templates, and operating practices are documented, consistent, regularly updated, and implemented at scale.
  
Embed common data standards, reporting formats, and methodologies across all locations to reduce complexity, cost, and risk while enabling effective oversight.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities (KSA)
  
Minimum 15 years’ experience in real estate services, with deep expertise in Facilities Account Management and working knowledge of Transaction Management, Project Management, Strategic Portfolio Management, Lease Administration, Workplace Strategy, and Employee Experience.
  
Proven track record managing complex, multi\-country IFM accounts, including P\&L responsibility across multiple geographies.

Experience balancing client expectations with firm profitability while maintaining trust, transparency, and mutual value creation.

description:
Headquartered in Tokyo, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (SMBC) is a leading global financial institution and a core member of Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (SMBC Group). **Data Governance*** Set the strategic direction and provide executive sponsorship for the enterprise\-wide adoption and continuous enhancement of BCBS 239 principles, ensuring governance frameworks, risk management practices, and control environments support the Bank's regulatory and business objectives.
* Establish and govern the enterprise Data Governance, Data Risk, Data Quality and Data Control operating model in partnership with the Enterprise Chief Data Office, ensuring consistent implementation of policies, standards, and accountability across the organization.
* Define and oversee the multi\-year Data Governance strategy and transformation roadmap, ensuring alignment with business priorities, regulatory expectations, investment decisions, and enterprise capabilities.
* Provide leadership and oversight for Data Governance and Data Management functions, building organizational capability, developing future leaders, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior management and governance committees on data governance matters, influencing strategic decisions and promoting data as a critical enterprise asset.
* Partner with executive stakeholders across business, technology, risk, compliance, and operations to drive enterprise\-wide governance initiatives and embed data management considerations into strategic planning and business transformation programmes, including implementation and maintenance of data quality(DQ) rules, DQ systems, provision of data awareness and data culture programs etc.
* Establish executive\-level governance reporting and performance frameworks, ensuring appropriate oversight of governance maturity, regulatory compliance, data quality outcomes, risk exposure, and value realization.
* Champion the strategic use of data and analytics to support business growth, operational excellence, client outcomes, risk management, and enterprise decision\-making.
* Provide effective challenge and oversight of data\-related risks arising from business strategies, transformation programmes, and regulatory developments, ensuring appropriate governance, escalation, and remediation of material issues.
* Drive alignment and consensus among senior stakeholders across regions and business functions, influencing strategic priorities and securing executive sponsorship for key data initiatives.
* Oversee a portfolio of strategic Data Governance programmes, ensuring effective governance, disciplined execution, resource optimization, and delivery of measurable business and regulatory outcomes.

**AI Governance*** Define and champion the enterprise\-wide AI Governance vision, strategy, and operating model , establishing governance principles, policies, standards, and oversight mechanisms to ensure the responsible, ethical, secure, and compliant adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Generative AI technologies across the organization.
* Provide executive oversight and governance of AI risk management and model governance frameworks , ensuring robust lifecycle controls, validation standards, monitoring practices, explainability, accountability, bias management, and compliance with evolving regulatory and industry requirements.
* Partner with senior business, technology, risk, compliance, legal, and data leaders to establish governance structures for the evaluation, approval, and ongoing oversight of AI initiatives, ensuring appropriate risk management, control effectiveness, and alignment with the Bank's strategic objectives .
* Chair or sponsor AI Governance forums and decision\-making bodies , providing effective challenge , oversight, and strategic direction on AI\-related risks, opportunities, and investments.
* Represent the organization on AI Governance matters with regulators, auditors, and executive management , ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations, industry best practices, and emerging AI governance requirements.
* Establish executive\-level AI Governance reporting and performance frameworks , monitoring AI adoption, compliance, risk exposure, model effectiveness, and business value realization while providing strategic insights and recommendations to senior leadership and governance committees.
* Drive enterprise\-wide awareness and adoption of responsible AI practices , fostering a culture of accountability, transparency, and ethical AI use across business and technology functions.

**Key Qualifications*** + 12\-15\+ years of progressive leadership experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Data Risk, Data Strategy, or related disciplines within the banking or financial services industry, including experience leading enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives and managing senior stakeholders.
	+ Deep expertise in BCBS 239 and related regulatory requirements, with a proven track record of defining and leading large\-scale Data Governance transformation programmes within complex, global financial institutions.
	+ Extensive knowledge of Data Governance frameworks, Data Operating Models, Data Risk Management, AI Governance, and regulatory compliance practices, with the ability to shape and influence enterprise\-wide governance strategies.
	+ Proven success in leading large, multidisciplinary teams and complex organizational change programmes, driving strategic outcomes, strengthening organizational capabilities, and fostering a high\-performance culture.
	+ Strong strategic thinking, business analysis, and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate evolving business, regulatory, and technology priorities into sustainable governance frameworks and operating models.
	+ Exceptional executive presence, communication, and influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to engage Board members, senior executives, regulators, and governance committees, negotiate priorities, and drive enterprise\-wide alignment.
	+ Strong commercial and analytical acumen, with experience leveraging data, analytics, and emerging technologies to enable business growth, improve operational effectiveness, and support strategic decision\-making.
	+ Demonstrated ability to lead through complexity and ambiguity, balancing multiple strategic priorities while maintaining strong governance, risk management, and execution discipline.
	+ High degree of integrity, sound judgment, and leadership maturity, with a strong commitment to regulatory excellence, responsible governance, ethical decision\-making, and organizational transformation.
	+ Experience engaging with regulators, auditors, and external stakeholders on Data Governance, Data Risk, BCBS 239, AI Governance, and enterprise control matters is highly desirable.

title: Product Manager | Service Interactions
description:
About GoTymeX
GoTymeX is the product, technology and data analytics hub of GoTyme Group. At GoTymeX, we're reimagining digital banking across emerging markets, across South Africa and Asia.


Our mission is to unlock human potential, and we aim to do so through the development of transformative financial services that empower individuals and small businesses. We believe in the power of digital in building products that our employees and customers love.


About the Service Interactions product team
The Service Interactions team owns every channel through which customers connect with their bank, and the intelligence layer that makes those connections smarter over time.


We sit within GoTymeX's Customer Service Experience portfolio, operating as a Group function across both GoTyme Bank (South Africa) and GoTyme Bank (Philippines).


We make conscious decisions to keep service access simple and intuitive and help them move up the digital adoption curve where needed.


Part service designers, channel strategists and AI pragmatists; we're a cross\-functional team of product, engineering, analysis, and design people spread across the globe, united by a shared belief that the best service interaction is the one that leaves a customer feeling genuinely looked after.


Why work with GoTymeX* Innovation\-driven environment: Reinvention of processes, incorporating the structure and safety of explainable business processes, incorporating AI.
* International and collaborative culture: Be part of a dynamic team that values collaboration,  

continuous learning, and personal growth.
* Competitive benefits: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, opportunities for professional  

development (see below).
* Learning and development: Access to technical seminars, conferences, career talks, and  

overseas training to accelerate your career advancement and ensure continuous growth.
* Impactful work: Contribute to projects that directly influence financial empowerment and  

access in emerging markets.


About the Role
We're looking for a senior **Product Manager** who brings real depth in service interaction design. You’ve wrestled with the nuance of a conversational flow, understood when a self\-service needs a graceful exit to a helpful human, and who genuinely cares about the difference between an interaction that just closes and one that leaves a customer feeling looked after.


This is a Group role, spanning both GoTyme Bank (Philippines) and TymeBank (South Africa), with ownership of the product roadmap and outcomes across both markets.


The right person has navigated both the fast\-moving world of AI\-first service technologies and the operational reality of cloud contact centre environments. They understand that platform knowledge is not product strategy, and that a truly great service interaction often happens without the customer noticing the technology behind it at all.


This role works closely with adjacent product teams in the CSE portfolio — including those responsible for case management, service fulfilment workflows, and operations tooling — to ensure that the space between a service interaction and its resolution is as seamless as the conversation itself.


What you’ll be doing
Working closely with business colleagues, design and product engineering teams to shape and manage a vision of intuitive self\-service and AI\-assisted digital servicing interactions across several servicing channels, while ensuring that every touchpoint still requiring a human feels like it was worth the conversation. This role owns the full spectrum of the crafting the experience, how that gets built and how it performs.

* Craft customer self\-Service journeysthrough our In\-app and, Kiosk Help Centre, growing the resolution before any agent is involved
* Enable digital messaging across In\-app chat and WhatsApp (via platforms such as Twilio) and any other channels customers feel at home, including AI\-assisted service conversation management.
* Orchestrate inbound customer email management, auto\-response frameworks, routing, and resolution workflows
* Optimise inbound and outbound call routing and IVR design (contact centre platforms such as Genesys Cloud CX or AWS Connect)

**Product ownership \& delivery**

* Own and prioritize the group's Service Interactions backlog across both markets, with clear rationale balancing Group objectives and in\-country urgency
* Lead sprint ceremonies (refinement, planning, reviews, retrospectives) with the engineering, BA, and design team
* Define and iterate on the product roadmap in collaboration with the Director of Product, aligned to Group strategic objectives and in\-country OKR targets
* Hold the Definition of Done across all product delivery outputs and own release readiness
* Track and report on product\-level OKRs: CSAT, digital channel adoption, self\-service resolution, cost to serve per active customer, and NPS

**Service interactions strategy**

* Own the Group\-level strategy and platform performance for how customers interact with GoTymeX banks balancing digital\-first ambition with the realities of customer adoption curves in each market
* Use operational and semantic data signals like Voice of Customer (VOC) to surfacing service drivers to inform product decisions, operational management, and Group\-level service insights.
* Evaluate emerging interaction technologies and AI platforms, bringing external thinking and competitive benchmarks into product direction and roadmap.

**Operational support and advisory**

* Serve as a Group Lead and Thought Leader to customer service operations leadership in\-country on best\-in class service interactions, contact center management and service operations \- not just delivering features, but leading Service Interactions across the Group as a single business operations team.
* Provide observability tooling, dashboards, and data insights that help operations managers make better decisions about their teams, channels, and service levels
* Identify and drivee changes to operating models, agent workflows, routing strategies, and headcount planning where product capability unlocks a better approach

**Stakeholder management and group collaboration**

* Proven ability to influence, lead, align, and hold accountability across product, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders and senior executives in a complex multi\-market environment.

**Innovation and continuous improvement**

* Champion AI\-first service experiences — from intelligent deflection and self\-service to AI\-assisted agent tools and real\-time VOC intelligence
* Define clear hypotheses and learning objectives for new features; ensure analytics and interaction tagging coverage is in place to validate them
* Actively source new ideas from inside and outside financial services; bring competitive and emerging technology perspectives into the product

 **Benefits**  

  

What you bring**You must have:**

* Minimum 5 years of product ownership or product management experience, with at least 3 years in the service interactions, customer service, or contact centre domain
* Demonstrated experience leading through influence rather than authority with a track record of mobilising cross\-functional teams, driving decisions, and holding accountability in complex organisational environments where direct line management is not the primary tool available.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience aligning product, engineering, and business perspectives in a complex multi\-market environment
* Demonstrated product delivery across at least two of: voice/IVR, digital messaging (chat or WhatsApp), email management, self\-service or help centre
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-centric service platforms (such as Google CCAI, LivePerson, or equivalent LLM\-based conversation platforms) and traditional CCaaS platforms (such as Genesys Cloud CX or AWS Connect)
* A solid working understanding of traditional and outcomes focussed contact centre operational metrics such as CSAT, CES, first contact resolution, WFM, and cost to serve sufficient to credibly advise and challenge CS operations leadership
* Strong analytical mindset with demonstrated ability to make data\-driven prioritisation decisions and track feature impact through well\-defined metrics
* Fluency in English; comfort operating across cultures and time zones
* Experience in retail financial services or digital banking

**It would be great if you also had:**

* Experience working with or alongside CRM and case management platforms (eg: Pega Customer Service, Service Now, Camunda or Appian) as part of a broader service interaction delivery stack
* Multi\-country or Group\-level product delivery experience, particularly across markets with different channel maturity and customer digital adoption profiles
* Familiarity with WhatsApp Business API (BSP model, template messaging, conversational flows)
* Exposure to conversation intelligence and VOC tooling (sentiment analysis, topic modelling, interaction analytics)
* Experience influencing or co\-designing contact centre operating models, not just the technology layer
* Familiarity with WFM tools and contact centre capacity planning methodologies
* Experience mentoring junior product or BA colleagues


Education* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* A product management qualification (CSPO, SAFe PO/PM, or equivalent) is advantageous
* Relevant professional certifications in CX or contact centre disciplines (CCXP, COPC, or equivalent) are a plus


Compensation and benefits* Competitive salary that recognizes your talent and potential
* Performance\-based bonus, including stock\-based incentives for high performers
* Conferences and expert\-led training to accelerate your career

description:
The Smart Nation Group – Digital Government (SNDG), under the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI), is at the forefront of the Singapore Government’s digital transformation. We shape and implement strategies and policies to achieve our vision of a Digital Government that is Digital to the core, and serves with heart. This includes building long\-term digital capabilities for the public sector, driving innovation across Government agencies, and ensuring digital services are user\-centric, secure and resilient.


The Government Data Division (GDD) within SNDG plays a central policymaking role in advancing data governance excellence across the public sector. Its responsibilities include:


(a) formulating and implementing whole\-of\-government (WOG) data policies that guide the strategic management, sharing, and utilisation of data as a national asset;


(b) identifying and driving new initiatives to improve the exchange of data within Government agencies, and sharing of Government data with commercial partners and the public; and


(c) strengthening data governance by developing policies relating to responsible use of data, as well as driving the development of capabilities, institutionalizing structures and standardising tools for WOG.


We want a change maker who has experience in policymaking, and is collaborative in stakeholder management. Experience in data management, governance or related domains will also be helpful.


You must be ready to roll up your sleeves and rally different teams across Government agencies to achieve SNG’s vision of a public sector that is ‘data driven to the core’. This includes enabling Government agencies to use data to create solutions that benefit citizens and businesses, while ensuring the responsible use of data.


You will be part of a team at the forefront of transforming Government data and driving the next bound of the whole\-of\-Government data ecosystem, through policy formulation and development of key systems and structures. Your work will involve one or more of the following areas:

* **Policy Development and Implementation**. Formulate and implement key data policies across whole\-of\-Government, that cover data governance, data sharing policies, data classification frameworks, treatment and protection of personal data, as well as the accompanying legislative frameworks.
* **Stakeholder Engagement**. Work closely with agencies to understand their use cases and governance context, and drive implementation. Provide advice on policies and measures, including arbitrating between competing needs where necessary.
* **Ecosystem Development**. Design and implement the next bound of the Government data ecosystem, to supercharge data sharing and usage across whole\-of\-Government to enable agencies’ use cases in policy, operations and service delivery, while ensuring good data governance. This entails the following work:
* Conceptualising a whole value chain perspective of the data ecosystem, including how the pieces should come together to best facilitate the sharing and usage of data underpinned by proper governance frameworks.
* Developing the system\-level roles and responsibilities that agencies need to play, as part of the broader data value chain perspective.

We are an industry leader in cybersecurity with over two decades of experience, we deliver a holistic suite of trusted cybersecurity solutions to empower cyber resilience for government and ministries, critical infrastructure, and commercial enterprises. Backed by our indigenous capabilities and deep domain expertise, we offer robust cyber\-secure products and services in cryptography, cybersecurity engineering, digital authentication, SCADA protection, audit and compliance. We specialise in the design and build of security operations centres for cybersecurity professionals and provide managed security services to strengthen the cybersecurity posture of our government and enterprise customers.
  
  

Role Overview
  
  

We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Assistant Marketing Manager to support the Head of Cyber Marketing in driving the organisation's brand visibility, demand generation, and stakeholder engagement initiatives. The successful candidate will play a key role in planning and executing digital campaigns, organising corporate events and visits, and producing high\-quality marketing collateral that reinforces the company's positioning in the cybersecurity space.
  
  

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys hands\-on execution, and can manage multiple work streams simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail and brand consistency.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

1\. Digital Campaigns
  
  

Support the planning, execution, and optimization of digital marketing campaigns across channels (LinkedIn, EDM, website, paid media, etc.)
  
Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external agencies/vendors on campaign timelines, content, and creative assets
  
Monitor campaign performance metrics (engagement, leads, reach, CTR) and prepare regular reporting with actionable insights
  
Assist in managing marketing automation tools, email marketing platforms, and CRM data hygiene related to campaigns
  
Support SEO/SEM and social media content calendars in alignment with overall marketing strategy
  
  

2\. Event Execution
  
  

Plan and execute end\-to\-end logistics for corporate events, trade shows, seminars, and webinars, including venue coordination, vendor management, and on\-site/virtual execution
  
Develop event timelines, and checklists to ensure smooth delivery
  
Liaise with internal business units, speakers, and external partners to align event objectives and content
  
Manage event budgets and track expenditure against approved plans
  
Conduct post\-event evaluation, including attendee feedback, ROI analysis, and lessons\-learned documentation
  
  

3\. Corporate Visits
  
  

Coordinate logistics for corporate visits, client delegations, and VIP engagements, including scheduling, briefing materials, and on\-site hosting arrangements
  
Prepare welcome decks, briefing notes, and company overview materials tailored to visiting delegations
  
Work closely with cross\-functional teams (business development, operations, security) to ensure seamless visit experiences
  
  

4\. Marketing Collaterals
  
  

Design and produce marketing collaterals such as brochures, corporate profiles, case studies, presentation decks, banners, and digital assets
  
Ensure all collaterals adhere to brand guidelines and maintain consistency across touchpoints
  
Collaborate with designers, copywriters, and external agencies where required to deliver polished, on\-brand materials
  
Maintain and organize a central repository of up\-to\-date marketing collaterals for internal and external use
  
  

5\. Vendor \& Team Oversight
  
  

Vet and review work submitted by the team, external agencies, designers, and vendors (e.g., creative concepts, campaign assets, event proposals) to ensure quality, accuracy, and alignment with brand and business objectives before sign\-off
  
Assess vendor/agency proposals, quotations, and past portfolios during the selection process to ensure value\-for\-money and fit with project requirements
  
Provide clear feedback and direction to the team and external parties to ensure deliverables meet required standards and timelines
  
Supervise, guide, and mentor junior marketing executives, interns, or ad\-hoc project staff, including delegating tasks, reviewing work quality, and supporting their professional development
  
Manage team workflows and priorities to ensure timely delivery of marketing initiatives, stepping in to unblock issues as needed
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Education \& Experience
  
  

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in marketing, events, or communications
* Experience in B2B marketing, technology, defence, or cybersecurity sectors is an advantage
* Prior experience vetting or managing the output of external agencies/vendors, and reviewing creative or campaign deliverables for quality and brand fit
* Proven experience leading or supervising a team (direct reports, interns, or project\-based staff), including task delegation, performance guidance, and workflow management


Skills \& Competencies
  
  

* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines
* Proficiency in design tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) and Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word)
* Familiarity with digital marketing platforms (LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, EDM tools such as Salesforce/Pardot) is a plus
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail
* Ability to work collaboratively across departments and with external vendors/agencies
* Comfortable with occasional travel and work outside standard hours for events


Personal Attributes
  
  

* Self\-motivated, resourceful, and able to work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
* Creative mindset with a keen eye for brand consistency and quality
* Adaptable and able to thrive in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment

As Hitachi Rail GTS, we are advancing rail signalling and safety solutions to ensure safe and efficient railway operations worldwide.


Our technologies help to bring billions of people reliably to their destinations by rail every year – making sustainable mobility a reality.


**System Assurance Manager (Ref.No. R1012182\)**

**at our location in Singapore**

**You will enjoy having these responsibilities:**

This System Assurance Manager is reporting directly to the Head of Technical Safety.


The System Assurance Manager is responsible for enforcing the safety strategy, developing and continuously improving safety methodologies, execution of Safety Engineering activities in accordance with the company’s process, applicable industry standards, best practices and sharing expert knowledge.


* Ensure RAMS Engineering activities are executed in accordance with the company’s process, applicable industry standards and best practices
* Provide leadership and training to the project RAMS team
* Perform hazard identification studies (HAZID, HAZOP), hazard analyses (PHA, SHA, OSHA, FTA), safety analyses (FFMEA, FMECA, FSA) and hazard management

* Review safety test strategies, plans, procedures, scenarios and test results;
* Review Installation, Cut\-in / Cut\-out, T\&C, and Deployment method statements;
* Review the adequacy and completeness of safety evidence and produce safety artefacts;
* Ensure effective communication of Safe Operating Requirements (SORs) to Customer;
* Perform RAM analyses and manage RAM demonstration;
* Be the interfacing point with Customer, external and internal parties for project RAMS coordination and reporting;
* Maintain KPI on RAMS activities including: Quality, Cost and Deadlines;
* Other tasks as assigned by the direct manager.

**You have:**

* B.Sc. in Engineering Fields of Electrical, Electronic, Computer Science, or related discipline
* Minimum 10 years of experience in RAMS Engineering on railway safety\-related systems, preferrable SIL2 systems and above.
* Good knowledge of CENELEC (EN) Railway RAMS Standards
* Good knowledge of railway signalling principles and CBTC system
* Good understanding of systems engineering, software engineering and functional safety
* Good technical writing skills, excellent communication and analytical skills; excellent command of the English language, both written and oral

Preferred Qualifications:


* M.Sc. in Engineering Fields of Electrical, Electronic, Computer Science, or related discipline
* At least 5 years of RAMS experience on CBTC system, or in various Design \& Engineering (System, HW and/or SW), Integration, Testing, Verification and/or Validation role of CBTC system.
* Working knowledge of Communications\-Based Train Control (CBTC) and/or Solid\-State Interlocking (SSI)
* Member of Institution of Railway Signal Engineers (IRSE)

**Our Talent Acquisition Team is looking forward to hearing from you**

We look forward to receiving your application in just a few clicks via our career portal.


For further information about Hitachi Rail as an employer visit us on www.hitachirail.com/careers

Our projects are diverse. To make our teams even stronger, we are looking for your support. In return, we offer you an attractive overall package with the following benefits:

* **Our drive:** Together, we are laying the foundations for the digitization of the rail around the world, to get people safely to their destinations and to their loved ones!

title: Technical Lead
description:
### **About Endowus**


Endowus is an award\-winning, independent fee\-only wealth platform licensed in Singapore (MAS 101051\) and Hong Kong (SFC BQR225\). We serve over **300,000 clients**—individuals, family offices, charities, and institutions—with over **US$12 billion** in assets under advice.


Our mission: help people invest better so they can live easier today, and better tomorrow. Today, we work with 100\+ global leading asset managers across major asset classes – public markets, private markets, hedge funds and alternatives – and make it our job to assess and access their Best\-in\-Class funds, and advise clients on how to invest in these funds to reach their goals.


Our mission is clear: help people invest better so they can live easier today, and better tomorrow. The team has deep domain knowledge in finance and technology, bringing together decades of experience from various banks and tech companies. We treasure our diversity in background and experience, and we look for people who share these beliefs in our mission.

### **The Opportunity**


We are seeking a hands\-on **Technical Architect** to define \& develop the technical vision \& implementation approach for our most ambitious projects, such as **Retirement Solutions**.


In this role, you will hold strategic responsibility for project architecture, looking beyond immediate feature delivery to design scalable, resilient systems capable of handling complex financial workflows. Acting as the bridge between business goals and engineering execution, you will ensure our technical choices support long\-term scalability \& stability while adhering to strict regulatory standards.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Design System Architecture:** Translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable technical designs for the retirement vertical.
* **Drive Technical Strategy:** Make high\-level decisions on technology stacks and integration patterns (Build vs. Buy) to ensure long\-term viability.
* **Ensure Compliance:** Embed security and regulatory requirements (e.g., MAS TRM) into the architecture from the start to ensure system resilience.
* **Drive Implementation:** Ensure that the code delivered matches the architectural vision and quality standards.
* **Manage Technical Debt:** Proactively identify bottlenecks and create roadmaps to address tech OKRs.
* **Mentor Engineers:** Provide technical guidance to senior engineers, helping them develop their architectural thinking and design skills.

### **What You'll Bring**

**The Must\-Haves:**

* **8\+ Years of Experience:** Significant experience in software engineering and system architecture, specifically within FinTech, Banking, or complex enterprise systems.
* **Architectural Expertise:** Proven ability to design microservices, event\-driven architectures, and scalable cloud\-native solutions (AWS/GCP).
* **Strategic Problem Solving:** Ability to frame ambiguous technical problems and develop long\-term roadmaps that align with business goals.
* **Tech Stack: Expert level fluency in a JVM language such as Scala, Java, or Kotlin. Strong experience with Cassandra, Kafka, and relational databases.**
* **Operational Maturity:** Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, and site reliability engineering (SRE) principles.
* **Communication:** Ability to explain complex architectural concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and drive consensus across cross\-functional teams.
* **Security Focus:** Deep knowledge of secure coding practices and data protection standards required for regulated financial institutions.

**The Nice\-to\-Haves:**

* Experience designing systems for **Pension Administration, Ledger Management, Portfolio Management or Payments**.
* **Hands\-on Scala/Akka Experience:** You have used Akka Streams or Akka Cluster in production.
* **Event Sourcing/CQRS:** You have built systems where state is derived from a log of events.

### **Our Tech Stack**

* **Backend:** Written in **Scala/Akka.** We are heavy users of **DDD, Event Sourcing,** and **CQRS.** APIs are tested using Cucumber\-Scala.
* **Data \& Messaging:** We use **Kafka** for async communication between services. **Cassandra** is our transactional database \& **PostgreSQL** is our read\-side database. Our data lake is built using **Spark/Athena.**
* **Frontend:** The web app is in **TypeScript/React** (e2e tested with Playwright). The mobile app is in **Dart/Flutter** (tested with flutter\_test \& Maestro).
* **Ops**: We are 100% cloud\-native (AWS) and rely heavily on **CI/CD \& IaC** for automated deployments \& operations.

**Want to look under the hood?** Read how we solve distributed systems challenges on our Engineering Blog at https://build.endowus.com/

### **Why Endowus?**

* **Modern Stack, Serious Business:** You get to apply a cutting\-edge stack (Scala, K8s) to mission\-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top\-tier private bank with the agility of a startup.
* **World\-Class Engineering Talent:** You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Goldman Sachs, Google, Grab, JPMorgan, Meta, Redmart and Shopee. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture.
* **Career Growth with Upside:** We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high\-talent team (\~85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category.
* **Leadership Pedigree:** Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more.

### **Why NOT Endowus?**


We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment.

* **You prefer highly structured environments:** If you do your best work when given a detailed roadmap and specific tasks to execute, you might find our level of autonomy stressful. We rely on engineers to help define the "what," not just the "how."
* **You prefer a "Move Fast and Break Things" culture:** We move fast, but we manage people's life savings. If you view writing tests or rigorous code reviews as bureaucratic slowdowns, you will likely feel frustrated by our safety culture.
* **You prefer deep specialization:** If you want to focus 100% on coding a specific component and leave infrastructure, QA, operations, or product decisions to others, this role may feel too broad. We need owners who can wear multiple hats.
* **You want 100% Remote:** We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in\-person collaboration.

### **The Interview Process**


We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient.

* Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission.
* Online Coding Assessment (60 min): A hands\-on coding challenge to assess your problem\-solving fundamentals.
* Technical Deep Dive (60 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus equally on code \& communication \- we want to get a feel for what it’ll be like coding everyday next to you.
* System Design (60 min): We talk Architecture, DDD, and how you handle data consistency at scale.
* Culture \& Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match.

### **Our Investors, recognition, licensing**


Founded in 2017, Endowus has raised over US$130 million from investors including UBS, EDBI, Prosus Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Citi Ventures, MUFG Innovation Partners, Singtel Innov8, Samsung Ventures, SBVA, Illuminate Financial, OSK Ventures, Z Venture Capital, and ACF – a joint venture between JLIN LLC and The Wells Investments. Endowus also counts some of the largest billionaire family offices in Asia among its investors.


Endowus partners with 1,000\+ global fund managers across public markets, private markets, hedge funds, and alternatives to deliver world\-class solutions at transparent cost through its fee\-only model. Private Wealth clients access curated strategies from firms such as EQT, Carlyle, Partners Group, KKR, Ares, Brookfield Oaktree, HarbourVest, Millennium, Point72, Bridgewater, and more.Recognition includes CNBC's World's Top FinTech Companies 2025, the Financial Times' High\-Growth Companies Asia Pacific 2025 (\#45\), Fortune Fintech Innovators Asia 2024, and the World Economic Forum's Technology Pioneers 2023\. The platform has won Asia's Best Digital Wealth Management and Hong Kong's Best FinTech Innovation in Asset Management (Asia Asset Management 2025\), Singapore's Best Digital Wealth Management Experience (The Asset Triple A 2025\), and Best WealthTech Solution 2023 (Asian Private Banker).


The Endowus Group comprises licensed companies in Hong Kong and Singapore, and Hong Kong\-based multi\-family office Carret Private. With group assets over **US$12 billion**, Endowus is one of the largest independent wealth managers in Asia, estimated to save clients more than US$50 million in fees per year. title: Enterprise Account Executive - Singapore
description:
**Who are Evotix?**
===================


We're a growing global SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world\-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare\-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

  

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**The Role**
============

**Build market presence. Win strategic accounts. Accelerate growth.**

  

Are you an experienced enterprise seller with a strong network in Singapore? At Evotix, we’re looking for an **Enterprise Account Executive** to grow our presence in the region by winning new business, building trusted customer relationships, and driving strategic revenue growth.

  

You’ll combine direct enterprise sales expertise with a proven ability to work through partners, creating opportunities and expanding our reach across the Singapore market. If you’re a commercially driven salesperson who knows how to navigate complex buying environments, build credibility quickly, and deliver results, this is an opportunity to shape Evotix’s growth in a key strategic region.

**What You'll Do**
==================

###### **Drive Revenue Growth Across Singapore \& Southeast Asia**

* Own and deliver an annual sales target through a combination of new business acquisition, existing account growth, and strategic expansion within the region.
* Develop and execute account growth plans across an established customer base of 20\+ enterprise customers, increasing adoption, retention, and revenue opportunities.
* Identify, qualify, and close complex enterprise software and professional services opportunities.

###### **Expand Existing Customer Relationships**

* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across customer organisations, identifying opportunities to expand Evotix’s footprint and business value.
* Work closely with the regional Customer Success Manager to drive account development, renewals, cross\-sell, and upsell activity.
* Lead commercial discussions and growth initiatives within existing accounts while ensuring customer outcomes remain the priority.

###### **Develop Strategic Partnerships**

* Establish, manage, and grow relationships with implementation, consulting, and channel partners to create new revenue opportunities.
* Strengthen and expand existing partnerships, including collaboration with established implementation partners and global consulting firms.
* Develop joint go\-to\-market activities, referral opportunities, and partner\-led sales motions to accelerate regional growth.

###### **Lead Complex Enterprise Sales Cycles**

* Manage multi\-stakeholder sales processes involving business, operational, technology, and executive decision\-makers.
* Position both software and professional services solutions, demonstrating clear business value and return on investment.
* Negotiate and close enterprise agreements while maintaining accurate forecasting and pipeline management.

###### **Represent Evotix in the Region**

* Act as a market expert and brand ambassador, building awareness and credibility within Singapore's enterprise risk, governance, compliance, and health \& safety communities.
* Provide market intelligence and customer insight to support regional growth strategy and partnership development.

**What You Bring**
==================

* **Business proficient Mandarin is required**.
* Proven experience selling multi\-year, subscription\-based SaaS products – focus being on Enterprise deals, typically on a 6\-9\-month cycle.
* Experience growing strategic accounts and developing partner\-led revenue opportunities.
* Experience building regional sales strategies and conducting software demonstrations.
* Knowledge of Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC), EHS, ESG, or related enterprise software markets.
* Experience working alongside implementation partners, consulting organisations, or systems integrators.
* Strong network and experience operating within the Singapore enterprise market.

 *Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.*

**Interview Process**
=====================


We aim to keep our interview process transparent, fair, and respectful of your time. While steps may vary slightly by role, you can typically expect:

* **Initial chat:** A conversation with a member of our Talent team to learn more about your background, motivations, and answer any initial questions.
* **Hiring Manager interview:** A role\-focused discussion exploring your experience, skills, and how you approach real\-world scenarios relevant to the role.
* **Key Stakeholder interview:** A discussion with a member of senior leadership in another department that you will be working with should you join.
* **Final Panel interview:** A conversation with key stakeholders to dive deeper into collaboration, alignment, and mutual fit. This stage may involve a Case Study or Presentation to allow you to show off your skills!
* **Offer:** If successful, we’ll move quickly to share an offer and next steps.


We’re happy to make reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process — just let us know what you need.

### **Why Join Evotix?**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a competitive base salary and company\-based performance bonus.
* **Support for You:** Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
* **Growth Opportunities:** Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
* **Team Culture:** Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

 **Ready to Make a Difference?**  

If you’re a bold, results\-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!  

  

*Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.*

description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**At Ferring Pharmaceuticals, we help people around the world build families and live better lives. We are entrepreneurial and innovative, with a global team focused on scientific advances in the areas of reproductive and women’s health, gastroenterology and urology. Ferring \+ You is all about working together and sharing ideas, so that we can bring science to life for patients around the world.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Our Technical Operations division develops, manufactures and supplies high\-quality products so our patients can live better lives. Creating and delivering life\-changing products means getting it right first time is a shared responsibility, so our global manufacturing teams work closely together to ensure quality, accuracy and safety at all times. That means a culture of empowerment, where speaking up is valued, and growth and development are constant.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Ferring\+You**
----------------

**You will be responsible for supporting the smooth and efficient running of commercial, operational, and cross\-functional activities. The role combines coordination, analysis, process improvement, and administrative support to help the company meet business goals while staying compliant with industry regulations.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Your day at Ferring**
-----------------------

* **Visit key doctors, key hospitals, and, where necessary, health authorities to promote Ferring's products in accordance with the agreed marketing strategy and call frequency.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Build and maintain strong relationships with key accounts and Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs). Participate in scientific congresses and industry events as required by the Company.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify, develop, and manage key accounts, including proposing new key accounts and reviewing existing ones. Monitor prescribing habits, product perception, publications, and the influence of KOLs within the medical community.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Deliver accurate and timely product information, effectively communicate product positioning, address customer objections, and differentiate Ferring's products from competitors. Collaborate cross\-functionally to meet key account needs and drive business growth.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support the listing of new products, identify potential public tender opportunities, and collaborate with internal stakeholders to achieve strategic business objectives.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Proactively plan and execute territory activities, including clinical sessions, journal clubs, and educational meetings. Identify and invite KOLs as speakers or faculty members while ensuring activities are conducted within the approved budget.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Negotiate with key account stakeholders where appropriate regarding product purchases. Maintain accurate records of contracts, quotations, and customized purchasing agreements.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Record customer interactions, daily activities, and call reports in the CRM system while maintaining an up\-to\-date database of customer feedback and prescribing behaviour.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Submit accurate and timely expense claims in compliance with Company policies.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Manage the assigned territory budget and complete all required approval processes to support business activities and account growth.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Build relationships with nurses and allied healthcare professionals by providing product information, educational support, and in\-service training to improve patient care and product adoption.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Behind our innovation…There’s you**
-------------------------------------

* **Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biology, Medicine, or a related discipline is preferred.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Minimum 5 years of sales experience in the pharmaceutical industry**
----------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Proven track record of achieving sales targets and developing key accounts.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in engaging with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), healthcare professionals, and hospital stakeholders.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Excellent** **relationship\-building** **and key account management abilities.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Self\-motivated, proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Positive attitude with the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross\-functional team.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong planning, organizational, and territory management skills.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.**
----------------------------------------------------------------
* **Fluent in spoken and written English.**
-----------------------------------------
* **Possess a valid driving licence and own transportation.**

The National University Hospital (NUH) is Singapore’s leading university hospital, with a proud heritage dating back to 1905 with the establishment of what’s now the NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine. Our strong ties with the medical school have shaped us into a unique institution, allowing us to seamlessly integrate clinical care with teaching and research. As a university hospital, we go beyond the realm of providing tertiary medical care. We are a hub of knowledge and innovation, attracting healthcare professionals who are passionate about pushing boundaries and making significant contributions to the field.

  

**About Department and Purpose of the Position**


Reporting to the Senior Manager of the NUH Access and Audit Governance Section, the role supports the management of NUH system access, systems support, audit activities, and the development and implementation of policies and procedures relating to information governance and technology risk management practices across the organisation.  

**Key Responsibilities**


* **Data Compliance**
	+ Work with relevant stakeholders to establish practical and effective data governance and compliance processes
	+ Assist in advising internal management on implementation plans for new data governance and compliance processes.
	+ Support the implementation of new policies and procedures through engagement with relevant stakeholders.
	+ Provide guidance to NUH staff on data and research compliance\-related queries.
	+ Evaluate NUH research and non\-research requests to ensure they are processed in accordance with NUHS policies.

* **User Access Governance**
	+ Assist in establishing and reviewing IT procedures to ensure appropriate controls are in place and aligned with the IT governance framework.
	+ Support the implementation of new user access policies and procedures through engagement with relevant stakeholders.
	+ Facilitate periodic reviews of the organisation\-wide System Role\-Based Access Matrix.
	+ Support the resolution of ID requests relating to clinical applications and research projects.

* **IT Audit Management**
	+ **Assist in developing a risk\-based IT audit workplan and defining the scope of review in consultation with the Institution Chief Medical Informatics Officer (CMIO).**
	+ **Work with key stakeholders to ensure audit activities adequately address key organisational risks and are completed within the required timelines.**
	+ **Work with key stakeholders to monitor and follow up on management action plans for identified control issues in a timely manner.**
	+ **Coordinate with the CIO Office to prepare and provide IT audit artefacts and supporting documentation requested by auditors.**
	+ **Assist in delivering ad hoc projects, including but not limited to investigations, policy and procedure reviews, and training initiatives.**

* **IT Systems Support**
	+ Engage relevant stakeholders to support troubleshooting, feedback management, and requirements gathering.
	+ Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to support timely resolution of system issues and service requests.
	+ Assist in monitoring system\-related issues, tracking follow\-up actions, and escalating matters where required.
	+ Support user acceptance testing, system enhancement reviews, and validation of system changes where applicable.
	+ Maintain relevant documentation, user guides, and support records to facilitate effective system support and knowledge sharing.
	+ Provide IT systems support, including after\-office hours and weekend support when required.

**Key Requirements**


* Bachelor's degree from a recognised institution
* At least 1 to 2 years of relevan working experience; fresh graduates are welcome to apply
* Prior experience in IT management, healthcare, buinsess analysis, audit, or compliance will be an advantage
* Basic knowledge of IT governance, risk and compliance, with proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and tracking purposes
* Meticulous and analytical, with good logical thinking and process flow skills
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, writing, and interpersonal skills
* Able to work independently, manage timelines, and collaborate effectively as a team player
* Willing to provide after\-office hours and weekend support when required
  

**Closing \& Applications**
  

When you join NUH, you become part of a dynamic and collaborative environment where expertise, knowledge, and compassion all come together.


Working in healthcare offers satisfaction that extend far beyond the ordinary. The smiles of gratitude from patients and the profound sense of fulfilment that comes from helping others cannot be measured. It is a career that allows for both personal and professional growth. The challenges you encounter in this rapidly evolving industry push you to constantly expand your knowledge and skills, as well as encourage lifelong learning.


Be a part of a team that gets to create a transformative healthcare experience for our patients and professionals alike.

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to be part of a global team that relentlessly pursues procurement excellence, improves operational processes and outcomes, and manages compliance and business risks? Do you have a solid procurement background, excel at program and stakeholder management, and thrive in a fast\-paced environment?  

  

We are hiring a Program Manager \- Procurement Excellence to work closely with procurement stakeholders, operations, functions, systems and engineering to enable scalable, well\-controlled business processes and decision\-making.  

  

This role sits within a broader team of program managers that operates as highly embedded business partners to procurement, focused on operational effectiveness and impact, scalable mechanisms, and risk\-informed execution.  

  

The ideal candidate combines strong business process thinking, stakeholder influence, operational rigor, and technical literacy to help teams move quickly while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.
  

  

The ideal candidate require a high tolerance of ambiguity aligned to AWS Day 1 culture, ability to influence executive decisions, drive strategic initiatives and change management that deliver meaningful programmatic improvements.
  

  

This is not a traditional audit or policy\-focused role. We designed this role for individuals who enjoy solving operational problems, driving influence and alignment across teams, and building scalable mechanisms in fast\-paced environments. Over time, this role has opportunity to evolve toward broader technical program management style leadership responsibilities.  

  

Your role:
  

  

Business Partnership \& Operational Enablement  

* Partner closely with Technical, Engineering, Operations, Procurement, and Risk stakeholders to shape scalable business processes and controls.
* Engage early with teams to influence decisions, identify risks, and enable efficient execution.
* Translate risk and controls requirements into practical, actionable operating mechanisms.

  

Risk \& Controls Integration  

* Design and improve scalable controls, guardrails, and operational frameworks that support business velocity while managing risk appropriately.
* Simplify and modernize existing processes to align with evolving business needs and risk appetite.
* Ensure controls are operationally practical and embedded into day\-to\-day workflows.

  

Business Process \& Mechanism Ownership  

* Identify process gaps, friction points, and operational inefficiencies across programs and workflows.
* Build mechanisms, playbooks, decision frameworks, and scalable patterns that improve consistency and reduce ambiguity.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across governance, operational readiness, and execution processes.

  

Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Audit Readiness  

* Act as a business partner to Procurement teams and a key coordination point across Risk, Audit, Assurance, Legal, Technical and Engineering teams.
* Streamline audit readiness and evidence gathering through scalable operational processes rather than manual coordination.
* Ensure teams have clarity on ownership, expectations, and escalation paths.

  

Technical \& Operational Collaboration  

* Engage effectively with technical teams by understanding system architecture, workflows, dependencies, and operational trade\-offs.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure controls and operational requirements are designed into solutions early.
* Use data and operational signals to identify risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.

  

What good looks like for this role:  

* Procurement teams and functional partners proactively engage you as a trusted partner early in planning and execution.
* Decisions move faster because of your involvement, not slower.
* Processes become simpler, clearer, and more scalable over time.
* Risk Management and controls are embedded into operational workflows rather than managed as separate activities.
* Stakeholders experience clear ownership, practical guidance, and streamlined engagement across governance functions.

  

What We Are Not Looking For  

* Purely policy or checklist\-driven approaches.
* Candidates who operate primarily through approvals or gatekeeping or arm's length approach
* Candidates who identify problems without driving practical solutions.

  

High stakeholder engagement, influencing and cross\-functional ownership is essential is for the role.  

  

The Data Center Procurement Governance (DCPG) function is part of Amazon Infrastructure Services (AIS)
  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)  

  

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Lead various audit programs, risk remediation, policy and process improvement projects internally and with external stakeholders
* Take lead in establishing necessary controls, mechanisms, and policies to improve DCSP compliance and assurance
* Drive culture of innovation, simplification and continuous improvement through best practice sharing, advocacy and hands\-on leadership and execution of projects
* Identify new tools and business processes that simplify, standardize and enable operational excellence
* Derive actionable insights and routinely present recommendations from analysis

  

A day in the life  

\-This role has a global scope so there is no standard day \- there is much variety in the day
  

* You could be starting with a morning meeting speaking with US team members, a coffee with APAC and finish up with a call with EMEA
* You will work on multiple projects with global teams, stakeholders and customers
* Your biggest customers will be our Data Center Services Procurement teams and our AWS security assurance teams. Stakeholders also include legal, finance, H\&S and other Data Center Communities colleagues

  

  

  

  

About the team  

Data Center Procurement Governance (DCPG) is a global function that includes:  

  

\-Program Management \- a team of Program Managers who are strong business partners to procurement, intersect business process with technology and tooling across the procurement life cycle, to identify, architect and deliver impact projects for our DC procurement teams.
  

  

Procurement Systems, Tools \& Analytics \- Define, support and drive procurement technical roadmap in systems, tooling, automation, analytics and GenAI.
  

  

About AWS  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.
  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
