title: Principal Full Stack Engineer
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back\-office easy for micro SMEs.


We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing \- growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.


We operate 3 business segments:


Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with \~5% market share of all new business incorporations


Accounting \& Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service


FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses


Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset.


We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of \>70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.


Backed by world\-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech\-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.


At Sleek, we are on a mission to streamline operations and elevate customer experience through intelligent automation and modern engineering.

**About the Role:**


As a Principal Full Stack Engineer, you will be one of Sleek’s most senior individual contributors, leading the architectural vision and end\-to\-end delivery of complex web applications and core platform services. You'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, solving ambiguous engineering problems while helping raise the technical standards of the wider engineering organisation.

**Mission:**


In this role you will balance deep technical execution across the full stack—from intuitive user interfaces to scalable distributed backend systems—while championing developer productivity and embedding agentic AI workflows into our products.

**Key Outcomes:**  

1\. Full Stack Architecture \& Product Delivery


Architect, build, and maintain production\-grade SaaS applications across the entire stack using modern JavaScript/TypeScript, frontend frameworks (React/Vue), and backend environments (Node.js/NestJS).


Design resilient APIs, database schemas (Postgres, MongoDB), and cloud\-native services capable of scaling with business growth.


Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to turn complex operational and financial challenges into simple, robust software solutions.


2\. Agentic AI Integration


Architect and implement agentic AI capabilities and intelligent workflows into production applications (e.g., document processing, automated classification, and decision\-support systems).


Establish reliability patterns for AI features, including guardrails, evaluation frameworks, fallback strategies, and observability for model behavior.


3\. Harness Engineering \& Engineering Productivity


Build and maintain engineering harnesses, automated workflows, and internal developer tooling that eliminate friction in the engineering lifecycle.


Introduce modern AI\-assisted development tools (such as Cursor, automated test/documentation generators, and debugging aids) to significantly increase productivity across the entire engineering organization.


4\. Platform Performance \& Technical Leadership


Identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks in APIs, data pipelines, and backend microservices.


Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, lead technical architecture reviews, and raise the bar for code quality, testing, and system design across Sleek.

 **Requirements** **Must\-Have Requirements:**

* Depth— 8\+ years shipping and running production SaaS.
* Architecture— scalable distributed systems, APIs, and service boundaries you've had to live with.
* TypeScript / Node.js— years in this ecosystem, not a recent port from another language. Relational and document databases both.
* Full\-stack ownership— you take a feature from schema to API to UI and out to production without handing off the parts you like least. You're strongest somewhere, but you're not helpless anywhere.
* Developer platform— you've built internal developer tooling, automation, and paved paths that other engineers depend on daily, and treated them as products with users rather than side projects.
* Cloud and operations— you deploy it, monitor it, respond to incidents, and continuously improve it in production. Observability and security are part of the job, not someone else's.
* Production AI — You've built and shipped AI\-powered product capabilities (agents, intelligent automation, document processing, workflow orchestration, or similar) and understand how to evaluate, monitor, and improve them in production.
* Force multiplier— you've raised the people around you through mentoring and standards that outlast you.
* Autonomy — You thrive in ambiguous environments, proactively identify problems worth solving, and drive technical outcomes without relying on detailed task management.

 **What Success Looks Like**

* You pick up ambiguous problems and come back with a direction to argue about, not just a list of questions.
* You use AI tooling aggressively on your own work, and you're honest about where it fails.
* You'd rather delete code than add it, and you can tell which is which.
* You say when something is a bad idea, including when it's ours.
* You leave the codebase and the people around you better than you found them.
* You treat production incidents as your problem regardless of who wrote the code.

 **Nice\-to\-Have Experience**

* Our stack— NestJS, React or Vue, Postgres or MySQL, MongoDB, AWS, Kubernetes or Rancher.
* Tooling and observability— Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot; Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry.
* Applied AI—agentic systems, multi\-agent workflows, LLM observability, sandboxed agent execution, and AI data pipelines.
* Context— async work in globally distributed teams; FinTech, Accounting, Compliance, or RegTech.


The interview process


The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.


Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

**Talent Acquisition Screen (30 minutes)**


An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to learn more about your background, motivations, and overall fit for the role.


**Technical Deep Dive (60 minutes)**


A discussion with a member of the Engineering team focused on your recent experience, technical ownership, architecture decisions, AI experience, and engineering approach.


**Technical Panel Interview (90 minutes)**


A live technical interview with a panel of two engineers covering system design, distributed systems, software architecture, AI engineering, production systems, reliability, engineering trade\-offs, and developer productivity.

**Engineering Leadership Interview (45–60 minutes)**


A behavioural discussion with Engineering Leadership exploring ownership, communication, technical leadership, decision\-making, mentoring, and how you work in ambiguous environments


Offer \+ reference interviews


We’ll make a non\-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or video calls with references that you provide to us.


Requirement for background screening


Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.


This may include using external vendors to verify the below:


Your education


Any criminal history


Any political exposure


Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history


We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.


By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

 **Benefits**  

Some other great things about working at Sleek…


Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.


Flexibility: You’ll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year


Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.


Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek \- we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well\-rounded person and professional.


Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben \& Jerry's, and P\&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

About the team
  
  

In line with ByteDance's globalization plans, there has been an increasing demand for payment services and financial services—including digital payments, merchant acquiring, money transfer, and capital markets activities—to support and enhance our current business needs and expand our service offerings to end users.
  
To deliver these capabilities, Global Payment ("GP") was established. GP operates through a group of licensed entities that are subsidiaries of ByteDance Ltd. In Singapore, this includes entities regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore ("MAS") under the Payment Services Act 2019 ("PSA") and the Securities and Futures Act 2001 ("SFA"), among others.
  
  

About the role
  
We are seeking a Compliance Officer to lead and manage the compliance function for ByteDance's regulated financial services activities in Singapore, with a dual focus on capital markets services (including CMS licensing under the SFA) and payment services (including MPI licensing under the PSA). The candidate should possess strong knowledge of MAS regulations across both domains, a solid understanding of AML/CFT requirements as set out in MAS Notice 626, Notice 824, and related guidelines, and demonstrate experience engaging with MAS on licensing, supervisory, and examination matters.
  
Familiarity with regulatory developments related to digital payment tokens (DPT), e\-money issuance, merchant acquisition, cross\-border money transfer, dealing in capital markets products, and fund management will be advantageous. This role requires someone who is self\-driven, adaptable to change, and possesses strong leadership capabilities to guide the team in a fast\-paced, globally matrixed environment. The role reports to the Head of Compliance, APAC Advanced Markets, Global Payment.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
1\. Lead Singapore compliance coverage. Serve as the primary compliance officer for ByteDance's licensed entities in Singapore, with end\-to\-end responsibility for compliance oversight of capital markets services, payment services, and other regulated financial activities under MAS supervision. Act as the designated compliance officer for CMS and MPI licensed entities where required.
  
2\. Own the regulatory licensing strategy. Lead and execute Singapore's regulatory and licensing strategy, including new license applications (e.g., CMS license for dealing in capital markets products, MPI license for payment services), license renewals, and ongoing supervisory obligations.
  
3\. Manage MAS engagement as the primary engagement lead with MAS. Own all regulatory examinations, inspections, supervisory reviews, thematic reviews, and ad\-hoc regulatory inquiries.
  
4\. Design and maintain the compliance framework. Design, implement, and continuously enhance a scalable, risk\-based compliance framework that aligns Singapore regulatory requirements with ByteDance's global governance, control, and risk management standards. Ensure the framework covers all material compliance risk areas.
  
5\. Deliver AML/CFT program oversight. Own and continuously enhance the Singapore AML/CFT program in compliance with MAS Notice 626, MAS Notice 824, and related MAS guidelines.
  
6\. Advise on product and market expansion. Partner closely with regional and global stakeholders across Product, Payments, Business Development, Legal, Risk, Operations, and Engineering to advise on regulatory feasibility, product readiness, and compliant market expansion strategies in Singapore. Provide compliance guidance on new product launches, feature changes, and cross\-border initiatives.
  
7\. Maintain deep awareness of regulatory developments across Singapore's financial services landscape—including AML/CFT, consumer protection, data privacy, technology risk management, outsourcing, prudential requirements, and operational resilience. Translate evolving requirements into practical policies, controls, and operational guidance.
  
8\. Oversee third\-party and partner compliance. Provide governance and oversight of third\-party and partner compliance, including payment processors, acquiring banks, technology vendors, outsourcing service providers, and other critical partners. Ensure contractual controls, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring meet MAS outsourcing and third\-party risk management expectations.
  
9\. Drive compliance culture and training. Build a strong compliance culture through regular training, awareness programs, guidance, and effective communication with stakeholders across the organization. Develop and deliver role\-specific compliance training tailored to capital markets and payment services businesses.
  
10\. Escalate and report on compliance risks. Escalate significant compliance risks, regulatory developments, and control issues to senior regional leadership and Global Compliance, providing clear risk assessments and strategic recommendations. Prepare and present regular compliance reports to senior management and the board of directors of the licensed entities.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

Minimum Qualifications
  
* Bachelor's degree in Law, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* Strong compliance experience within payment institutions, capital markets services firms, banks, fintech platforms, professional services firms, or regulatory bodies, with demonstrated responsibility at a managerial or regional level.
* Deep working knowledge of Singapore's financial services regulatory framework, including Payment Services Act 2019 (PSA), Securities and Futures Act 2001 (SFA), MAS AML/CFT Notices and Guidelines, and MAS Technology Risk Management Guidelines
* Proven experience engaging credibly and effectively with MAS, including direct involvement in licensing applications, regulatory examinations, inspections, supervisory reviews, thematic reviews, and ongoing regulatory correspondence.
* Strong command of AML/CFT regulatory frameworks and enforcement expectations, including Singapore\-specific requirements and global standards such as FATF Recommendations and Wolfsberg Principles.
* Demonstrated ability to draft, implement, and maintain compliance policies, procedures, risk assessments, and regulator\-facing materials at a level suitable for submission to MAS and presentation to boards of directors.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex regulatory concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences across a globally matrixed organization.


Preferred Qualifications
  
* Prior experience at MAS or another major financial regulator, or at a professional services firm advising on Singapore financial services regulation, is a strong advantage.
* An advanced degree or professional qualification in compliance, law, or financial regulation is strongly preferred.
* Direct experience obtaining a CMS license and/or an MPI license from MAS, including managing the full application lifecycle from pre\-application consultation through to grant of license.
* Familiarity with the compliance implications of digital payment tokens (DPT), stablecoins, blockchain\-based financial services, and related emerging regulatory developments in Singapore.
* Working knowledge of Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act 2012 (PDPA) as it applies to financial institutions, and familiarity with cross\-border data transfer requirements.
* Professional compliance certifications such as Certified Anti\-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), International Compliance Association (ICA) Diploma, or equivalent.
* Proven leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with business growth in a fast\-moving, global technology environment. Experience operating in a matrixed organization with both local and global reporting lines.

description:
Description
**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!


At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success\-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.


If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!


**Why is the role important to us**

SimCorp APAC is seeking a Senior Solutions Engineer at Director level to take functional ownership of deals across the region, including strategic pursuits. This is a commercial, deal\-shaping role where the candidate will own the functional sales workstream end\-to\-end for a number of opportunities throughout the year, partner on executive\-level customer engagements, and shape deals toward where SimCorp is growing: front\-to\-back, in key markets, across public and private assets, managed services, and AI.


You will bring deep domain expertise in buy\-side investment management through SimCorp's multi\-asset platform, and use it commercially: framing technical answers in business terms, and setting the standard within a high\-accountability team. The role also requires to mentor junior members of the team, orchestrating SMEs deliberately, and building reusable assets that scale across the team. Your contribution will directly shape deal outcomes and customer trust across APAC.


**What you will be responsible for**

In this role, you own the functional sales workstream end\-to\-end. You drive deals through its functional stage\-gates, can engage customers at executive level, support shaping the deal commercially, and raise the bar around you. As a director, ownership, orchestration, judgment, and the standard you set come on top of the technical excellence.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with sales to lead enterprise deals, end\-to\-end, as the functional owner, incl. strategic deals.
* Deliver impactful product \& functional RfPs, RfIs, presentations to prospects, while building reusable assets that scale across the team: demo environments, standard pitches tailored to segments and personas, industry and competitor materials.
* Anchor deals in the customer's outcomes, demonstrating tangible value, while shaping the opportunity toward SimCorp's growth priorities: open ecosystem, front\-to\-back across public and private, and managed services.
* Delegate and orchestrate: Pull SMEs in deliberately and early (operations, accounting, technical teams).
* Proactively drive each deal through its stages
* Frame technical answers in commercial terms by providing answers in both technical and industry context.
* Document risk and gaps, demo/PoC planning, proposal input, and clean handoff. Coordinate closely with internal teams (Product, Consulting, Services, SMEs) to align solution design with client needs.
* Be able to build and carry customer relationships at executive level, e.g. Head of Investments, COO, CTO.
* Mentor junior team members, raise the bar around you, and set and reinforce team standards.
* Stay up to date on market developments and link them to platform workflows.
* Light to moderate travel as required based on sales activity.

**What we value**

We are looking for a proactive, deal\-shaping Solutions Engineer with deep buy\-side domain expertise and a track record of winning enterprise deals \- someone with a results driven mindset to own the functional workstream and overcome complex challenges.


**Key Skills and Qualifications**

* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in FinTech (implementations, transformations, presales, or relationship management with technical/commercial exposure), with exposure to portfolio management \& risk mgmt. activities.
* A track record of shaping and winning enterprise deals in financial software.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with attention to detail.
* Strong understanding of financial markets and investment processes
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to simplify complex concepts.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment and pivot quickly.
* Technical fluency across multi\-asset platforms (securities, derivatives, loans, public and private assets), APIs, and data workflows
* Experience working in APAC: South East Asia and Australia are a strong plus.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; ability to simplify complex concepts and tailor the message to the audience.
* Comfort operating in a high\-accountability deal team where ownership and autonomy are expected.

**Recommended Attributes**

Success in this role requires more than technical skill in combination with ownership, orchestration, and the judgment to set the standard for the team.


* Ownership mindset and proactiveness.
* Lead by example: Mentor junior team members and raise the bar around them.
* Strategic contribution: Partners with sales to shape deals and surfaces opportunities.
* Committed approach to problem\-solving and taking initiative
* Comfortable with direct configuration work as part of creating compelling sales demonstrations and build out the demo and presentation library.
* Builder's mindset \- creates reusable assets that make the whole region more scalable and successful.
* Transparency and collaboration in a team environment.
* Capacity for handling changes effectively.
* Integrity and accountability in all interactions.
* Effective communication and relationship\-building skills.
* Respect and reliability in interactions with others.

**Language Skills:**

* Business\-level proficiency in Mandarin (spoken and written) to liaise with clients in North Asia
* Good to have: Additional languages such as Cantonese, Korean, or Japanese
* These language skills are essential for effective communication and relationship\-building with potential clients in the North Asian Markets where we are expanding.

**Others:**

* Hybrid work arrangement

**BENEFITS:**

Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid workplace model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.


**NEXT STEP:**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non\-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.


If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.


We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.


**WHO WE ARE:**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000\+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds in general.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full, front\-to\-back offering for our clients.


**SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.** We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday


*\*\*We are also honored to have been voted as a WealthTech100 company for three consecutive years. The new WealthTech100 list aims to highlight tech innovation leaders in the investment management industry.\*\**

Job Summary
  
  

The Operational, Technology and Cyber Risk (OTCR) organisation is instrumental in protecting and ensuring the resilience of Standard Chartered Bank’s operations, data, and IT systems by managing operational, technology and cyber risk across the enterprise. Reporting into the Group Chief Risk Officer (CRO), the Group OTCR team serves as the second line of defence for assuring that controls are implemented effectively, in accordance with the OTCR Framework, and for instilling a risk culture within the Bank.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* The Director, OTCR, AI SME, will play a crucial role in the second line of defence, responsible for overseeing and challenging the management of risks associated with the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) within Cyber Security and Technology. This role will focus on ensuring the effective identification, assessment, mitigation, and monitoring of AI\-related risks, contributing to the development and implementation of a robust AI risk management framework. The ideal candidate possesses a strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, cyber security principles, and risk management best practices.
* This role is responsible for shaping and overseeing the bank’s AI risk and governance framework in the second line of defence, including collating the enterprise AI risk profile, analysing risk and control data to identify emerging issues and themes, and providing independent challenge to ensure alignment with regulatory expectations and risk appetite. It requires strong analytical capability (to interpret complex risk, control and model data), effective coordination skills (to drive OTCR\-wide AI activities and consistency across policies and standards), and high\-quality written and verbal communication (to engage senior stakeholders, influence decision\-making, and translate technical concepts into clear, actionable insights), alongside a solid grounding in cyber or technology risk concepts.
* The role also leads OTCR\-wide coordination of AI initiatives, supporting policy development, governance, and control implementation, while driving learning, awareness, and stakeholder engagement to enable safe and informed AI adoption; candidates should demonstrate curiosity and active learning in AI developments, with a working understanding of key concepts and risks, but deep technical specialism or prior hands\-on AI experience is not required.


Strategy
  
* AI Though Leadership: Provide though leadership on the emerging trends and best practices across Cyber and Technology risk. Input into strategic and emerging risk identification and management capabilities to enable the bank to take a forward looking and proactive stance in the management of AI related risks.


Business
  
* AI Though Leadership: Provide though leadership on the emerging trends and best practices across Cyber and Technology risk. Input into strategic and emerging risk identification and management capabilities to enable the bank to take a forward looking and proactive stance in the management of AI related risks.
* AI Risk Framework Development \& Implementation: Contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of a comprehensive AI risk management framework, aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Risk Identification \& Assessment: Proactively identify and assess emerging AI\-related risks across Cyber Security and Technology, considering both current and future AI applications. This includes evaluating risks related to Technology, operational risk and security vulnerabilities and design.
* Risk Mitigation \& Control Evaluation: Evaluate the design and effectiveness of controls implemented by the first line of defence to mitigate identified AI risks. Challenge and provide recommendations for improvement where necessary.
* Monitoring \& Reporting: Establish and execute ongoing monitoring activities to track the effectiveness of AI risk management controls. Prepare and present regular reports on AI risk posture to senior management and relevant committees.
* Collaboration \& Communication: Collaborate closely with stakeholders across Cyber Security, Technology, Data and other relevant departments to ensure a consistent and coordinated approach to AI risk management.
* Knowledge \& Expertise: Stay abreast of the latest developments in AI/ML technologies, cyber security threats, and regulatory landscape related to AI. Share knowledge and best practices with the broader organization.
* Policy \& Guidance: Contribute to the development and maintenance of policies, standards, and guidelines related to the responsible use of AI within the organization.
* Challenge \& Oversight: Provide independent challenge and oversight of the first line of defence’s management of AI risks.


Processes
  
* Second Line of Defence oversight of AI related processes.


People and Talent
  
* Support the training, develop and upskilling of the wider team on Security and AI.


Risk Management
  
* Support the effective identification, assessment and management of risk.


Governance
  
* Ensure good governance and management of identified risk and issues.


Regulatory and Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

Key stakeholders

* Mobilize cross\-functional contributor stakeholders across the Region and global enterprise to source inputs, drive alignment at pace, and ensure seamless execution.

title: Director, Human Resources
description:
**At SBF, people strategy is business strategy**. As Singapore's apex business chamber, SBF supports the needs of the business community while building a future\-ready organisation internally. The Director, Human Resources will shape how we attract, develop, engage and retain talent, while ensuring that HR policies, governance and operations remain robust, fair and responsive to organisational priorities.

**We are looking for a strategic and hands\-on HR leader** who can partner senior management, guide a capable HR team and translate people priorities into practical, well\-governed solutions. This role suits someone who enjoys both policy and execution, can influence across diverse stakeholder groups, and is comfortable operating in a mission\-driven organisation where governance, employee experience and organisational impact matter equally.

 **Responsibilities**

**1\. HR strategy, governance and policy**

* Develop and deliver HR strategies, policies and programmes that support SBF's organisational goals, workforce plans and employee experience.
* Strengthen HR governance through clear policy frameworks, fair and consistent decision\-making, and compliance with relevant employment legislation and Tripartite guidelines.
* Serve as Secretariat to the Appointments and Remuneration Committee, including preparing papers, recommendations and updates for senior management, Board and Council discussions.
* Monitor workforce, engagement and talent metrics, benchmark HR practices against market trends, and provide management with data\-driven insights and recommendations to strengthen workforce capability, employee experience and organisational performance.

 **2\. Workforce planning and talent acquisition**

* Lead manpower planning, manpower budgeting and workforce movements to ensure SBF has the right capabilities and capacity for current and future priorities.
* Oversee end\-to\-end recruitment, selection and onboarding, ensuring a positive candidate and employee experience from first interaction through the first six months.
* Build targeted hiring strategies for critical roles, including job positioning, sourcing channels, assessment quality and hiring manager capability.

**3\. Rewards, benefits and performance**

* Oversee compensation, benefits, salary review and manpower cost planning to balance market competitiveness, internal equity, affordability and governance.
* Review benefits and wellbeing provisions to ensure they remain relevant, sustainable and aligned with employee needs and organisational priorities.
* Drive the performance management approach to strengthen clarity of expectations, quality of conversations, accountability and recognition of contribution.

**4\. Talent development, leadership capability and culture**

* Lead the learning, talent and career development agenda, including capability building, leadership development, succession considerations and development pathways.
* Translate SBF's values and culture aspirations into practical interventions, rituals and leadership behaviours that employees can experience day to day.
* Partner divisional leaders to understand talent needs, ground sentiments and opportunities to improve team effectiveness, collaboration and change readiness.
* Oversee learning administration, budget, vendor management and reporting on learning participation, effectiveness and return on investment.

**5\. Employee engagement, experience and retention**

* Lead employee engagement, employee voice and retention strategies that strengthen trust, belonging, productivity and organisational commitment.
* Oversee the employee engagement survey cycle, including survey design, analysis, leadership sharing, action planning and follow\-through on priority areas.
* Design initiatives that improve the employee lifecycle, from onboarding and development to mobility, recognition, wellbeing and offboarding.

**6\. HR operations, analytics and team leadership**

* Lead the HR team in delivering responsive, accurate and professional HR services across the employee lifecycle.
* Improve HR processes, systems, documentation and service standards to enhance efficiency, data quality and user experience.
* Maintain accurate HR records, dashboards and metrics including headcount, attrition, recruitment, engagement, learning and manpower cost indicators.
* Coach and develop HR team members, building a collaborative team that is credible with the business and disciplined in execution.

 **What we are looking for**

* Degree\-qualified with at least 12 years of progressive HR experience, including 5 or more years of leadership responsibility across multiple HR disciplines. Professional certification such as IHRP\-SP or equivalent will be an advantage.
* Strong working knowledge of Singapore employment legislation, fair employment practices, compensation and benefits, performance management and HR governance.
* Proven experience leading HR projects across policy review, workforce planning, talent acquisition, rewards, learning, engagement or organisational development.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to advise senior leaders and the judgement to handle sensitive matters with discretion.
* Analytical, structured and comfortable using HR data to identify issues, shape recommendations and track outcomes.
* Hands\-on, collaborative and resilient, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with operational delivery in a lean team environment.
* Experience in a public sector, trade association, professional services, membership\-based, non\-profit or mission\-driven organisation will be useful but is not mandatory.

We're hiring someone to lead the operational side of how Wise handles payments that don't complete cleanly and to help redesign that operation for a world where AI agents do most of the work.
  
  

Why this role exists
  
  

Wise moves money across borders for millions of customers globally. Most payments go through cleanly. Some don't — they get delayed, returned, misrouted, or need a human to step in. Those payments are handled by the Payment Operations function.
  
  

Wise is on a long\-term growth trajectory, and operational handling needs to scale in a way that doesn't just track volume linearly. So we've made a deliberate bet: over the next three years, we're rebuilding Payment Operations into a hybrid human \+ AI operating model — where AI agents execute the majority of frontline work, and humans move from handlers to designers, monitors, and escalators of agent\-driven systems.

title: Manager, Financial Operations (Reconciliation)
description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

  

**About the role**
------------------


We are looking for a Financial Operations Manager based in Singapore to lead global cash and transaction reconciliation. In this role, you will own end\-to\-end break investigation and resolution, drive cross\-functional issue follow\-ups through to closure, and partner with Product, Engineering, Data, and Finance to strengthen reconciliation controls and improve automation. You will also lead and develop a team, setting clear operating rhythms and performance standards.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Lead daily, weekly, and month\-end reconciliations for cash and transaction flows across channels, entities, and regions, with clear coverage, **SLAs**, escalation paths, and closing calendars.
* Manage reconciliation breaks end\-to\-end, including triage, investigation, root\-cause analysis, documentation, and follow\-up with Product, Engineering, Data, Ops, and PSP/Bank partners until full resolution.
* Understand end\-to\-end fund flows and transaction lifecycles to identify control gaps and risks, and design policies, procedures, and governance that ensure fund safety and strong financial controls.
* Drive continuous improvement of reconciliation systems, tools, and workflows, including automation, data quality checks, dashboards, and other scalable enhancements.
* Translate operational needs into clear requirements/PRDs and partner with Product and Engineering to deliver and measure enhancements (e.g. break volume reduction, faster cycle times, improved accuracy).
* Partner with Product, Ledger/Accounting, and regional stakeholders to align reconciliation with product changes and reporting needs, and to standardise practices while respecting local requirements.
* Lead, coach, and develop the reconciliation team, allocating resources across BAU and project work, and maintaining capacity planning, coverage, and training.

**What you bring:**
-------------------


* **5\+ years of experience** in Financial Operations, reconciliation, financial operations, payments operations, or related roles; experience in payments/fintech is strongly preferred.
* Proven track record leading cash, settlement, and transaction reconciliations at scale, and driving issues to closure with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of end\-to\-end payment flows (authorisation, capture, settlement, refunds, disputes/chargebacks) and how these map to ledger entries.
* Experience improving processes and systems (automation, workflow tooling, data pipelines, controls), with the ability to write clear requirements and influence prioritisation.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills; able to deep\-dive into large datasets and identify patterns and root causes.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; comfortable escalating and driving accountability.
* People leadership experience (direct management or strong team lead experience).
* Proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with SQL/BI tools is a plus.

**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third\-Party Recruiters**
--------------------------------------------------------------


*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*


*Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*


**Equal opportunity**
---------------------


Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, driven to address operational challenges and value add to the future of Operations
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Eager to learn and keen to work on different projects
* Comfortable and willing to work across multiple work sites and geographically mobile to work internationally for final year rotation.

**Application Deadline: 31 August 2026, 2359 SGT**

--------------------------------

* **Upload a copy of your resume and make sure to have the following in your resume: 1\. Expected graduation date; 2\. Latest cumulative CAP/GPA**

**Who We Are**
--------------


At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

------------------


OKX runs a large peer\-to\-peer (P2P) crypto marketplace: an escrow\-protected orderbook where users buy and sell crypto for local fiat through verified liquidity providers, with support for a wide range of local payment methods. The professional liquidity providers who post offers are what keep the marketplace deep and reliable.
You will lead a team that owns the relationship with these key liquidity providers in variousmarkets: supporting partners' operational needs, maintaining marketplace depth and reliability, and improving partner experience. This is a builder's seat: high ownership, frontline, and fast\-moving.

------------------


* Own the P2P liquidity provider programme:

monitor marketplace depth and coverage, and improve partner satisfaction and retention
* Lead and grow a team of account managers, setting direction and raising the operating bar.
* Manage the liquidity\-provider programme, tiering frameworks, account management and retention\\
* Lead the growth strategy and retention funnel with data: build and read funnels, produce recurring analysis, and turn it into decisions.
* Contribute to user quality and marketplace health, partnering with the user risk team on high\-risk user profiling and dispute reduction. (Growth is the priority; risk exposure is a plus, not a requirement.)

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* 7\+ years in growth, account management or relationship management for high\-value users or clients, including team leadership, with a track record of managing partner programmes at scale. Multi\-market experience is strongly preferred.
* Proven experience managing high\-volume client or partner relationships and improving partner engagement and service quality.
* Strong data and funnel fluency: owns metrics, runs analysis, steers decisions from data.
* High\-energy and genuinely hungry: gets on the frontline, has built something 0 to 1, and pushes into harder markets rather than safer ones.
* Backgrounds in payments, remittance or fintech are especially relevant. Crypto or digital\-currency experience is a plus, not a requirement. Strong operators from large internet and marketplace companies are also welcome.
* Working proficiency in English. At least one of the two roles also requires working proficiency in Mandarin (liquidity\-provider and stakeholder coverage across Greater China markets).

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience with fiat on\-ramp / off\-ramp, cross\-border payments, or remittance.
* Exposure to emerging markets (Southeast Asia, Africa, LatAm, MENA).
* Experience with user\-segmentation, high\-risk\-user filtering, or trust and safety / fraud operations.

**Perks \& Benefits**
---------------------


* Competitive total compensation package
* L\&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
* Various team building programs and company events
* Wellness and meal allowances
* Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
* More that we love to tell you along the process!

description:
**We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;** enabling entrepreneurship,
  

job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience


As Asia's leading securities brokerage, regulated exchange and fund management platform for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.


Empowering Private Markets: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end\-to\-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets.


Innovative Financial Ecosystem: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset\-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services.


Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us.


**About The Role**
------------------

We are looking for a VP, Execution/Advisory to join our team. You will be a critical partner to the CCO and the Head of Origination and Execution, leading deal origination, structuring, and execution efforts across the full range of asset classes our Private Capital Markets business deals in — including equities, funds, and other alternative investment assets.


You will lead and manage the Investment team responsible for evaluating opportunities and issuers seeking to raise funds on Alta, and will drive or support every aspect of the deal process, including due diligence, research, analysis, and documentation of transactions, as well as liaising closely with legal and compliance counterparts.


Alta operates at high velocity across multiple markets, including Singapore and Indonesia, multiple product lines, and functions such as Sales, Syndication, Technology, Compliance, Operations, and Marketing. In this role, you will help ensure that speed does not come at the expense of rigor — building robust financial models to value capital\-raising transactions, supporting the sales team on deal syndication and distribution, and working closely with the Product team to strengthen deal management through technology.


This is a high\-visibility role for someone who thrives in fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environments, enjoys hands\-on deal work, and wants to play a central role in building a leading global alternative investments marketplace. Beyond execution, you'll also contribute to broader business development, marketing, networking, and events.


**Some Of The Key Responsibilities Include**
--------------------------------------------

* Lead deal origination, structuring, and execution across all asset classes covered by the Private Capital Markets team, including equities, credit, funds, real estate, and other alternative investments.
* Lead and manage the Investment team in evaluating investment opportunities and issuers seeking to raise capital through Alta.
* Oversee and support all stages of the deal process, including transaction coordination, operational execution, and liaison with Legal and Compliance.
* Conduct comprehensive due diligence, market and industry research, financial analysis, and transaction documentation.
* Develop and review financial models and valuation analyses for capital\-raising transactions.
* Partner with the Sales team to support deal syndication, investor engagement, and distribution efforts.
* Contribute to broader business development initiatives, including marketing, networking, partnerships, and industry events.
* Work closely with the Product team to improve and streamline the deal management process through technology and automation.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with issuers, investors, professional advisers, and other key stakeholders across the private capital ecosystem.

**About You**
-------------

* At least 5–8 years of relevant experience in Investment Banking, Corporate Finance, Deal Advisory, Transaction Services, Venture Capital, and/or Private Equity.
* Transaction Advisory or Transaction Services experience from a Big Four accounting firm would be highly regarded.
* Strong capabilities in company and industry research, financial analysis and modelling, valuation, and preparation of client presentations and investment materials.
* Strong numerical and analytical skills, supported by sound commercial judgement and business acumen.
* Established corporate relationships within the regional private markets, start\-up, or investment ecosystem would be an advantage.
* Experience in, or a strong interest in, fintech, start\-ups, private markets, and alternative investments.
* Intellectual curiosity and the ability to quickly understand different industries, business models, and transaction structures.
* A genuine passion for private capital transactions and helping businesses access growth capital.
* Highly motivated, proactive, and results\-oriented, with the drive to succeed in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in a second language, such as Mandarin, Bahasa Melayu, or Bahasa Indonesia, would be an advantage.

If you are interested, please send your resume to jobs@alta.exchange

description:
Company Description  

Sopra Steria is a listed European technology leader specializing in Consulting, Digital Services, and Software. With over 51,000 employees worldwide across Europe, North America and Asia, the Group supports organizations in driving their digital transformation and delivering sustainable business value.  

  

In Asia Pacific, Singapore serves as the regional headquarter for Sopra Steria’s Infrastructure, Cloud and Cybersecurity services.

**Descriptions:**


For this position, we are looking for a **Cybersecurity Architect (Cyberark)** to assist one of our clients in the banking industry – a leading global investment bank.


As the APAC IAM Production\-Cybersecurity Architect CyberArk Expert, you will lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of CyberArk vault and associated PAM solutions across all APAC operations.


Reporting to the APAC Head of IAM Production, this role is accountable for securing, monitoring, and governing all privileged credentials and sessions, thereby reducing the risk of credential‑theft, insider abuse, and lateral movement in the enterprise environment.


You will be measured on the following four performance drivers that will dictate how individual impact is considered on the platform:

* Expert knowledge of CyberArk (Vault, PSM, CPM), and PAM solutions.
* Demonstrated L3\-level expertise in Conjur (design, policy\-as\-code, secret lifecycle automation, and Kubernetes integration) combined with deep, hands\-on experience in CyberArk Privileged Access Management, enabling the architect to drive end\-to\-end secret\-management and privileged\-account implementation
* Proven track record of building high\-availability, resilient identity platforms with robust monitoring, automated remediation, and documented DR procedures
* Client, Customer and Stakeholder Focus, Compliance Culture and Conduct

  

Job Description **Responsibilities:**

* Define and own the enterprise‑wide CyberArk architecture (Vault, CPM, PSM, PVWA, Conjur, ) to support the banks technical accounts inventory.
* Design and enforce privileged‑access policies (least‑privilege, separation‑of‑duties, time‑bound access) across Windows, Linux, UNIX, databases, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* 3\. Provide high\-availability support for the CyberArk, establishing robust monitoring, incident\-response, and disaster\-recovery processes that keep critical services up and running 24×7\.
* Drive the secret‑management lifecycle – automatic password rotation, SSH key management, API‑credential vaulting, and on‑demand retrieval.
* Partner with engineering, application, and cloud teams to embed secure identity controls into every new service launch, migration, or platform upgrade.
* Automate PAM processes using PowerShell, Python, and CyberArk REST APIs (e.g., bulk onboarding/off‑boarding, credential rotation schedules).
* Evaluate emerging PAM technologies (e.g., CyberArk Conjur, Secret\-Zero, Zero\-Trust Privilege) and build business cases for adoption.
* Collaborate with DevSecOps, Cloud, and Application teams to embed privileged\-access controls into CI/CD pipelines and cloud\-native workload

  

Qualifications **Requirements:**

* Requires a minimum of 8\+ years of experience as security professional
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (Master’s ).
* Hands\-on experience architecting, deploying, and operating CyberArk PAS (Vault, CPM, PSM, PVWA) at enterprise scale.
* Conjur (CyberArk) – L3 – policy\-as\-code (CPL/HCL), secret rotation, dynamic secrets, Kubernetes side\-car injection, API/CLI integrations
* Deep expertise in CyberArk Core PAS components and CyberArk Privileged Threat Analytics.
* Strong knowledge of Windows/UNIX/Linux authentication mechanisms, Kerberos, LDAP/AD, SSH, database authentication.
* Experience integrating CyberArk with SSO/IdP solutions (SAML, OIDC, AD).
* Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, and CyberArk REST API for automation.
* Familiarity with cloud providers (AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault) and Hybrid‑IAM environments.
* Solid understanding of Zero‑Trust concepts for privileged access.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; ability to influence and motivate
* Leverage PAM analytics (session recordings, anomaly scores) to drive risk\-based decisions
* Ability to handle high pressure situations with key stakeholders to collaborate and communicate effectively and respectfully with both business\-oriented executives and technology\-oriented personnel in teams across the organization

**Specific qualifications:**

* CyberArk Certified Defender (CCD)
* Secrets Manager (Conjur) certified

  

Additional Information* **Work\-life balance**: Hybrid working mode and 18 days of Annual leave
* **Health \& insurance:** Comprehensive coverage including General Practitioner, hospitalization, dental, and optical


**•Performance incentives:** Annual bonus based on individual performance  

**•Learning \& development**: Training programs, certification opportunities, and training incentives to support career growth  

**•Team culture:** Regular team\-building activities and social events

title: Senior Manager, FP&A & Strategic Finance
description:
Truegenics Pte Ltd is a Singapore\-based e\-commerce company with a track record of more than US$218 million in online product sales. We develop and market our own brands of health and wellness products to customers around the world.

We strive to create value and make a positive difference, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and we are committed to creating products that enhance the lives of our consumers.

As we continue to scale and strengthen the way we manage our business, we are looking for a commercially minded and analytically strong Senior Manager, FP\&A \& Strategic Finance to improve financial visibility, strengthen planning and help management make clearer, faster and more informed decisions.

**How the Role Fits Within Finance**

Truegenics has an established finance operations function responsible for accounting, financial reporting, controls, compliance and day\-to\-day finance execution.

This role will complement that function by taking primary ownership of FP\&A, forecasting, business performance analysis and strategic financial decision support.

The Senior Manager, FP\&A \& Strategic Finance will report directly to the CEO and work closely with the Head of Finance. Together, both functions will ensure that management decisions are supported by accurate financial information, forward\-looking analysis and sound commercial judgment.

As the company and finance function evolve, the scope of this position may expand into broader finance leadership responsibilities based on business needs and demonstrated capability.

**Mission of the Role**

This is a high\-impact position that works closely with the CEO and management team.

You will be responsible for turning financial and operational data into clear insights, forecasts and recommendations. You will help management understand where the company is making or losing money, what is driving performance, where resources should be allocated and what actions should be taken next.

This is not a purely reporting role. We are looking for someone who can connect financial data with business reality, investigate the underlying causes of performance and provide a clear point of view.

Success will be measured not only by the quality of the reports produced, but also by the quality of the decisions those reports enable.

**Key Responsibilities**

Financial Planning \& Forecasting

* Own the company’s rolling forecasting and scenario\-planning processes. Build financial models covering revenue, margins, operating costs, manpower, inventory, cash flow and profitability.
* Work with department leaders to ensure forecasts reflect commercial and operational reality. Track actual results against budgets and forecasts, explain material variances and recommend appropriate actions.

Business Performance Analysis

* Analyse performance across products, brands, funnels, sales channels, marketing partners and customer segments.
* Evaluate revenue, contribution margins, customer acquisition costs, affiliate payouts, average order value, refunds, fulfilment costs, inventory requirements and cash impact.
* Identify the key drivers behind performance, distinguish profitable growth from unproductive growth and highlight risks, opportunities and early warning signs before they become major issues.

Strategic Finance \& Decision Support

* Serve as a trusted financial and commercial partner to the CEO and management team.
* Evaluate major decisions involving pricing, marketing investments, product launches, hiring, vendor expenditure and resource allocation. Build business cases and scenario models, assess expected returns and recommend a clear course of action.
* Challenge assumptions constructively and track whether approved initiatives ultimately deliver the results originally expected.

Management Reporting

* Develop concise and decision\-oriented management reports, dashboards and performance commentary.
* Ensure that reporting explains not only what happened, but why it happened, why it matters and what management should do next.
* Work closely with the Head of Finance to ensure that FP\&A analysis is consistent with the company’s accounting records and operational finance data.

Cash Flow \& Working\-Capital Planning

* Develop forward\-looking cash\-flow and liquidity forecasts and provide early warning of potential cash constraints or funding requirements.
* Analyse inventory commitments, receivables, payables and other major working\-capital drivers. Partner with the Head of Finance and operating teams to improve cash visibility, inventory planning and working\-capital efficiency.

Cross\-Functional Business Partnership

* Work closely with sales, marketing, product, operations, supply chain, human resources and finance.
* Help department leaders translate business plans into financial assumptions, targets and measurable outcomes. Support business cases for new initiatives, investments and operating changes while strengthening financial accountability across the company.

Process, Systems \& AI Improvement

* Improve FP\&A processes, reporting cadences, dashboards and analytical workflows.
* Use Excel, Google Sheets, DOMO, business\-intelligence tools, automation and AI to reduce manual reporting, accelerate analysis and surface insights more quickly.
* Apply sound financial judgment and appropriate validation to all automated or AI\-generated outputs.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or a related field.
* At least 5–8 years of relevant experience in FP\&A, business finance, commercial finance, management reporting or financial analysis.
* Strong financial\-modelling, forecasting, scenario\-planning and analytical capabilities.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, profitability, cash flow and working capital.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets capability and comfort using dashboards, automation and AI tools.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations.
* Demonstrated experience working directly with the CEO, senior management and department heads.
* Hands\-on, intellectually curious and willing to investigate the underlying numbers.
* Able to challenge assumptions respectfully and influence decisions through evidence.
* Proactive, accountable and comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, performance\-driven environment.

**The Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is commercially curious, financially disciplined and comfortable operating close to the business.

When a number changes, you do not stop at describing the variance. You want to understand what caused it, whether it matters, what it means for the company and what action should follow.

You are comfortable moving between financial statements, marketing economics, product profitability, operating costs, inventory requirements and cash flow.

You use technology, AI and automation to improve the speed and quality of your work, but you rely on judgment, business context and critical thinking when forming recommendations.

Most importantly, you take ownership. You see financial analysis not as an end product, but as a tool for improving decisions and business performance.

**Why Join Us**

This is an opportunity to work directly with the CEO and play a meaningful role in shaping how an established international e\-commerce company plans, measures and manages performance.

You will have visibility across the full business, exposure to senior decision\-making and the opportunity to build FP\&A practices that directly influence company direction. Your analysis will not sit in a report. It will be actively used to guide investment, improve profitability, allocate resources and make important business decisions.

If you enjoy turning numbers into decisions and want your work to have a direct and measurable impact, we would like to hear from you.

* Financial modelling: 5 years (Preferred)

**Company Description**  

foodpanda is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking a strategic and experienced leader to join our regional logistics team as the **Lead, Logistics Performance.**


In this role, you will lead a dedicated team of Specialists, owning the design, analysis, and optimization of logistics performance, rider payments, and incentive strategies across our 17 diverse markets. You will own the strategic roadmap for rider payments and incentives, acting as the bridge between high\-level business goals and on\-the\-ground operational reality. You will treat rider compensation as a critical operational lever. You will use it to optimize fleet behavior, improve delivery times, and solve supply challenges while ensuring financial sustainability and fleet stability.

* Team Leadership \& Development: Lead and mentor a high\-performing team of Specialists. Build a culture of analytical rigor and curiosity, encouraging the team to challenge the status quo
* Strategic Roadmap \& Governance: Define the long\-term strategy for rider payments and incentives. Develop and enforce regional frameworks that allow for necessary local adaptations while maintaining consistency and financial discipline across the markets. Ensure compensation models align with broader business goals, logistics performance KPIs (e.g., delivery time), and profitability targets
* Budget Management \& Efficiency: Oversee the rider payment and incentive budget and continuously monitor cost\-per\-order (CPO) trends. You will drive initiatives that improve cost\-efficiency while ensuring sufficient rider supply and fleet retention
* Rollout of Models \& Automation: Own the regional implementation of advanced data science models and automated tools
* Experimentation \& Testing: Drive the testing and rollout of new pay components (e.g., dynamic pricing, surge models, quest incentives) to enhance fleet efficiency and order acceptance rates, ensuring every initiative is optimized for maximum ROI and operational impact
* Product Collaboration: Partner with the Central Product team to influence the development of payment\-related features. You will translate business requirements into product requests, participate in testing, and ensure the successful adoption of new product capabilities across the region
* Stakeholder Management \& Market Partnership: Act as the primary partner to Local Logistics Directors, Finance Leaders, and Product Managers. Build strong relationships with local market teams to understand their unique operational challenges and translate complex data into clear, actionable strategic recommendations for senior leadership

  

**Qualifications**  

* Experience: 5\+ years of professional experience in high\-growth tech, logistics, strategy consulting, or investment banking. Experience specifically in gig\-economy, marketplace dynamics, or logistics is a strong plus
* Leadership: Proven track record (1\-2\+ years) of managing direct reports or leading complex cross\-functional project teams
* Education: University degree in STEM, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field
* Technical Fluency: Strong proficiency in SQL and Excel is required to audit team work and dive into data when needed
* Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, both written and spoken. You are comfortable effectively challenging the status quo, and negotiating with senior stakeholders and leadership

  

**Additional Information**  

* A dynamic and challenging work environment.
* A company committed to developing you personally and professionally.
* A great working atmosphere with regular company and team events.
* A vibrant and international team committed to diversity and inclusion.
* Responsibility from day one in a fast growing and global company.
* Other benefits include free food, health and dental insurance, and learning and development opportunities!


foodpanda is operated by Delivery Hero Group (“DH Group”) \- the world’s leading local delivery platform, operating in 70\+ markets across Asia, Europe, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa. Delivery Hero started as a food delivery service in 2011 and now employs 40,000\+ people globally. Additionally, Delivery Hero is pioneering quick commerce, the next generation of e\-commerce, aiming to bring groceries and household goods to customers in under one hour and often in 20 to 30 minutes. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
