title: Benefits Consultant
description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**About the Team**


The Asia Pacific Total Rewards team is central to Visa's people strategy across one of the company's most dynamic and complex regions. We design and deliver benefit programs that enable Visa to attract, retain, and support exceptional talent across diverse markets, regulatory environments, and employee populations. The team operates with a high degree of trust and direct access to HR and business leadership, our recommendations shape outcomes that are felt by every Visa employee in the region.


We are in a period of active development. That means there is genuine opportunity to influence how benefits are designed, delivered, and experienced across AP, including how the function harnesses AI and data tools to work smarter and advise with greater precision.

**The Role**


The Benefits Consultant is a strategic contributor to Visa's Total Rewards function in Asia Pacific, responsible for the end\-to\-end ownership of benefits programs across a portfolio of AP markets. The role demands equal strength in strategic advisory and rigorous execution, engaging senior business leaders, people team and other cross functional partners on program effectiveness while ensuring operational delivery meets the highest standards of quality and compliance.


This is an in\-house role with real organisational impact. The Benefits Consultant partners with a broad range of stakeholders — from employees seeking guidance on their benefits, to HRBPs navigating complex cases, to business leaders and finance partners requiring data\-driven insights on program performance and investment. The ability to communicate credibly and with appropriate depth across all these audiences is essential.


This role reports to the Benefits Director.

**What You'll Do:**

* Strategic Program \- Ownership Lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of benefit programs across an assigned portfolio of AP markets. Ensure programs are competitive, compliant, and aligned to Visa's broader Total Rewards and people strategy. Bring market intelligence and analytical insight to inform renewal strategy, plan design decisions, and cost management.
* Stakeholder Partnership \- Serve as a trusted advisor across a wide stakeholder spectrum, providing expert guidance to HRBPs on complex benefits matters, supporting employees with clarity and confidence on their benefits, and presenting program performance and recommendations to business leaders and People leadership with rigour and commercial acumen.
* Vendor \& Commercial Management \- Own the end\-to\-end vendor relationship for benefits providers in your markets, from procurement and contracting through to performance management, invoice governance, and renewal negotiations. Hold vendors accountable to agreed service levels and ensure commercial arrangements reflect Visa's interests.
* Data, Analysis \& Benchmarking \- Translate benefits data into meaningful insight. Analyze utilisation trends, claims experience, and market benchmarks to evaluate program effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement. Present findings and recommendations in a manner that supports informed decision\-making at leadership level.
* Compliance \& Governance \- Ensure benefit programs meet all applicable regulatory requirements across your markets. Maintain accurate records, manage audit requirements, and keep documentation, including employee handbooks and plan materials, current and accurate.
* Capability Building \& Projects \- Contribute to regional initiatives including new market implementations, program redesigns, and Workday system enhancements. Actively engage with AI and data tools as the team builds more intelligent, scalable ways of working. Identify and drive process improvements that strengthen the team's effectiveness.


**What Sets You Apart:**


You approach your work with intellectual curiosity, you bring perspective and market intelligence, not just process updates. You are forward\-looking in how you work, actively embracing AI tools and new analytical approaches as the function evolves, seeing them as a way to advise with greater depth and speed, not as a threat to how things have always been done. You understand that markets across AP are distinct, and you adapt accordingly. Above all, you are someone stakeholders at every level can rely on, for sound advice, accurate information, and consistent follow\-through.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

* 8\+ years of benefits experience with direct, hands\-on exposure to multiple AP markets
* Experience across both the advisory/consulting and in\-house environments is strongly preferred
* Strong analytical capability, comfortable building cost models, interpreting claims and utilisation data, and constructing data\-driven recommendations
* Demonstrated ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, from employees to senior business and HR leadership
* Hands\-on Workday proficiency: familiarity with benefits administration platforms is an advantage
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt tone and depth to the audience
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent; GRP or equivalent certification is a plus

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Study Director (Immunochemistry)
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data\-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

  

Labcorp is seeking a **Study Director, Immunochemistry** to join our team in **Singapore**.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Strong expertise in ligand binding assay (LBA) development, validation, and sample analysis for pharmacokinetic (PK) and anti\-drug antibody (ADA) bioanalysis in support of preclinical and clinical drug development programs.
* This role requires a scientific leader who can independently develop and troubleshoot assays, manage project deliverables, mentor junior scientists, and contribute directly to client success.

**Assay Development \& Validation**

* Design, develop, optimize, and validate ligand binding assays for PK, ADA, and other biomarker applications in accordance with applicable SOPs, regulatory guidelines, and industry best practices.
* Lead scientific troubleshooting and implement appropriate assay improvements to address technical challenges.
* Perform method transfer, qualification, and validation activities to support study requirements.
* Evaluate assay performance characteristics and ensure methods are robust, reliable, and fit for purpose.

**Bioanalysis \& Data Review**

* Analyze biological samples using validated methods while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and laboratory procedures.
* Review, interpret, and evaluate analytical data to ensure accuracy, quality, and scientific integrity.
* Perform quality control (QC) review of experimental data and study documentation.
* Maintain complete, accurate, and audit\-ready laboratory records.

**Project Leadership**

* Serves as a Study Director / Principal Investigator / Responsible Scientist for research studies. Take on overall responsibility for the technical conduct of a study, analytical direction, review, documentation and reporting of results. All activities are conducted in compliance with appropriate SOPs and regulatory agency guidelines.
* Plan, monitor, and coordinate laboratory activities to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
* Effectively manage resources and prioritize workloads to meet client and study timelines.
* Participate in project meetings and provide technical expertise and recommendations to stakeholders.

**Equipment \& Laboratory Operations**

* Independently operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and perform routine and non\-routine maintenance of laboratory equipment.
* Identify equipment or process\-related issues and implement effective corrective actions.
* Support laboratory compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Mentorship \& Scientific Contribution**

* Train, mentor, and provide technical guidance to junior scientists and laboratory staff.
* Review and contribute to study protocols, validation plans, reports, methods, and SOPs.
* Participate in process improvement and innovation initiatives to enhance laboratory efficiency and scientific quality.

**Client Interaction**

* Participate in client meetings, teleconferences, and site visits as needed.
* Communicate scientific findings, study progress, and technical recommendations effectively to clients and internal stakeholders.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Immunology, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences.
* Extensive hands\-on experience in ligand binding assay development and validation, with a strong focus on PK and ADA bioanalysis.
* Demonstrated expertise in immunoassay platforms such as ELISA, ECL (MSD), Gyrolab, or other relevant technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting regulated GLP and/or GCLP bioanalytical studies.
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and industry guidance related to bioanalytical method validation.
* Prior experience leading projects and mentoring junior scientists.
* Direct client\-facing experience in a CRO or pharmaceutical/biotechnology environment.

**Additional Job Standards:**

* Proven ability to independently troubleshoot complex assay and analytical challenges.
* Excellent data analysis, scientific writing, and communication skills.

title: Marketing Manager Emerging Markets,Asia
description:
*At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you're a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you'll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit* *klaviyo.com/careers* *to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny.*

**About the Team and Role**
---------------------------



China and Japan aren't emerging markets in the way the label suggests \- they're sophisticated, mature ecosystems that simply don't run on the same playbook as the rest of APAC. Different platforms, different buying cultures, different definitions of trust. We're looking for a Marketing Manager who understands that going deep in these markets is a different job entirely from running broad regional campaigns, and who's genuinely excited by that depth rather than looking to generalise it away.



You'll own integrated marketing execution across the full funnel \- SMB through enterprise \- for China and Japan, working closely with our Head of Marketing Asia, to build and adapt campaign strategy for markets that each deserve their own thinking \- not a translated version of what works elsewhere. You'll collaborate with Demand Generation, Brand \& Content, Creative Services, Field, BDR, Sales and Partnerships to make sure campaigns are built for how buyers in these markets actually discover, evaluate, and decide, so that they move the pipeline as a result.



This is an individual contributor role. You won't have direct reports, but you'll need the judgement and stakeholder skills of someone who could.


**Supervisory Responsibilities:**
---------------------------------


* None.

**How You'll Make a Difference**
--------------------------------


* Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across China and Japan, spanning paid, organic, lifecycle, field, ABM and partner marketing
* Build and adapt campaign strategy for local relevance \- platform choices (e.g. WeChat, Baidu, LINE), buyer behaviour, content format, and competitive context differ significantly between China and Japan, and campaigns need to reflect that rather than flatten it
* Partner with BDR, Sales, field, partnerships and shared services teams to align campaign timing and messaging with market\-specific pipeline goals and account priorities
* Work with Brand \& Content and Product Marketing to identify where existing assets translate well and where new, market\-native content and localisation is needed
* Develop and execute co\-marketing programs with local partners \- campaigns, in\-market events, and webinars \- that drive demand and pipeline while showcasing our joint value proposition in China and Japan
* Activate partner\-led marketing initiatives with the right tools, content, and guidance, and champion the partner voice internally so collaboration keeps deepening
* Manage campaign calendars, budgets, and vendor relationships specific to China and Japan, including local media and platform partners
* Track and report campaign performance by market and channel, with a clear point of view on what's working, what isn't, and why
* Build and maintain a market\-level measurement view in partnership with Marketing Analytics, so decisions are grounded in data rather than assumption
* Bring forward recommendations on where investment should shift across China and Japan based on results
* Establish success criteria that inform resource planning, campaign flighting, and prioritisation across multiple stakeholders
* Represent the needs and constraints of these markets in global and regional campaign planning, so strategy isn't built only from a US, EMEA, or broader APAC lens
* Stay informed on market trends and competitive dynamics in China and Japan, bringing fresh thinking to how we and our partners show up
* Other related duties as assigned

**Who You Are**
---------------


* 5\+ years in partner marketing, demand generation, or regional marketing, ideally with direct experience in China and/or Japan
* Comfortable owning campaigns end\-to\-end, from planning through execution to reporting, without a large supporting team
* Comfortable self\-serving in a lean\-resource environment \- from copywriting, basic design, case study interviews, to event execution \- are part of the job here, not someone else's
* Experience managing media budgets across multiple markets, with a clear read on where spend is and isn't working
* Working knowledge of the platforms and channels specific to China and Japan (e.g. WeChat, Rednote, LINE, X, local social and search ecosystems)
* Able to read data and turn it into a recommendation, not just a report. Familiarity with Tableau and Salesforce (or equivalent) preferred
* Ability to report performance against OKRs/KPIs to executive leadership, translating market\-level detail into a regional story
* Strong collaborator who can align global and local priorities without treating either as the default answer
* Organised enough to manage multiple stakeholders and timelines across two distinct markets, and pragmatic about where to flex process versus where to hold the line
* Familiarity with the partner ecosystem in China and/or Japan \- agencies, technology, and channel partners is a strong plus
* Knowledge of local publisher media landscapes in China and/or Japan
* Genuinely curious about what makes buyers different in China and Japan, and willing to say so when a global or regional template doesn't fit
* Comfortable working async across timezones with a globally distributed marketing team
* **Mandarin and/or Japanese language business proficiency ideal**, given the depth of market and cultural nuance this role requires

  


**Klaviyo in APAC:**



We are rapidly expanding our footprint in Asia\-Pacific with our new Singapore Hub. Since launching here just six months ago we are already scaling fast, aggressively building out our core GTM functions, including Sales, Pre\-sales, Business Development, Customer Success, Partnerships, Marketing, and People.



This is a true **"1% done"** moment. While we build on the strong foundation of our Sydney presence, our Singapore Hub offers the unique energy of a startup within a global company. We are looking for **"Drivers"**—builders who want to shape our local culture and define the future of Klaviyo in Asia\-Pacific and Japan.



Aligned with our value of **Always Learning**, we are looking for the leaders of the future. The headroom for growth here is massive. If you are insatiably curious and eager to accelerate your career, Klaviyo provides the platform. Join us, and help build something exceptional from the ground up.

As part of the evaluation process we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound on April 3, 2025\.



Please see the independent bias audit report covering our use of Covey here  

  

\#LI\- Hybrid

 *This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Travel is coordinated in advance.*


**Get to Know Klaviyo**



We're Klaviyo (pronounced clay\-vee\-oh). We empower creators to own their destiny by making first\-party data accessible and actionable like never before. We see limitless potential for the technology we're developing to nurture personalized experiences in ecommerce and beyond. RX is in the business of building businesses for individuals, communities and organisations. We elevate the power of face\-to\-face events by combining data and digital products to help customers learn about markets, source products and complete transactions at over 350\+ events in 25 countries across 42 industry sectors. This is an exciting opportunity to join **RX Global** , a market leader with over 50 years of experience delivering some of the world's most prestigious travel and business events. In this role, your focus will be on driving growth for **IBTM Asia Pacific in Bangkok** , connecting the region's most innovative destinations, hotels, venues, and industry suppliers with a global audience. * Experience of working in a highly competitive, dynamic marketplace
* Experience within exhibitions sector is desirable

* Proven ability to build a wide network of influencers
* Able to adapt and thrive in a fast paced sales environment

**About the Team and Role**
---------------------------



Demand generation in ANZ and Southeast Asia isn't a smaller version of the US playbook \- it's its own game. Different buying behaviours, different channel mixes, different languages, and a region that spans everything from mature enterprise markets to fast\-growing SMB ecosystems. We're looking for a Demand Generation Manager who's energised by that complexity, not intimidated by it.



You'll own integrated campaign execution across the full funnel \- SMB through enterprise \- for Southeast Asia, working closely with our Head of Demand Generation APAC, to adapt global and regional campaign strategy for local relevance \- and to flag when local reality means we should do something different altogether. You'll partner with Brand \& Content, Creative Services, Field, BDR, Sales and Partnerships to make sure campaigns don't just run, but actually move pipeline in\-region.



This is an individual contributor role. You won't have direct reports, but you'll need the judgement and stakeholder skills of someone who could.


**Supervisory Responsibilities:**


* None.

**How You'll Make a Difference**
--------------------------------


* Plan and execute integrated demand generation campaigns across Southeast Asia, spanning paid, organic, lifecycle, field and ABM
* Localise and adapt global campaign frameworks for regional relevance \- language, buyer behaviour, channel mix, and competitive context differ market to market, and campaigns need to reflect that
* Partner with BDR, Sales, field, Partner Marketing and shared services team \- Brand \& Content, Creative Services, Lifecycle, Product Marketing \- to align campaign timing and messaging with regional pipeline goals and account priorities
* Work with Brand \& Content and Product Marketing to identify where existing assets translate well regionally and where new, locally relevant content is needed
* Manage campaign calendars, budgets, and vendor relationships across multiple markets and timezones
* Track and report campaign performance by market and channel, with a clear point of view on what's working, what isn't, and why
* Build and maintain a regional measurement view in partnership with Marketing Analytics, so decisions are grounded in data rather than assumption
* Bring forward recommendations on where regional investment should shift based on results
* Establish success criteria that inform resource planning, campaign flighting, and prioritisation across multiple stakeholders
* Represent Southeast Asia's needs and constraints in global campaign planning, so strategy isn't built only from a US, EMEA or ANZ lens
* Other related duties as assigned

**Who You Are**
---------------


* 5\+ years in demand generation, integrated campaigns, or performance marketing, ideally with experience across Southeast Asia markets
* Comfortable owning campaigns end\-to\-end, from planning through execution to reporting, without a large supporting team
* Comfortable self\-serving in a lean\-resource environment \- from copywriting, basic design, case study interviews, to event execution \- are part of the job here, not someone else's

* Ability to report performance against OKRs/KPIs to executive leadership, translating market\-level detail into a regional story

* **Mandarin proficiency** is highly desirable, with Bahasa Malaysia considered a plus

  


**Klaviyo in APAC:**



We are rapidly expanding our footprint in Asia\-Pacific with our new Singapore Hub. description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead, Production Support Engineer
Role Overview  

The Real Time Payments International team is looking for a Lead, Production Support Engineer to drive day\-to\-day operational stability and support the reliability of critical payment platforms by implementing automation, leverage best practices and work with a high‑impact team responsible for driving production readiness, reliability, and DevOps automation across Mastercard platforms.  

This role plays a key part in incident management, change readiness, and platform operations, while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.  

  

The ideal candidate brings strong technical troubleshooting skills, operational discipline, and ownership mindset, with the ability to lead during incidents and collaborate effectively across engineering and program teams.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

Platform Operations \& Stability  

* Support end\-to\-end availability, monitoring, and performance of critical payment platforms.
* Execute operational processes to ensure platform health and stability.
* Participate in capacity checks, readiness validations, and environment monitoring.

  

Incident Management \& Execution  

* Actively manage and coordinate incident triage and resolution.
* Serve as incident commander driving medium to high\-severity incidents.
* Ensure timely updates, accurate impact assessment, and appropriate escalation.
* Contribute to root cause analysis with clear identification of actions and ownership.

  

Change \& Release Support  

* Participate in highlighting gaps and defining test cases required for a change in lower environments and validate lower environment test completeness.
* Ensure adherence to change governance processes (test case reviews, checklists, approvals, rollback readiness).
* Engage in creating change plans and support execution of production changes, deployments, and validations.

  

Technical Troubleshooting  

* Perform hands\-on troubleshooting across:


o Application behaviour and dependencies.  

o Infrastructure components (compute, network, storage).  

o Database and performance issues.  

* Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure and other technical teams to isolate and resolve issues efficiently.

  

Monitoring \& Observability  

* Improve system health monitoring using observability tools and alerts.
* Identify gaps in alerting and contribute to improving quality of alerting and dashboards.
* Ensure proactive detection of anomalies using observability tools.

  

Automation \& Process Improvement  

* Contribute to automation initiatives to reduce toil and errors.
* Identify repetitive operational tasks and drive improvements.
* Support implementation of DevOps best practices.
* Leverage AI\-driven tools to improve monitoring, incident detection, and operational efficiency, enabling faster troubleshooting and reduced manual effort in day\-to\-day operations.

  

Stakeholder Coordination  

* Work closely with engineering, program teams, and external partners during incidents and changes.
* Provide structured updates to stakeholders with clarity and consistency.
* Ensure alignment during critical activities.

  

Risk Identification  

* Highlight operational and platform risks including test coverage gaps, infrastructure constraints, dependency risks.
* Escalate issues proactively and support mitigation tracking.

  

Team Contribution \& Mentorship  

* Support onboarding and guidance of junior team members.
* Contribute to runbooks, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
* Drive consistency in execution and adherence to operational standards.

  

Success in This Role Looks Like:  

1\. Deep Operational Ownership (“Built to Run” Mindset)  

A successful Lead SRE Engineer is fully accountable for the operational health of their program, not just responsive to incidents.  

* Monitoring, alerting, and dashboards that reflect real customer impact.
* Emergency response and incident leadership, including clear communications and post\-incident follow‑ups.
* Capacity planning and readiness aligned with product and business growth.
* Change management discipline, ensuring safe, compliant releases.

  

2\.Strong Technical \& System\-Level Understanding  

A Lead SRE Engineer is expected to operate at system dependency level, not just ticket or tool level.  

* Have a strong understanding of application business logic and workflows.
* Have a clear grasp of upstream/downstream dependencies.
* Expertise in observability (alerts, dashboards, synthetic monitoring).
* Ability to drive automation to reduce manual toil and recurring issues.
* End to End ownership of tasks and activities.

  

3\. Incident Leadership \& Decision\-Making Under Pressure  

Beyond technical skill, Leads are distinguished by how they lead during high‑severity situations.  

* Takes command of major incidents, not waiting to be asked.
* Maintains calm, structured communication with engineering, product, and leadership.
* Balances speed vs risk in decision\-making.
* Ensures clear ownership of actions, timelines, and follow‑ups.
* Drives root cause analysis and systemic fixes, not just recovery.

  

4\. Proactive Risk \& Reliability Engineering  

A successful Lead SRE prevents incidents more than fight them.  

* Identifies systemic risks before they become outages.
* Pushes for design, monitoring, or process improvements.
* Challenges “tribal knowledge” by insisting on documentation and runbooks.
* Drives improvements aligned with operational maturity models.

  

5\. Leadership Without Formal Authority  

Lead SRE Engineers often lead without being people managers, which requires strong influence skills.  

* Mentors and coaches senior and mid\-level SRE’s.
* Sets the technical and behavioral bar for the team.
* Gives clear, constructive feedback.
* Acts as a role model for ownership, urgency, and professionalism.
* Builds trust with Engineering, Product, and Platform teams.
* Flexible in terms of working hours where needed.

  

6\. Excellent Cross‑Functional Communication  

SRE Leads sit at the intersection of technology, operations, and business.  

* Translating technical issues into business impact to communicate clearly with senior stakeholders during incidents.
* Setting expectations early and transparently with junior team members.
* Represents SRE confidently in planning, reviews, and retrospectives,
* Ensuring post‑incident learnings are shared and acted upon.

  

  

All About You:  

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.  

8\+ years experience in production support, SRE, or BizOps roles.  

Exposure to managing incidents and supporting distributed systems.  

Experience in payments ecosystem will be preferred.  

Knowledge of monitoring and alerting tools like Splunk , Dynatrace , Blaze meter.  

Knowledge of automation and DevOps practices.  

Experience working in cross\-functional and high\-pressure environments.  

Ability to organize, multi\-task and prioritise work based on current business needs.  

Possesses strong verbal and written communication skills.  

Strong relationship skills, collaborative skills and stakeholder management skills.  

Experience in one or more of the following is preferred: C, C\+\+, Java, Python, Go, Perl or Ruby.  

Interest in designing, analysing and troubleshooting large\-scale distributed systems.  

Ability to work with little or no supervision.**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Singapore will host the **ASEAN Para Games 2029 (APG29\)**, making this a defining period for disability sport in the region and a rare opportunity to help build a strong, competitive Team Singapore for a home Games.

In this role, you will lead an assigned portfolio of para sports and take ownership of the full athlete development journey — from talent identification and transfer through to elite competition and major Games representation, with APG29 as a key milestone. Working within a collaborative Pathway and Performance team, you will play a central role in preparing Singapore’s para athletes to perform at their highest potential in front of a home crowd and on the regional and international stage.

**Sport Portfolio Management**

* Develop and implement quadrennial and annual performance plans for assigned para sports, with immediate focus on the ASEAN Para Games 2029 (APG29\) — which Singapore will host — and extending through the Asian Para Games, Commonwealth Games, and Paralympic Games cycles.
* Serve as SDSC’s primary liaison with NSAs, Para Sport Academy partners, and international federations for assigned sports; provide strategic oversight and guidance to NSA\-led programmes.
* Build and manage TeamSG for major championships and Games: coordinate travel, equipment, competition entries, team agreements, and budgets; serve as Team Manager or Secretariat as required.
* Actively monitor and manage athlete qualification pathways to ensure Singapore meets IPC and international federation qualification standards.
* Plan and deliver national championships, selection trials, and talent engagement events in partnership with the Events and Outreach team.

**Athlete Development \& Support**

* Identify and develop para athlete talent across assigned sports; drive talent identification and transfer activities and support SDSC’s NextGen Para Talent Programme.
* Lead the support of para athletes in assigned sports — including those on spexScholarship and spexPotential programmes — ensuring each athlete has a clear development pathway and the right level of programme services.
* Establish and maintain athlete performance monitoring systems; track progress against multi\-year targets and benchmark athletes against regional and international competitors.
* Proactively manage athlete classification timelines; liaise with international classifiers and sport federation classification panels to ensure athletes are competition\-ready.
* Work with Athlete Life Management to connect athletes to appropriate lifestyle and education support throughout their athletic career.

**Coaching \& Technical Support**

* Work with technical directors and coaches to ensure high\-quality, internationally benchmarked coaching provision across assigned sports.
* Identify and facilitate professional development opportunities for coaches; support the development of para sport coaching pathways and accreditation frameworks.
* Provide technical guidance on athlete training design, equipment selection, and sport\-specific adaptations for para athletes.
* Maintain regular liaison with NSAs and international federations to stay current on rule changes, technical regulations, and equipment standards.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Reporting**

* Foster strong, trust\-based relationships with athletes, coaches, caregivers, NSA partners, and institutional stakeholders, ensuring all parties are aligned to shared performance goals.
* Produce clear reports and recommendation papers — including budget proposals, entry criteria, selection criteria, and performance analyses — for the Pathway and Performance Director and relevant committees.
* Partner with the Corporate Communications team to promote assigned para sports and SDSC’s public profile and social impact mission.

* Support the planning manager to validate the forecast, and translate MFP forecast into capacity, allocation, material type. Use MFP forecast, historical and insights to provide initial allocation guidance for vendor allocation team, validate through critical GTM Milestones. * Understand demand forecasts and market information from regions, and use this to drive conversations and decisions for seasonal and long\-range planning
* Responsible to validate and present supply signal to ensure product supply group have one source of forecast for decision making

* Collect capacity risk assessment from capacity planning team and drive actions and resolutions with regional planning team
* Identify capacity risk and mitigation actions for both brand planning and product supply \- *Fairshare, prebuild, push\-out, re\-allocation, capacity increase, vendor own\-prebuild…etc.*
* Work with material planning to define material proposition strategy to optimize lead time while balancing liability risk
* Governance buy execution to ensure alignment with agreed actions during global consensus meeting
* Coordinate information/data gathering and system setup for smooth buy execution

description:
**Employment Type: Full\-Time**  

Work Setting: Remote
  

Work Location: Korea/International
  

Work Hours: Office hours
  

Find out more here: https://semianalysis.com  

  



**About SemiAnalysis**

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. Our in\-depth coverage spans the entire supply chain, from semiconductor fabrication processes to cutting\-edge AI Models, software, and infrastructure. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep\-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.


We’re a global team of over 50 analysts, each with extensive networks across the semiconductor supply chain and AI ecosystem, publishing industry‑shaping articles while participating in 40\+ conferences annually.


Our newsletter reaches more than 200 000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and C‑suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.


We also offer three core products:


* **Industry Models** – we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacenter demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.
* **Core Research** – our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distills our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.
* **Consulting and Technical Due Diligence** – We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private‑equity funds, leading venture‑capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.

**1\) Position Overview**
-------------------------

We are seeking a **Memory Market Analyst** to own supply\-and\-demand modeling across the DRAM, HBM, and NAND markets and contribute directly to the development of our **Memory Model** and **Accelerator \& HBM Model** .


This is not a purely financial role. Memory supply cannot be modeled credibly without understanding the technical factors that drive bit growth, including node migrations, wafer capacity conversions, die\-size penalties, NAND layer transitions, yield ramps, and packaging constraints.


You will translate this technical understanding into rigorous and defensible supply, demand, pricing, and financial forecasts used by leading asset managers, hyperscalers, and semiconductor companies worldwide.


The role is ideally based in **Seoul** , although exceptional candidates in other locations will also be considered.


**2\) Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Supply and Capacity Modeling**

* Build and maintain bottoms\-up supply models for DRAM, HBM, and NAND.
* Model fab\-by\-fab wafer capacity, node migration schedules, yield ramps, and bit growth from technology shrinks and wafer additions.
* Track production and technology transitions across Samsung, SK hynix, Micron, Kioxia, SanDisk, CXMT, and YMTC.
* Assess the effects of die\-size changes, wafer\-capacity conversions, process transitions, and manufacturing constraints on industry supply.

### **HBM and Advanced Packaging Analysis**

* Model HBM supply in detail, including trade ratios against commodity DRAM.
* Analyze TSV capacity, packaging bottlenecks, stack configurations, production yields, and qualification timelines.
* Track HBM qualification and supply agreements involving major AI accelerator and hyperscale customers.
* Evaluate how HBM production affects broader DRAM availability, product mix, pricing, and profitability.

### **Demand and Market Forecasting**

* Build demand models across AI accelerators, servers, smartphones, PCs, automotive, and other end markets.
* Develop particular depth in AI\-driven HBM demand and high\-density memory\-module requirements.
* Forecast contract and spot pricing, market sufficiency or deficits, inventory cycles, and customer purchasing behavior.
* Translate market assumptions into revenue, gross\-margin, earnings, and capital\-expenditure implications for covered companies.

### **Research and Client Support**

* Track memory\-maker earnings, capex announcements, capacity plans, product roadmaps, and industry developments.
* Identify and communicate key market catalysts to institutional clients in near\-real time.
* Publish concise, data\-rich research notes on memory\-market developments.
* Contribute to major SemiAnalysis newsletter reports and deep\-dive research projects.
* Support institutional clients through calls and the SemiAnalysis support portal.

### **Industry Engagement**

* Conduct channel checks with industry executives, investor\-relations teams, customers, suppliers, and other supply\-chain participants.
* Build and maintain relationships across Korea’s memory and semiconductor ecosystem.
* Represent SemiAnalysis at industry conferences, company meetings, and events across Korea and the broader APAC region.

**3\) Requirements**
--------------------

* 2–5\+ years of experience in equity research, industry analysis, corporate strategy, business planning, or a related role.
* Relevant experience at a memory manufacturer, OSAT, semiconductor supplier, financial institution, research firm, or memory\-adjacent company.
* Strong working knowledge of memory\-technology fundamentals, including:



	+ DRAM node naming and migration economics.
	+ NAND layer scaling and architecture transitions.
	+ HBM stack construction and packaging.
	+ Bits per wafer, cost per bit, yields, and manufacturing economics.
* Demonstrated ability to build and defend bottoms\-up supply\-and\-demand models using fragmented or incomplete information.
* Proven three\-statement financial\-modeling skills.
* Ability to connect technology, capacity, pricing, and product\-mix assumptions to revenue, margins, cash flow, and capital intensity.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex analysis clearly and concisely.
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving pricing and news environment while balancing speed, accuracy, and analytical rigor.
* Full professional proficiency in English.

**4\) Preferred Skills**
------------------------

* Korean\-language proficiency.
* Existing relationships across the Korean memory, semiconductor, equipment, materials, packaging, or investment ecosystem.
* Familiarity with Python for data analysis, automation, and model maintenance.
* Experience conducting channel checks or engaging directly with semiconductor executives, suppliers, customers, and investor\-relations teams.
* Experience covering Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, Micron, Kioxia, SanDisk, CXMT, YMTC, or related supply\-chain companies.
* Understanding of AI accelerator architectures and how accelerator deployments influence HBM capacity and memory demand.
* Experience producing institutional\-quality research reports or presenting analysis to investors and corporate decision\-makers.
* Ability to work across technical, financial, and commercial datasets to identify inconsistencies and develop independent conclusions.

**5\) Growth Areas**
--------------------

This role provides the opportunity to develop into a leading expert at the intersection of memory technology, semiconductor manufacturing, artificial intelligence infrastructure, and financial markets.


Potential growth areas include:


* Taking broader ownership of SemiAnalysis’ global Memory Model and Accelerator \& HBM Model.
* Developing deeper expertise in HBM, advanced packaging, AI accelerator supply chains, and next\-generation memory technologies.
* Expanding coverage into memory equipment, materials, controllers, modules, and adjacent semiconductor companies.
* Leading major research reports and becoming a recognized external voice on global memory\-market developments.
* Building direct relationships with senior executives, investors, hyperscalers, and semiconductor\-industry leaders.
* Representing SemiAnalysis at major global conferences, client meetings, and industry events.
* Mentoring junior analysts and helping develop the firm’s memory\-research capabilities.
* Progressing into a senior analyst, research lead, or broader semiconductor\-sector leadership position.

The Growth Business (GB) unit drives NTUC First Campus’ portfolio of growth and enrichment ventures, spanning Changemakers Explorer, Changemakers Afterschool, Chinese enrichment, in\-centre enrichment, Outdoor School, and the SEED social programmes, alongside regional expansion across Southeast Asia. GB operates as an entrepreneurial, build\-phase unit focused on scaling new revenue streams and brand\-led experiences for children and families.



The Marketing \& CRM Manager owns marketing execution and the end\-to\-end customer journey across all Growth Business lines. The role plans and runs marketing for each business line, maps and orchestrates the customer journey from first awareness through enrolment, retention, and renewal, and activates that journey across every channel, from WhatsApp and email to CRM, social, web, and ad retargeting.



The CRM and marketing automation platform is the engine behind this work, giving the role a single, reliable view of every family and the ability to reach them with the right message, on the right channel, at the right moment. The incumbent works in close partnership with the Performance Marketing Lead on paid acquisition and retargeting, and with the enrolment leads across CEB, CAE, and SEED, providing the marketing and systems that strengthen their conversion work rather than duplicating it.


**Key Responsibilities**



A. Marketing across Growth Business Lines



Plan and run marketing for each Growth Business line (Changemakers Explorer, Changemakers Afterschool, Chinese enrichment, in\-centre enrichment, Outdoor School, and SEED programmes), tailored to each brand, audience, and business objective.



Develop and execute marketing plans and campaigns that drive awareness, enquiry, and enrolment across the portfolio.



Own the marketing calendar across the business lines, ensuring a consistent cadence and clear prioritisation.



Work with the Brand \& Strategy Lead to translate brand and strategy into effective, on\-brand marketing execution.

  



B. Customer Journey \& Lifecycle Marketing



Map and own the end\-to\-end customer journey for each business line, from first awareness through enquiry, enrolment, onboarding, retention, and renewal.



Design and run lifecycle campaigns and automated nurture journeys that move families through each stage and deepen engagement.



Identify friction points and drop\-offs in the journey and act to improve conversion and retention.



Personalise messaging and offers by segment, stage, and behaviour across the portfolio.

  



C. Multi\-Channel Orchestration



Orchestrate marketing across all owned and paid channels, including WhatsApp, email, SMS, CRM, social, web, and ad retargeting, ensuring a coherent experience across touchpoints.



Build and manage the audiences and segments that power targeted messaging and retargeting.



Partner with the Performance Marketing Lead to align retargeting audiences and paid activity with the customer journey and CRM data.



Select, integrate, and get the most from the channel and messaging tools in the marketing stack.

  



D. CRM Platform \& Marketing Automation



Own, administer, and continuously improve the CRM and marketing automation platform across the Growth Business portfolio.



Manage lead capture, scoring, segmentation, and routing so that every enquiry reaches the right enrolment team at the right time.



Maintain a clean, reliable, and PDPA\-compliant database, with strong data governance and hygiene across all business lines.



Serve as the system owner for CRM and automation across the marketing and enrolment teams.

  



E. Analytics, Reporting \& Optimisation



Build and maintain dashboards that track the funnel, customer journey, channel performance, and campaign effectiveness across all lines.



Translate data into clear, actionable insight for the marketing team, the CGO, and the enrolment leads.



Run testing and optimisation across channels, journeys, and campaigns to improve yield over time.



Support forecasting and target\-setting with reliable pipeline and conversion data.

  



F. Cross\-Functional Enablement



Partner closely with the enrolment leads across CEB, CAE, and SEED so that marketing and the CRM serve their conversion work on the ground.



Lead the implementation of any funnel\-optimisation technology adopted by the Growth Business, including third\-party platforms and engines.



Work with IT and external vendors to keep the marketing and CRM stack integrated, secure, and fit for purpose.



Champion adoption and capability\-building so that marketing and enrolment teams use the tools and data consistently and well.

  


**Key Requirements**


* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years’ relevant experience spanning marketing execution and CRM or lifecycle marketing, ideally across multiple brands or business lines.
* Strong track record running multi\-channel marketing (including WhatsApp, email, social, and paid retargeting) and customer journey or lifecycle programmes.
* Hands\-on mastery of a CRM and marketing automation platform (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent).
* Strong data and analytics capability, with the ability to build dashboards and turn data into action.
* Experience working across marketing and frontline sales or enrolment teams, with the diplomacy to enable rather than encroach.
* Sound understanding of data governance and PDPA\-compliant data management.
* Experience within education, services, or family\-oriented sectors will be advantageous.
* Personal Attributes
* A marketer who thinks in customer journeys and can join brand, channel, and data into one coherent experience.
* Both creative and analytical, comfortable moving between campaign ideas and funnel metrics.
* Collaborative and service\-minded, able to build trust across marketing and enrolment teams.
* Hands\-on, organised, and able to run multiple business lines and channels at once.
* Comfortable working in an agile, fast\-evolving, build\-phase environment.

  




Other Skills \& Knowledge


* Familiarity with WhatsApp Business or conversational marketing platforms (e.g. Omnichat, WATI, or similar).
* Experience integrating CRM with paid media and web for audience building and retargeting.
* Familiarity with marketing analytics and visualisation tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Looker, Power BI).
* Exposure to AI\-driven lead scoring or funnel optimisation tools.

title: AI Prototyping Coordinator / Project Manager
description:
We are looking for an AI Prototyping Coordinator / Project Manager to sit at the intersection of business teams and technical delivery. This role owns the coordination, scoping and hands\-on build of AI prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts (POCs), turning business ideas into working demonstrations that can be tested with users and, where successful, handed off for full\-scale engineering. The role does not require deep AI research expertise, but does require the ability to build functional prototypes (no\-code/low\-code, Python, or via AI application builders), manage a project end to end, and coordinate effectively across business and IT stakeholders.


### **ABOUT THE JOB**


**Data \& Requirements Coordination**


* Maintain a working inventory of relevant data sources, systems and formats needed to support AI prototyping initiatives, in coordination with IT and data teams.
* Gather and document business requirements from stakeholders, translating loosely defined ideas into clear prototype briefs and user stories.
* Coordinate access to internal and external data sources needed for prototype development, working with data owners on extraction and usage.

**AI Prototype Development**


* Build functional AI prototypes and POCs (chatbots, assistants, simple RAG/search tools, automation workflows) using no\-code/low\-code platforms, off\-the\-shelf AI application builders, and basic scripting (Python) where needed.
* Assemble simple retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) demos connecting a knowledge base or document set to an AI model, using existing tools and platforms rather than building infrastructure from scratch.
* Configure and test AI application builders, low\-code agent platforms and reporting/BI tools to support rapid prototyping.
* Iterate on prototypes based on stakeholder and user feedback, prioritising speed and clarity of demonstration over production\-grade engineering.

**Project \& Stakeholder Management**


* Own the end\-to\-end project plan for each prototype: scoping, timeline, milestones, resourcing and status reporting to business and IT stakeholders.
* Act as the day\-to\-day point of contact between business units, IT/engineering teams and, where relevant, external vendors or consultants supporting the build.
* Organise and facilitate working sessions, demos and feedback loops, including human\-in\-the\-loop testing with end users before wider rollout.
* Prepare clear documentation, status updates and decision materials (slides, one\-pagers) for steering committees and sponsors.

**Testing, Governance \& Handover**


* Define lightweight success criteria for each prototype (accuracy, usefulness, adoption) and track results through user testing.
* Flag data privacy, security and responsible\-use considerations to IT/security teams, ensuring prototypes stay within approved guardrails.
* Prepare handover documentation and a business case for prototypes that are validated and ready to move into a formal engineering backlog for productionisation.
* Maintain a repository of prototypes, learnings and reusable components to accelerate future initiatives.

**Tools \& Analytics Support**


* Support the selection and evaluation of AI/data tools and platforms (BI tools, data visualisation, AI app builders) suited to business needs.
* Provide first\-level support and training to business users on prototype tools once deployed.

### **ABOUT YOU**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in project coordination, project management, business analysis, or a related role, preferably with exposure to data, digital, AI, or automation initiatives.
* Hands\-on experience developing or configuring AI/automation prototypes using no\-code/low\-code platforms, AI application builders such as Copilot Studio or Power Platform, and/or basic Python scripting.
* Good working knowledge of AI and LLM concepts, including prompting, RAG, and AI agents, with the ability to scope, assess, and support prototypes without requiring deep machine learning expertise.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
* Highly organised and capable of managing multiple workstreams simultaneously, with a practical, iterative approach to delivery.

### **WHY AMARIS?**


* An international community bringing together 110\+ different nationalities
* An environment where trust has a central place: 70% of our key leaders started their careers at the first level of responsibilities
* A robust training system with our internal Academy and 250\+ available modules
* A vibrant workplace that frequently gathers for internal events (afterworks, team buildings, etc.)
* At Mantu, sustainability is part of everything we do. You’ll have the opportunity to turn your ideas into action and make a tangible impact. Every day, our teams bring our ESG commitments to life, from reducing our footprint to driving positive change within our communities. Through our WeCare Together program, you’ll be empowered to design and lead projects that create real social or environmental impact, with the company’s full support.

*Amaris Consulting is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace. We are committed to promoting diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. For this purpose, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or other characteristics.*


\#LI\-AP5

---------------


**Amaris Consulting** is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Risk and Control Framework

Experience reviewing customer and vendor contracts and determining their accounting implications.
  
  

Hands\-on experience with Oracle NetSuite, particularly its reporting capabilities.
  
  

Track record in finance process improvement, automation, standardisation or transformation programmes.
  
  

Sound understanding of financial controls, governance and risk management.
  
  

Comfortable working across different countries, entities and regulatory environments.

We're hiring a Senior Account Executive to own end\-to\-end sales for Aspire's Employer of Record (EOR) product. This is a hunter role for a proven closer, someone who doesn't wait for pipeline to land in their lap, but goes out and builds it.


You will own the full sales cycle: from prospecting and outbound outreach to running complex, multi\-stakeholder deals and driving them to close. You'll work with founders, CFOs, and HR leaders navigating international expansion, cross\-border hiring, and compliance complexity and you'll be their trusted advisor through it all.


This is the right role for you if you've closed deals at other EOR players and you're ready to bring that playbook to a high\-growth fintech with a differentiated product.


**What You'll Do**

**1\. Outbound Prospecting \& Pipeline Generation**

* Build and own your own outbound pipeline through cold outreach, LinkedIn, events, referrals, and partner channels
* Identify and target high\-fit accounts: startups, scaling SMBs, and mid\-market companies with cross\-border hiring needs in SG, HK and the broader APAC region
* Develop a territory plan and execute it with discipline: tracking activity, pipeline health, and conversion rates in CRM
Collaborate with Marketing to amplify outbound efforts, but hold yourself accountable for pipeline generation regardless  
* 

**2\. Full\-Cycle Deal Ownership**

* Own the end\-to\-end sales cycle from first outreach to signed contract
* Run structured discovery to uncover hiring needs, compliance challenges, headcount growth plans, and key decision\-making dynamics
* Deliver compelling product demos and tailor value propositions for each stakeholder \- HR, Finance, Founders.
* Handle commercial negotiation, pricing conversations, and contract sign\-off with minimal escalation

**3\. Consultative Expertise**

* Serve as the go\-to expert on EOR, global payroll, cross\-border compliance, and Aspire's product suite
* Proactively identify triggers for EOR adoption: market expansion, remote\-first hiring strategies, cost optimisation, compliance risk reduction
* Advise prospects on country\-specific nuances, employment law considerations, and Aspire's coverage across 50\+ countries

**4\. Customer Handoff \& Early Success**

* Ensure a smooth transition from closed\-won to onboarding, collaborating closely with Customer Success and Operations
* Remain engaged during early customer lifecycle to protect NRR and drive expansion opportunities

**5\. GTM Collaboration \& Feedback Loop**

* Work cross\-functionally with Marketing and Product to sharpen positioning, surface product gaps, and refine ICP
* Maintain clean CRM hygiene, accurate forecasting, and detailed deal notes so the whole team benefits from your deal intelligence

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of B2B SaaS or HRTech/EOR/Payroll sales experience, with at least 2 years in a full\-cycle AE role
* Proven track record of consistently hitting or exceeding quota with specific deal examples you can speak to
* Strong outbound muscle: you've built pipeline from scratch, not just worked inbound queues
* Experience closing complex, multi\-stakeholder deals with ACV of USD 30K\+ annually
* Excellent communication and executive presence \- you're comfortable pitching to a CFO or CEO
* Based in Singapore or India, with the ability to meet customers in\-person when needed

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience at Deel, Remote, Multiplier, Rippling, Velocity Global, Papaya Global, or a comparable EOR/HRTech company
* Deep familiarity with EOR, cross\-border payroll, global employment compliance, or international HR
* Experience selling into the APAC and/or South Asia market \- understanding buyer personas, decision cycles, and regional nuances
* Comfort using data and CRM analytics to drive forecasting and prioritise opportunities
* Ability to run webinars, roundtables, or in\-person events to build pipeline and brand presence

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary with uncapped variable \- the more you close, the more you earn
* Uncapped flexible annual leave
* A high\-calibre team of ex\-founders, operators, and sales leaders who will push you to grow

description:

**Group:****Department:****Section:****Job Type:****Req ID:** 12145
Temasek’s purpose, “So Every Generation Prospers” is our North Star, serving as a single, unifying pledge that encapsulates who we are, and why we do what we do. As a generational investor, we seek to deliver sustainable returns over the long term, with a spirit of doing things today with tomorrow in mind. As a firm, what differentiates us is our commitment to do well, do right, and do good. We are constantly building future\-centric capabilities and creating enablers for innovation and growth. Sustainability remains at our core – we need to act now to deliver a better, more inclusive and resilient future for all.  

  

Temasek is a global investment company headquartered in Singapore with a net portfolio value of S$518 billion (US$401 billion, €350 billion, £304 billion, and RMB2\.77 trillion) on a mark\-to\-market basis as at 31 March 2026, spanning across a myriad of private and public listed companies as well as diverse industry sectors. For information on Temasek, please visit www.temasek.com.sg.**Introduction**  


We are looking for a project intern to join one of our teams in the first half of 2027\. You will be working closely with one of our teams (description of hiring teams below) with key responsibilities and opportunities including:


* Support evaluation of investment opportunities in companies through industry/company research and analysis
* Support scoping of value creation opportunities for portfolio companies such as: industry landscaping, peer benchmarking, strategy refocusing, JV/Partnership analysis
* Monitor market trends, performance of portfolio companies and supporting landscaping studies of companies in new sectors
* Prepare financial models and write investment memos
* Work closely with the team to support the preparation of presentations and analysis
**Qualifications/Capabilities**  

* Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in any discipline, preferably having taken modules in finance, accounting, corporate finance, or economics, and with a passion in investing
* Previous internship experience in investment banking, management consulting, private equity, venture capital or M\&A / corporate development is preferred
* High level of interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong financial literacy, analytical skill and spreadsheet modelling skills
* Able to work well with diverse teams and deal with multiple stakeholders
* Self\-starter with a proven ability to manage multiple priorities and to work independently
**Application Details**  


Please state the following clearly in your resume/CV:
* Availability (Start Date \- End Date)
* Team preference in order of ranking from most preferred to least preferred.

  



Successful candidates will be assigned to a team based on preference indicated by both hiring team and candidate. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview to find out more about the respective teams. We encourage you to apply early, as the application will be reviewed on a rolling basis.**Team Description**
**Agri\-Food**

The Agri\-Food investment team invests in and works with innovative companies in the food and agriculture sectors that are unlocking their potential while making a difference in the world. Our sub\-sectors of interest encompass the entire Agri\-Food value chain, and include alternative protein, vertical farming, digital platforms, and biotechnology among others. With over $10 billion invested since inception, the team’s investment portfolio consists of many market\-leading and innovative companies from around the world. The team invests across a wide spectrum of investment opportunities, including early stage, growth equity, and control / co\-control investments. We are recognized as one of the leading investors and thought leaders globally in Agri\-Food, having been selected as the "Agritech Investor of the Year (2022\)" by Agri Investor.  


**Artificial Intelligence (AI)**

The AI adopts a tech\-centric investment approach to AI and aims to identify and capture opportunities in AI for Temasek and its broader portfolio ecosystem. It invests across 1\) early\-stage, AI\-native companies, 2\) AI\-specialist VC funds, and 3\) venture building, where it has set up a number of ventures, including Minden.ai, Aicadium and Resaro AI.  



Potential candidate should ideally have an interest in the field of AI, preferably with a background in either finance/VC/investing or software engineering.  


**Asia Pacific (excluding China \& India)**

Be part of the investment team covering APAC markets (excluding China and India), supporting the sourcing, evaluation, execution, and portfolio management of investments across sectors. This role offers exposure to the full investment lifecycle within a long\-term, value\-oriented global investment platform.  


**Blockchain**

The Blockchain team leads Temasek’s efforts in exploring opportunities in blockchain technology. The team is pioneering efforts to expand Temasek’s scope beyond traditional investing.  


**Financial Services**

The Financial Services team invests globally in companies that benefit from long term secular themes such as the digitization of commerce and infrastructure. The team evaluates opportunities from early\-stage disruptors to more mature cash generative companies listed in public markets, in core focus areas such as i) payments and commerce enablement, ii) capital market infrastructure, iii) financial software, iv) emerging market technology platforms and v) wealth.
**Innovation**

The Innovation team is responsible for investing in promising high growth companies and venture/growth funds globally. The team pursues a three\-pronged strategy through direct investments in disruptive technology companies showing meaningful inflection on commercial traction, fund investments in global leading venture capital and growth funds, and establishing/anchoring strategic platforms to address market gaps within the innovation economy. There is a global mandate with a core focus in North America, Europe and Israel. Portfolio companies include Zipline, Twin Health, Loft Orbital, Solugen, Truelayer and Solid Energy, among others.  


**Impact Investing**

Impact Investing team focuses on investing into innovative business solutions that tackle challenges for the underserved demographic across global emerging markets. Sectors of interest include financial services, healthcare, agriculture, education, and climate.

Our strategy predominantly focuses on fund investments by supporting leading impact fund managers (both private equity and venture capital). Beyond investments, the team also has developed its proprietary Impact Management and Measurement framework and actively engages with the impact investing ecosystem to advance impact practice. The team is also actively involved in broader impact ecosystem building, collaborating with partners in Asia and beyond, incl. Centre for Impact Investing \& Practices, GIIN, etc.  



Potential candidate should be passionate about making a difference, preferably with skillsets and demonstrated interests in emerging markets, finance / investing and impact methodologies/measurement.  


**Investment Performance Management (IPM)**

Drive unified alignment across the organization to support Temasek’s strategic investment vision and enhance our overall investment performance.  


**New Energy \& Industrials (NEI)**

The NEI team invests globally in companies that benefit from the long\-term secular themes of Energy Transition and Industry 4\.0\. Key sub\-sectors of focus include i) batteries, ii) advanced fuels, iii) renewables, iv) hydrogen, v) building/industry decarbonization, and vi) robotics \& intralogistics automation. The team invests across a diverse set of opportunities including growth equity/scale\-up plays to more mature late\-stage/ buyout situations in the private domain, to various opportunities in listed assets.
**Private Equity Capital Solutions (PECS)**

PECS invests in many of the world’s premier Private Equity fund managers. With a portfolio that spans across the Americas, Europe and Asia, we generate many fund and direct co\-investment opportunities in different industries globally. The successful candidate will have hands\-on experience of both Private Equity fund and direct investments opportunities alongside our global investment team.  


**Portfolio Development (PD)**

Our Portfolio Development team partners with select major portfolio companies to build/unlock and drive value creation for long\-term sustainable returns. We work closely with the Boards and Management of the companies to plan and execute strategic initiatives which take into account changing market conditions, industry/sector trends and disruptors. We also build platforms to address disruptive trends and opportunities and transform existing businesses to better position companies for the future. Combining capabilities across M\&A, strategy, transformation, operational and industry experience, we aim to build a collaborative partnership with our companies, going beyond investing to building for resilient growth. Examples include Sembcorp demerger, merger of Sembcorp Marine and Keppel O\&M, CapitaLand restructuring, Olam restructuring, SATS acquisition of WFS etc.  


**Structuring \& Execution**

S\&E is Temasek’s in\-house M\&A specialist team within the Investment Group and focuses on structuring and executing large and complex transactions for Temasek. The team has worked on \>US$20b of announced deals since 2022, spanning various sectors and geographies. Examples of transactions include public and private M\&A, JVs, capital raises and restructuring, among others.  



The successful candidate will be joining a lean and highly collaborative team, working closely with various teams across the Temasek ecosystem. This internship also provides the opportunity for candidates to hone their corporate finance skills and a springboard into investment banking, with past interns placing into Tier 1 investment banks / private equity firms.  


**Real Estate**

The real estate team invests in equity and credit opportunities across US, Europe, and Asia. The successful candidate will gain broad exposure from investing and managing a large and diversified portfolio, including public and private investments at both asset\-level and company\-level.
