title: ServiceNow Business Process Consultant (HRSD)
description:
**Role Overview**
  

  

The ServiceNow Business Process Consultant / Business Analyst \- HR Service Delivery (HRSD) is a pivotal role at the intersection of HR process design, stakeholder engagement, and ServiceNow platform implementation. You will be responsible for analysing, designing, documenting, and optimising HR service delivery processes on the ServiceNow platform, ensuring that solutions are aligned with business requirements, ServiceNow best practices, and client governance standards.
  

  

You will work closely with HR stakeholders, subject matter experts, solution architects, and offshore delivery teams to translate HR business needs into clear configuration specifications, process maps, user stories, and test artefacts \- driving high\-quality outcomes across the full implementation lifecycle. You will also champion AI\-readiness, knowledge management quality, and change management adoption on HRSD engagements.
  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
  

  

**Requirements Gathering \& Process Analysis**
  

  

* Facilitate and document requirements workshops with HR stakeholders across all Centres of Excellence (COEs) \- including Talent Acquisition, Reward \& Performance, Learning \& Development, Payroll, and HR Operations.

  

* Translate business requirements into ServiceNow HRSD configuration specifications, process maps, and functional design documents.

  

* Document as\-is HR processes, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and map to to\-be ServiceNow workflows \- including routing rules, escalation paths, and SLA tiers.

  

* Maintain a live requirements traceability matrix (RTM) to ensure all business requirements are tracked through to configuration, testing, and sign\-off.

  

* Produce clear and structured business analysis artefacts including user stories, acceptance criteria, process narratives, and data flow diagrams.

  

**Solution Design \& Platform Advisory**
  

  

* Translate business requirements into ServiceNow HRSD solution designs covering HR Case Management, Employee Service Centre, HR Services, HR Catalogue, Record Producers, Assignment Rules, Lifecycle Events, and Knowledge Management.

  

* Advise business stakeholders on ServiceNow HRSD standard processes, platform capabilities, and configuration options \- clearly articulating trade\-offs between configuration and customisation.

  

* Collaborate with the ServiceNow Solution Architect and development teams on configuration decisions, integration requirements, and data model considerations.

  

* Support AI\-readiness for NowAssist chatbot integration \- ensuring knowledge articles are structured, tagged by COE and service category, and reviewed for auto\-resolution quality.

  

* Work with integration teams to define interface requirements between ServiceNow HRSD and HRIS/HCM systems (e.g. Workday, SAP SuccessFactors) and other enterprise platforms.

  

**Knowledge Management**
  

  

* Collaborate with HR Knowledge Managers and subject matter experts to draft, structure, and quality\-review knowledge base (KB) articles for the Singapore market.

  

* Ensure knowledge articles are appropriately tagged by COE, service category, and audience type to support self\-service and NowAssist AI auto\-resolution rates.

  

* Liaise with HR SMEs to validate accuracy of compensation, benefits, policy, and regulatory content published in the Employee Service Centre.

  

* Apply familiarity with the Knowledge Management lifecycle (Draft Review Approved Published Retired) and taxonomy design to maintain a high\-quality KB.

  

**Testing, UAT \& Quality Assurance**
  

  

* Prepare, execute, and manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) test scripts covering HR service categories, queue routing, SLA enforcement, and lifecycle event workflows.

  

* Log, triage, and track defects in ServiceNow, coordinating resolution with offshore delivery and configuration teams.

  

* Obtain formal sign\-off from HR stakeholders at each testing cycle gate, maintaining clear test evidence and traceability to requirements.

  

* Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and end\-to\-end scenario validation in collaboration with technical teams.

  

**Change Management \& Stakeholder Engagement**
  

  

* Work with HR business stakeholders to deliver change impact assessments and readiness surveys for HR agents and service centre staff.

  

* Develop stakeholder communications, training materials, and adoption tracking metrics to support successful HRSD go\-live and hypercare.

  

* Capture agent and stakeholder feedback post\-training and translate into knowledge base updates, workflow refinements, and continuous improvement recommendations.

  

* Coordinate with the ServiceNow Solution Architect and offshore teams to resolve configuration and integration issues, escalating risks and issues to the Engagement Manager in a structured and timely manner.

  

**Delivery Governance \& Project Administration**
  

  

* Participate in daily standups, sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and governance checkpoints as the business analysis lead on HRSD workstreams.

  

* Maintain action logs, decision registers, RAID logs, and weekly status summaries for stakeholder reporting.

  

* Assist in the scoping of new opportunities and the preparation of client approach documents, proposals, and Statements of Work (SOWs) under the direction of Engagement Leadership.

  

* Ensure solutions adhere to ServiceNow best practices, client security and compliance requirements, and maintainability standards.

  

**Skills, Qualifications \& Experience**
  

  

**Domain \& Functional Knowledge**
  

  

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst, Business Process Consultant, or Functional Consultant on ServiceNow HRSD implementations \- or strong experience in HR service operations with demonstrable ServiceNow exposure.

  

* Good understanding of ServiceNow HRSD module components: HR Case Management, Employee Service Centre, HR Services, HR Catalogue, Knowledge Management, Lifecycle Events, and Assignment Rules.

  

* Understanding of HR service delivery processes \- case management, employee onboarding/offboarding, HR knowledge management, self\-service portals, and SLA management.

  

* Exposure to HR processes such as Talent Acquisition, Reward \& Performance, or Learning \& Development within regulated or enterprise environments is advantageous.

  

* Familiarity with HRIS/HCM platforms such as Workday or SAP SuccessFactors and their integration patterns with ServiceNow.

  

* Awareness of AI\-assisted HR tooling including NowAssist, conversational AI, intent libraries, and knowledge deflection metrics is an advantage.

  

**Business Analysis \& Process Skills**
  

  

* Strong experience eliciting requirements, facilitating workshops, and producing functional specifications, user stories, process maps, and test scenarios.

  

* Demonstrated ability to document as\-is/to\-be processes, identify gaps, and translate business needs into structured platform configuration specifications.

  

* Experience maintaining requirements traceability matrices, action logs, decision registers, and test evidence packs.

  

* Solid grasp of the testing lifecycle \- test script authoring, SIT/UAT coordination, defect triage, and release readiness sign\-off.

  

* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and daily standups.

  

**Interpersonal \& Professional Skills**
  

  

* Strong facilitation and communication skills \- able to run requirements workshops, present findings, and manage stakeholder expectations at all levels.

  

* Excellent written communication and documentation discipline \- able to produce clear, structured, and audit\-ready artefacts.

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; able to simplify complex HR processes into implementable ServiceNow solution components.

  

* Collaborative mindset; effective working with HR stakeholders, solution architects, developers, and offshore delivery teams.

  

* Strong organisational skills \- able to manage parallel workstreams across multiple COEs and meet sprint\-based milestones.

  

* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office suite; familiarity with ServiceNow reporting or Performance Analytics is an advantage.

  

**Certifications**
  

  

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) \- Advantageous
  

  

ServiceNow HR Fundamentals Certification \- Advantageous
  

  

ServiceNow CIS \- HRSD \- Preferred
  

  

ITIL Foundation v3 / v4 \- Preferred
  

  

Agile / Scrum Practitioner Certification \- Advantageous
  

  

BA / Business Analysis Certification (e.g. CBAP, CCBA) \- Advantageous
  

  

**Education**
  

  

A degree or equivalent professional qualification in Information Technology, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline is preferred. Equivalent practical experience as a Business Analyst or Process Consultant on ServiceNow implementations will be given equal consideration, consistent with merit\-based hiring principles.

Collaborate with RFMs and RWLs to translate these insights into actionable, long\-term continuous improvement plans.

Provide ongoing coaching to site teams and emerging leaders. Foster a culture of continuous learning and accountability.
  
Revamp and manage the onboarding process for new hires alongside line managers, ensuring rapid integration into the team and immediate understanding of operational standards and cultural expectations.
  
Maintain a skills matrix for the operations team. Create personalized development plans to address individual and team\-wide competency gaps.
  
Lead change management initiatives when rolling out new processes, technologies, or organizational structures. Act as a change agent to overcome resistance, ensure staff adoption of new standards, and communicate the benefits of operational improvements to all stakeholders.
  
  

**4\. Key performance indicators for this position (KPIs) (50%) :** Operational stability and improvement via KPI, CSAT survey, training delivery
  
360 performance review by line manager, peers, subordinates and clients.
  
Annual finance targets
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply you will have:** A university degree or professional qualification in engineering/facilities management;
  
Over 5 years practical experience in facilities operations;
  
Interpersonal skills with a strong client focus.
  
Travel frequency\-up to 25% travel around the APAC region.
  
Technical comprehension and experience with performance\-based service contracts and vendor management both soft and technical.
  
Proven track record in designing and delivering training programs.
  
Experience with multi\-site operations or floating resource models is highly desirable.
  
Strong understanding of FM operational workflows in client account and industry standards.
  
Excellent presentation, public speaking, and coaching skills.
  
Proficiency in process mapping tools (e.g., Visio) and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
  
Change management expertise with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  
Microsoft Office and knowledge of relevant software
  
Knowledge of occupational safety requirements
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Growth Marketing Associate
description:
**About Endowus**
-----------------


Endowus is an award\-winning, independent fee\-only wealth platform licensed in Singapore (MAS 101051\) and Hong Kong (SFC BQR225\). We serve over 300,000 clients—individuals, family offices, charities, and institutions—with over US$12 billion in assets under advice.


Our mission: help people invest better so they can live easier today, and better tomorrow. Today, we work with 100\+ global leading asset managers across major asset classes – public markets, private markets, hedge funds and alternatives – and make it our job to assess and access their Best\-in\-Class funds, and advise clients on how to invest in these funds to reach their goals.


The team has deep domain knowledge in finance and technology, bringing together decades of experience from various banks and tech companies. We treasure our diversity in background and experience, and we look for people who share these beliefs in our mission.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


We are seeking a Growth Marketing Associate who is eager to experience what it takes to be a full\-funnel marketer. You will **work across** the entire journey—from the ad that first catches a client's eye to the lifecycle campaign that keeps them investing.This is a hands\-on, high ownership role, where you will help to build, ship, and measure the campaigns that bring new clients to Endowus and deepen the relationship with existing ones.


In this role, you'll manage real budgets and communicate with hundreds of thousands of clients primarily in our Singapore market, while also supporting our Hong Kong initiatives. This offers a unique opportunity to gain regional exposure across two of APAC's most important wealth markets, all within a regulated environment.


It’s an exciting time to be a marketer in the age of AI. We're hiring for how you think, not the tools you already know. Working with AI is a given here–Endowus moves fast on adopting new tools, and this role gives you room to explore them. We’re looking for someone who knows which problem is worth solving, asking the sharper question, reading data with a keen eye, and seeing the whole funnel as one system.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* **Lifecycle Marketing:** Identify the right audience, the right moment, and the right message, then bring it to life across EDMs, push notifications, and in\-app messaging. You'll run promotional campaigns and lifecycle strategies that nurture clients through their investment journey, and meaningfully contribute to how we grow lasting client relationships.
* **Paid Acquisition:** Go deep on the digital channels that drive acquisition (Meta, Reddit, Google, and beyond), building audiences and ad\-group setup, running creative tests, optimising CAC and budget utilisation. You'll learn how to acquire clients efficiently at scale and see the direct impact of your decisions on how Endowus grows our client base.
* **Collaborate with Cross Business Units:** Work hand in hand with teams across Endowus (Product, Data, Client Advisory, and the Investment Office) to craft seamless, engaging customer journeys. It's a great opportunity to learn how each part of the business fits together and understand the full picture of how a wealth platform works.

**Where This Role Grows**
=========================


As you master execution and build judgment on what moves our metrics, the role can gradually expand to include strategy: owning channel mix and designing lifecycle and cohort journeys, moving from reporting into experimentation, and partnering with product and data on the growth roadmap. We will map this progression with you explicitly, with clear milestones.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **The Must\-Haves**

* **Sharp Problem Framing:** You instinctively ask the question behind the question. Before executing, you can tell whether a brief is solving the right problem, and you reframe it when it isn't.
* **Data Judgment and Skepticism:** You don't just read a dashboard, you interrogate it. You can compute and interpret data points, and expand on the “so what” next steps from the data.
* **Systems Thinking:** You see the funnel as one connected system, not a stack of separate channels. You understand how a change in acquisition ripples into lifecycle, data, and cost, and you optimise for the whole rather than a single box.
* **AI\-Native Leverage:** You use AI and modern tooling to move faster and go deeper, treating them as a force multiplier in your work. You'd rather learn a new tool in a week than lean on one you already know.
* **Execution Rigour:** You pair systems thinking with real operational discipline. In a regulated environment where a wrong send reaches hundreds of thousands of clients and money moves, you sweat the details that matter and ship clean, accountable work.
* **Clear Cross\-Functional Communicator:** You work and collaborate well across content, design, product, compliance, and external vendors, and can explain your reasoning and results simply.

**The Nice\-to\-Haves**
-----------------------

* **1 to 3 years in growth, performance, CRM, or lifecycle marketing (strong internship experience counts)**. We care more about how you think than which platforms you've touched.
* Familiarity with paid platforms (Meta, Google, Reddit), an MMP (Adjust/AppsFlyer), a CRM/lifecycle tool (Braze or similar), or product analytics (Amplitude, SQL query)—or the demonstrated ability to ramp on any of them fast.
* Exposure to HTML/email build, Webflow, or Figma.
* Interest in fintech, investing, or wealth management, and a strong aptitude for growing into a strategic growth role.

**How We Work and How We Hire**
-------------------------------


We are building an AI\-native growth team. We assume the mechanics of execution will keep getting more efficient, so we hire for the things that don't: judgment, curiosity, and the ability to think in systems. Our interview process will reflect this. Rather than quizzing you on tools, we will give you messy, real\-world scenarios and watch how you frame it, what you ask, and how you sanity\-check the data. Come ready to think out loud, not to recite your experience based on existing systems and tools.

**Our Investors, recognition, licensing**
=========================================


Founded in 2017, Endowus has raised over US$130 million from investors including UBS, EDBI, Prosus Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Citi Ventures, MUFG Innovation Partners, Singtel Innov8, Samsung Ventures, SBVA, Illuminate Financial, OSK Ventures, Z Venture Capital, and ACF – a joint venture between JLIN LLC and The Wells Investments. Endowus also counts some of the largest billionaire family offices in Asia among its investors.


Endowus partners with 1,000\+ global fund managers across public markets, private markets, hedge funds, and alternatives to deliver world\-class solutions at transparent cost through its fee\-only model. Private Wealth clients access curated strategies from firms such as EQT, Carlyle, Partners Group, KKR, Ares, Brookfield Oaktree, HarbourVest, Millennium, Point72, Bridgewater, and more.Recognition includes CNBC's World's Top FinTech Companies 2025, the Financial Times' High\-Growth Companies Asia Pacific 2025 (\#45\), Fortune Fintech Innovators Asia 2024, and the World Economic Forum's Technology Pioneers 2023\. The platform has won Asia's Best Digital Wealth Management and Hong Kong's Best FinTech Innovation in Asset Management (Asia Asset Management 2025\), Singapore's Best Digital Wealth Management Experience (The Asset Triple A 2025\), and Best WealthTech Solution 2023 (Asian Private Banker).


The Endowus Group comprises licensed companies in Hong Kong and Singapore, and Hong Kong\-based multi\-family office Carret Private. With group assets over **US$12 billion**, Endowus is one of the largest independent wealth managers in Asia, estimated to save clients more than US$50 million in fees per year. Also pls double check that all the awards in the logo below have been captured.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**About Us**


Finmo is a next\-generation Treasury Operating System that enables CFOs to see their financial operations in real time and forecast what's coming next. It unifies payments, cash and liquidity management, FX risk management, and financial reporting into a single intelligent platform, transforming fragmented data into connected, actionable intelligence.  

  

Finmo is backed by leading fintech investors. Our oversubscribed US$18\.5M Series A was co\-led by PayPal Ventures and Quona Capital, with participation from Citi Ventures, bringing total funding to US$27M.


We are also recognised by respected industry institutions, including:

* CB Insights Fintech 100 (2025\) \- named among the 100 most promising private fintech companies
* Forbes Asia 100 to Watch (2025\)


Founded in 2021, Finmo is headquartered in Singapore, with additional offices in Australia, Malaysia, and India, and plans for further global expansion. We are committed to upholding core values such as curiosity, integrity, attitude and customer\-centricity. We foster a culture that encourages thoughtful risk\-taking and problem\-solving, aiming to balance perfection with timely execution.  

  

For more information, please visit our website at www.finmo.net  

  

**About the role**


Finmo is building the treasury and payments layer that finance teams actually want to use. Our buyers are business owners, CFOs, treasurers, and finance leaders in mid\-market companies across the globe.


We are hiring a Digital Marketing Manager to own the performance engine that reaches them. This is a hands\-on, metrics\-owning role \- you will run the paid accounts yourself, own the organic and answer\-engine visibility strategy and execution, turn HubSpot into a single source of truth with every lead source accounted for and that marketing, sales, and executives all trust.


You are comfortable to be measured on CPL, sign\-ups, demo requests, pipeline, and conversions against budget; not on activity volume, impressions, or campaigns shipped. If you are looking for a role where you brief agencies and report on what they did, this is not it.

 **What success looks like**


You will own targets for these metrics:

* **Efficiency.** Cost per qualified lead, cost per sign\-up, and cost per demo held, tracked by channel, geo, and persona against a defined budget. Targets are set per channel rather than blended, because precision and cost vary widely between LinkedIn, paid search, and Meta.
* **Volume.** Month\-on\-month growth in qualified sign\-ups and demos from paid and organic, at or below target CPL.
* **Search visibility and ranking**. Whether SEO or AEO, Finmo needs to be inching upwards in search results. You'll provide analysis on search keywords for the team to constantly update content to support search behaviours and prompts. Backlinking would be in your expertise to drive.
* **Organic and answer\-engine share.** Growth in non\-brand organic sessions and conversions in priority APAC and EU markets, plus measurable citation share for Finmo across a defined set of buyer\-intent prompts in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and AI Overviews.
* **Attribution integrity.** Every lead in HubSpot carries complete, correct source data; reported spend, leads, and pipeline reconcile to the ad platforms and to sales without manual cleanup.
* **Pipeline contribution.** Marketing\-sourced and marketing\-influenced pipeline by geo and segment, reported on a cadence the sales team relies on.

 **What you'll own**  

***1\. Paid performance — LinkedIn, Google, Meta***

* Own strategy, build, budget pacing, and daily optimisation across LinkedIn, Google Ads, and Facebook and Instagram, with the objective of hitting CPL, sign\-up, and demo targets against spend.
* Build audiences that go well beyond geo and interest layers: named target\-account lists, job\-function and seniority combinations, buying\-committee personas, technographic segments, matched\-audience and customer\-list uploads, and retargeting tiers by funnel stage.
* Run LinkedIn target\-account campaigns off maintained and cold company lists, layering job function, seniority, and persona filters while keeping matched audience sizes viable without diluting the account list.
* On paid search, weight the auction toward target accounts through audience layering and bid modifiers, remarketing lists for search ads, Customer Match, and reverse\-IP\-identified account audiences applied on top of keyword targeting.
* Ability to fine\-tune copy to align with key word optimisation needs e.g. ad headlines, LinkedIn and Meta captions, landing page headlines, and email subject lines. You will have a track record of working with marketing and design on campaign building.
* Maintain a live A/B testing roadmap across creative, offer, landing page, and audience, with documented results and decisions. Kill what does not work quickly.

Report performance by geo, campaigns, personas highlighting market behavior differences, CPMs, competitive density, and conversions, and budget allocations.  
* 

  

***2\. Organic visibility — SEO and AEO (existing and new markets)***

* Own the SEO strategy end to end: keyword and intent mapping for payments, treasury, FX, and cash management topics; content gap analysis against competitors; technical health; internal linking; and market\-level localisation for priority APAC and EU geos.
* Own Answer Engine Optimisation as a distinct, measured discipline. Define the buyer\-intent prompt set we want to win, track where and how Finmo is cited across LLM and AI\-search surfaces, and structure content, schema, and third\-party presence to improve that share.
* Performance reporting by geos, keywords, SOV against competitors, recommendations to drive higher searchability
* Build presence on software comparison and review platforms (G2, Capterra, and category\-relevant regional equivalents), including profile optimisation, review generation, and paid category placement where it pays back.

 ***3\. HubSpot as the single source of truth***

* Own HubSpot as the system of record for campaigns, leads, attribution, and pipeline reporting.
* Create a robust UTM and naming system across every lead source whether inbound or outbound
* Build and maintain lead to live transaction lifecycle stages, lead scoring, routing, segmentation, and email nurture workflows in partnership with product and sales.
* Own CRM data hygiene, deduplication, and the integrations between HubSpot, the website, ad platforms, and outbound tooling.
* Build the reporting layer: channel and campaign performance, funnel conversion by stage, lead aging, lead touches, cohort and geo views, and spend\-to\-pipeline efficiency.
* Handle consent and tracking compliance correctly across regions — GDPR consent mode in the EU and PDPA\-equivalent requirements in APAC — so that attribution stays intact and lawful.

 ***4\. Website and CMS***

* Own the marketing site as a conversion asset: page structure, user journeys, forms, calls to action, page speed, and conversion rate.
* Build and ship landing pages and campaign experiences directly in the CMS independently
* Run continuous A/B and multivariate testing on pages, forms, and offers, with results tied back to CPL and sign\-up rate.

 ***5\. Digital tooling and outbound enablement***

* Build the digital tool stack to expand and sharpen reach: technographic and intent\-data providers, contact and account enrichment, cold email infrastructure and deliverability, LinkedIn automation and sequencing, and comparison\-site placement.
* Build and maintain target\-account and persona lists in cold email system that feed both paid campaigns and sales outbound, keeping them synchronised in HubSpot.

**Who you are**

* 6–10 years in B2B digital or performance marketing, with proven hands\-on in the ad accounts owning budgets against CPL, sign\-up, demo targets, and SEO / AEO effectiveness
* Strong agency experience delivering these functions for clients, ideally including finance, fintech, or payments accounts.
* Strong copywriting instincts to optimise ad copy, social captions, and landing pages to increase reach and lower CPL
* Deep hands\-on ownership of LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, including target\-account campaign construction on LinkedIn company lists and audience layering on paid search. Facebook / Instagram experience for B2B retargeting and awareness is expected.
* Highly curious individual who is always learning and levelling yourself up. Keen eye for detail, proactive and with high energy levels to drive projects
* Demonstrated experience marketing to finance buyers including CFOs, treasurers, controllers, or finance operations in a considered, multi\-stakeholder sale.
* Proven multi\-geo experience across APAC and Europe and attuned to search intent and keyword landscapes, channel efficiency by market, localisation, multi\-currency budgeting and CPL benchmarking, and EU consent and privacy constraints on tracking.
* Strong hands\-on HubSpot expertise across workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, campaign attribution, and reporting — at the level where you can diagnose why a number is wrong, not just read the dashboard.
* Comfortable in a CMS: building pages, managing structure, shipping without engineering support.
* Genuinely analytical. You build the model, question the attribution, and can defend a budget reallocation with data.
* Comfortable operating independently and setting your own priorities in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment.

 **This role is probably not for you if**

* You are not a seasoned hands\-on marketer with LinkedIn, Meta and Adword campaign managers
* You prefer to set strategy and hand execution to agencies.
* You would rather be measured on brand and awareness outcomes than on cost per lead and pipeline.
* You want clean attribution and mature infrastructure on arrival

 **Our Commitment to Fairness**  

  

Finmo is an inclusive, people\-first workplace that values merit and performance. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all and to fostering a work environment free from discrimination. We evaluate all candidates on the basis of merit, performance, and role fit without regard to age, race, gender, religion, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic unrelated to job performance.  

  

We provide a supportive environment where our people can grow, contribute meaningfully, and thrive. All hiring decisions are made in accordance with applicable employment and fair employment laws in the country of hire.  

  

**Note:** Submissions by recruitment agencies will not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.  

  

Thank you for your interest in pursuing a career with Finmo!

description:
**Job description:**

Electrical Engineer – Roles \& Responsibilities

1\. **Project Coordination \& Site Management**

· Coordinate daily site activities to ensure electrical works are executed in accordance with project specifications, approved drawings, and construction schedules.

· Attend **Daily Tool Box Meetings (TBM)** to review safety requirements, site activities, and workforce coordination.

· Participate in key coordination meetings including **DABS meetings, logistics meetings, and architectural coordination meetings**.

· Conduct regular **site inspections and joint site walks** with M\&E teams, QA/QC personnel, consultants, and subcontractors to monitor progress and quality of work.

2\. **Permit \& Compliance Management**

· Apply and manage all required **electronic and hardcopy work permits**, including WAT permits, Testing \& Commissioning permits, and other relevant site permits.

· Ensure all electrical works comply with **site safety regulations, permit conditions, and project requirements**.

· Coordinate with the permit office to ensure timely approval and validity of permits prior to commencement of works.

3\. **Material Inspection \& Quality Assurance**

· Verify incoming electrical materials such as **cables, cable trunking, conduit pipes, panels, and related accessories** against approved material submittals and delivery orders.

· Ensure materials comply with **project specifications, approved shop drawings, and quality standards**.

· Arrange and coordinate **Resident Technical Officer (RTO) inspections** for material approval prior to installation.

4\. **Equipment Delivery \& Logistics Coordination**

· Plan and supervise **night\-time equipment deliveries** in compliance with site logistics requirements.

· Verify delivery access routes, lifting locations, crane positions, and equipment movement pathways to ensure safe and efficient handling.

· Coordinate with logistics teams and contractors to prevent site obstructions and ensure smooth delivery operations.

· Arrange **RTO inspection for equipment upon arrival** at site.

5\. **Installation Supervision**

· Supervise installation of all electrical services to ensure compliance with **approved shop drawings, method statements, and project specifications**.

· Monitor installation of **cable containment systems, power distribution systems, electrical panels, and associated equipment**.

· Coordinate with drafting teams to resolve **site clashes or installation constraints** and update drawings where necessary.

· Arrange inspection and approval by the **Resident Technical Officer (RTO)** after installation works.

6\. **Testing \& Commissioning Support**

· Assist in the preparation and execution of **Testing and Commissioning (T\&C)** activities for electrical systems.

· Coordinate inspections and reporting for **Cx\-2 and Cx\-3 commissioning stages**.

· Support the **service team and equipment vendors (e.g., Vertiv)** during installation, testing, and system integration.

· Assist the client and commissioning team during:

· **Cx\-4 and Cx\-5 inspections**

· **Heat Load Testing (HLT)**

· **Pre\-Integrated System Testing (Pre\-IST)**

· **Integrated System Testing (IST)**

7\. **Documentation \& As\-Built Management**

· Review and verify **Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLD)**, layouts, and shop drawings to ensure accuracy and compliance with project requirements.

· Prepare and verify **As\-Built drawings** based on actual site installation.

· Coordinate **As\-Built inspections with the RTO** prior to final submission and project handover.

8\. **Progress Monitoring \& Reporting**

· Monitor daily work progress and report updates to the **Project Manager (PM)**.

· Prepare inspection reports, commissioning documentation, and technical reports for submission to consultants and clients.

· Maintain accurate records of inspections, testing activities, and installation progress.

9\. **Defect Management \& Client Coordination**

· Identify, document, and coordinate rectification of **client and consultant defects**.

· Communicate project updates, key issues, and schedule changes discussed during coordination meetings to company management and subcontractors.

· Ensure timely resolution of punch list items and compliance with project completion requirements.

Pay: $2,000\.00 \- $3,000\.00 per month

title: Strategic Business HR Manager

title: Senior Release Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Release Manager to oversee and manage software releases across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile Release Management processes. The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing the release of applications, updates, and system changes while ensuring minimal risk and disruption to business operations.
  
This role requires collaboration with development teams, DevOps, QA, product owners, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless deployments and continuous delivery. The candidate must have a strong background in release planning, CI/CD pipelines, risk management, and ITIL processes while being able to navigate both traditional and Agile frameworks.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Release Planning \& Coordination
  
* Define, manage, and continuously improve the release process across SDLC and Agile methodologies.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA teams, DevOps, and Business Stakeholders to ensure successful releases.
* Develop and maintain a release calendar to track upcoming releases and dependencies across multiple teams and applications.
* Align releases with business priorities, security, and compliance requirements.


Agile \& DevOps Integration
  
* Implement and optimize Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
* Support Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) or other Agile methodologies to improve release cadence.
* Coordinate with Scrum Masters and Agile teams to streamline releases within sprints and program increments (PIs).
* Ensure release readiness by conducting Go/No\-Go meetings and managing change requests.


Deployment \& Environment Management
  
* Oversee release packaging, version control, and deployment processes across various environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
* Collaborate with DevOps to automate deployments, monitor system health, and resolve deployment issues.
* Manage configuration changes, rollback strategies, and hotfix releases when required.


Risk \& Compliance Management
  
* Identify, document, and mitigate release risks to ensure minimal impact on production.
* Establish and enforce release governance, change management controls, and audit trails.
* Ensure all releases comply with relevant security standards (e.g., OWASP, SOC 2, GDPR) and participate in security reviews when applicable.


Continuous Improvement \& Metrics
  
* Define and track release KPIs (e.g., deployment frequency, change failure rate, mean time to restore).
* Drive post\-release retrospectives, root cause analysis (RCA), and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of collaboration between Development, QA, Operations, and Business teams. Qualifications


Technical \& Process Expertise
  
* 5\+ years of experience in Release Management, Change Management, or DevOps roles.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, Kanban), and ITIL processes.
* Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Bamboo).
* Proven experience in managing the release of mobile applications through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, including app submission, metadata management, release versioning, and phased rollouts. Familiarity with App Store Connect and Google Play Console is required.
* Experience integrating mobile builds into CI/CD workflows using tools such as Fastlane, Bitrise, or mobile\-specific pipelines in GitLab or Jenkins.
* Proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git, Bitbucket, SVN).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability and alerting tools (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, New Relic) to monitor deployment success and post\-release stability.
* Experience working in a telecom or digital consumer services environment is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of customer\-impacting systems such as CRM, billing, e\-commerce platforms, and service activation APIs.


Soft Skills \& Leadership
  
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple releases across multiple teams and applications.
* Experience working in fast\-paced, cross\-functional environments.
* Customer\-centric mindset with the ability to prioritize releases based on business impact and user experience
* Ability to mentor junior release managers and contribute to the development of standardized release practices across teams.


Preferred Qualifications
  
* Certifications in ITIL, SAFe, PMI\-ACP, or Agile Release Management.
* Experience in large\-scale enterprise environments with distributed teams.
* Exposure to incident and problem management frameworks.

**Regional Inventory Program Manager – (Warehouse \& Data Center), APAC**
=========================================================================


**Position Summary**
====================



The **Regional Inventory Program Manager – (Warehouse Operations), APAC** holds a key leadership and analytical role in governing regional logistics, inventory control, and data integrity across regional Spoke Warehouses supporting Cloud Logistics in APAC (**Australia, Japan, Korea, Hong Kong, and Indonesia**).



Combining operational program management with advanced business analytics, this role is responsible for maintaining high inventory accuracy standards, managing WMS\-to\-ERP system deltas, monitoring key performance indicators (OTS, OTIF, IFD, WH Utilization), developing BigQuery/Looker Studio dashboards, and leading Root Cause Corrective Actions (RCCA) for operational discrepancies.

### 


### **Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities**


#### **1\. Inventory Governance, Cycle Counting \& Accuracy**


* Oversee system\-generated (ABC logic) and manual cycle count processes across all regional spoke warehouses.
* Enforce strict separation of duties across counting passes and supervisor audits.
* Drive site execution to meet established regional accuracy targets for first\-pass counts, audit counts, and High\-Risk Inventory (HRI).
* Lead Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) investigations for count discrepancies exceeding established value thresholds, all HRI items, or upon client request within defined SLAs.
* Manage specialized inventory controls including Expiry Date Controlled Inventory (FEFO allocation), battery expiration workflows, packaging consumption, re\-sealing standards, and HRI cage security.

#### **2\. Metric Monitoring, Data Analysis \& Business Intelligence**


* Oversee the accuracy and reporting integrity of regional warehouse KPIs, including On\-Time Shipping (OTS), On\-Time In Full (OTIF), In\-Full Delivery (IFD), Dock\-to\-Stock, and Warehouse Utilization.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize data dashboards using **Looker Studio and BigQuery** to provide actionable operational insights to leadership.
* Build automated scripts (AppScript/SQL) to streamline data extraction, perform shrink analysis, and validate data against official sources of truth.
* Prepare and present data\-driven operational performance packs for Weekly, Monthly, and Quarterly Business Reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs) with client and 3PL leadership.

#### **3\. System Delta \& Reconciliation Management**


* Identify, track, and resolve system deltas (quantity discrepancies between Warehouse Management Systems like DSV JDA/gWMS and SAP S/4HANA using the SAP Inventory Reconciliation App.
* Maintain and update the APAC Regional Delta Logs on a daily cadence to ensure multi\-system synchronization.
* Audit historical transaction logs, material movements, and S/4HANA Material Documents to resolve complex inventory mismatches.

#### **4\. Inventory Moves, Adjustments \& Excess Sweeps**


* Govern inventory status changes, attribute updates (expiry date, Country of Origin), and location transfers across sites.
* Enforce multi\-eye authorization controls (four\-eyes principle) for all inventory adjustments exceeding defined site approval thresholds.
* Manage Stock Owner Changes (SOC) and Project Code transitions (e.g., MAIN, Research, Quarantine, Scrap, and Remarket).
* Direct the excess inventory sweep program to transfer surplus stock from Spokes to Central Hubs aligned with site utilization criteria.

#### **5\. Operational Ticketing \& Resource Management**


* Support site teams in resolving operational tickets within designated turnaround times.
* Oversee tool room inventory, non\-GPN part stocking levels, and material movement tracking to ensure optimal part availability.


### **Systems, Technical \& Analytics Proficiency**


* **WMS \& ERP Systems**: gWMS, SAP S/4HANA (Inventory Overview, Transactions, Reconciliation App).
* **Data Analytics \& BI**: BigQuery, SQL, Looker Studio, AppScript.
* **Tracking \& Operational Dashboards**


### **Key Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, or related field.
* Extensive professional experience in regional inventory management, contract logistics, or supply chain business analytics across multi\-country networks.
* Technical proficiency in **SQL, BigQuery, and Looker Studio** with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize dashboards.
* Broad understanding of core supply chain metrics (OTS, OTIF, IFD, Dock\-to\-Stock, Reverse Logistics, Shrinkage, Cycle Counting).
* Hands\-on experience with WMS/ERP platforms (JDA, gWMS, SAP) and conducting structured root\-cause analysis (RCCA).

**Summary**



As Manager/ Senior Manager within the Design Practice division, you will drive initiatives, events, and strategic engagements that embed design thinking capabilities across the General Education ecosystem. Your focus will be on maximising the long\-term impact of our core Learning by Design programmes. This includes leading whole\-of\-school engagements, our signature Design Education Summit (“The Wonder Lab”), and community initiatives like “The Wonder Pop” and “The Wonder Gather.”


**About DesignSingapore Council**



DesignSingapore Council (Dsg)’s vision is for Singapore to be a liveable, loveable, and limitless city by design. As the national agency for design, our mission is to develop the design sector to be globally competitive, champion the use of design for innovation and growth in Singapore, and make life better in this UNESCO Creative City of Design. The Dsg is a subsidiary of the Singapore Economic Development Board.


**About Design Practice Division**



The Design Practice division equips Singaporeans with practical design thinking and application skills across the general education sector and the wider community, including collaboration with other Dsg divisions as our design thinking delivery partner. Primarily established to activate the non\-design community to understand the role design can play in realising desired outcomes, and equipping people with skills to enable them to design for change, the Design Practice division focuses on upskilling, building design mindsets, and enabling design\-led change by everyday innovators.



The Design Practice division comprises two teams: School of X, a national platform for development of design thinking skills and mindsets whilst co\-designing solutions to complex, real world challenges; and Learning by Design, a multifaceted platform to enable stakeholders in the General Education space to readily integrate design thinking, design mindsets and design culture into schools through curriculum innovations, innovative learning experiences, partnerships, and change programmes.



To advance Singapore’s Design 2035 Masterplan and develop Singapore into a liveable, loveable and limitless city by design, the Design Practice division – bringing together the Learning by Design and School of X – curates experiences to deepen participation in design with and in communities, across the General Education ecosystem, social sectors and public agencies.



The Learning by Design formulates and implements policies and initiatives to grow a pipeline of future ready workforce by infusing design into our national skills sets. It is a nationally supported initiative that advances the adoption of Design Thinking and Mindsets across General Education, from primary to junior college levels, with the aim of nurturing creative, resilient youths who can navigate change and contribute meaningfully to society. For more information on the various programmes of Learning, please visit https://iamlearningbydesign.sg/.


**Responsibilities**



This position reports to the Assistant Head, Design Practice (Learning by Design). You will be part of a team responsible for implementing design education strategies to nurture design sensibilities as a national capability. You will have a chance to be involved in policy implementation of the Learning by Design initiative by engaging, and co\-creating, with key stakeholders in the General Education space, such as students, educators, parents, community and industry partners.



We are seeking a self\-initiated individual who is passionate about design and enjoys working with people. Here is what you will do:



Project Management


* Drive the implementation of programmes under the Learning by Design initiative to nurture design mindsets in everyday innovators from the General Education ecosystem (from Primary, Secondary Schools to Junior Colleges).
* Develop and strengthen relationships with the General Education stakeholders (e.g. School leaders, students, parents, design consultants, industry partners etc), especially the schools partnering with the Learning by Design initiative to unlock actionable insights and drive further adoption.
* Work closely with the schools to co\-design actionable roadmaps and ensure key milestones of the plans are delivered and achieved.


Community Engagement


* Contribute to, and implement, stakeholder engagement plans for the General Education Community to enable sustained practice and learning.
* Manage outreach and organise regular events to engage the General Education community, including the design educators in the space.


Communications and Website Management


* Work closely with the marketing communications team in the development and implementation of a Communications \& Outreach Plan (i.e Learning by Design Resource Portal, Dsg’s website, social media and other engagement channels) to raise awareness of design mindsets and facilitate the building of a community of educators, students, parents and industry stakeholders.
* Develop, or contribute to the development of, visual assets for use in social media and marketing campaigns.
* Manage the Learning by Design Resource Portal, including website maintenance and content updates.


Business Administration


* Support Learning by Design operations, including procurement, contract management, tracking and monitoring of key metrics, finance processes, and reporting functions.
* Provide training operations support to drive effective learning and project outcomes, (e.g. by supporting logistics, set\-up, managing inventory etc).
* Co\-ordinate with team members across the Design Practice and provide regular updates to ensure an integrated and informed approach to project delivery.

title: Assistant Relationship Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) to join our growing wealth management team. This position offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of wealth management, equity research, and AI\-driven innovation.


The role suits individuals with strong communication skills, a passion for investments, and an interest in wealth management, equity research, and emerging AI technologies. In addition to supporting client servicing activities, the successful candidate will have opportunities to develop knowledge and experience in business valuation, portfolio construction, and AI solutions.  

  



### **Key Responsibilities**

* Support Relationship Managers in delivering a high\-quality client experience.
* Assist with portfolio reviews, account administration, client onboarding, documentation, and other client servicing matters.
* Prepare investment presentations, market updates, portfolio reports, and client materials for review by the Relationship Manager.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external counterparties to facilitate the accurate and timely execution of client requests.
* Participate in equity research, including company analysis, financial modelling, valuation, and intrinsic\-value assessments.
* Support portfolio construction, asset allocation, and investment discussions under the guidance of the Relationship Manager and Portfolio Manager.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of agentic workflows and AI solutions to improve productivity, research processes, and client engagement.
* Maintain a high level of professionalism and attention to detail in all client interactions.

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients and colleagues.
* Demonstrated interest in investments, capital markets, and wealth management.
* Willingness and aptitude to learn:

* Equity valuation methodologies, including discounted cash flow, comparable\-company, and intrinsic\-value analysis;
* financial statement analysis;
* portfolio construction and risk management; and
* AI and agentic technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Familiarity with Python, AI tools, or automation platforms would be advantageous.
* A proactive and self\-directed approach, with a strong commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
* Ability and willingness to meet any applicable regulatory, competency, examination, fit\-and\-proper, and internal approval requirements relevant to the role.

### **Preferred Attributes**

\> Prior experience in private banking, wealth management, equity research, investment management, or financial services would be advantageous.
  

\> Familiarity with technical analysis and established investment frameworks would be an advantage.
  

\> Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
  

\> Demonstrates initiative, intellectual curiosity, sound judgement, and a long\-term commitment to personal and professional development.  

  



### **What You Will Gain**

\> Practical exposure to client servicing, portfolio\-support activities, and investment research.
  

\> Mentorship and guidance from experienced wealth management professionals.


\>Opportunities to contribute to AI initiatives and workflow innovation within wealth management.


\> Structured learning and development opportunities that may support longer\-term career progression across wealth management, investment management, and related financial\-services functions, subject to performance, business needs, and applicable regulatory requirements.  

  



If you are passionate about investing, technology, and building meaningful client relationships, we welcome your application.

TikTok Shop's Governance and Experience (GNE) is a global team responsible for ensuring our marketplace is safe and trustworthy for not only our users, but also sellers and creators. Role Overview
  
TikTok Shop is TikTok's global e\-commerce platform that connects consumers, creators, and merchants across the world through immersive content experiences.
  
Our Singapore\-based Logistics Risk team safeguards the integrity of TikTok Shop's global logistics ecosystem, supporting key markets across the US and EMEA. We leverage large\-scale data analytics, risk intelligence, and AI technologies to detect emerging logistics fraud, optimize risk strategies, and minimize platform financial losses while ensuring a secure and trustworthy fulfillment experience.
  
  

As a Logistics Risk Data Analytics Intern, you will work closely with Risk Strategists, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Engineers to analyze complex logistics data, uncover fraud patterns, and develop data\-driven risk solutions. This role offers hands\-on experience across the full lifecycle of logistics risk management—from risk investigation and strategy development to performance evaluation and cross\-functional implementation.
  
  

As a Project Intern, you will contribute to impactful short\-term projects and gain hands\-on experience in a fast\-paced, professional environment. This internship offers the opportunity to develop practical skills, apply your knowledge to real\-world challenges, and explore your career interests.
  
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

1\. Data Exploration \& Risk Signal Mining
  
* Analyze large\-scale carrier, order, and merchant data to identify abnormal patterns and uncover emerging logistics fraud signals. Transform complex datasets into actionable insights that support risk detection and strategy development.


2\. Risk Investigation \& Root Cause Analysis
  
* Conduct in\-depth investigations into logistics risk scenarios, including fake tracking, postage fraud, and compensation abuse. Summarize fraud patterns and support the continuous evolution of risk strategies.


3\. Strategy Analysis \& Performance Evaluation
  
* Monitor key logistics risk metrics and evaluate the effectiveness of existing risk control strategies through data analysis. Identify coverage gaps and recommend optimization opportunities to improve recall, precision, and operational efficiency.


4\. Cross\-functional Collaboration
  
* Partner with Risk Strategy, Platform Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Algorithm teams to support strategy implementation, experiment analysis, and data\-driven decision making.


5\. AI \& Risk Innovation
  
* Explore the application of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI tools to improve fraud investigation, knowledge management, and analytical efficiency across logistics risk scenarios.

* Gain hands\-on experience solving real\-world logistics fraud and risk problems on a global scale.
* Work with cutting\-edge technologies including AI, LLMs, and large\-scale data analytics.
* Receive mentorship from experienced logistics risk strategists and participate in the full lifecycle of risk strategy development.
* Develop strong cross\-functional collaboration skills by working with global teams.

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or above degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related disciplines.
* Strong SQL skills with the ability to independently extract, clean, and analyze large datasets.
* Familiarity with Python (Pandas, NumPy, etc.) or R for data analysis.


**Preferred Qualification(s):**  

* Strong analytical thinking, structured problem\-solving ability, and attention to detail.
* Self\-motivated, curious, and eager to learn in a fast\-paced environment.

description:
**About us**


Food waste is a $1 trillion problem – costing the world over 1% of global GDP. We’re dead set on solving the problem and looking for people to help us achieve our mission. We, at Winnow, believe that food is far too valuable to waste, and that technology can transform the way we produce food. Our team is made of people who all share a passion for food and technology.


Winnow was founded in London in 2013 to help the hospitality industry prevent food waste through internet of things tools in the kitchen. We have worked with thousands of sites and are operating in over 90 countries around the world supported by our offices in London, Dubai, Singapore, Cluj\-Napoca (Romania) and Chicago. We are a scale\-up stage company with a strong base of clients who are rolling out our system globally. We have blue\-chip customers including Accor Hotels, IKEA, IHG, Marriott, Compass Group and many others.


Winnow’s clients on average reduce waste by over 50% by value and sustain savings. Winnow works with hotels, universities and schools, staff restaurants, event/hospitality kitchens, buffets, pubs, and high street restaurants. Where the system is permanently adopted, pre\-consumer waste value is reduced by 50% \- 70% with no detrimental impact to the perceived quality or value of the offer to their customers. This represents a typical improvement of food cost savings of 3% to 8%, commonly a 40%\+ increase in profitability for operations.


As the global leader in addressing food waste, we are committed to continue pushing the envelope on what technology can do to solve this problem. Winnow Vision, our new artificial intelligence\-based technology, is trained to automatically track all food waste thrown away. It has won awards at the World Economic Forum and has received tremendous enthusiasm from our clients and the industry. You can read more about it on our website and this article in Forbes.


Other recent accolades saw Winnow listed in the 2025 Sunday Times Best Places to Work \- a recognition based on feedback from our UK team. While this award is based in the UK, it reflects something global: a culture built on purpose, collaboration, and the belief that businesses can \- and should \- tackle real\-world problems while being great places to work. Previous awards saw Winnow in the top 10 of the FoodTech 500 awards \- the worlds first definitive list of the global entrepreneurial talent at the intersection between food, technology and sustainability, as well as winning Impact 50's most impactful companies to work for. You can read more about it here.


We are passionate about living our values and place them at the centre of everything we do. We are excited about like minded talent who share these values, joining us in our mission:

**Equal parts head and heart.** We’re both passionate and measured. We carefully balance the need for quick solutions and pragmatism with the ability to step back, take in the bigger picture and build for the long term.


Bravely honest. With each other, that means we’re a transparent organisation where healthy, respectful debate is encouraged. With our customers, we challenge them if we don’t think they’re achieving their goals, whether they be environmental or financial.

**People of action.** Done is better than perfect, and we learn by boldly doing then rapidly improving. We’re breaking new ground, so we know things might go wrong. But we judge ourselves and each other on our reaction and our resilience.


Bound by food. We’re a diverse bunch, but our belief in the value of food is the common thread in everything we do. With each other, we celebrate through our love and respect for food. With our customers, it means we work hard to develop creative tools to make it easy for chefs to value food.

**Hungry and humble.** Our product is revolutionary, our people are impressive, and we’re hungry for change. But, we’re just the catalyst for a bigger movement. We stay humble regardless of our success, and make chefs the heroes in this journey.

**People and planet positive.** We’re caretakers of the planet, helping to preserve and support it for now and the future. Our work already minimises the impact that the hospitality industry has on the planet, and we’re also committed to actively reducing our own footprint while doing so. We’re leaving the planet and its people better off than we found them.


This is an opportunity to join an exciting organisation and help us propel our growth at what are truly the most exciting and dynamic points in time in our business. You will work alongside a driven team who are motivated by building an exciting business and leaving the world a better place than we found it.

**About the role**


An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Customer Success Team Lead to lead Winnow's APAC Customer Success team. Team members are currently located in Singapore and China, but management responsibilities are expected to expand to include managing colleagues in Malaysia and the Philippines.


Leading a growing, multi\-country team, the postholder will not only be responsible for their own portfolio of accounts, but will also own the strategy and performance of accounts across APAC. As part of this, the postholder will devise the regional strategy as well as create action\-oriented implementation plans with the team of CS Managers to deliver it, ensuring Winnow and client KPIs are met. This role sits at the heart of Winnow's APAC operational strategy.


The Customer Success Team Lead, APAC will report to the APAC MD. Collaboration with other internal Winnow functions, such as Product, Support and Data Services, will also be essential to maximise growth opportunities and ensure Winnow's operating model supports the regional strategy.


This role will suit an experienced people leader looking to inspire and develop a growing Customer Success team, while maintaining a hands on approach to managing your own clients.


Key Responsibilities:* **Team Leadership \& Development**
* + Lead, manage and develop the APAC Customer Success team
	+ Coach, guide and support the development of team members across the region, representing APAC Customer Success team across the wider organisation
	+ Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement within the team, including championing the adoption of AI tools and new ways of working in line with Winnow's wider AI adoption initiative
* **Client Portfolio Ownership**
* + Take full ownership of your own strategic portfolio of client accounts across APAC
	+ Drive key performance indicators (KPIs) for retention, satisfaction (NPS), and usage
	+ Proactively minimize client churn through strong relationships and value delivery
	+ Identify and cultivate opportunities to expand product adoption and upsell solutions
	+ Develop deep relationships with key influencers and full decision\-making units to help build additional demand for our products
* **Strategic Execution**
* + Translate Winnow's regional Customer Success strategy into actionable quarterly and annual plans, independently overseeing the planning and execution across multiple markets, whilst also delivering your own portfolio.
	+ Partner and influence across internal teams (e.g. Product, Sales, Marketing) to ensure seamless delivery and client success, gaining buy\-in where required
	+ Provide monthly performance reports to the APAC MD proactively identifying areas requiring attention and recommending improvements
* **Client Advocacy \& Governance**
* + Act as the Voice of the Customer internally, , translating client feedback and analytics into operational improvements and ensuring needs are prioritized in product and service delivery
	+ Help the client build and deliver a governance structure to provide clients timely, accurate and insightful reports, with a mixture of regular updates and ad\-hoc reporting


This role will require travel to customer sites which is anticipated to be around 20% of total working time.

 **Requirements**  

* You are likely to be degree educated
* You will have significant work experience ideally within a multi\-national organization in a Client Success / Delivery or Project Management / Account Management / Consultancy capacity,
* You will have proven experience leading and developing teams across multiple countries or markets.
* Experience in hospitality or SaaS organisations will be preferred.
* You have a strong grasp of standard office productivity tools including Microsoft Office, Google Suite etc.
* You will possess excellent business\-level proficiency in both English. Proficiency in other Mandarin is preferred

**Personal attributes**

* You have proven experience leading and developing a team, ideally across multiple countries or cultures, and are skilled at coaching others, gaining buy\-in and managing performance with a non\-confrontational, empathetic style
* You know how to inspire and motivate a team, setting a clear vision and holding others to a high standard, and you take pride in driving the performance of the people around you as much as your own
* You are a data driven person who can use data and analytics to track performance across a portfolio, team or region, and can use these insights to drive and influence change
* You are curious about and comfortable adopting AI\-powered tools, both to support how you and your team work day\-to\-day and to help clients get the most value out of Winnow's AI\-driven product
* You have proven experience in challenging and questioning the status quo. You enjoy suggesting creative and innovative solutions to improve the way things get done
* You have proven experience of knowing what it takes to provide consistently first\-class customer service to customers, remaining calm and measured even when dealing with the most demanding of individuals
* You have excellent attention to detail and a meticulous eye for identifying inconsistencies or inaccuracies in data. You take your time to ensure you get things right the first time
* You are able to organize self, including effective project management and scheduling, prioritization and time management skills, managing multiple tasks in parallel and completing tasks to tight deadlines
* You are willing to roll up your sleeves and get work done, taking the initiative to help your team members. You have a growth mentality and a willingness to learn.

  

**Benefits**  

* Company stock options package
* Eligible for Customer Success Bonus
* Company part\-funded health insurance and eye care allowance
* Life insurance (3 times base salary)
* 22 days of paid vacation time in addition to national holidays, plus the option to buy a further 5 days annual leave
* Company stock options package
* Learning and development allowance of SGD $500 annually
* S$76 gross monthly wellness allowance
* Employee Assistance Programme – 24/7 helpline for your wellbeing
* Hybrid way of working – we're all in the office on Tuesday and Wednesday
* Early Finish Fridays – log off at 3 PM on a Friday if you have completed your tasks by then
* Our own office space with a great working environment
* You will love what you do – waking up every day solving one of the biggest social problems of our generation \- food waste
* Committed team members with broad experience who share a common passion to build a world class business

description:
LUXASIA is the leading and largest beauty omnichannel brand\-builder of Asia Pacific. Since 1986, it has successfully enabled market entry and brand growth for more than 100 luxury beauty brands, the likes of Albion, Aveda, Bvlgari, Calvin Klein, Creed, Diptyque, Hermes, La Prairie, Maison Francis Kurkdjian, Montblanc, Paco Rabanne, Salvatore Ferragamo, and SK\-II. The Group's integrated brand\-building capabilities include luxury retail, online commerce, consumer marketing \& analytics, and supply chain management. LUXASIA is powered by a diverse and dynamic \#OneTeam of 2700 talents across a growing footprint of 15 markets.

  

Why Join Us?

  

At LUXASIA, we believe there is beauty within every talent – that is you.


We grow you by building your competencies and unleashing your potential. We have curated a vast portfolio of over 100 luxury brands across Asia Pacific, and growing. Your work will enrich the lives of millions of consumers across the region. With us, you get to be an entrepreneur, running the business like it is your very own. We give you the autonomy but not without guidance and genuine care. We are a diverse and inclusive team that is courageously innovative. Together as \#OneTeam, we celebrate differences, embrace change, explore new ideas, take risks, fail fast, and drive results. While challenges at work are inevitable, the journey promises to be fulfilling.

  

With LUXASIA, an exciting career filled with robust professional growth awaits you. Isn’t that beautiful?

 **Role Purpose:**


The Beauty Trainer is responsible for developing and elevating the capabilities of our retail teams through engaging training, coaching, and performance development initiatives.


The role focuses on strengthening product knowledge, makeup artistry, selling skills, customer experience, and retail execution to enable Beauty Advisors and Brand Ambassadors to confidently represent our brands, deliver exceptional client experiences, and achieve strong commercial results across all retail locations and sales channels.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

**Training and Facilitation**

* Develop, adapt, and deliver engaging training programmes covering product knowledge, makeup techniques, skincare, fragrance, consultation skills, customer service, selling skills, and brand standards.
* Conduct beauty masterclasses, demonstrations, workshops, and other learning activities for Beauty Advisors, Brand Ambassadors, and relevant retail partners.
* Ensure training content and delivery methods are aligned with brand guidelines, business priorities, and the learning needs of the retail teams.
* Attend relevant Train\-the\-Trainer sessions, education seminars, and development workshops, and effectively cascade the learning to local retail teams.
* Complete and maintain the relevant brand certifications or assessments required to conduct brand training and beauty masterclasses.

**In\-Store Coaching and Performance Development**

* Conduct regular store visits and provide hands\-on coaching to improve retail employees’ product knowledge, makeup artistry, consultation skills, selling behaviours, confidence, and overall performance.
* Observe retail performance and identify individual or team capability gaps through field observations, stakeholder feedback, and relevant retail performance indicators.
* Develop and implement targeted coaching and development action plans in partnership with the Brand, Retail, and Training teams.
* Provide timely follow\-up and ongoing coaching to ensure that learning is effectively applied on the retail floor.
* Support the continuous development and progression of Beauty Advisors and Brand Ambassadors.

 **Retail Excellence and Commercial Performance**

* Drive consistent execution of brand standards, consultation protocols, customer experience expectations, and retail excellence across all locations.
* Translate business priorities and retail performance needs into practical training and development interventions.
* Support retail teams in improving key commercial indicators, including sales achievement, conversion, average basket value, units per transaction, productivity, and client retention.
* Partner with key stakeholders to identify opportunities to strengthen retail performance and customer engagement.
* Monitor training effectiveness and recommend enhancements based on retail results, participant feedback, observations, and business needs.

 **Recruitment and Onboarding**

* Support the recruitment and selection of Beauty Advisors and Brand Ambassadors by participating in interviews, practical assessments, or makeup artistry evaluations where required.
* Deliver structured onboarding and induction programmes to ensure new retail employees are equipped with the required product knowledge, service standards, and selling capabilities.
* Work closely with the Talent \& Excitement, Brand, and Retail teams to support the successful integration and development of new hires.

 **Events and Client Engagement**

* Support retail events, brand activations, product launches, roadshows, and client engagement initiatives through training, demonstrations, masterclasses, and on\-site coaching.
* Equip retail teams with the required knowledge, skills, and confidence before major campaigns, launches, and commercial activities.
* Represent the brand professionally during internal and external education or client engagement activities.

 **Stakeholder Management and Reporting**

* Build strong working relationships with Brand, Retail, Sales, Marketing, Talent \& Excitement, and regional or global Education teams.
* Communicate training priorities, performance observations, development needs, and recommended actions clearly to relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate training records, attendance information, field coaching reports, and development plans.
* Provide regular updates and reports on training activities, effectiveness, retail capability gaps, and recommended follow\-up actions.
* Manage training schedules, materials, resources, and competing priorities in an organised and timely manner.

 **Requirements**  

* Diploma or professional qualification in Beauty, Makeup Artistry, Training, Retail Management, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Relevant experience in beauty, cosmetics, makeup, skincare, fragrance, luxury retail, retail operations, or retail training.
* A makeup artistry background is strongly preferred, as the role will be required to conduct beauty masterclasses, demonstrations, and relevant brand assessments.
* Strong practical makeup artistry and beauty consultation skills.
* Experience in training, coaching, facilitating workshops, or developing frontline retail employees is preferred.
