**Role Summary**


Act as ADSB's dedicated on site Project Manager and Owner's Representative, providing leadership, supervision, technical oversight, inspection coordination, and project assurance throughout the construction, commissioning, testing, trials, and delivery phases of three Offshore Patrol Vessel platforms being built at ST Engineering, Singapore. The Project Manager shall ensure compliance with contractual requirements, class rules, OEM requirements, Interface Control Documents (ICDs), approved drawings, Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs), and ADSB quality standards while maintaining effective communication between ADSB, the Shipyard, OEMs, and Classification Society.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project Management \& Coordination**


* Serve as the primary on site interface between ADSB, ST Engineering, OEMs, subcontractors, and Classification Society.
* Lead day to day project management activities at the shipyard.
* Monitor construction progress against the approved master schedule and key milestones.
* Identify schedule, technical, interface, quality, and delivery risks and develop mitigation actions.
* Support execution of construction, installation, commissioning, testing, trial, and delivery activities.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary inspection activities covering hull, machinery, electrical, outfitting and control systems.

**Construction Monitoring \& Site Supervision**


* Maintain regular site presence within the shipyard throughout the construction program.
* Verify workmanship quality and compliance with approved specifications, drawings and standards.
* Monitor hull construction, structural fabrication, outfitting, machinery installation, piping, electrical works, coatings and testing activities.
* Review material certificates, inspection records, vendor documentation and quality dossiers.
* Verify compliance with Classification Society requirements and applicable statutory regulations.
* Monitor closure of punch items, technical observations and non\-conformance reports.

**Inspection \& Quality Assurance**


* Coordinate and oversee site inspectors and discipline specialists.
* Verify implementation of approved Inspection and Test Plans.
* Review WPS, PQR, WPQ, NDT reports, coating inspections, testing records and acceptance documentation as required.
* Monitor NCRs, deviations, concessions, and corrective actions through to close out.
* Ensure material traceability and quality records are maintained throughout construction.

**Commissioning, Testing \& Trials**


* Oversee Harbour Acceptance Tests, Platform Acceptance Tests, commissioning activities and integrated testing programs.
* Witness major tests and trials and coordinate participation of relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor testing results and verify satisfactory closure of deficiencies prior to acceptance.
* Support preparation and execution of sea trials and final acceptance trials.
* Assess vessel readiness for delivery and operational service.

**Reporting \& Communications**


* Prepare and submit weekly and monthly progress reports in accordance with ADSB requirements.
* Maintain project dashboards, risk registers, NCR registers, action trackers and recovery plans.
* Provide timely escalation of critical issues affecting quality, schedule, testing, class approval, or delivery milestones.
* Lead progress meetings and provide management updates to ADSB and LR management.

**Contract \& Technical Support**


* Monitor compliance with contractual obligations and milestone requirements.
* Support review of technical queries, design changes, concessions and interface issues.
* Assist ADSB in assessing technical implications of proposed changes and deviations.
* Support coordination with OEMs and vendors on installation, testing and commissioning matters.
  

**Delivery \& Handover**


* Verify completion of contractual scope prior to acceptance.
* Review final documentation, certification packages, inspection records and handover dossiers.
* Support punch list close out and delivery acceptance activities.
* Coordinate final inspections and delivery readiness reviews prior to transfer to ADSB.

**Candidate Profile**


* Degree in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent maritime discipline.
* Proven experience in shipbuilding project management and supervision of naval, offshore patrol, military, coast guard or commercial vessel newbuild programs.
* Strong understanding of hull construction, machinery systems, electrical systems, outfitting, commissioning, testing and sea trials.

What You Will Work On
  
We are looking for a nurse who has excellent medical report\-writing and critical thinking skills. They should be able to work well under pressure, understand how to prioritize and escalate as necessary.
  
The Nurse Case Managers are integral to the provision of Medical Assistance. Our role is to review medical information in a timely fashion and provide an expert opinion on how to provide the highest level of care to our client group. title: Quantitative Analyst
description:
**About Attix**
---------------

Attix APAC Pte Ltd is at the forefront of AI\-driven quantitative finance, building sophisticated machine learning and LLM products that power intelligent trading decisions. We research and run systematic strategies across equities and options, and deliver them to clients through our in\-house advisory and wealth products. We're looking for a Quantitative Analyst to join our growing team in Singapore and contribute to the research that drives our investment performance.


**The Role**
------------

As a Quantitative Analyst at Attix, you will conduct research across the full investment lifecycle — from signal generation and strategy development through portfolio construction, implementation and performance attribution. You will partner with portfolio managers, engineers and product teams to take research from hypothesis through to live capital, and you will remain accountable for how that research performs once deployed.


This is a hands\-on research role in a small, fast\-moving team. You will have significant ownership over the problems you take on and direct visibility into how your work affects returns.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Alpha \& Signal Research**

* Conduct research into alpha signals across equities and options, covering the full signal lifecycle: idea generation, feature construction, testing, implementation and ongoing monitoring
* Construct and evaluate factors derived from fundamental, market, macro and alternative data sources
* Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to feature discovery, selection and combination
* Assess signal efficacy, decay and capacity, and determine which signals merit inclusion in live models

### **Strategy Development \& Backtesting**

* Develop, backtest and implement systematic trading strategies across asset classes
* Design and maintain rigorous backtesting methodology, including cross\-validation, walk\-forward testing, and realistic assumptions for transaction costs, slippage and capacity
* Evaluate candidate strategies on both standalone performance and their contribution to existing portfolios
* Apply disciplined controls against overfitting, look\-ahead bias, survivorship bias and multiple\-testing effects

### **Portfolio Construction \& Asset Allocation**

* Research and implement portfolio construction methodologies, including mean\-variance optimisation, risk parity, hierarchical approaches and robust or resampled methods
* Support strategic and tactical asset allocation across model portfolios
* Quantify portfolio risk, exposures and concentration using factor risk models
* Develop allocation frameworks that respond to changing market conditions, correlation structure and drawdown
* Execute portfolio rebalances and generate trade lists consistent with model views

### **Model Validation \& Performance Monitoring**

* Monitor deployed models for performance decay, drift and changing market sensitivity
* Define the criteria and evidence thresholds that determine when a model should be retrained or retired
* Document model methodology, assumptions and limitations to support internal review and governance
* Investigate performance anomalies and distinguish genuine model degradation from market conditions, data quality issues or execution effects

### **Macro \& Market Regime Research**

* Research market regime classification, sector rotation and cross\-asset relationships
* Translate macro and sentiment research into positioning and allocation views
* Validate the persistence and stability of the relationships that inform allocation decisions

### **Collaboration \& Communication**

* Partner with AI/ML engineers, product managers and traders to move research from hypothesis into production
* Communicate research findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Document methodology, assumptions and results so that research is reproducible by colleagues
* Contribute to research standards and mentor junior team members

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline — mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering, computer science, financial engineering or economics — or equivalent practical experience
* 3\-7 years of relevant experience in quantitative research, systematic investing, or a closely related quantitative finance role
* Strong programming ability in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn, statsmodels or equivalent) and SQL
* Solid foundation in statistics, econometrics, probability and time\-series analysis
* Demonstrated experience designing and running backtests, with a rigorous understanding of how they can mislead
* Working knowledge of derivatives, options pricing models, the greeks and volatility behaviour
* Understanding of modern portfolio theory, optimisation methods, risk metrics and performance attribution
* Experience working with large financial datasets, including data quality investigation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills

### **Preferred**

* Experience taking a model or strategy into production and supporting it in a live environment
* Familiarity with machine learning applied to financial prediction, and the challenges of low signal\-to\-noise data
* Knowledge of market microstructure, execution algorithms and transaction cost analysis
* Experience with factor risk models
* Experience with cloud data infrastructure (AWS S3, Athena or equivalent) and version\-controlled research workflows
* Exposure to LLM\-based tooling and its application to investment research
* CFA, CQF, FRM or comparable professional qualification

### **Personal Attributes**

* Intellectual rigour and honesty in evaluating your own results
* High initiative and ownership mentality, comfortable taking research from idea through to live capital
* Meticulous attention to detail, particularly around data integrity and validation methodology
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently on open\-ended questions
* Deep curiosity about financial markets and what drives returns
* Adaptability to work in a fast\-paced, evolving environment

title: AVP, Product Designer, Group Design, Consumer Banking Group
description:
The Product Designers we really want to hire deliver real value to real users. In other words, they design stuff that gets built. If you are passionate about bringing simplicity to complex information systems — we have a challenge for you.


**What you'll be doing**

You'll spend most of your time trying to simplify very complex products and ideas. It may be an uphill battle, but it's worth it. If you succeed, your designs will enable thousands of people to serve millions of our customers better. We say that, if you can work in a bank, you can work anywhere. Don't worry, we're a nice bunch of people. Around here, we go out of our way to help one another.


**Here's what your week might look like**  

You’ll work closely with designers \& collaborating with engineers and stakeholders to make sure we are heading in the right direction when it comes to design systems \& standards
  

Once you know where you're going, it's time to tackle the behemoth tech systems and legal restrictions of a bank. Your product manager will become your best friend. You'll message the tech lead more than your parents. You'll get a crash course in finance and operations.
  

We do respect the privacy of people with headphones\-on, trying to avoid eye contact. So you'll have the time to actually produce work you're proud of.
  

We want to hire people who have opinions, believe in their ideas and are willing to fight for them. But we also want people who can recognise when a better argument or solution is put before them. All of us participate in user testing, and so will you.
  

Like we said, producing good work is not good enough if it doesn't get built. We love you, Dribble/Behance. It's not you, it's us. You will meet stakeholders from different departments and articulate your ideas so clearly that you'll become an honorary Toastmaster.
  

To prepare for those meetings you'll need to check the latest relevant data.
  

Before you know it, it will be Friday and time for team dinner, drinks or Creative Day (we do something fun and creative together once a month).
  

  

**Here are the experience and skills we'd love you to have**  

You're an end\-to\-end designer: you can turn high\-level requirements into well\-posed problem statements, wireframes, prototypes or Powerpoints for the management teams.
  

You should have a strong working knowledge designing for complex web applications
  

You can talk confidently and clearly about design and build lasting relationships with our stakeholders.
  

And you're not afraid to improvise—to think on your feet—when required.
  

You can brainstorm the next big thing one moment and still tweak pixels right before launch.
  

You have the ability to prioritise (you don't focus on illustrations if the UX looks like a love child between Frankenstein and Krusty the Clown).
  

You work smart and are ready to improve processes especially in Ai front.
  

You have enough curiosity to stay savvy about industry and UX trends.
  

You have confidence in your ideas and the ability to communicate them clearly.
  

You follow through—when built, your designs actually look and work like they should. You monitor products after launch and are ready to suggest improvements.
  

  

**Bonus points**  

You actively contribute to the UX community.
  

You're kind of a behavioural science geek.
  

You have personal pet projects you work on for fun in your free time.
  

You have experience with Agile methodology and financial products in Treasury domain is ideal
  

Your team and career


**You will be part of the DBS enterprise design team.**

The enterprise design team is redefining what great internal tools look like: working on a collaborative platform to enable bankers, credit risk managers and credit controllers to manage corporate loans digitally.


Behind the scenes, the team understands how important it is for a proper design process and system to be in place before great things can happen.


**About DBS**

DBS is a leading financial services group in Asia. We are headquartered in Singapore, with a growing presence in Greater China, Southeast Asia and South Asia.


We were named the Best Bank in the World by Global Finance in August 2018—the first Singapore and Asian bank to receive this honour.


We want our customers to Live more, Bank less. And we want to make banking invisible.


Every day, there’s a lot more to explore, experience and enjoy—and a lot less time to do it in. That’s why we’ve created banking that’s fast, natural, effortless. Banking that’s with you wherever life takes you, instead of taking you away from life. So you can enjoy a lot more life, with a lot less bank.


**About the design team**  

Hi, we are the DBS user experience design team


We create digital products that deserve to be built because they solve real problems in an impactful way with empathy.


How we design


We go beyond numbers


Every dollar means something. No one actually wants money. We want what it can give us. So we acknowledge that money is not really about money. We inject emotion into our products to go from transactional to magical.


We have one profound idea


Because ambiguity is the enemy of good user experience. What is our unique value proposition? Would adding another feature dilute the idea or make it stronger?

Regular

Full time

Temasek Laboratories@NTU explores the frontiers in science and develops strategic technologies to enhance the defence and security of Singapore. For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/temasek\-labs .


This position primarily involves working on a project that aims to evaluate and develop work rest cycles that will be used by the Singapore Armed Forces. It will be done through the collection of empirical data through field trials and the development of prediction models based on these data. Together with the PD, the candidate is to lead the planning and execution of the project, to provide scientific guidance and leadership, and to chart the scientific direction for our research domains. The candidate will build capabilities to push the frontiers of research in exercise and health particularly in heat physiology and the physiological bases for physical work tolerance.


**Key Responsibilities:**

The candidate will work closely with Programme Director in the following areas of responsibilities


**Administrative** :


The PI takes the lead to:


* Establish a research team that comprises the appropriate mix of knowledge and skillsets to meet the demands of the projects.
* Build a cohesive team that is collaborative, highly productive and innovative in conducting their duties.
* Ensures that the team has all essential equipment and facilities to conduct the studies safely and in accordance with professional standards.
* Comply with all standards, policies and processes that are governed by the Institutional Research Board.
* Comply with all administrative processes and policies of TL and NTU.
* Ensure financial discipline and that the projects operate within the allocated budget.
* Develop the professional and leadership skills of team members to lead future projects
* Ensure sound data management practices for all projects under my charge

**Technical** :


The PI will lead his team in:


* Ensuring sound study design, planning, operation and data management and analysis,
* Upholding the quality of project presentations, technical reports and manuscripts for publication
* Mentoring and nurturing the professional growth of members of the research team
* Complying the standards and practices of Research Integrity in NTU
* Attracting the appropriate collaborators to complement expertise and resources of the research team
* Maintaining a close watch of the technological developments in the domain of specialty and to capitalise on these developments to generate impactful solutions to defence science research

**User Engagement**

* Anchor engagement with MINDEF, DSTA and SAF stakeholders to maintain a good level of trust and alignment in project outcomes
* Guide the team in navigating the areas of misalignment with users to minimise impact on progress of project and cohesion with users
* Building credibility by benchmarking our research outcomes and deliverables to world class best practices and state of technology. In some areas of work, we are the ones pushing the technological barriers in the international scene.
* Where possible, we deliver solutions beyond the scope of the contract.
* Regular update to users on the state of technological development and our efforts in the technological race in the interest of defence R\&D.
* Keeping a close watch on technological development in the SAF and to seek opportunities to on human safety and performance in operating new equipment / platforms.

**Programme Strategy and Growth**

* Keep close technological watch for developments and potential solutions that are relevant to the interests of MINDEF/SAF/DSTA.
* Maintain and leverage on strategic alliances and networks with technology partners worldwide to offer novel solutions. We are both the gateway and drivers of solutions for human science in national defence
* Capitalise on the strengths in the NTU ecosystem to offer a united front in delivering defence solutions
* Engage users to generate interest on future projects and grow new programme domains in defence human science.

**Job Requirements:**

* PhD degree in sports science / physiology / exercise physiology/ engineering or related field
* At least 12 years of relevant experience in human performance / exercise physiology research
* Familiarity with human physiology research and science, particularly in heat physiology
* Proficiency in skills and processes involved in human performance research, such as IRB application, coordination with stakeholders, human subject recruitment, pre\-during and post\-trial operation and data collection, data analyses, manuscript writing
* Good writing skills for writing proposals, technical reports, and publications in good academic journals.
* Experience in leading and mentoring such as in heading labs or mentoring students at various levels or junior colleagues
* Experience in obtaining research grants, as well as leading and managing research projects
* Demonstrated academic / research excellence through high quality peer\-reviewed publications
* Good understanding of SAF and defence operating imperatives and working models / processes
* Strong network with relevant local and international technical ecosystem

A key priority will be developing large\-scale data center campuses supported by behind\-the\-meter energy solutions that enhance energy security, resilience, sustainability and long\-term capacity availability. The Director will work closely with utilities, renewable energy developers, technology providers, infrastructure investors and government stakeholders to secure both grid\-connected and independent energy solutions that enable Vantage's continued growth across Australia and APAC.


Working cross\-functionally with Business Development, Site Selection, Sustainability, Construction, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Finance and Executive Leadership teams, the successful candidate will align energy strategy with Vantage's growth objectives, customer requirements and sustainability commitments. The ideal candidate combines commercial energy origination expertise with strong technical and execution capabilities, and will be measured on their ability to secure long\-term power capacity, execute strategic energy transactions, build industry partnerships and deploy innovative clean energy solutions.

* Provide market intelligence, investment recommendations and strategic guidance on energy markets, regulatory developments, pricing trends and emerging technologies.

* Develop innovative energy architectures that support customer decarbonization goals, integrate distributed energy resources and reduce reliance on constrained utility infrastructure.


3\. Utility, Grid \& Strategic Partnership Management

* Build and manage executive\-level relationships with utilities, regulators, government agencies, renewable developers, investors and technology providers across APAC.
* Lead engagement on grid access, transmission planning, renewable integration and utility capacity to secure power for existing and future campus developments.
* Establish strategic partnerships and represent Vantage in key energy policy, market reform and industry initiatives to strengthen long\-term energy security.


4\. Project Development, Delivery \& Execution

description:

---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. This role is the single\-threaded owner of factory layout and material flow design across AWS rack fulfillment manufacturing sites. You will work at the intersection of capacity planning, automation engineering, construction, and operations — spanning EC2, Machine Learning, and Storage hardware platforms in AWS manufacturing. Your work directly enables AWS to meet datacenter capacity commitments by ensuring manufacturing infrastructure scales efficiently, reliably, and repeatably across a global site network. Possessing strong leadership, influencing skills, and technical depth are critical elements of success for this role. This leader will establish manufacturing standards and publish process control guidelines to assure flawless ramp into volume manufacturing.

* Translate rack fulfillment capacity plans into data\-driven facility layouts for AWS manufacturing operations, designing end\-to\-end material flow from dock receipt through assembly, integration, test, and dispatch across EC2, Machine Learning, and Storage product platforms


. Coordinate utility and infrastructure requirements (power, cooling, network, compressed air) for each production zone with facilities and construction teams, ensuring infrastructure readiness aligns with layout phasing — particularly for high\-density ML accelerator and Storage rack configurations requiring liquid cooling and high\-power distribution  

. Manage phased layout plans aligned with construction milestones, enabling production in early zones while build\-out continues in adjacent areas; own layout change control, produce clear visual documentation (2D/3D layouts, material flow diagrams, phasing overlays), and develop replicable standards across the global manufacturing site network  

. Drive continuous improvement and operations sustaining by owning the factory layout as a living document, partnering with Operations, Test, Process, and Automation Engineering teams to implement optimizations that reduce cycle time, improve throughput toward manufacturing\-to\-ship SLA targets, and enable rapid capacity deployment for new product platform introductions  

* Excellent communicator with an ability to concisely and precisely convey information to executives and cross functional teams
* Ability to multitask on several concurrent projects of med to high complexity

About AWS

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience in technical product or program management
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

title: Account & Channel Manager (Chemical sales)
description:
**Job Description: Account Manager II**

* Department: APAC AIS
* Reporting To: APAC RC Sales Leader
* Product Portfolio: **Research Chemicals (RC), Fine Chemicals (FC), Electronic Chemicals (EC)**
* Territory: **Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore**
* Location: **Singapore (Remote)**

**Job Purpose**

This role owns end\-to\-end channel sales management for the RC, FC and EC product portfolios across Indonesia, Philippines and Singapore. The core mandate is to deliver annual revenue targets, develop and optimize authorized distributor networks, and build channel capabilities to drive sustainable business growth in assigned markets.


  
**About Solstice Advanced Materials**

Solstice Advanced Materials is a leading global specialty materials company that advances science for smarter outcomes. Solstice offers high\-performance solutions that enable critical industries and applications, including refrigerants, semiconductor manufacturing, data center cooling, nuclear power, protective fibers, healthcare packaging and more. Solstice is recognized for developing next\-generation materials through some of the industry's most renowned brands such as Solstice®, Genetron®, Aclar®, Spectra®, Fluka™, and Hydranal™. Partnering with over 3,000 customers across more than 120 countries and territories and supported by a robust portfolio of over 5,700 patents, Solstice’s approximately 4,000 employees worldwide drive innovation in materials science. For more information, visit Advanced Materials .


  
**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Revenue Target Delivery**

* Take full ownership of annual revenue, gross margin and market share targets for the RC, FC and EC product lines across assigned territories.
* Track monthly and quarterly sales performance, conduct gap analysis, and implement corrective actions to ensure on\-target delivery.
* Manage distributor demand forecasts, sales pipeline and open order status to secure predictable revenue recognition.

**2\. Distributor Management \& Capability Building**

* Develop, select, onboard and manage authorized distributors for RC, EC products; set clear performance KPIs and conduct regular business reviews to drive accountability.
* Guide distributors on inventory planning, order rhythm and end\-customer development; optimize stock structure to mitigate overstock or shortage risks.
* Deliver regular product training, sales enablement and market insight sharing to distributors to strengthen their frontline sales competence.
* Coordinate channel promotions, marketing campaigns and on\-site customer activities in alignment with global product and marketing teams.

**3\.Key Account Management (FC)**

* Own and grow FC strategic accounts through solution\-based value selling and specification adoption.
* Identify and convert new FC opportunities with cross\-functional support.

**4\. Market Expansion \& Business Development**

* Work closely with distributors to explore high\-potential end\-customer segments and deepen market penetration of RC, FC and EC products.
* Collect local market intelligence, competitor dynamics and unmet customer needs, and provide actionable feedback to regional and global product teams.
* Ensure full compliance with company policies, local chemical import regulations and ethical standards across all channel activities.

**5\. Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Act as the primary liaison for distributors and FC accounts on order fulfillment, delivery, technical support, and issue resolution.
* Collaborate with supply chain, marketing, technical services, and finance to streamline processes and enhance customer experience.
* Work with Sales Manager to shape territory strategy, execute business plans, and align with regional priorities.

  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related science discipline.
* 5\+ years of sales experience in specialty chemicals, industrial chemicals or a related industry; direct distributor / channel management experience is mandatory.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in Indonesia, Philippines or Singapore markets.
* Fluent English in both written and verbal communication as the working language.
* Familiarity with local chemical import regulations and market landscape in the three territories is strongly preferred.
* Hands\-on knowledge of laboratory reagents, fine chemicals or electronic grade chemicals is a significant plus.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Results\-driven with the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Solid cross\-functional coordination and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Customer\-oriented mindset with sound commercial acumen.

title: External Affairs Manager, Asia Pacific
description:
**What We Can Achieve Together:**
---------------------------------

The Manager, External Affairs, Asia Pacific supports the advancement of The Nature Conservancy’s public funding and external engagement priorities across the region. Reporting to the **Director of External Affairs, Asia Pacific** , this role plays a key regional function in contributing to the implementation of the **One Conservancy Public Funding Strategy** , with a strong emphasis on building and managing relationships with targeted public sector entities and securing public funding in support of TNC’s 2030 Goals. The Manager will engage with major public institutions, governments, multi\-lateral agencies, NGOs, public officials, influential individuals, and TNC staff to support the positioning of TNC with public sector entities, as a leading organization for the design and delivery of conservation work in the Asia\-Pacific region. The Manager also works with TNC’s global strategy teams, Science and Field Conservation staff, other External Affairs departments and with TNC’s Operating Units to further conservation goals, policies and strategy.


This role is a two‑year fixed‑term position with the possibility of extension, subject to work performance, business needs, and funding availability.


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**  

The Manager contributes to TNC’s conservation impact by strengthening our strategic engagement with public sector entities, supporting the co\-creation of projects, and enhancing internal capability to both locate and capture public funding for TNC and influence the nature and scope of public funding policy, relevant to achieving TNC’s 2030 goals. Key functions include:


**Implementing the Public Funding Strategy**

* Support implementation of the One Conservancy Public Funding Strategy across Asia Pacific, including the achievement of Organisational Key Results related to the amount of public funding captured in a fiscal year and the anticipated value of the pipeline of public funded projects going into the next fiscal year.
* Identify and assess public funding opportunities across Asia Pacific.
* Support prioritization of public sector engagement to maximize funding outcomes and provide direct support to TNC Business Units to capture prioritised public funding through either selected competitive calls for proposals or through collaborative project formulation where projects are co\-designed with targeted public donors.
* Align regional actions with global strategy to drive coordinated engagement with priority public donors.
* Facilitate co\-creation of projects with governments, bilateral and multilateral donors.
* Monitor and prepare reports and recommendations on public fundraising efforts to global and regional leadership.

**Strengthening Public Sector Relationship Management**

Under the direction of the nominated TNC Relationship Manager for a specific PSE, develop and strengthen relationships with targeted public sector entities (PSEs) and their representatives in Asia Pacific, including national governments, development partners, and public donors.


* Support and record strategic, coordinated engagement approaches consistent with TNC standards for PSE engagement.

**Enhancing internal capability**

* Add to and promote internal awareness and use of BBCRM, the HUB, and the guidance and tools archived in the Public Funding Knowledge Bank, relevant to public fundraising.
* Manage and improve capacity building materials for designing and documenting conservation projects for public donors and deliver theory and practice training sessions and mentoring services to selected staff involved in public fundraising activities.
* Provide subject matter expertise in presenting project designs in logical frameworks, drafting text related to managing the project’s risks, and describing project governance arrangements and approaches to monitoring and evaluation of project compliance and impact.

**RESPONSIBILITIES \& SCOPE**
-----------------------------

**Capacity Building**

Enhance the capacity of TNC staff to:


* Build and manage relationships with public sector entities.
* Navigate public donor systems and requirements.
* Develop competitive, fundable project designs and documents.
* Support delivery and use of relevant tools, training, and learning platforms.

**Project Design \& Proposal Development**

* Support teams to design, document, and package projects for submission to public donors.
* Strengthen quality, consistency, and competitiveness of proposals.

**Internal Coordination \& Approvals**

* Facilitate cross\-functional coordination required for proposal development.
* Support teams in securing internal approvals for submission to public donors.
* Promote consistency and adherence to organizational processes.

**Knowledge Management**

* Build and maintain institutional knowledge of priority public donors in Asia Pacific.
* Track donor priorities, processes, and engagement strategies.
* Provide strategic advice on which public sector entities to prioritize for engagement.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in political science, environmental policy, international development, management or other relevant field and 5 years of government relations or corporate sector experience, or equivalent combination education/experience.
* Fluency in English.
* Analytical and project management experience. Demonstrated experience in successfully developing and implementing complex projects in an unstructured environment.
* Experience developing, directing and managing multiple projects and implementing strategic program goals.
* Proven communication and presentation skills.
* Proven negotiation skills.

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

* Experience working with governments, public sector entities, or multilateral institutions.
* Experience supporting relationships with external partner organisations, proposal development and/ or managing donor\-funded projects.
* Knowledge and expertise in developing theories of change, logical frameworks, result chains and related methodologies.
* Experience working in Asia Pacific.
* Familiarity with public funding mechanisms and agencies, including knowledge and application of current and evolving trends in public funding.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and management abilities.
* Experience coordinating with people in difference locations and cultures.

**Pay Grade** : 8


### **Who We Are** **:**

  

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science\-based organization, we create innovative, on\-the\-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor .


One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”


### **What We Bring** **:**

  

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non\-profit into one of the most effective and wide\-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!
  

  

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well\-being benefits.
  

  

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well\-being of the people we employ.


Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.


**Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.**

The Nature Conservancy is an **Equal Opportunity Employer.** Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.
  

  

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.
  

  

TNC is committed to offering accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please send a note to applyhelp@tnc.org with Request for Accommodation in the subject line.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Go + TypeScript)
description:
**Company Overview**
hermeneutic research is a best\-in\-class proprietary trading firm and hedge fund. It deploys research\-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long\-term investments. The partners' decade\-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm\-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard\-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

**Job Overview**
We are seeking experienced full\-stack engineers to build the user interfaces and services for mission\-critical financial applications: visual analytics platforms and data\-driven tools used by traders, researchers, and analysts.


You will work on the TypeScript front\-ends and the Go services that serve them. We are evolving our front\-end applications into a modular, plugin\-based platform that other engineers and teams build on—so you will build reusable UI modules, component libraries, and SDKs as much as end\-user features, and also the Go services that ingest, process, and serve market and on\-chain data to these applications. You will own your work from structured product requirements through to production.


This is a highly collaborative role in a fast\-paced environment where clean design, high performance, and responsive UIs are critical to the business.


You don't need a background in trading or finance. We care most about engineering craft and will teach you the domain.


Responsibilities* Collaborate with traders, researchers, and product managers to translate complex workflows into elegant UI solutions.
* Design and implement high\-performance, responsive front\-end applications using a current\-generation TypeScript framework (Svelte, React, or Vue).
* Design, build and operate Go back\-end services with security and performance considerations baked into their design.
* Own service boundaries and data contracts end\-to\-end, from Go services to typed front\-end SDKs.
* Build reusable UI modules, component libraries, and SDKs for a modular, plugin\-based UI platform.
* Build real\-time UIs that ingest and render high\-frequency market and on\-chain data from multiple streaming sources.
* Develop high\-performance data visualizations for large, fast\-updating datasets, using canvas\-based charting (e.g. uPlot, TradingView Lightweight Charts) and D3\.js for bespoke views.
* Integrate the front\-end with back\-end services through typed SDKs and MCP\-based interfaces, including real\-time market and on\-chain data.
* Drive architecture and performance decisions for modular, extensible systems, with scalability and maintainability in mind.
* Deploy and maintain applications, keeping them reliable and performant under heavy load.
* Write and maintain automated tests and take part in code review to keep the codebase reliable and maintainable.
* Support system maintenance and feature evolution with a high delivery cadence and short iteration cycles.
* Mentor other engineers and promote engineering best practices across the team.

  

**Requirements**  

  

Must Have* 7\+ years of hands\-on full\-stack development, with production ownership on both back\-end and front\-end.
* Strong, current TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and one or more modern front\-end frameworks (Svelte, React, or Vue), with the adaptability to work primarily in the framework a team has chosen rather than staying tied to one.
* Strong, current Go experience, able to design, build and operate production Go services independently.
* Experience building reusable, well\-structured UI components and shared abstractions.
* Proven experience handling large datasets and real\-time updates from back\-end sources (WebSockets, Server\-Sent Events).
* Strong understanding of performance optimization and rendering strategies in data\-heavy applications, including a solid grasp of the JavaScript runtime.
* Solid testing discipline, with unit and integration tests as a normal part of delivery.
* Genuine UI/UX sensibility—you can tell a polished interface from a rough one, and care about the difference.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and version control.
* Excellent communication and collaboration in a cross\-functional team.


Nice to Have* Background or strong interest in trading systems or financial platforms.
* Exceptional design taste / portfolio\-grade UI work.
* Experience with relational databases, data warehouses, and caching strategies.
* Experience with real\-time or on\-chain / crypto market data.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or other AI\-native / agent integration.
* Experience building developer platforms, SDKs, or shared component libraries used by other engineers.
* Understanding of microservice architectures, continuous delivery, and zero\-downtime deployment.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, or ELK.
* Prior work in hedge funds, proprietary trading, or similar finance environments.


Interview Process* **CV Screening** – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
* **Phone Screening** – A screening session with a few on\-the\-spot technical questions to assess your fundamental knowledge and problem\-solving approach.
* **Assignment** – A take\-home assignment to demonstrate your approach, critical thinking, and relevant skills.
* **Assignment Review** – A discussion of your assignment, focusing on your approach, reasoning, and solutions.
* **CTO Interview** – Interview with the CTO to discuss your experience, technical expertise, problem\-solving approach, and overall fit for the role.
* **Co\-Founder Interview** – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

**Company Values**
Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

* **Drive** – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
* **Ownership** – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
* **Judgment** – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
* **Openness** – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
* **Competence** – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast\-changing environments.
* **Resilience** – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long\-term goals.

description:

===============

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932\. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. 	+ Administer and maintain all DevSecOps tools including Blackduck Hub, Coverity , Contrast, Jenkins and SonarQube.
	+ Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of these platforms.
* **Upgrades \& Patch Management:**


	+ Plan and execute regular upgrades and patches for all tools and underlying infrastructure.
	+ Ensure tools are running on non\-vulnerable versions and platforms and are free from known security issues.
* **Compliance \& Security:**


	+ Monitor and enforce compliance with bank standard policies and industry standards.
	+ Implement security best practices across all tools and ensure audit readiness.
* **Automation \& Optimization:**


	+ Develop and maintain automation scripts for tool configuration, deployment, and monitoring.
	+ Optimize tool usage and workflows to improve developer productivity and operational efficiency.
* **Monitoring \& Troubleshooting:**


	+ Set up proactive monitoring and alerting for tool health and performance.
	+ Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to tool integration, performance, and access.

* Good organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to lift and move stock items safely.

**Domain Knowledge:**

title: APAC Regional Product Manager - DXC Integral
description:
**Job Description:**

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry\-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates. Learn more on dxc.com .


DXC protects, extends and transforms technology estates across all lines of business to meet customers wherever they are on their digital transformation journeys. As the No. 1 provider of core technology to the global insurance industry, DXC brings unparalleled domain expertise, next\-generation software and services, and a world\-class ecosystem of partners to help insurers achieve their digital transformation.


Insurance industry solutions \| DXC Technology


Assure Platform \| DXC Technology


**Role Overview:**

As the APAC Regional Product Manager for the Assure Integral product suite, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing our extensive portfolio of tools and products. This role blends insurance product knowledge, leadership, product first strategy, and line of business team collaboration to deliver high\-impact solutions in a fast\-paced, AI first, SAFe® Agile environment. You will be responsible for ensuring the adoption of Product Management best practices and supporting the Global Product Manager in the successful delivery of the product roadmap.


**Reporting Line:**

Reports to Global Product Manager – Assure Integral


**Key Responsibilities:**

Regional Product Execution \- Support execution of the global Integral roadmap within APAC, ensuring alignment with regional priorities, regulatory needs, and delivery commitments, whilst enforcing a product first, adopt, not adapt approach.


Customer \& Market Engagement \- Act as regional SME for Assure Integral. Support regional deal qualification, solution reviews and translate regional needs into scalable, reusable product capabilities.


Product Configuration \& Design \- Support the Build team in the design of configurable insurance products including benefits, riders, underwriting rules, pricing structures, and policy lifecycle events aligned to Integral platform constraints.


Delivery Enablement \- Work closely with delivery and implementation teams to ensure consistent, high\-quality adoption of Integral solutions across projects. Provide functional guidance and governance.


Feedback into Global Product \- Capture product gaps, regional challenges, and client feedback. Provide structured input to the global product roadmap to improve capability and reusability.


Governance \& Standardisation \- Promote standard product patterns and reduce bespoke builds. Ensure adherence to documentation standards, traceability, and product design principles.


**Key Skills \& Experience:**

Insurance Domain Knowledge \- Strong knowledge of Life, Protection, Annuities and/or P\&C insurance, with understanding of APAC market practices and regulatory environments.


Integral / PAS Expertise \- Experience working with Assure Integral or similar PAS platforms including product configuration, policy lifecycle processes, and data structures.


Regional Experience \- Experience working with APAC clients and delivery teams across multiple countries and regulatory regimes.


Technical \& Delivery Understanding \- Understanding of APIs, Integrations, Roadmap Management and backlog management tools, i.e.: JIRA, Confluence and AHA!, Agile delivery, and platform constraints within enterprise insurance systems.


Communication \& Stakeholder Management \- Strong ability to engage with clients, delivery teams, and global product management, translating between business and technical perspectives.


**Required Qualifications:**

* **5\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering and product management with regional exposure.**
* Proven experience in Insurance, PAS delivery, data migration, and Agile delivery.
* Strong understanding of insurance.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.,,
* Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments.

**Key Success Measures**

Successful adoption of Integral across APAC clients, increased reuse of core product capabilities, reduced customisation, and strong alignment with global product strategy.


At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in\-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.


**Recruitment fraud is a scheme in which fictitious job opportunities are offered to job seekers typically through online services, such as false websites, or through unsolicited emails claiming to be from the company. These emails may request recipients to provide personal information or to make payments as part of their illegitimate recruiting process. DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf.**

description:
**Date:** 2026\-08\-05


**Location:** Singapore, , Singapore


**Company:** NCS


**Job Requisition ID:** 173051


**Company Description**

  

  

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000\-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group

  

  

**Job Description**

  

  

We are seeking a talented **AI Consultant Lead** to join us. This role uniquely blends deep artificial intelligence expertise with advanced human\-centred design thinking to create intelligent, intuitive, and impactful digital experiences at scale. You'll lead design initiatives at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI technology and user experience, ensuring our AI\-powered solutions are not only technically robust but also delightful, accessible, and strategically aligned with business objectives.

  

**What you will do**


Strategic AI \& UX Leadership


* Lead the design vision and strategy for complex AI\-powered products and platforms across multiple client engagements
* Define and evolve design standards, frameworks, and best practices for AI\-driven user experiences
* Conduct strategic design research to identify emerging user needs and market opportunities in the AI space
* Provide thought leadership on the future of AI\-UX integration and its application across industry sectors
* Influence product roadmaps and business strategy through data\-driven design insights and recommendations

Advanced AI \& Machine Learning Integration


* Architect sophisticated AI\-driven features and functionalities that deliver measurable business value and exceptional user experiences
* Partner closely with data scientists, ML engineers, and technical architects to design scalable AI solutions
* Evaluate and optimize AI model performance from a UX perspective, balancing technical capabilities with user expectations
* Design transparent, explainable AI interfaces that build user trust and understanding

Data Strategy, Analytics \& Insights Leadership


* Lead the definition and execution of data strategies that underpin AI\-powered products and services across client engagements
* Partner with data scientists, data engineers, and analytics teams to align data pipelines, models, and insights with user and business needs
* Translate complex datasets, model outputs, and analytics into clear, actionable insights that inform design decisions, product strategy, and roadmaps
* Define data\-driven success metrics, KPIs, and experimentation frameworks to measure AI effectiveness, user trust, and business impact
* Guide teams in leveraging quantitative and qualitative data to validate assumptions, prioritize features, and optimize user experiences
* Evaluate data quality, bias, and representativeness, ensuring responsible and trustworthy use of data in AI\-driven experiences
* Champion human\-in\-the\-loop and data transparency practices, designing workflows where users can understand, challenge, and act on AI insights

Expert User Experience Design


* Lead end\-to\-end design processes for enterprise\-scale projects, from discovery through delivery
* Conduct and oversee comprehensive user research programs
* Create sophisticated design artifacts including service blueprints, experience maps, design systems, and interactive prototypes
* Design complex, multi\-platform experiences that seamlessly integrate AI capabilities across web, mobile, and emerging interfaces
* Oversee the design of data\-rich user interfaces, including dashboards, analytics tools, and decision\-support systems for enterprise users

Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Collaboration


* Lead design thinking workshops, innovation sprints, and co\-creation sessions with various stakeholders, including C\-suite
* Collaborate with product managers and business leaders to define product vision, strategy, and success metrics
* Bridge technical and business stakeholders, translating complex requirements into elegant design solutions

Responsible AI \& Ethical Design


* Champion ethical AI practices and responsible design principles
* Proactively identify and mitigate fairness, bias, privacy, and transparency issues in AI\-driven experiences
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards across all design work
* Advocate for user rights, data privacy, and inclusive design throughout the organization
* Establish governance frameworks for ethical AI design practices

Google AI \& Cloud AI Leadership


* Lead the design and delivery of AI solutions leveraging Google Cloud AI platforms, including Vertex AI, AutoML, and managed machine learning services
* Drive the adoption of Google Generative AI capabilities (e.g., large language models, embeddings, conversational AI) to create scalable, enterprise\-ready user experiences
* Partner with data scientists, ML engineers, and cloud architects to architect end‑to‑end AI workflows on Google Cloud, from data ingestion to model deployment and monitoring
* Define use cases and solution patterns that balance custom models and Google\-managed AI services, considering scalability, cost, performance, and risk
* Guide teams on MLOps best practices on Google Cloud, including model training, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management
* Ensure AI solutions built on Google Cloud follow responsible AI, privacy, and security principles, including explainability, fairness, and transparency
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to align Google AI capabilities with business strategy, regulatory requirements, and digital transformation roadmaps
* Evaluate and experiment with emerging Google AI services and features, translating platform advancements into practical enterprise use cases
* Provide technical and strategic leadership in designing AI\-powered products that integrate Google Cloud data services (e.g., BigQuery, analytics platforms)
* Support pre‑sales and client engagements by shaping Google AI solution architectures, proposals, and value cases
  

  

**Qualifications**

  

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field
* **At least** **3\-5 years focused on AI/ML\-powered products,** with 3 years of professional UX consultant experience.
* **Proven track record** of leading complex, enterprise\-scale design projects from concept to launch
* Comprehensive portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, design process excellence, and measurable business impact
* Deep understanding of AI/ML concepts, capabilities, limitations, and ethical considerations
* Expert proficiency in industry\-standard design tools (Figma, Sketch, Adobe Creative Suite, prototyping tools)
* Extensive experience with user research methodologies, both qualitative and quantitative
* Strong background in designing for multiple platforms (web, mobile, conversational interfaces, dashboards)
* Demonstrated ability to influence product strategy and drive design\-led innovation
* Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
* Experience presenting to and influencing senior executives and C\-level stakeholders
* Familiarity with Agile and Design Thinking methodologies
* Understanding of business metrics, KPIs, and how design drives business outcomes
* Familiarity with data governance, privacy, and regulatory requirements (e.g., PDPA, GDPR\-aligned practices) in AI and analytics contexts
* Hands\-on experience defining and tracking data\-driven KPIs, success metrics, and experimentation frameworks for AI initiatives.
* Strong understanding of data analytics, statistics, and applied machine learning concepts relevant to AI\-powered products and services.
* Experience designing or delivering AI solutions using Google Cloud AI services, such as Vertex AI, AutoML, and managed ML platforms.
* Familiarity with Google’s Generative AI capabilities (e.g., foundation models, LLMs, embeddings, conversational AI) and their application in enterprise products and services.
* Hands\-on experience integrating AI solutions with Google Cloud data services (e.g., BigQuery, data pipelines, analytics platforms) to support end\-to\-end AI workflows.
* Strong understanding of MLOps concepts on Google Cloud, including model training, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of Google AI APIs for vision, natural language, speech, recommendation, or search use cases.
  

  

**Additional Information**

  

  

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

  

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

  

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

  

Scam Alert

  

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing\-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

  

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. When in doubt, verify the sender’s identity by contacting us at reachus@ncs.com.sg.

**Data \& AI – Manager**



CFGI, founded in 2000, is a dynamic and fast\-growing financial consulting firm serving as a trusted partner to CFOs and their organizations. We help clients address complex challenges across accounting, financial reporting, transactions, regulatory compliance, digital transformation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. We combine deep technical expertise with a hands\-on, entrepreneurial approach to help leading organizations move forward with confidence.



We are expanding our Data \& AI practice across Asia\-Pacific and seeking a hands\-on Manager to lead client engagements and support business development in either the India or Japan market. Managers oversee day\-to\-day engagement delivery, mentor junior professionals, collaborate with senior client stakeholders, and help identify and shape new opportunities.



Candidates are not expected to support both markets. The successful candidate will be aligned to either India or Japan based on their relevant language capabilities, market experience, and client relationships.


**What You Might Expect**
* Lead Data \& AI engagements involving data engineering, advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, dashboards, automation, and data\-governance solutions.
* Manage the design, development, and implementation of data pipelines, analytics solutions, predictive models, generative\-AI applications, agentic workflows, and intelligent process\-automation initiatives.
* Lead AI readiness assessments, use\-case identification, implementation roadmaps, responsible\-AI governance, and AI\-enabled managed\-services engagements.
* Partner with CFOs, CTOs, and senior finance, technology, data, risk, and operations stakeholders to translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions.
* Own day\-to\-day client relationships, facilitate working sessions, communicate recommendations, and present technical solutions to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Lead engagement planning, project execution, workstream management, quality assurance, and client\-ready deliverables.
* Embed appropriate model validation, explainability, auditability, privacy, security, and human\-oversight controls into AI solutions.
* Manage and mentor junior team members by providing technical guidance, reviewing deliverables, and supporting professional development.
* Identify and qualify new client opportunities in the assigned market.
* Contribute to proposals, solution design, executive presentations, account expansion, and pursuit activities alongside CFGI partners.
* Collaborate with CFGI’s APAC and global Data \& AI, Data \& Analytics, controls, and managed\-services teams.
* Help adapt and productize CFGI’s existing accelerators, platforms, and delivery methodologies for local\-market requirements.


**What You Must Have**
* 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, data science, advanced analytics, applied artificial intelligence, machine learning, analytics consulting, and/or technology consulting.
* Strong hands\-on experience delivering data or AI solutions from requirements and solution design through implementation, with demonstrated depth in at least one core discipline: AI engineering, data\-platform engineering, or advanced analytics and modeling.
* Experience leading client\-facing workstreams, managing project deliverables, communicating with senior stakeholders, and mentoring junior professionals.
* Demonstrated professional experience supporting **either the India or Japan market**, including professional working English and the language capability needed to deliver client work and build relationships in the assigned market:
	+ - **India:** Hindi or another relevant Indian regional language, such as Kannada, Marathi, or Tamil; **or**
		- **Japan:** Business\-level Japanese.

Candidates are not required to speak both an Indian language and Japanese. Each candidate will be assessed only against the language and market requirements of the market they are being considered to support.  


**What Sets You Apart**
* Experience designing and implementing generative\-AI, predictive\-AI, or agentic\-AI solutions in a production or enterprise environment.
* Experience developing data platforms and solutions using Python, SQL, Snowflake, Databricks, cloud data platforms, data orchestration tools, and/or modern lakehouse technologies.
* Experience evaluating and selecting AI models based on capability, cost, latency, throughput, security, licensing, context\-window, and data\-residency requirements.
* Experience developing retrieval\-augmented generation, tool\-enabled AI, multi\-agent workflows, semantic layers, knowledge graphs, or other enterprise knowledge architectures.
* Experience applying AI governance, model evaluation, observability, explainability, model\-risk, data\-lineage, and auditability practices.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform and its managed AI services, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience leading business\-intelligence, workflow\-automation, or analytics solutions using platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, UiPath, or Microsoft Power Platform.
* Experience originating or co\-originating client opportunities, shaping business cases and scopes, developing proposals, and presenting solutions to executive buyers.
* Experience growing existing client accounts or converting delivery relationships into follow\-on engagements.
* Established relationships with senior client stakeholders, alliance partners, or technology vendors in India or Japan.
* Experience delivering data or AI solutions in regulated, audit\-focused, risk\-sensitive, or data\-residency\-constrained environments.

  


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with generative\-AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol, function calling, vector databases, embedding models, hybrid search, prompt management, or prompt\-versioning practices.
* Experience with AI evaluation or observability tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, MLflow, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or Evidently AI.
* Experience with responsible\-AI tools and methodologies, including SHAP, LIME, fairness testing, model registries, data contracts, or data\-lineage platforms.
* Familiarity with self\-hosted inference technologies such as vLLM, Ollama, SGLang, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with semantic\-layer technologies, ontologies, knowledge graphs, RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or graph databases such as Neo4j.
* Office\-of\-the\-CFO experience involving finance, financial close, reporting, controls, risk, tax, FP\&A, or related workflows.
* Experience in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, technology, manufacturing, energy, consumer products, or another relevant industry.
* Experience delivering AI or analytics solutions within a governed finance, reporting, controls, or risk environment.
* Familiarity with the data\-privacy, AI\-governance, and sector\-specific regulatory requirements applicable to the candidate’s assigned market.

  


**Who Thrives Here**
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to build relationships across client, technical, and engagement teams.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving abilities.
* Comfortable communicating technical concepts and business value to executive and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proactive in identifying client needs, developing relationships, and creating new opportunities.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, priorities, and deadlines.
* Hands\-on and willing to remain close to the technical work while leading teams and client relationships.
* Entrepreneurial, self\-motivated, adaptable, ethical, and dependable.
* Collaborative across countries, cultures, practices, and technical disciplines.
* High energy with a commitment to delivering exceptional client service and developing junior team members.

  


**Why CFGI**

This role offers a combination of hands\-on delivery leadership and a meaningful commercial mandate within a growing Data \& AI practice.



You will have exposure across the full client lifecycle—from the first executive conversation and qualified opportunity through solution design, implementation, and managed operation. You will work across industries and across the AI lifecycle, supported by CFGI’s global Data \& Analytics capabilities, controls expertise, and managed\-services platform.



CFGI’s vendor\-agnostic approach allows teams to recommend solutions based on client needs rather than a single technology platform. As the APAC practice continues to grow, Managers who develop strong delivery reputations and lasting client relationships will be well positioned for future leadership opportunities.



CFGI is an equal\-opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on job\-related skills, experience, and demonstrated capability. CFGI does not make employment decisions based on nationality, ethnicity, national origin, race, religion, gender, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
