title: Senior/Clinical Research Associate
description:
Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO. At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life\-changing therapies to patients. What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease.



Precision for Medicine is looking for a Senior/Clinical Research Associate.


**Position Summary:**



The CRA II provides overall support to study sites and clinical project teams engaged in clinical research studies. Adheres to applicable protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and all applicable guidelines and regulatory requirements (e.g., International Council for Harmonization (ICH) \-Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP), and country/region\-specific regulations). Acts as point of contact for study sites. The CRA is a solid team member who can execute all core responsibilities consistently across several studies using independent judgment and critical thinking. Individual works independently as study team member with minimum support in complex activities.


**Essentials functions of the job included but not limited to:**


* Oversees all aspects of study site management to ensure patient safety is protected, quality of data generated by managed sites resulting in consistently low query levels and in acceptable Quality Assurance reports.
* Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow\-up actions.
* Updates, tracks and maintains study specific trial management tools/systems, and status reports.
* If required, manages site start up procedures including the feasibility and recruitment of potential investigators, preparation of EC/IRB submissions, collection and review of regulatory documents, review and adaptation in Patient Informed Consents, notifications to IRB, EC and regulatory authorities, as appropriate, translation of study related documentation, organization of meetings and other tasks as instructed by the Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager.
* If required, assists the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee.
* Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient's safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
* Independently conducts all forms of site visits, including pre\-study/ qualification, initiation, routine monitoring, and close\-out visits, in accordance with the protocol, local laws, ICH\-GCP and Precision SOPs. Prepares and submits for review, accurate and timely monitoring reports from all site visits (on\-site and remote).
* Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow\-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs, Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan and client requirements. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
* Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
* Communicates effectively and proactively with both site personnel and Precision Project and Clinical Trial Management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues.
* Develops and maintains good working relationship with investigators and study staff, serving as an ambassador to promote Precision high quality and professional image.
* Performs investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
* Performs data review activities, including remote EDC CRF and patient profiles review, query resolution, and assists data management and clinical data quality personnel to resolve data discrepancies
* Identifies and processes Serious Adverse Events according to the procedures defined by the study team. Also demonstrates a full understanding of the SAE reporting process.
* Identifies site risks and escalates those to Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager with suggested contingencies. Owns the timely and appropriate resolution of the risk with minimal support from project team.
* Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face\-to\-face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
* Travels as necessary according to project needs.
* Performs other duties as assigned by management.

**Minimum Required:**


* Bachelor's degree / international equivalent or equivalent combination of education and experience ideally in a business, scientific or healthcare discipline.
* Minimum of 2 years of on\-site monitoring experience; 1 year oncology experience；
* Global Clinical Trial experience

  


**Other required:**


* High in proficiency in the Microsoft Office package of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).
* Customer service demeanour; demonstrate flexibility and teamwork.
* Ability to focus on detail for extended periods of time, high attention to accuracy.

* Working knowledge of the drug development process.

description:
**Manager**
===========

Date: 5 Aug 2026
Location: Singapore
Company: Fleet Ship Management Pte Ltd
Our 30\-year journey rides on the passion of over 27,000 seafarers and 1,000 onshore professionals. Today, we are one of the largest independent third\-party ship management companies managing over 650\+ diverse types of vessels.

  


Headquartered in Hong Kong SAR, China, we operate on a global scale having 27 offices in 12 countries. Our client base spans over 100 world\-class ship owners, including Fortune 500 companies from China, Greece, India, Japan, Korea, Netherlands, Norway, Turkey and the USA, among others.

  


In a shore career at FLEET, you will be working with a team of a highly passionate, self\-driven and committed group of people. We aim to be a place where you can achieve your full potential, regardless of your background. We are looking for individuals who are ambitious about making a strong contribution to FLEET’s short and long\-term sustainable growth – whether you are dealing directly with clients or working in a role supporting the business, such as technology, legal or communications.

  


**Job Position Summary**


The Manager/ Senior Manager will actively lead an on\-shore and off\-shore team to deliver high quality, innovative, sustainable solutions to the customer with complete responsibility for safe and cost\-effective management of the vessels assigned.  

Employees designated as Managers will have additional responsibilities as acting Group in\-charge in the absence of the Group Manager.

  


**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

  


***Technical Management / Operations***


* Accountable for vessel inspection and ensure the ships condition and maintenance standards adhere to organisation procedures
* Ensure all maintenance is performed to a high standard and as per manufacturer’s recommendations
* Prepare specifications and evaluate tenders
* Supervise daily operational activities of all assigned vessels
* Advise Line Manager on a regular basis about vessel operation, budgetary performance and any untoward incidents on vessels in the fleet
* Liaise with the Procurement Department related to supply of spare parts of all vessels, considering the opportunities for replenishment in respect to the trading commitments of the vessels to provide for the most economical supply
* Responsible for communication, promotion and implementation of company's health, safety, environment and quality policy on board the vessels related to technical
* Drives all technical related mobilization activities, refits, dry\-docking \& major repairs. Plan for repairs and dry\-docking of the vessels at suitable regular intervals

  




***Regulatory/Legislative Statutory Compliance***


* 100% compliance with International Maritime Organisation (IMO), Flag State and Port State rules and regulations
* Maintenance of ship certificate and survey status at all times keeping track of renewals and placement on board vessels.

  




***Financial Management***


* Maintain, monitor and report budgets for all vessels under charge. Work closely with Technical staff, purchasing and finance controllers to ensure budget is within the agreed variables/targets \*(current target 3% variance)
* Support reporting manager to plan “Operating Budget” for all vessels under charge.
* Responsible for planning and execution of all dry\-docking activities within the allotted budget limits

  




***Quality \& Continuous Improvement***


* Scan the environment and recommend improvement in processes to enhance productivity an efficiency in the system
* Drive implementation of approved ‘Continuous Improvement’ projects in collaboration with the Quality team
* Establish clear expected levels of performance from crew and work with manager on updating the SOP’s.
* Demonstrates a complete understanding of the Safety \& QMS policies \& procedures and ensures that the on\-shore and off\-shore employees operate at the same level of understanding and awareness

  




***Health, Safety and Environment Compliance***


* Responsible for creating and sustaining a positive safety culture on\-board all vessels under charge
* Act as a first point of contact for any emergencies aboard vessels under charge. Ensure a technically qualified representative is available and responds to emergencies within the agreed time limit
* Ensures a safe \& compliant working environment is provided to all off\-shore employees by demonstrating a complete and accurate understanding of the health \& safety policies and practices of the organisation
* Responsible for corrective action being implemented to remedy safety hazards or risks and restore a safe working environment on board vessels. Escalate to Manager in the event of the hazards/risks exceeding authority limits provided in the role
* Owns and responsible for delivery of safety messages/training to off\-shore employees during site or vessel visits

  




***People and Leadership Management***


* Articulates clear and specific goals for employees on board vessels under charge
* Lead, coach, engage, motivate, mentor employees to develop their strengths and build their capabilities as per their defined roles and personal goals
* Ensure development plans are in place for all offshore team members and it is followed up closely to ensure completion
* Responsible for continuous performance discussions with direct reports to drive learning and self\-improvement
* Manage and maintain the talent pool by engaging top performers and taking definitive action on bottom performers

  




**Relationship:**

  


***Internal:***


* Management team
* Business Support – Purchasing, Finance, Quality, Human Resources \& IT
* Off\-shore employees on vessels under charge
* Cross\-functional Peer Group

  




***External:***


* Vessel Owner or a designated authority
* Regulatory/Government authorities
* Vendors

  




**Job Experience, Functional Knowledge and Qualifications**

  


***Essential:***


* Bachelor’s degree/Diploma or equivalent in Marine Engineering/ Navigation/Internationally recognized shipping degree/qualification
* Hold MEO Class 1 Certificate of competency or Certificate of Competency II/2 (for Master/Chief Officer) or Certificate of Competency III/2 (for Chief Engineer/Second Engineer) under STCW Code
* A minimum of 3 years’ relevant experience as Chief Engineer/Second Engineer or Master/Chief Officer on Dry/Tanker/Gas in the relevant type of vessel being recruited for e.g. Dry Cargo, Oil, Chemical or Gas, etc. Of this a minimum sailing experience of 6 months as Chief Engineer/Master (12 months is desirable).
* A minimum of 3 years’ experience as a superintendent, a shore\-based management role with an exceptional performance track record

  




***Desirable:***


* Knowledge in Classifications Society procedures and regulations is desirable.
* Should have prior people management experience
* Proven track record in intermediate and special dry dockings, ship repair, mobilizations and in\-water repairs
* Demonstrated Commercial acumen and ability to manage vessel financials within scope as well as satisfy client’s requirements
* IT literate and computer savvy
* Business Administration qualification will be an added advantage

  




**Competencies**


* Effective decision making
* Analysis and Problem solving
* Interacting with others
* Listening and communicating
* Collaboration, inclusion and teamwork
* Driving High Quality
* Customer focus
* Planning and Organising
* Initiative
* Accountability
* Responding to context
* Resilience and wellbeing

description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

  

As Manager, Account Management at Airwallex, you'll lead a team of account managers who own and grow our highest\-potential client portfolios. This role blends industry and account strategy with people leadership — you'll set standards and coach your team to deepen client relationships, understand industry trends and insights, qualify account potential and drive product adoption across our full suite of products.
  

  

You'll work cross\-functionally with sales, product, operations, marketing, and strategy to build playbooks, sharpen customer journeys, and bring what you learn from clients back into the business. The ideal candidate combines account management or business development skills with proven people leadership, plus the hustle and creativity to build new approaches in a fast\-moving environment.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Lead and develop the team:** set high expectations, manage, coach, and grow a team of account managers — setting goals, reviewing performance, and building their skills in consultative selling and account planning.
* **Drive portfolio growth:** set strategy and priorities to expand Airwallex's footprint, strengthen client relationships, and grow wallet share across the team's combined portfolio.
* **Shape playbooks:** identify workflows, pain points, and product opportunities across the team's client base, and turn them into repeatable playbooks.
* **Bring back market intelligence:** share insights on industry trends, competitors, and emerging client behaviours with commercial leadership.
* **Guide account strategy:** support the team in understanding each client's business, transaction trends, and operational needs, so they can advise on the right payment, FX, and workflow setup.
* **Maximise wallet share:** use data and consultative selling to drive adoption across payments, collections, transfers, cards, yield, and workflow automation.
* **Educate and activate clients:** help the team teach clients how to get the most out of Airwallex to streamline operations and improve margins.
* **Champion customer needs:** advocate internally for a better product fit for account management clients.
* **Collaborate cross\-functionally:** partner with product, ops, and marketing to run pilots, refine messaging, and improve platform usage.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 7\-10 years' experience in account management, business development, or a similar commercial role, ideally in payments, fintech, or a high\-growth company
* 3\-5 years leading a team directly, ideally in a 0 to 1 or rapid growth phase
* Hustler mentality: scrappy, persistent, and comfortable working in ambiguity
* Creative problem solver who can build new approaches for complex client needs
* Strong commercial intuition, with the ability to map payment flows and spot revenue opportunities.
* Relationship\-first mindset, with the ability to build trust across multi\-stakeholder environments, internally and externally
* Excellent communication skills — clear, structured, and persuasive
* Experience in fintech or high\-growth startups

--------------------------------------------------------------

All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*


*Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*


**Equal opportunity**
---------------------


Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Vice President, Financial Crime & Identity Solutions
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Vice President, Financial Crime \& Identity Solutions
The Security Solutions organization leads product management and innovation across Mastercard solutions that address evolving risk, security, and trust needs.
  

  

Within Security Solutions, Financial Crime Solutions develops payment data\-powered solutions to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, scams, and identity risk. The team also leads the Asia Pacific Cyber and Scam Centre of Excellence, combining data science and payments expertise to help institutions and partners address criminal behaviours behind fraud, scams, and money laundering.
  

  

Overview
  

  

This role develops and executes the Asia Pacific strategy for Mastercard’s Financial Crime and Identity solutions, spanning implementation, commercialization, partnerships, and adoption across governments, financial institutions, e\-commerce platforms, digital players, and priority segments.
  

  

The role owns performance tracking, budget forecasting, external narratives, communications, and stakeholder engagement to scale Mastercard’s offerings across Asia Pacific. It includes leading subject matter experts and mobilizing product, customer success, delivery, and business development teams to meet financial objectives and drive market impact.
  

  

The role collaborates closely with global, regional, product, technology, data science, franchise, sales, and customer\-facing teams to align requirements, market feedback, solution development, and go\-to\-market execution.
  

  

The Role
  

  

Thought Leadership and Advocacy
  

  

Position Mastercard as a trusted advisor across Asia Pacific on financial crime, identity, fraud, scams, and cyber resilience.
  

  

Represent Mastercard in regional forums, industry events, and policy dialogues to advance adoption of Financial Crime and Identity solutions.
  

  

Lead executive narratives, external communications, white papers, industry engagement, academic partnerships, and senior leader talk tracks.
  

  

Owning Go\-To\-Market Strategy for Financial Crime and Identity Solutions
  

  

Develop and execute the Asia Pacific go\-to\-market strategy, including:
  

  

Prioritize markets, customer segments, and deployment opportunities.
  

  

Assess local regulatory, policy, data, technology, and operational requirements.
  

  

Strengthen understanding of offerings, features, commercialization needs, and RFP responses for Financial Crime and Identity solutions.
  

  

Policy / Standards / Regulation Enablement: Advocate for policies, standards, and regulations that support solution deployment and adoption.
  

  

Buying Centre Engagement: Identify and engage relevant buying centres, decision makers, and influencers across Asia Pacific to support go\-to\-market and deployment plans.
  

  

New Opportunity Qualification: Guide qualification of new sales opportunities and educate internal and external stakeholders on how Financial Crime and Identity solutions work and can be deployed.
  

  

New Use Case Development: Identify new customer use cases and partner with global product teams to develop propositions that resonate with Asia Pacific customers.
  

  

Partnership Building
  

  

Engage strategic partners, including Big Tech, governments, multilateral organizations, technology providers, and industry associations, to advance Mastercard’s Financial Crime and Identity and Centre of Excellence objectives.
  

  

Build coalitions that foster innovation, shared best practices, and scalable ecosystem responses to fraud and scams across markets.
  

  

Maintain strong partnerships with Mastercard regional sales teams, divisional product teams, and other internal verticals
  

  

Collaborate broadly with internal stakeholders to surface and scale success, including case studies, repeatable narratives, and responses to consultation papers relevant to financial crime, data sharing, and cross\-border money movement.
  

  

Demonstrate thought leadership, product and technology development expertise, and strong project management skills to integrate technology into new product and service solutions.
  

  

Generate ideas, validate concepts, and shape product designs for new services and product enhancements.
  

  

All About You  

  

  

  

  

Experienced leader with 15\-20\+ years of experience leading teams, setting direction, demonstrating humility and decisiveness, and building strong cross\-functional and executive relationships.
  

  

Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, with the ability to build credibility, influence stakeholders, and empower high\-performing teams through trust, autonomy, accountability, and innovation.
  

  

Ability to navigate technical complexity across account\-to\-account, blockchain, and crypto flows, assess security implications, and shape solutions for emerging risks.
  

  

Proven ability to engage \& influence senior stakeholders across banks, e\-commerce, governments, and ecosystem partners to drive regional initiatives.
  

  

Cross\-functional leadership experience managing multiple complex projects concurrently and delivering high\-quality outcomes under tight timelines.
  

  

Knowledge and experience in payments, cybersecurity, identity, fraud, authentication products, and the broader payment ecosystem.
  

  

Ability to embrace complexity while articulating clear, simple, and actionable priorities.
  

  

Strong executive communication skills, cross\-functional / multi stakeholder management skills, strategic thinking, problem solving \& analytical skills
  

  

Ability to converse in, or understand, multiple Asia Pacific languages, such as Chinese or Japanese, is a plus.**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Work closely with group and country finance teams to improve accounting practices and shorten month\-end closing timelines.
  
  

Identify opportunities to standardise, simplify and automate finance processes across multiple entities and jurisdictions.
  
  

Support the longer\-term transition towards a more efficient and scalable finance operating model.
  
  

Manage short\-term improvement projects in collaboration with country finance teams.
  
  

Financial Reporting and Contract Reviews

Provide technical accounting guidance to local finance teams on complex contracts, transactions and reporting matters.
  
  

Review vendor contracts together with Group Procurement and evaluate the related accounting implications.
  
  

Support accurate and consistent financial reporting across the organisation’s international operations.
  
  

Assist the Group Finance Controller with group\-level accounting, reporting and consolidation matters.
  
  

Systems and Process Integration
  
  

Review requests for enhancements to operational and finance systems, particularly those relating to customer contracts and financial reporting.
  
  

Ensure that proposed system changes are aligned with appropriate accounting treatments, reporting requirements and internal controls.
  
  

Contribute finance and accounting perspectives to the design and development of operational systems.
  
  

Participate in cross\-functional workshops involving Finance, Operations, Procurement and technology stakeholders.
  
  

Support the implementation and optimisation of Oracle NetSuite, particularly in relation to reporting and finance processes.
  
  

Risk and Control Framework
  
  

Establish and strengthen finance risk and control frameworks across the group.
  
  

Improve governance, documentation and consistency of financial controls across country operations.
  
  

Identify control gaps and work with relevant teams to implement practical remediation measures.
  
  

Support internal, statutory and tax audit requirements when needed.

Chartered Accountant, Certified Public Accountant or an equivalent professional accounting qualification; candidates with a Big Four background are preferred.

Strong technical knowledge of IFRS, including revenue recognition principles.
  
  

Demonstrated experience managing month\-end close, group consolidation and intercompany accounting within a multi\-country environment.
  
  

Previous exposure to a headquarters or group\-level finance function is highly preferred.
  
  

Experience reviewing customer and vendor contracts and determining their accounting implications.
  
  

Hands\-on experience with Oracle NetSuite, particularly its reporting capabilities.
  
  

Track record in finance process improvement, automation, standardisation or transformation programmes.
  
  

Sound understanding of financial controls, governance and risk management.
  
  

Comfortable working across different countries, entities and regulatory environments.

title: Regional Project Management Manager - Singapore
description:
Are you looking to work for a global organization that has a positive impact on the environment? Would you like to work for a multi\-cultural team? As part of the Fluence Corporation family, you can play a pivotal role in the success of the company. Our mission at Fluence is to provide communities and businesses with cutting\-edge solutions for treating water and wastewater, helping improve our customers’ sustainability, resiliency, and operational success.



We’re committed to reshaping the future of water treatment on a global scale with our innovative technologies. We offer solutions that produce clean water for drinking or industrial use, as well as products for effectively treating wastewater so it can be safely returned to the environment or reused, with the potential to generate energy in the process. In addition to customized solutions, Fluence leads the global charge in decentralized treatment with advanced, quickly deployable packed plants.

  


**POSITION SUMMARY:**



The Regional Project Management Lead will lead the Asia regional project management function and directly manage a team of approximately 3–5 project management professionals.



The role has overall responsibility for project execution governance across the Asia region, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in accordance with contractual and technical requirements.



The Regional PM Lead will establish consistent project management standards, assign and balance project resources across the portfolio, develop the capability of the regional PM team, and provide hands\-on leadership for major, complex, or high\-risk projects.



A key objective of the role is to protect and improve project margins from contract handover through final completion, while proactively managing commercial, contractual, technical, schedule, supply chain, and customer\-related risks.



This role will support the continued growth of the Asia business by building a scalable, accountable, and commercially focused regional project execution team.

  


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:**


**Team Leadership \& People Management**


* Set clear roles, responsibilities, objectives, and performance expectations for each team member.
* Assign Project Managers to projects based on project complexity, workload, experience, and business priorities.
* Balance project workload and resources across countries and projects within the Asia region.
* Conduct regular one\-to\-one meetings, project performance reviews, and team development discussions.
* Establish annual objectives and KPIs for direct reports and provide regular performance feedback.
* Coach and develop Project Managers to improve their technical, commercial, contractual, and leadership capabilities.
* Build succession and capability plans to support future regional business growth.
* Identify competency gaps and develop appropriate training, mentoring, and development plans.
* Promote a team culture based on ownership, accountability, transparency, collaboration, and early escalation.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of additional project management resources as the regional project portfolio grows.
* Develop the team from primarily project coordination toward stronger end\-to\-end project ownership and commercial accountability.


**Regional Project Portfolio Leadership**


* Take overall leadership and governance responsibility for projects executed across the Asia region.
* Maintain visibility of the complete regional project portfolio, including project status, schedule, cost, margin, cash flow, risks, claims, and key customer issues.
* Allocate projects and responsibilities across the regional PM team.
* Monitor team capacity and identify resource constraints before they affect project delivery.
* Conduct regular portfolio and individual project reviews with Project Managers.
* Provide coaching and direction to Project Managers on critical execution issues.
* Personally lead or provide senior oversight for major, complex, strategic, or high\-risk projects.
* Ensure consistent project management standards are applied across all projects and countries.
* Provide Regional Management with accurate project forecasts and early visibility of material risks and opportunities


**Project Execution \& Delivery**


* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with contractual requirements, approved budgets, schedules, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Hold individual Project Managers accountable for project performance and agreed deliverables.
* Ensure clear project execution plans are established at the beginning of each project.
* Drive effective coordination among Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Site, Commissioning, Finance, and Customer teams.
* Ensure project milestones, deliverables, and customer obligations are actively tracked and managed.
* Support Project Managers in resolving critical execution issues and removing delivery bottlenecks.
* Intervene directly when projects face material commercial, contractual, technical, schedule, or customer risks.


**Margin Protection \& Improvement**


* Take ownership of execution margin performance across the regional project portfolio.
* Establish project cost baselines and ensure disciplined tracking of actual and forecast costs.
* Hold Project Managers accountable for project budget, cost\-to\-complete, and margin performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve project profitability through procurement savings, design optimization, execution efficiency, scope management, and commercial recovery.
* Prevent margin leakage caused by uncontrolled scope changes, rework, delays, poor coordination, or unrecorded customer requests.
* Drive early identification and realization of project upside opportunities.
* Work closely with Finance and individual Project Managers to maintain accurate cost\-to\-complete and margin forecasts.


**Contract \& Commercial Management**


* Develop the commercial and contractual awareness of the regional PM team.
* Ensure Project Managers understand key contractual obligations, milestones, payment terms, acceptance criteria, liquidated damages, warranties, and liability exposures.
* Establish disciplined management of variations, change orders, claims, extensions of time, and customer\-driven scope changes.
* Ensure no material additional work is performed without appropriate documentation and commercial approval.
* Maintain proper project records to support contractual positions and claims.
* Support Project Managers in commercial negotiations with customers, partners, EPC contractors, and suppliers.
* Personally lead or support negotiations involving significant commercial or contractual exposure.


**CORE COMEPETENCIES:**


* **Leadership \& People Development** – Ability to lead a professional team of 3–5 people, set clear goals, provide ongoing feedback, and enhance team members' technical, commercial, and leadership capabilities through coaching and training.
* **Commercial \& Financial Acumen** – Demonstrates sharp commercial judgment, with the ability to protect and improve project margins from contract handover through final completion, and understands the impact of cash flow, cost control, and contract terms on business performance.
* **Contractual \& Risk Management** – Familiar with EPC/engineering project contract management, capable of identifying, assessing, and proactively managing commercial, contractual, technical, schedule, supply chain, and customer\-related risks, ensuring timely escalation and effective mitigation actions.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** – Able to effectively coordinate across Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Site, Commissioning, Finance, and Customer teams, driving cross\-functional collaboration to achieve project objectives.
* **Strategic Portfolio Thinking** – Possesses a big\-picture perspective, capable of balancing resource allocation across multiple projects and countries in a complex environment, ensuring the overall health of the regional project portfolio.
* **Problem Solving \& Decision Making** – Able to quickly identify root causes of issues when facing complex or high\-risk projects, make decisive judgments, and personally intervene when necessary to bring projects back on track.
* **Cross\-Cultural Communication** – Able to communicate effectively across diverse Asian cultural contexts, build trust, and drive team collaboration.
* **Process Orientation \& Governance** – Able to establish and continuously improve project management processes and stage\-gate governance mechanisms, ensuring consistency and compliance in execution.


**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:**


* Bachelor's degree or above in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Project Management, or related discipline.
* Master's degree or MBA is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of project management experience, with at least 5 years in project lead or team management capacity.
* Proven experience in municipal or industrial wastewater treatment, water supply, or related water infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated experience in EPC, design\-build, or turnkey project delivery models.
* Experience working in a multi\-country, cross\-cultural environment within the Asia region, with specific familiarity with Southeast Asian markets and project practices is highly preferred.
* Proven track record in project budget management, cost control, and cash flow forecasting.
* Strong knowledge of contract terms, variation management, and claims processes.
* Basic understanding of wastewater treatment processes, mechanical and electrical equipment, SCADA systems, and plant commissioning is preferred.
* Fluent in English (both written and spoken) as the primary working language.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently within the Asia region (approximately 30%–50% of working time) to project sites, client meetings, supplier facilities, and partner engagements.

  


**EXPECTATIONS TO BE SUCCESSFUL:**


* Motivates and leads a regional PM team with strong strategic alignment to business goals.
* Demonstrated ability to translate regional business strategy into clear, actionable objectives for a PM team, while maintaining team morale, engagement, and a shared sense of purpose across countries and cultures.

**What can you expect as a member of the Fluence team?**


* Interesting, engaging, and challenging work
* The ability to make a difference
* Growth opportunities
* Engaged and motivated colleagues from around the world
* Diverse and global organization
* Approachable leadership
* A team\-oriented environment
* The ability to make a meaningful impact on sustainability and the environment.

As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race or color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, gender expression, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, vetera**n status, genetic information, or disability.*

* Industry Expertise: Multiple industries with an emphasis on Food and Beverage, Airport and Logistic, Textile, Packaging

* Revenue Impact: Directly contributes to top\-line revenue and business growth
* Team Collaboration: Works closely with cross\-functional teams (Product, Operations, Customer Service and Finance) to align strategies.
* Decision\-Making: Influence on pricing, contract terms, and strategic decisions

 **What Are We Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Preferably in Mechanical Engineering)
* 5 years of technical sales experience in managing distributors, OEM and end users
* Experience in conveyor belts, power transmission belts, bearings, pulleys, gears, or similar mechanical components is a strong advantage
* Strong customer\-oriented mindset with excellent relationship\-building skills and the ability to provide tailored commercial solutions
* Dynamic team player with sharp business acumen and the capability of new business development
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English and Bangla), capable of engaging with key internal and external stakeholders and decision\-makers
* Strong negotiation skills, with the ability to manage pricing while maintaining profitable margins
* Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce) to track and manage sales activities, accounts, and reporting
* Strong time management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently
* Positive, proactive, and sales\-driven attitude with a strong results\-oriented mindset

  

AMMEGA values diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. Employees are valued for their experiences and skills, and we are passionate about placing people in positions where they succeed. We create an environment that reflects these values and we are passionate about this.

title: Workplace Ambassador
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Overall Role
  
The Workplace Ambassador (Back\-of\-House) plays a critical operational role in ensuring seamless day\-to\-day facilities support and workplace services for BCG Singapore. This role replaces the previous Facilities Coordinator position and focuses on behind\-the\-scenes operational excellence, vendor coordination, quality assurance, and supporting workplace functionality. The Workplace Ambassador (BOH) ensures the workplace environment operates smoothly, efficiently, and to the highest standards, working collaboratively with the broader facilities and experience team.
  
Duties \& responsibilities
  
  

**Back\-of\-House Operations:**  

* Oversee daily BOH operations for assigned level(s)
* Conduct thorough physical checks of back\-of\-house spaces, storage areas, pantries, and service zones to ensure cleanliness, organization, and operational readiness
* Monitor and maintain digital systems and SharePoint trackers for BOH activities
* Coordinate with cleaning and maintenance teams to ensure compliance with quality standards
* Manage locker systems including assignments, maintenance, and user support
* Perform quality inspections for workplace office
* Ensure BOH areas are well\-stocked, organized, and compliant with safety protocols


**Vendor Management:**  

* Coordinate with 3 manpower vendors for daily operations
* Manage 2 additional vendor relationships for specialized services
* Oversee 4 Managing Agent scope vendors for BOH\-related activities
* Process purchase orders (PO) for manpower and vendor services
* Manage billing and invoice reconciliation for assigned vendors
* Monitor vendor performance and escalate issues as needed
* Escort and supervise vendor activities in BOH areas


**Office Supplies Management:**  

* Manage end\-to\-end office supplies inventory and procurement
* Monitor stock levels and anticipate replenishment needs
* Process requisitions and coordinate timely delivery
* Maintain organized storage systems for office supplies
* Track usage patterns and recommend cost optimization measures
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies and budget guidelines


**Events Support:**  

* Provide back\-of\-house support for event setup and execution
* Coordinate vendor logistics for events including delivery and setup
* Manage event\-related purchase orders and billing
* Ensure BOH spaces are prepared and restored post\-event
* Support catering logistics and F\&B coordination for events
* Collaborate with Workplace Executive on seamless event delivery


**Building Management Office (BMO) Coordination:**  

* Act as liaison between clientoperations and Building Management Office
* Coordinate facility\-related requests, permits, and approvals
* Track and follow up on BMO service requests
* Ensure compliance with building regulations and protocols
* Manage access control coordination with BMO for vendors and contractors


Supporting Scope of Work
  
  

**Facilities Management Support:**  

* Assist with reactive work order coordination and follow\-up
* Support preventive maintenance (PPM) scheduling and tracking
* Provide backup support for meeting room preparation as needed
* Assist with courier and mail service coordination
* Support visitor management during peak periods or staff absences


**Pantry and Café Operations:**  

* Monitor pantry supplies and coordinate restocking
* Ensure café areas are clean, organized, and well\-maintained
* Coordinate with F\&B vendors on service delivery
* Address user feedback and service issues promptly
* Support special catering requirements for meetings and events


**Quality Assurance:**  

* Conduct regular quality inspections of Back\-Of\-House (BOH) areas and services
* Document findings and follow up on corrective actions
* Support continuous improvement initiatives
* Ensure service standards align with client expectations
* Participate in quality audits and assessments


Reporting Requirements
  
  

**Regular Reports:**  

* SharePoint tracker updates for BOH operations
* Vendor performance and billing reports
* Office supplies inventory and usage reports
* Quality inspection findings and corrective action logs
* Event support activity summaries
* Locker management status updates
* User request tracking and resolution metrics


Key Accountabilities
  
  

**Operational Excellence:**  

* Maintain highest standards of service delivery in all BOH functions
* Ensure timely resolution of operational issues and user requests
* Proactively identify and address potential service gaps
* Support efficient resource utilization and cost management
* Maintain comprehensive documentation of all BOH activities


**Client Relationship Management:**  

* Maintain direct reporting relationship with Client's POC
* Participate in day\-to\-day operations reporting and performance reviews led by Client
* Respond promptly to client requests and feedback
* Support Client\-led continuous improvement initiatives
* Ensure alignment with modified governance structure and KPI/SLA requirements


**Collaboration:**  

* Work closely with Senior Facilities Coordinator on integrated FM operations
* Coordinate with Workplace Executive and Workplace Ambassador (FOH) on cross\-functional activities
* Interface with Client's POC as required
* Collaborate with multiple JLL points of contact per revised contract structure
* Support Mobile Technician coordination for technical matters


**Customer Service:**  

* Provide responsive and professional support to all internal users
* Address inquiries and resolve issues efficiently
* Foster a culture of service excellence and user satisfaction
* Anticipate user needs and provide proactive solutions
* Create positive workplace experiences through authentic, caring service


Candidate Specification
  
  

**Experience:**  

* Minimum 2\-3 years' experience in facilities operations, workplace services, or hospitality sector
* Experience in corporate office environment preferred
* Background in vendor coordination and supply chain management advantageous
* Prior experience with office services, inventory management, or event support beneficial
* Experience working in fast\-paced, client\-facing environments


**Technical Skills:**  

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience with SharePoint or similar collaboration platforms
* Familiarity with work order management systems
* Basic understanding of building systems and facilities operations
* Inventory management and procurement knowledge
* Budget tracking and invoice reconciliation skills


**Personal Attributes:**  

* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Proactive mindset with ability to work independently
* Service\-oriented approach with genuine care for user experience
* Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities
* Problem\-solving abilities with practical, solution\-focused thinking
* High level of integrity and reliability
* Professional demeanor and appearance


**Communication Skills:**  

* Good command of verbal and written English
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with vendors, users, and management
* Diplomatic approach to resolving conflicts and addressing concerns
* Collaborative team player with positive attitude


**Work Attributes:**  

* Ability to meet tight schedules and deliver high quality work
* Comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously
* Willingness to provide hands\-on support when needed
* Ability to maintain composure under pressure
* Commitment to continuous learning and improvement

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.

title: Director, Supplier Quality
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**


The **Director of Global Supplier Quality** is a senior leadership role responsible for building and driving the company’s global supplier quality strategy to support rapid growth, technology expansion, and scalability. This leader oversees **supplier development**, **supplier engineering**, **external manufacturing quality**, and **NPI supplier readiness**, ensuring suppliers consistently meet the company’s quality, reliability, and delivery expectations.  

The role will define global standards, strengthen supplier capability, lead supplier risk management, and drive continuous improvement using a robust **supplier scorecard**, governance mechanisms, and performance improvement frameworks. Preferred candidates will have deep experience in **electronics manufacturing, EMS environments, and supplier engineering leadership**.
**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:**


**1\. Global Supplier Quality Strategy \& Governance**
* Develop and execute the **global supplier quality strategy** in support of company growth initiatives, product roadmap expansion, and supply chain complexity.
* Establish supplier quality standards, performance metrics, and governance frameworks.
* Lead global Supplier Quality Council/Review structures with cross‑functional stakeholders (Procurement, Operations, R\&D, NPI).

Identify strategic supplier quality risks and drive global mitigation plans.  
* 

**2\. Supplier Development \& Capability Building**
* Lead **supplier development programs** to elevate capability, process robustness, reliability performance, and operational excellence.
* Implement standardized assessments, readiness evaluations, and maturity models across key suppliers.
* Deploy continuous improvement programs (SPC, Six Sigma, PFMEA, PPAP/APQP where applicable).

Partner with Procurement to influence supplier selection, onboarding, and long\-term capability building.  
* 

**3\. Supplier Engineering Leadership**
* Oversee global Supplier Engineering teams responsible for component qualification, process validation, and Design for Manufacturability \& Assembly (DFM/DFA) at suppliers.
* Strengthen supplier quality engineering rigor across key domains (PCBA, plastics, metals, cables, packaging, modules, sub\-assemblies).

Ensure robust change management: PCN/ECN implementation, golden sample controls, and process change qualification.  
* 

**4\. External Manufacturing (EMS) \& Outsourcing Quality**
* Lead quality oversight for **EMS partners, ODMs, JDMs**, and strategic contract manufacturers.
* Ensure suppliers meet production quality KPIs (incoming quality, in\-process quality, yield, OBA/ORT, customer returns).
* Drive corrective action effectiveness and ensure closure of systemic supplier issues.

Implement governance for outsourced operations to ensure consistency, compliance, and alignment to company standards.  
* 

**5\. NPI Development Support**
* Ensure supplier readiness for NPI builds, from EVT to MP.
* Lead supplier participation in NPI phases: DFM/DFA reviews, qualification plans, golden sample validation, line readiness audits, and ramp‑up quality controls.

Coordinate with R\&D, NPI Quality, and Supply Chain to ensure early supplier engagement and manufacturability alignment.  
* 

**6\. Supplier Scorecard \& Performance Management**
* Own the global **supplier scorecard** process, covering quality, delivery, responsiveness, cost, capacity, and risk.
* Drive quarterly supplier business reviews (QBRs) with key suppliers and executive stakeholders.

Rank suppliers based on performance and risk profile; work with Procurement on sourcing strategies, dual‑sourcing, and supplier transitions where necessary.  
* 

**7\. Team Leadership \& Global Collaboration**
* Lead and develop a high\-performing global team across Supplier Quality, Supplier Engineering, and EMS/outsourcing quality functions.
* Establish clear roles, metrics, and development plans to grow organizational capability.
* Foster strong collaboration with Procurement, Operations, R\&D, NPI, and Manufacturing Quality.

May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**


Works in a standard office environment and uses office equipment (telephone, PC, copier, fax machine, etc.).


Travel required approximately 25% of time both domestic and international.


**SKILLS:**


* Strategic thinker with the ability to set and drive long\-term goals and objectives
* An active leader who earns trust, inspires his/her team, builds collaborative relationships, and leads by example
* Excellent problem\-solving capabilities to address and resolve issues that face a growing enterprise.
* Strong Communications Skills, both Oral and Written, and be able to do participate and/or lead meetings.

Pathwise Academy has grown from one school to a portfolio of partnerships, camps, and corporate programmes — and it's currently all running through one person. We're hiring the first Sales \& Operations Manager to take ownership of both sides of that: winning new school and corporate clients, and making sure every programme that lands actually runs beautifully.

This is the role for someone who wants to build a business function, not inherit one.

We teach people to build with AI. Our "Young Builders" programmes take students aged 10–17 from zero to shipping real apps and AI projects. We also run adult workshops, corporate AI training, and in\-school partnerships with international schools across Singapore, Hong Kong, and Southeast Asia. We're small, fast, and hands\-on. What you propose on Monday can be running by the end of the month.

Twelve months in, you'll have added new school and corporate partnerships to the pipeline, built a repeatable enrolment process that doesn't depend on the founder, and taken day\-to\-day programme operations fully off his plate. * Manage and support the operational risk event reporting process and internal loss database, working with risk owners to ensure timely and accurate capture of risk incidents, near misses, and operational losses in the risk management system.
* Perform root cause analysis, remediation tracking, and trend analysis, escalating material incidents or findings as appropriate.
* Design, implement and maintain Key Risk Indicators (KRIs); collect, validate and analyze KRI data; produce regular dashboards and reports identifying trends, threshold breaches, and early warning signals for escalation.
* Support in reviewing and providing appropriate challenge on control effectiveness assessments, ensuring findings are well supported and conclusions are sound.
* Advise process owners on control remediation and process enhancements, working constructively to develop practical and effective action plans.
* Support operational resilience initiatives, including the maintenance of the BCM framework and policies, coordination of Business Impact Analysis, dependency and workaround reviews, and BCP exercises.
* Execute third party and outsourcing risk assessments, coordinating with risk owners and as relevant, service providers, to gather relevant information and assess risk against established criteria and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain oversight of the outsourcing register and the monitoring of key outsourced service providers, track performance indicators and flag areas of concern as they arise.

**ABOUT TANGSPAC**


Tangspac is a regional recruitment, workforce solutions, and technology consulting group headquartered in Singapore, with over 30 years of experience partnering financial institutions, technology companies, multinational enterprises and government agencies.


Through our multi\-award\-winning talent advisory and technology consulting businesses, Tangspac delivers executive search, permanent recruitment, contingent workforce solutions, staff augmentation, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Managed Service Provider (MSP) services. We work alongside clients to help them build, transform, and scale their businesses with confidence.


As we continue to expand our capabilities and strengthen our position as a trusted partner to our clients, we are expanding our executive leadership team to support the Company's next phase of growth, organisational capability and regional ambitions.


**THE OPPORTUNITY**


This is a key executive leadership appointment within Tangspac. Reporting to the CEO, the Managing Director will provide executive leadership across the Company's Singapore business to drive commercial performance, organisational capability and operational excellence, while contributing to broader strategic initiatives across the Group.


**ROLE PURPOSE**


As a member of the executive leadership team, the Managing Director will be accountable for delivering agreed business outcomes jointly established with the CEO. Performance objectives and key performance indicators will encompass commercial performance, profitability, organisational capability, client growth, leadership effectiveness and strategic initiatives.


The role will work across all business units and functions to:


* Drive execution of the Company's strategic and commercial objectives.


* Have overall accountability for the Company's profit and loss performance, including revenue growth, gross profit, operating profitability and sustainable business growth.


* Build a high\-performing leadership team that consistently delivers on its growth objectives


* Strengthen client relationships and commercial performance.


* Develop the people, systems and processes required to support the Company's next stage of growth.


* Champion a culture built on trust, client focus, commitment, accountability and continuous improvement.

**Business Growth \& Commercial Performance**

Responsibilities include:


* Drive sustainable revenue growth across existing and new business lines.


* Identify opportunities for market expansion and new service offerings.


* Monitor business performance and implement corrective actions where required.


* Improve commercial discipline, forecasting and business planning.


**Leadership \& Organisational Capability**


Build a high\-performing leadership team capable of delivering consistent business results.


Responsibilities include:


* Establish a culture of ownership, accountability and execution.


* Ensure performance expectations remain clear and measurable.


* Ensure business leaders are supported, challenged and developed to achieve their full potential.


* Achieve agreed commercial, operational and people objectives and KPIs

* Ensure high performers are retained.


* Identify capability gaps and implement development, restructuring or hiring plans where appropriate.


* Foster collaboration across business units and eliminate organisational silos


**Client Growth \& Strategic Relationships**


Drive the growth and development of Tangspac's strategic client portfolio.

* Develop and maintain executive\-level relationships with key existing and prospective clients.


* Drive growth across the client portfolio through new client acquisition, cross\-selling and expansion of existing service offerings.


* Lead selected strategic pursuits, enterprise negotiations, and executive client engagements.


* Participate in strategic client reviews and executive governance meetings where required.


**Operational Excellence**


Drive operational effectiveness across the organisation.


Responsibilities include:


* Improve service delivery standards and client experience.


* Strengthen operational processes, governance and execution.


* Improve collaboration between recruitment, delivery and corporate functions.


**Innovation \& Business Transformation**


Drive Tangspac's evolution into a best\-in\-class talent advisory, workforce solutions, and consulting business.


Responsibilities include:


* Champion the development of new workforce solutions, consulting capabilities and managed service offerings that address evolving client needs.


* Identify, evaluate and commercialise new business opportunities, products, services and growth platforms.


* Drive the adoption of technology, automation and AI to improve operational efficiency, client experience and business scalability.


* Identify and pursue strategic partnerships, government initiatives, grants and ecosystem opportunities that support business growth and innovation.


**Strategic Leadership**


Partner with the CEO to shape the Company’s long\-term direction, organisational culture and strategic priorities.


Responsibilities include:


* Drive annual business planning, strategic reviews and execution of key corporate initiatives.


* Champion a high\-performance culture by fostering employee engagement, recognition, motivation and leadership development.


* Develop initiatives that strengthen Tangspac's employer value proposition, employee experience and ability to attract and retain top talent.


* Identify opportunities to create synergies across the Group and strengthen the Company's competitive positioning.

RBI owns four of the world's most prominent and iconic quick service restaurant brands – TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES®, and FIREHOUSE SUBS®. These independently operated brands have been serving their respective guests, franchisees and communities for decades. Through its Restaurant Brands for Good framework, RBI is improving sustainable outcomes related to its food, the planet, and people and communities.


RBI is committed to growing the TIM HORTONS®, BURGER KING®, POPEYES® and FIREHOUSE SUBS® brands by leveraging their respective core values, employee and franchisee relationships, and long track records of community support. Each brand benefits from the global scale and shared best practices that come from ownership by Restaurant Brands International Inc.

**Our Opportunity:**


The Marketing Analytics team evaluates business performance, marketing programs, product promotions, and pricing strategies across Tim Hortons in Asia\-Pacific region. The team works directly with regional leadership and franchisee executives to develop marketing calendars and sales plans that drive same\-store sales growth.


The **Sales \& Marketing Data Analyst, Tim Hortons, APAC** will own the full analytics agenda for markets within the Tim Hortons brand — covering performance diagnostics, sales forecasting, calendar planning, digital channel reporting, and franchisee engagement. This role requires ownership, analytical expertise, and an entrepreneurial spirit. You’ll be providing strategic recommendations to franchisee and internal stakeholders.

**RBI follows a 5 day, in\-office work schedule to support collaboration. Candidates should be comfortable working onsite 5 days per week.**

**Your Roles \& Responsibilities:**

**Performance Analytics**

* Independently produce end\-to\-end performance diagnostics including sales decompositions, product mix analysis, pricing reviews, and competitive benchmarks.
* Build and refine analytical models to evaluate business performance, product promotions, and marketing programs.
* Proactively identify performance drivers and surface emerging risks or opportunities to leadership team and franchisees.
* Conduct sales reports analysis, ticket and guest segmentation, and category\-level deep dives to drive business performance.

**Forecasting**

* Own the bottom\-up forecast model for assigned markets, building monthly and annual sales forecasts based on historic trends, seasonality, and planned marketing activity.
* Track actuals versus forecast and flag variances early, recommending corrective actions where needed.
* Develop performance forecasts to support leadership and franchisees in performance management and calendar planning.

**Brand \& Strategic Planning**

* Analyze competition and pricing data to evaluate business performance and inform long\-term brand strategy.
* Interpret broader brand and product research to identify short\-term sales opportunities and long\-term growth pillars.
* Deliver market\-level strategic recommendations grounded in quantified commercial logic

**Digital Sales \& Channels**

* Own digital performance reporting, including the digital activation calendar across delivery platforms, mobile app, and kiosks
* Analyze channel\-level conversion funnels, identify drop\-off points, and recommend improvements to franchisees
* Benchmark digital KPIs across markets and flag underperformance with root\-cause analysis.
* Build and maintain digital channel dashboards and reporting templates.

**Franchisee Engagement**

* Present analysis in regular performance reviews and influence calendar and promotional decisions through data.
* Collaborate with franchisee marketing leaders to secure alignment and buy\-in on identified opportunities.

* 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, consulting, finance, or commercial strategy in a consumer\-facing business. Previous experience within QSR industry or in a business franchising business model is an advantage.

* Proficient in SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to independently build analytical models, structure research questions, and develop comprehensive recommendations.

title: Project Manager
description:
KONE moves two billion people every day. As a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, we employ over 60,000 driven professionals in more than 60 countries worldwide joined together by a shared purpose, to shape the future of cities. In 2025, we had annual net sales of EUR 11\.2 billion.
KONE has consistently been featured on Forbes list of World's Best Innovative Companies, World's Best Employers \& World's Largest Public Companies. At KONE, we believe in teamwork and a work culture where everyone can be who they are. This is exactly what makes us strong and successful.


**Why this role?**

The Project Manager is accountable for safe, high\-quality, and efficient installation of the KONE solution, adhering to the agreed scope of work, schedule, and budget, he/she ensures proper site preparation and readiness, leads the installation team, verifies the installation deliverables, coordinates with the builder and other contractors and ensures readiness for customer and maintenance handovers.


The person is responsible for following and continually improving standard ways of working in adherence to Lean principles. The Project Manager proactively leads the installation teams to prevent interruptions and ensure smooth installation flow and serves as the KONE interface with the customer and other stakeholders throughout the installation process, supporting Sales, CSE as needed.


**What will you be doing?**

Site supervision:


* Accountable for safety, quality, and productivity during installation and handovers, and for raising and actioning corrective actions to any detected non\-conformities.
* Responsible for the use of correct KONE installation methods and tools by the installation team, and for proper risk assessment for parts of installation where KONE method is not feasible.
* Responsible for proactive site preparations, site readiness, customer deliverables to KONE, site visits and audits, including resolution of non\-conformities with customer (supported by Project Manager as needed)
* Responsible for verifying the site execution plan and field cost management as part of the pre\-delivery review, assuming site execution responsibility, and thereafter installation activities and handovers.
* Responsible for maintaining realistic MS 3c (material delivery to site) throughout the S\-plan, and for confirming of S\-plan milestones 3 – 5z.
* Active support to Project Manager and Project Admin for the verification of payment status according to S\-plan concept and contract terms
* Responsible for planning and organizing installation activities, site storage and logistics, and needed resources and tools.
* Requests materials to site (MS 3x), confirms arrival of KONE materials to site (MS 3c), receives other materials and services at the site, and performs Goods Receipt.
* Performs handover to installation team (KONE and subcontractors), clarifying the scope of work, completion date and other necessary customer milestone dates, as well as target installation hours for own KONE fitters.
* Organizes continuous huddles with the installation team to empower them and proactively prevent interruptions, ensure smooth, continual flow of work on site, with a focus on efficiency and waste reduction.
* Achieves targets for variation sales and change orders during installation, ensures costs attributable to others are claimed and collected.
* Verifies quality of installation and ensures installation the scope of work is completed. Is accountable for final testing of the equipment and for closing any raised items (tester, customer, third party inspector, as is applicable). Completes a successful handover to maintenance.
* Responsible for quality claims / feedbacks, time sheet approvals, installation documentation, reporting of installation progress, status, cost accumulation, and risks, and managing schedule and other changes.
* Responsible for the management of environmental aspects of the installation (waste and hazardous material handling).

Customer Relationship management:


* Acts as the primary contact for the customer regarding site management, proactively communicating and using related tools.
* Ensures customer satisfaction with proactive and timely communication, professional installation process, as well as safety and quality of installation.

People leadership and subcontractor relations:


* Responsible for verifying that installers, testers and other contractors on site are trained, certified, competent, and capable of performing each installation task.
* Accountable for site operatives’ safety, motivation and wellbeing.
* Responsible for identifying Installation operative training needs and communicating these to respective line managers, HR, installation subcontracting companies and procurement.
* Responsible for managing and developing the performance of the team and individuals.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining a proactive and professional relationship with subcontractors’ installation team and ensures they meet their commitments

Continual improvement:


* Responsible to follow and continually improve standard ways of working according to LEAN principles.
* Motivates and empowers the installation team to identify waste and make improvements, with a focus on teamwork and collaboration.
* Supports and coaches the installation team to improve their standard ways of working.
* Continually identifies and shares opportunities, root causes and improvement ideas with the team and other collaborators, applying lean tools (Go \& See, retrospectives, improvement sessions).
* Promotes success stories of team improvements, recognizing and rewarding efforts to drive continuous improvement.

**Are you the one?**

* Experience from construction industry or elevator industry is an asset
* Safety and quality management
* Customer relationship management
* Project management phase 1
* Installation resource planning
* Managing installation performance
* Understanding financial impact
* Understanding installation methods
* Understanding of relevant laws, standards, norms and other requirements
* General contractual understanding
* Subcontractor management
* Lean fundamentals

**What’s On Offer**

* Career progression in opportunities within a global organization
* Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work
* Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills
* You are surrounded by fun colleagues and a lively working environment. The best part is all leaders are great and open\-minded

**To Be Considered**

Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our Talent and Culture team will review your application and will be in contact with additional information accordingly.


In the meantime, feel free to browse our website for additional information on our company, brands and culture – KONE Corporation.

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

Read more on *https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*
