title: Senior Consultant - Technology, Data & Digital Transformation in Energy and Commodities Trading
description:
**About Baringa**
  

  

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.
  

  

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence \- all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.
  

  

Clients value Baringa's collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly \- all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.
  

  

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World's Best Management Consulting Firms.
  

  

**We are growing our Energy \& Commodities Trading Practice in Singapore and are looking for people excited by technology, data, digital innovation and AI to help shape the future of trading across Asia.**
  

  

Our Singapore based team works with leading energy, metals, mining and agricultural trading organisations across Asia to deliver strategic, digital, data and operational transformation. We help clients redesign how their trading businesses operate, modernise technology landscapes, improve decision\-making through better data, and deliver complex change.
  

  

We are looking for individuals who are excited by technology\-enabled transformation, data\-driven problem solving and the rapidly evolving AI landscape. You do not need prior commodities or energy experience to apply, but you do need a genuine interest in these markets and an appetite to build your expertise in this sector.
  

**What you will be doing**
  

  

You will be working on transformation projects for our Energy \& Commodities Trading clients, with a strong focus on technology strategy, data\-led change, digital architecture and emerging AI applications.
  

  

This will include:
  

* Designing trading operating models and business workflows, with technology and data embedded at the core.
* Shaping technology strategy, platform roadmaps and transformation plans for trading businesses
* Supporting clients to strengthen data foundations, improve reporting and analytics, and enable better decision\-making across front, middle and back\-office trading functions.
* Selecting and implementing trading systems, and advising clients on structuring implementation programmes \- especially of CTRM/ETRM
* Identifying practical applications for automation and AI to improve trading processes, controls and user workflows
* Designing risk management and control frameworks that support resilient, scalable and technology\-enabled trading operations.

  

Working as a team in the following types of day\-to\-day activities on projects:
  

* Supporting project workstreams, including planning, tracking actions, and helping to manage risks and issues.
* Producing high quality project deliverables and being able to ensure quality of output for team members.
* Building trusted working relationships with key project stakeholders.
* In addition, you will be expected to engage in internal 'grow our business' type activities.

**Your skills and experience**
  

  

**Experience:**
  

* Hold some demonstrable consulting or transformation experience gained in management consulting or an internal transformation role within a trading company, financial institution or similarly complex organisation.
* Experience supporting across a mix of technology\-enabled change, digital transformation, data strategy, systems delivery, operating model design, process improvement, or related AI\-enabled business transformation.
* Energy \& Commodities industry experience is desirable but not essential! We are open to candidates from adjacent sectors who bring strong consulting, technology, digital, data or AI capability and a clear interest in applying those skills in energy and commodities trading.
* You possess a good understanding of project lifecycle management and systems delivery methodologies.
* You have worked previously in an internal or external client\-facing project role.

  

**Skills:**
  

* You are curious, self\-driven and comfortable navigating a steep learning curve in a specialist domain.
* You are passionate about learning, personal growth and developing sector knowledge alongside your consulting or technical skillset.
* You have excellent communication and presentation skills and a track record of effective team working.
* You possess a structured problem\-solving mindset and enjoy using technology, data, analytics and AI to tackle complex business challenges in fast\-moving trading environments.
* You can work in a start\-up culture, being able to deal with uncertainty, have flexibility, and provide support across a range of different internal initiatives in conjunction with primary client project.

**What a career at Baringa will give you**
  

**Putting People First.**
  

**Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work\-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:**
  

* Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well\-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5\-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.
* Flexible Working: We know that the 'ideal' work\-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.
* Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.
* Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We've introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice.
* Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company's success.

**Diversity and Inclusion**
  

  

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.
  

**An award\-winning workplace**
  

  

You can be a part of our 'Great Place to Work' \- with our commitment to women and well\-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we've achieved this.
  

**Using business as a force for good.**
  

  

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI\-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis \- helping us to continually identify where we can improve.
  

  

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.
  

  

**Join us**
  

  

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. ------------------------------------------------

* Drive product launch excellence through launch toolkits, readiness frameworks, and cross\-functional execution plans.
* Partner with global and APAC teams to localise positioning, value propositions, clinical messaging, and compliant promotional materials.
* Oversee product lifecycle management, including portfolio rationalisation, phase\-out planning, gap analysis, and white\-space opportunities.
* Champion evidence\-based marketing in partnership with clinical, medical affairs, regulatory, and market access teams.

**3\. Customer \& Market Insights**
-----------------------------------


The Director builds a strong customer and market intelligence capability for East Asia, ensuring decisions are grounded in healthcare trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics.

* Establish market research priorities and translate insights into actionable recommendations for the East Asia Leadership Team.
* Lead voice\-of\-customer programmes across key customer groups to understand unmet needs and decision drivers.
* Develop market maps, segmentation, account stratification, and opportunity assessments to guide targeting and resource allocation.
* Track market share, sales trends, competitor activity, and early signals of market shift; recommend proactive responses.
* Build customer\-centricity across marketing and commercial teams by embedding insights into campaigns, positioning, and engagement strategies.

**4\. Field Marketing \& Events**
---------------------------------


The Director oversees East Asia’s field marketing and events agenda, ensuring customer engagement is strategically aligned, well executed, and commercially measurable.

* Develop the annual field marketing and events strategy, including congresses, symposia, customer education, workshops, and digital engagement.
* Oversee major regional and country\-level events, ensuring clear commercial objectives, disciplined execution, and ROI measurement.
* Build and manage KOL and clinical champion engagement plans that support education, adoption, and market development.
* Champion digital and hybrid marketing approaches to extend Stryker’s reach and improve customer engagement across the region.
* Partner with education and training centres to deliver procedural workshops and training programmes that accelerate product adoption.

--------------------------------------


The Director serves as the senior custodian of marketing talent and capability across East Asia, building depth and consistency across the regional marketing community.

* Apply Stryker’s marketing skills framework to East Asia, defining the capabilities required for strong commercial marketing performance.
* Lead marketing talent assessment, development planning, and succession planning across the region.
* Champion continuous learning through Stryker University, global platforms, external development, and peer learning forums.
* Partner with HR and country leaders to attract, retain, and develop high\-potential marketing talent.
* Build a collaborative marketing community of practice across East Asia, including best\-practice sharing, peer coaching, and capability\-building forums.

------------------------


The Director leads the East Asia Sales Enablement function, ensuring commercial teams have the tools, content, training, and processes needed to perform effectively in market.

* Own the sales content library, ensuring commercial teams have accurate, compelling, and current selling tools.

* Establish field feedback loops and sales enablement KPIs to continuously improve content, training, adoption, and commercial impact.

* 12–15 years of progressive commercial experience in MedTech, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare.
* Senior regional marketing leadership experience across multiple Asian markets, with accountability for strategy, growth, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong track record in revenue growth, market share expansion, capability building, and people leadership across diverse geographies.
* Deep understanding of at least two East Asia markets and strong fluency in English; additional East Asian language capability advantageous.
 **Desired**  

* Experience in market access, health economics, value\-based marketing, or commercial excellence in an Asian MedTech context.
* Familiarity with Salesforce CRM or equivalent sales technology platforms.
* Track record of partnering effectively across global, regional, and local teams in a matrix organisation.

description:
**Company:**
------------


Oliver Wyman
**Description:**
----------------


**About Oliver Wyman**

At Oliver Wyman, a Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) business, we bring deep industry insight, bold innovation, and a collaborative approach that cuts through complexity to help organizations navigate their most defining transformative moments.


For more information, visit oliverwyman.com .


**Role purpose**

As the Senior Human Capital Manager, SEA, you will play a key role within the HC team, overseeing Human Capital operations and serving as the HR business partner for Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia. This role combines business partnering and employee relations with accountability for delivering a high\-quality people experience across the employee lifecycle, leveraging data, digital tools, and AI\-enabled insights to enhance operational efficiency, decision\-making, and the employee experience.


You will also lead the Shared Service Centre in Malaysia, with oversight of payroll and key administrative activities for the region.


**Why Join Us**

* A company with a strong brand and strong results to match. We are still growing in APR, now is the time to make your mark.
* An inclusive and collaborative culture, with a vibrant office environment.
* Competitive pay and outstanding benefits to help colleagues and their families live better – physically, mentally, and financially.
* A culture of internal mobility, with strong partnerships across Marsh HR and corporate functions.
* Colleague Resource Groups which provide access to leaders, volunteer and mentoring opportunities, and interactions with counterparts in industry groups and client organizations.

**Meet the Team**

* **Reports to** : Regional Head of Human Capital Services, APR
* **Day\-to\-day collaborators** : Regional business leaders, HC team in APR and globally, Talent Managers and colleagues from other teams including Legal, Finance and IT
* **People management** : This role includes direct management of HC Operations team members in SEA region including the Shared Service team in Malaysia.

**How this role will contribute to team success**

* **Enable strong operational delivery** by owning key HC processes end to end, helping ensure a consistent, compliant and efficient employee experience across the region.
* **Support effective business decisions** by being a trusted advisor to market leaders and senior stakeholders on employee matters, risks, and workforce priorities.
* **Strengthen regional HC effectiveness** by driving consistency, process improvement leveraging AI, and close collaboration across teams and markets

**Your Day\-to\-Day**

**HR business partnering**

* Be the lead HRBP for SEA and build strong relationships with Market Leaders, talent managers and other key stakeholders to provide trusted advice on people matters to support sound business decisions.
* Take the lead in coaching line and talent managers on employee relations matters, ensuring fair outcomes, sound judgment, and alignment with policy and local requirements.
* Provide advice and counsel managers and leaders on talent attraction, retention, rewards, and workplace culture to support a high\-performing environment.
* Using a data driven approach, actively monitor the experience of people, creating processes and policies to address challenges; working with the Talent Management team, you will lead our Return\-to\-work efforts to ensure that our returning parents are successful in their re\-integration.
* Proactively lead change initiatives, restructures, and employee engagement efforts to enable successful business and cultural transitions.
* Drive the translation of enterprise HC policies into practical local solutions and support adoption of COE solutions across the region.
* Share knowledge and best practices across the HC team in APR and globally

**Human Capital operations**

* Oversee and ensure effective delivery of HC operations from onboarding through exit management, including data collection, documentation, approvals, and coordination, while ensuring service quality and process control across the supported markets and shared services team.
* Monitor process performance, identify risks or bottlenecks, and implement practical solutions to improve timeliness, compliance, and service delivery.
* Lead, coach, and develop HC team members and managers, providing clear guidance, feedback, and support to build capability, confidence, and accountability across the function.
* Supervise the seamless regional delivery of payroll operations and act as the point of contact for payroll and other operational escalations, working closely with Shared Services to resolve issues effectively.
* Identify and support adoption of automation opportunities across HC processes, partnering with HR, IT, and Shared Services to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve consistency at scale.
* Use and promote data, AI\-enabled insights, and digital tools to spot recurring issues, improve decision\-making, and drive faster, more effective resolution of employee and operational matters.
* Role model strong leadership by setting clear expectations, fostering a collaborative and high performing team environment through regular coaching, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.

**Employee relations and stakeholder management**

* Manage employee relations matters end to end with due consideration to internal and external regulations.
* Lead ER/Compliance investigations and audits
* Lead terminations and exits of senior employees
* Handle sensitive issues with discretion, sound judgment, and a balanced commercial and people perspective.
* Ensure communications are clear, timely, and aligned to company values and governance standards.
* Escalate material risks or complex matters promptly to the Regional Head of HC Services and collaborate closely with Legal, Compliance, and other control functions to ensure timely resolution.

**Skills \& What You Bring to the Team**
----------------------------------------


* At least 10 years of experience as an HR professional, ideally within a large, globally matrixed organization operating across Asia Pacific.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a complex, multi\-stakeholder environment.
* Strong coaching, mentoring, and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge perspectives and support sound decision\-making.
* Demonstrated ability to use data and technology to support informed decisions and improve outcomes.
* Excellent client relationship skills with the ability to build positive, collaborative working relationships internally and externally.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, paired with sound problem\-solving ability and professional judgement.
* Knowledge of labor regulations across SEA is required.
* Experience using Workday is desirable.
* Bachelor’s degree in HR, Organizational Psychology, Industrial Relations, Business, or another related field.
* Strong proficiency in AI (Chat GPT/ Claude) Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

**What Will Make You Stand Out**

* Be a self\-starter with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently with minimal oversight.
* Work effectively both autonomously and as part of a team, with a collaborative and responsive mindset.
* Approach every task with a growth mindset, embracing challenges as opportunities to learn.
* Leverage AI in your day\-to\-day work for greater efficiency and champion its adoption within the team. Bring a practical mindset for using automation and AI to improve service delivery, employee experience, and operational control.
* Demonstrate a track record of turning manual HR processes into more efficient, scalable, and technology\-enabled ways of working. Be able to bring our team with you on that journey.
* Be proactive in keeping up with HR and industry trends and actively share insights and experiences with leaders and colleagues.
* Show curiosity about Oliver Wyman and its people, building a strong understanding to support our diverse job families.
* Professionally represent the department and the company, serving as a role model and exemplifying Oliver Wyman values.

**Living Our Values**

At Oliver Wyman, we lead with heart \- we love what we do and have fun while we do it! We also strive for breakthroughs by seeking diverse perspectives, and finding powerful and sustainable solutions. If you share these values and want to work as one and own our impact at the same time, be brave and achieve the amazing with us!


At OW, we're committed to building a diverse team, and we recognize that uncertainty about the relevance of one’s qualification and experience may deter some talented candidates from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you nonetheless! If you require adjustments during the recruitment process, we are happy to discuss it with you.


Find more about our Values and Firm Inclusion Stance .


Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
### **Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**

### **Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office\-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.**

Join CE\&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.


The Asia Technical Services organization will land Customer Support priorities including being the local incident commander for large\-scale events and high\-impact outages, drive in region quality requirements, deliver incident management, service management and assess regional support needs. In addition, they will deliver on Global Customer Success priorities including landing customer success plays in region, orchestrating the MACC end\-to\-end experiences, driving usage end\-to\-end experience and performance, scaling best practices through regional partners, and accelerating Get Well Plans in partnership with CSS.


As a Senior Support Escalation Manager, you will be the primary contact managing escalated customer and partner issues. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

Our Service Manager will be positioned and aligned with our customers as Chief Operating Officers within the account, strategically placed to ensure that we have the appropriate level of engagement to support and drive the customer’s reactive support landscape and improve operational health. As such you will work with some of the world’s largest companies, public sector depts and not for profit organisations pursuing strategic activities, utilising Microsoft technologies to modernise their business.


We create an environment where you can do your best work and build a career both in the Service Manager role as well as the wider Microsoft. As your interests and goals evolve we will enable you to connect you with a diverse, thriving community that can help you grow.


We are looking for people with a passion for delivering customer success. As a Senior Support Escalation Manager, you will be the primary contact managing escalated customer and partner issues. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, hone your problem\-solving, collaboration and orchestration skills, and deepen your relationship management expertise.

### **Customer Resolution:**

* Acts as an internal expert to resolve longer running, sensitive, or escalated issues or acts as a primary contact for escalated issues on behalf of less experienced IC levels. Identifies and builds relationships with various internal and external teams and senior leaders to resolve customer issues. Leads strategic projects. Informally provides coaching, mentorship, or support to less experienced Support Escalation Managers to resolve customer issues.
* Leads inter\-regions, cross\-regions, cross\-group, or account team unit (ATU) initiatives by creating plans and managing relationships with other business units to improve the customer support experience for a group of customers or a specific region/area. 	+ OR 9\+ years technology industry, customer service, or related experience
	+ OR equivalent experience

* Assist with phishing investigations

* Monitor endpoint compliance and security posture
* Coordinate local incident response activities
* Act as APAC liaison to the Group Security team
* Support security awareness initiatives

* Microsoft Defender

* Endpoint troubleshooting

title: Operations Executive
description:
Company: Zenith Facility Services Pte Ltd

Employment Type: Full\-Time, Permanent

Salary: SGD $3,200 – $3,500 per month \+ performance incentives

Location: Field\-based across client sites in Singapore, with office reporting

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

Zenith Facility Services is a NEA\-licensed cleaning and integrated facility management company operating across hawker centres, healthcare facilities, preschools, commercial buildings and premium residential developments in Singapore.

We are seeking a hands\-on and reliable Operations Executive to lead day\-to\-day field operations, manpower deployment and client servicing across our contracts.

This role suits someone who thrives on the ground — solving operational problems as they happen, supervising crews, and holding service standards steady across multiple sites. It is not a desk role.

Who You Will Work With

* Admin Executive — manages recruitment, documentation, payroll inputs and compliance records. You will provide real\-time operational input (attendance, punctuality, disciplinary matters, onboarding support) so that records stay accurate.
* Chief Executive Officer — oversees operational improvement and customer satisfaction. You will provide ground\-level insight and recommendations that support service quality and contract retention.
* Business Development/Sales Support — drives client relationships and new opportunities. You will support this by maintaining strong relationships during site visits, flagging expansion or additional\-service opportunities at existing accounts, and passing on referrals and new contacts.

Together these roles form the backbone of frontline delivery and back\-office support.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Site Operations \& Service Quality

* Oversee daily operations across assigned customer sites.
* Conduct site inspections and audits to uphold cleaning and service standards.
* Respond promptly to operational issues and service lapses, and close them out properly.
* Ensure compliance with workplace safety requirements, SOPs and NEA standards.

2\. Manpower Deployment \& Supervision

* Plan and allocate manpower daily based on site requirements and contract obligations.
* Supervise cleaning crews, ensuring punctuality, grooming, conduct and performance.
* Coordinate replacement staff to close urgent manpower gaps.
* Provide attendance and performance updates to the Admin \& HR Executive.

3\. Client Servicing \& Account Management

* Act as the main operations liaison for assigned clients.
* Address concerns and follow through on service recovery until the client is satisfied.
* Build strong working relationships that support contract retention and renewal.
* Provide periodic operational updates and reports to clients.

4\. Site Inventory, Equipment \& Vendor Coordination

* Monitor stock levels of cleaning consumables, chemicals and equipment across sites.
* Arrange repairs, replacements and replenishment before shortages affect service.
* Coordinate with vendors on equipment servicing and maintenance.

Site consumables and operational equipment sit with this role.

5\. Reporting \& Continuous Improvement

* Prepare site reports, incident logs and monthly operational summaries.
* Track manpower utilisation and performance trends across contracts.
* Recommend improvements to efficiency, cost control and service quality.

Requirements

Essential

* Diploma or Degree in any discipline (Operations, Facilities Management or Building Services preferred).
* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the confidence to supervise ground staff directly.
* Practical problem\-solving ability — you fix what is in front of you rather than escalating it.
* Comfortable managing multiple sites and shifting priorities within the same day.
* Willing to travel daily to client locations across Singapore.
* Customer\-service oriented, adaptable and proactive.

Advantageous

* Experience in cleaning, facilities management, security, logistics or similar operations.
* Familiarity with NEA cleaning standards, WSH requirements, bizSAFE or the Progressive Wage Model.
* Class 3 driving licence and own transport.
* Conversant in a second language commonly spoken by frontline crews.

Working Arrangements

We would rather be upfront about this than surprise you later:

* Cleaning operations begin early. Expect early morning site starts on a regular basis.
* This is a travelling role across multiple client sites, not a fixed\-location job.
* Occasional after\-hours or weekend attendance is required for incidents, audits and mobilisations, on a shared rotation.

Why Join Zenith Facility Services

* A key frontline role with direct impact on client satisfaction and contract retention.
* Clear career pathway to Operations Supervisor and Operations Manager.
* Direct working relationship with the CEO — your recommendations get heard and acted on.
* A stable, growing company with long\-term contracts across multiple sectors.
* Competitive salary with performance incentives and funded training where applicable.

How to Apply

Email your resume to stephanie@zenithfs.com.sg

Please include your earliest start date and expected salary. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $3,200\.00 \- $3,500\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
  
  

Bain \& Company is one of the world's leading global business consulting firms, serving clients across six continents. It was founded in 1973 on the principle that consultants must measure their success in terms of their clients' financial results. Bain's clients have outperformed the stock market 4 to 1\. With offices in all major cities, Bain has worked with over 4,400 major multinational and other corporations from every economic sector, in every region of the world.
  
  

POSITION SUMMARY
  
  

In this 10\-month contractual role, the incumbent will provide HR Generalist support for the delivery of people initiatives for Bain’s Southeast Asia (SEA) Functional Professionals (FP) teams. In this role, you will be looked upon to build a positive environment and provide sound advice to the FP teams across a broad range of tasks across Recruitment, Onboarding/Onboarding, Performance Management, Employee Engagement, Program Management and HR Administrative/Benefits Administration.
  
  

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES
  
  

**Talent Acquisition:**  

* Responsible for end\-to\-end recruitment support across all local FP positions \- Agency vendor liaison, LinkedIn sourcing, candidate shortlisting, interview arrangements, documentation, on\-boarding, induction
* Work with hiring managers to determine recruitment needs for local FP roles \- Initial resume screen, interview, manage reference and background checks, provide salary recommendations for new hires, considering internal equity \& market competitiveness
* Work with FP teams and Consulting case teams on temporary staffing needs and manage recruitment vendor contracts and relations
* Engage in medium to long term headcount/capacity planning with functional managers


**Onboarding / Offboarding:**  

* Support and work closely with the Onboarding team for the onboarding of all FP employees to ensure effective integration and training
* Coordinate departure process for all FP employees to ensure smooth transition \- Prepare necessary documentation, communicate departure to appropriate stakeholders and perform HRIS entry


**Performance Review:**  

* Responsible for the annual performance calibration work stream end\-to\-end, including preparation of the calibration materials for the FP Leadership team and own the compensation planning cycle which includes salary benchmarking and compensation administration after the review cycle
* Support the probation, performance, and talent management process, which includes the annual performance review and mid\-year promotion cycles
* Support and implement career development plans and apply BDPs from regional offices locally


**Insurance \& Benefits Program:**  

* Support the annual insurance renewals/remarketing exercise with insurance broker
* Review, assess and execute employee welfare and awards program
* Respond to employee questions on benefits and resolve claims issues
* Enter benefits data into HR system on a timely basis and prepare monthly payroll report


**Employee Engagement:**  

* Support and suggest levers to create a positive employee experience for FP teams
* Track karma and upkeep talent dashboards within the local FP professionals to be shared during quarterly People Council meetings
* Play a critical role in functional program design and development (e.g. FP Annual Summit, Forums, Mentor program etc.)
* Champion of FP causes and best practices


**HR Administration:**  

* Maintain FP employees’ personnel files to ensure they are kept up to date with all relevant offer letters, contracts, and agreements
* Maintain all FP employees’ information in HRIS
* Leave system management for all FP employees
* Co\-ordinate with Finance to ensure smooth payroll delivery
* Development of best in class HR playbook for repeatable processes


**Other duties:**  

* Perform other duties and projects as assigned/responsibilities dictate and as the business evolves, including but not limited to backup cover for other team members


QUALIFICATIONS / REQUIREMENTS
  
* Bachelors’ Degree with minimum 5\-7 years of HR experience in a fast\-paced, high\-touch and demanding work environment, preferably with some experience working within the Professional Services industry or within SEA (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand \& Vietnam)
* Working knowledge of Workday preferred
* Excellent organization, prioritization and time management skills
* Strong team player
* A dedicated attitude with a strong sense of ownership and high sense of self\-awareness and empathy
* Comfortable with ambiguity and degree of autonomy
* Meticulous and detail\-orientated
* Maturity and ability to navigate through varied employment regulations and challenges
* Flexibility and willingness to be very hands\-on in all aspects of the role
* Enjoy interacting with employees with a keen passion for creating a positive working environment
* Ability to deal appropriately with highly confidential information with tact and diplomacy
* Ability to prioritize and juggle multiple tasks simultaneously
* Excellent communication skills with a strong customer\-service mindset
* Possess good interpersonal skills, confidence, and maturity to interact effectively with all levels

The Assistant Manager, Accounting, is responsible for overseeing day\-to\-day accounting operations, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, maintaining strong internal controls, and supporting compliance with accounting standards and statutory requirements. Monitor changes in regulatory requirements, assess their impact on reporting obligations, and implement necessary updates to maintain ongoing compliance.

· Ensure the timely resolution of accounting issues, client queries and operational matters, escalating significant issues as appropriate


· Drive continuous improvement and standardization of accounting processes to enhance service quality, productivity and compliance


· Coordinate and support external and internal audit engagement, implement and monitor internal control measures and ensure compliance with governance, regulatory and company policy requirements


· Identify control gaps, assess risk and implement corrective and preventative actions to strengthen the overall control environment.


· Lead, coach and mentor accounting team members through effective coaching, technical guidance, and professional development initiatives. Review and approve accounting work to ensure high\-quality deliverables and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


· Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients, acting as a trusted business partner and key point of contact. Identify opportunities to expand service offerings, support proposals and client presentations, and contribute to business growth and revenue objectives.


· Collaborate closely with Business Development and operational stakeholders to support strategic growth initiatives, enhance client service offerings, and identify new business opportunities.


· Conduct and facilitate technical training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to strengthen the team’s accounting, regulatory and financial reporting capabilities and support continuous learning

· Chartered Accountant designation or equivalent professional certification would be an advantage.


*Business experience required:*

· Minimum 5 to 8 years of relevant accounting, financial reporting, or client accounting services experience, preferably within an accounting firm, corporate services provider, shared services environment, or professional services firm.


· Experience managing a portfolio of clients and handling full sets of accounts across multiple entities.


· Hands\-on experience in the preparation and review of management accounts, statutory financial statements, and group consolidated financial statements.


· Experience in regulatory reporting, including the preparation and review of MAS returns, would be advantageous.


· Proven experience leading, coaching, and developing team members.


· Experience managing external audits, implementing internal controls, and driving process improvement initiatives.


· Exposure to business development activities, client relationship management, and proposal preparation would be an added advantage.


*Language skills/other skills required:*

· Fluent in English and Chinese


·Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and risk assessment skills.


. Proficiency in accounting systems and ERP platforms, such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Xero, SAP Accpac, or similar applications.


. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Customer Success is NIQ's key department which is instrumental for the company’s success.

*So where do you fit here*?


A successful candidate for this role will be someone who can establish strong relationships with both our clients and our colleagues. You will quickly become a trusted partner, working with many of our clients’ teams, including marketing, sales, category, and many more.


You will be expected to understand our clients’ needs and then create and present solutions that help achieve their strategic and tactical goals.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders
* Coach, develop and inspire team to develop careers and drive innovative approaches to client briefs

**Description:**  

Director, Rewards
  
  

The Director, Rewards is responsible for leading CAG's enterprise\-wide strategy, governance and execution in the areas of compensation, performance management, incentives, executive remuneration, staff cost management, job architecture and HR policy governance.
  
  

As a strategic advisor to senior management, the Director will ensure that CAG's reward and performance frameworks drive organisational performance and cultivate behaviours that support innovation, collaboration and organisational transformation, and remain aligned with business priorities and governance requirements.
  
  

The role serves as the enterprise owner for compensation philosophy, performance and incentive frameworks, executive remuneration, workforce cost planning, job evaluation and HR policy governance.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Rewards Strategy and Compensation Management
  
  

Lead the development and continual refresh of CAG's compensation philosophy and rewards strategy to support business objectives and workforce priorities.
  
Establish and govern enterprise\-wide compensation frameworks, salary structures and remuneration policies.
  
Drive regular benchmarking exercises to ensure market competitiveness and internal equity.
  
Advise senior management on compensation trends, labour market developments and workforce implications.
  
Develop reward solutions that support talent attraction, retention and organisational transformation.
  
  

Performance Management and Incentives
  
  

Lead the design, implementation and continuous enhancement of CAG's performance management framework and philosophy.
  
Drive a robust performance management strategy that promotes accountability, organisational performance and desired leadership behaviours.
  
Oversee organisation\-wide performance review, talent calibration and governance processes.
  
Lead the design, development and review of CAG's incentive frameworks and programmes.
  
Oversee scorecard design, target\-setting methodologies, performance measurement and incentive payout processes.
  
Ensure effective governance and administration of performance\-linked remuneration programmes.
  
Partner business leaders and Finance to ensure alignment between incentive outcomes and organisational performance.
  
  

Executive Compensation and Board Governance
  
  

Lead the end\-to\-end management of senior management remuneration programmes.
  
Develop and review executive compensation structures, incentive arrangements and remuneration policies.
  
Conduct executive remuneration benchmarking, financial modelling and impact assessments.
  
Prepare and present remuneration recommendations to Management, Board Committees and the Board as required.
  
Ensure executive remuneration practices remain aligned with governance principles and market competitiveness.
  
  

Workforce Cost Planning and Staff Cost Management
  
  

Lead enterprise\-wide staff cost planning, budgeting and forecasting processes.
  
Partner Finance and business leaders to support manpower planning and workforce investment decisions.
  
Develop workforce cost models and analytics to assess the impact of compensation and incentive programmes.
  
Provide management with insights on manpower affordability, productivity and long\-term workforce cost sustainability.
  
Support annual budgeting and business planning exercises through robust workforce and compensation cost projections.
  
Advise leadership on the people cost implications of organisational restructuring, transformation initiatives and workforce growth plans.
  
  

Job Architecture and Organisation Effectiveness
  
  

Lead the job evaluation philosophy, governance framework and grading structure across CAG.
  
Oversee job architecture, role sizing and career framework initiatives.
  
Ensure consistency, rigour and governance in job evaluation and grading decisions.
  
Advise business leaders on organisational design and workforce structuring matters.
  
  

Digital Transformation, Analytics and AI Enablement
  
  

Lead the digital transformation of rewards and performance management processes, leveraging technology to enhance efficiency, governance and employee experience.
  
Drive the use of data, analytics and AI\-enabled insights to strengthen compensation planning, incentive design, workforce cost forecasting and performance outcomes.
  
Partner People Technology and business stakeholders to identify and implement innovative solutions that simplify processes and improve decision\-making.
  
Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting capabilities and predictive analytics to provide timely and actionable insights for management and business leaders.
  
Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the team by leveraging emerging technologies, automation and AI to improve productivity and effectiveness.
  
  

Stakeholder and Vendor Management
  
  

Serve as CAG's subject matter expert and trusted advisor on rewards, performance and policy matters.
  
Build strong partnerships with senior leaders, Finance, Legal and People Team stakeholders.
  
Manage and oversee consultants, survey providers and vendors engaged on rewards\-related projects.
  
Lead major rewards and policy initiatives from strategy formulation through implementation.
  
  

Leadership
  
  

Lead and develop a high\-performing Rewards team.
  
Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and evidence\-based decision\-making.
  
Build organisational capability in compensation, performance management, workforce economics and policy governance.
  
Coach and develop future people leaders within the People Team.
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Experience
  
  

Degree in Human Resource Management, Business, Economics, Finance, Accountancy or related discipline.
  
At least 15 years of progressive HR experience, with significant expertise in compensation, performance management, incentives and policy development.
  
At least 10 years of people leadership experience.
  
Proven track record in leading enterprise\-wide rewards and performance management frameworks in a large and complex organisation.
  
Experience managing senior management remuneration and Board\-level engagements.
  
Experience in workforce cost planning, financial modelling and job evaluation.
  
  

Knowledge and Expertise
  
  

Deep expertise in compensation strategy, incentive design and performance management.
  
Strong understanding of executive remuneration governance.
  
Deep knowledge of employment legislation and statutory requirements.
  
Strong understanding of job evaluation methodologies and grading structures.
  
  

Competencies
  
  

Strategic Leadership
  
  

Ability to think strategically and translate business priorities into integrated rewards solutions.
  
Strong commercial and organisational acumen.
  
  

Analytical Excellence
  
  

Strong numerical capability and financial modelling skills.
  
Ability to leverage data and insights to inform strategic decision\-making.
  
  

Stakeholder Influence
  
  

Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills.
  
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and Board\-level audiences.
  
  

Execution Excellence
  
  

Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational delivery.
  
Strong programme management and governance capabilities.
  
  

People Leadership
  
  

A strong people manager with a proven track record of building and leading high\-performing teams.
  
Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and inspire others.

* Apply mathematical and statistical thinking to model real\-world problems

* Support internal automation initiatives using AI

title: Project Engineering Manager - HVDC
description:
Join GE Vernova's Grid Systems Integration team and play a key role in delivering the energy transition through world\-class HVDC projects.
  

The Senior Project Engineering Manager (PEM) is accountable for the end\-to\-end engineering execution of large and complex HVDC projects, ensuring safe, high\-quality, on\-time, and on\-budget delivery. The role serves as the primary engineering leader and customer technical interface, coordinating multidisciplinary global engineering teams and ensuring successful project execution from contract handover through commissioning and project closeout.
**Job Description**
===================


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project Engineering Leadership**


* Lead and manage the complete engineering execution of HVDC projects from project launch through commissioning and handover.
* Act as the single point of accountability for engineering delivery, including safety, quality, schedule, cost, engineering risks, and customer satisfaction.
* Lead multidisciplinary engineering teams across System Engineering, Primary Plant, Civil \& Structural, Control \& Protection, Studies, Mechanical, Telecom, and Commissioning disciplines.
* Ensure engineering deliverables are completed in accordance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, project milestones, and quality standards.

**Technical \& Interface Management**


* Manage all engineering interfaces between customers, consortium partners, suppliers, contractors, and internal functions.
* Drive technical alignment across global engineering centers and solution line organizations.
* Lead engineering design reviews and technical governance activities.
* Ensure robust configuration management, design control, and document management throughout the project lifecycle.
* Anticipate, identify, and mitigate engineering risks and technical issues impacting project delivery.

**HVDC Engineering Governance**


* Ensure compliance with HVDC reference design, engineering standards, grid code requirements, and project\-specific technical specifications.
* Support Solution Engineering teams in ensuring approved technical solutions and identified gaps are addressed and delivered.
* Lead engineering change management and ensure strict adherence to approved change processes.
* Oversee technical integration of subcontractor and partner engineering deliverables.

**Project Delivery \& Performance**


* Own engineering KPIs including on\-time delivery, engineering budget performance, quality, productivity, and first\-time\-right execution.
* Coordinate engineering activities with Procurement, Manufacturing, Construction, Site Management, and Commissioning teams.
* Support project claims management, variation orders, and technical commercial discussions.
* Contribute to project reviews, risk assessments, and executive management reporting.

**Customer Engagement**


* Serve as the primary engineering interface with utility customers, developers, transmission operators, and consortium partners.
* Lead technical workshops, design reviews, and executive customer discussions.
* Provide clear communication of technical decisions, project status, risks, and mitigation plans.

**Continuous Improvement**


* Promote standardization, digital engineering tools, automation, and best practices across projects.
* Lead Return on Experience (RoE) and lessons learned initiatives.
* Support development and mentoring of engineering talent within the organization.

**Qualifications \& Experience**


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in EPC project engineering within the power transmission industry.
* Proven experience delivering large\-scale HVDC, FACTS, or EHV transmission projects.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in engineering leadership roles such as Lead Engineer, Engineering Manager, Project Engineering Manager, or Technical Project Manager.
* Strong understanding of engineering execution processes across all project phases from design through commissioning.

**Technical Expertise**


* Candidates should possess strong knowledge in several of the following areas:
* HVDC Converter Stations (LCC and/or VSC technologies)
* Power Systems and System Studies
* Control \& Protection Systems
* Primary Plant Engineering
* Civil \& Structural Engineering for Substations
* AC/DC Grid Integration
* High Voltage Equipment
* Grid Code Compliance
* Transmission \& Distribution Substations
* Engineering Configuration Management

**Leadership Competencies**


* Proven ability to lead large, globally distributed multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Excellent decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively within complex matrix organizations.
* Demonstrated customer\-facing leadership experience.
* Strong communication and presentation skills across technical and executive levels.

**Desired Characteristics**


* Experience on major HVDC EPC projects exceeding USD 300M.
* Experience working with global engineering centers and international consortium partners.
* Knowledge of offshore wind integration, renewable energy, and grid modernization projects.
* Experience managing multicultural teams in a global environment.
* Passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

**Travel Requirements**


* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (approximately 20\-30%) depending on project needs.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

Senior HR Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations and Transitions - APAC (HRBP)
description:
**About Remote**
----------------


Remote is solving modern organizations' biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.  

  

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.  

  

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best\-in\-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!**What this job can offer you**
-------------------------------



As a critical extension of our clients' HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it's about elevating it, integrating cutting\-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80\+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You're not just part of a team; you're at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.



The Senior Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations \& Transitions independently manages all employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance, excellent quality and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first\-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources.



As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Senior Specialist is also expected to drive process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Offboarding**


* Manage and resolve complex end\-to\-end employee exits with minimal supervision across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and employees.
* Provide sound and trusted guidance with an elevated level of knowledge on key jurisdictions, and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
* Independently lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
* Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, successfully navigating and directing multiple stakeholders with competing interests through a complicated, involved and sometimes lengthy process.
* Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
* Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
* Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, among other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
* Act as the first point of informal escalation as a trusted colleague with good judgment, by way of providing expertise, mentoring and guidance to more junior team members.
* Provide comprehensive guidance on Remote's Employee Relations resources, helping clients navigate complex workplace scenarios.
* Conduct thorough preliminary assessments of workplace concerns, identifying key facts, applicable local regulations, and potential paths forward.
* Serve as a trusted resource for internal and external stakeholders on employee relations matters, ensuring appropriate handling of complex cases.
* Guide clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches, documentation requirements, and best practices for handling difficult situations.
* Track and monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow\-up and appropriate coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Be the subject\-matter expert and proactively resolve internal and external queries on all offboarding and first\-level employee relations matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.
* Actively identify opportunities, advocate for and drive process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.
* Determine methods, procedures and standards on new assignments. Exercise judgment in selecting methods, evaluating, adapting complex techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results taking into account wider Lifecycle and Remote needs.

**Key Requirements and Charactristics**
---------------------------------------


* Experience as an HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
* Tertiary qualifications in HR/labour relations/employment law considered a plus.
* Proven experience with a strong background in independently managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR advice and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
* Understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
* Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues and apply problem\-solving skills to independently (occasionally with minimal supervision) arrive at solutions, undertake research and translate this into usable team resources, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
* Superior communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to independently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, while conveying authority and expertise as the representative of Remote, and maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
* Business\-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
* Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying, developing and implementing opportunities for automation and champion best practice.
* Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record\-keeping and data integrity.
* Tech\-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
* Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast\-paced, asynchronous, remote environment while successfully balancing multiple competing priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
* Proactive and self\-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, and ability to inspire others.
* **Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.**

**Practicals**
--------------


* **You'll report to:** Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations \& Transitions
* **Team:** Lifecycle, Employee Relations \& Transitions
* **Location**: APAC

**Application process**
-----------------------


* Interview with recruiter


* Take Home Exercise


* Interview with future manager


* Interview with team members (no managers present)


* Interview with Senior Manager


* Bar Raiser


* Prior employment verification check
**Benefits**
------------


Our full benefits \& perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
* work from anywhere
* flexible paid time off
* flexible working hours (we are async)
* 16 weeks paid parental leave
* budget towards co\-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
* mental health support services
* stock options
* home office budget \& IT equipment
**How you'll plan your day (and life)**
---------------------------------------



We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.



You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your **life\-work balance** is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.



If that sounds like something you want, apply now!


**How to apply**
----------------


* Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.


* **We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.**


* If you don't have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.



Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under\-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask \& encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

  


We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it's important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.



At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.  

  

*Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.*

**Senior Manager, Cybersecurity Governance, Risk \& Assurance**

  

PSA Group is seeking an experienced cybersecurity governance professional to strengthen group\-wide governance, risk and assurance practices across its global portfolio of businesses. The role will focus on clear policies, consistent risk oversight, effective assurance and concise management reporting.

  

  

The successful candidate should bring strong cybersecurity governance experience and sufficient awareness of IT, OT, cloud and AI environments to engage specialists and guide governance decisions. Deep technical expertise across every domain is not required.

  

  

Purpose:


Lead and strengthen cybersecurity governance, risk management and assurance across PSA Group, translating cyber risks into practical business decisions and consistent group\-wide requirements

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**


Governance and Policy


* Lead the development and continuous improvement of PSA Group’s cybersecurity governance framework.


* Develop, review and maintain cybersecurity policies, standards, guidelines and control requirements.


* Oversee policy adoption, compliance monitoring, policy exceptions and risk acceptance processes.

  

  

Cybersecurity Risk Management


* Establish and maintain a consistent group\-wide approach to cybersecurity risk management.


* Guide cybersecurity risk assessments for major business and technology initiatives, drawing on technical specialists where needed.


* Maintain oversight of key cyber risks, treatment plans, residual risk acceptance and escalation of significant issues.


* Translate cybersecurity risks into clear business implications and practical recommendations for decision\-makers.

  

  

Assurance and Maturity Improvement


* Oversee the Global Cybersecurity Assurance Programme and coordinate control and maturity assessments across business units.


* Track agreed remediation actions and report assurance outcomes, recurring gaps and improvement priorities to management.


* Drive practical initiatives that improve cybersecurity maturity and consistency across the Group.

  

  

Strategy and Programme Governance


* Support the development and review of cybersecurity strategies, roadmaps and masterplans.


* Provide governance oversight for strategic cybersecurity programmes, including decisions, milestones, dependencies, risks and reporting.


* Define and monitor meaningful governance metrics, key performance indicators and key risk indicators.


Stakeholder and Management Engagement


* Prepare concise dashboards, decision papers and management updates for cybersecurity governance forums and senior leadership.


* Coordinate business units, regions, technology teams and risk functions to align priorities and implementation outcomes.


* Communicate requirements clearly and support stakeholders in applying governance processes in a practical, risk\-based manner.


##### **JOB REQUIREMENTS**


Experience and Competencies


* Minimum 10 years of cybersecurity experience, with at least 5 years in cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, assurance or a closely related discipline.


* Practical experience developing or implementing cybersecurity governance frameworks, policies, standards or control requirements.


* Sound knowledge of cybersecurity risk management, assurance and maturity improvement approaches.


* Ability to engage senior stakeholders, facilitate governance decisions and explain technical risks in clear business terms.


* Working knowledge of cybersecurity considerations across IT, OT, cloud and AI.


* Experience in a large, complex, multinational, critical infrastructure, maritime, logistics or transportation environment would be advantageous.


* Experience coordinating cross\-functional or cross\-regional initiatives would be advantageous.

  

  

Qualifications and Skills


* Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, Risk Management, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.


* Practical familiarity with recognised cybersecurity and risk frameworks (eg ISO, NIST, ISA/IEC, etc)


* Strong policy \& governance documentation, analytical, presentation, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.


* Good programme governance capability, with the ability to establish clear outcomes, ownership, milestones and reporting.


* Relevant professional certifications will be an advantage.

  

  

Personal Attributes


* Clear, credible and concise communicator.


* Practical and collaborative, with the judgement to balance governance rigour and business needs.


* Able to work effectively across functions, business units, regions and levels of seniority.


* Organised, analytical and comfortable managing changing priorities.


* Willingness for occasional travel when required

title: Operations Associate
description:
**Operations Executive (Part\-Time, Mostly Remote)**

\~15 hrs/week · SGD 800–1,000/month · Mostly remote, 1–2 in\-person days a month · No fixed schedule · Judged on outcomes, not hours

**The setup**

We’re a small Singapore group running several operating businesses alongside a growing line of AI automation work for external clients.

We build our own internal systems: AI agents on Telegram and WhatsApp, a multi\-entity ledger, staff and finance portals, and automations handling payment alerts, backups and scheduling. You’d be working directly with the founder.

**Read this part first**

A lot of this job is already automated, and we’d rather be upfront about it.

Bank reconciliation alerts, failed\-payment chasing, membership expiry, payroll variance and service monitoring all run without a human. You will not be checking dashboards to see if things are working — the systems say so themselves, in Telegram, unprompted.

So this role is deliberately the part machines are bad at: judgement when the runbook runs out, conversations with real people, and one area we have not automated at all because a human has to gather it first.

If you want a job where you follow a checklist all day, this isn’t it — the checklist is already running.

**What you’ll own**

\- Client response (the one that matters most). First point of contact for our external automation clients. Acknowledge, log, route, chase to closure. You own the response loop, not the technical fix — the founder handles that. Speed and clarity matter more than answers.

\- Money conversations. Chase failed and overdue payments. Work the payment\-review queue — a small share of card payments don’t reconcile and need a human to work out what was actually sold. The system tells you who and how much. It cannot have the conversation.

\- Payroll preparation. Resolve the monthly variance exceptions, reconcile, prepare the voucher for founder review. You prepare. The founder approves and pays. Never both.

\- Member lifecycle. Follow up expiring memberships, unconverted trials and lapsed members. We know exactly who they are — what’s missing is someone to message them.

\- Service monitoring. Act on alerts per the runbook, escalate anything outside it with a clear write\-up. Most weeks this is nothing. When it’s something, it matters a lot.

\- Growth research (about 2 hrs/week, when the queue is clear). Build and qualify a prospect list. You research and qualify; the founder does the outreach.

**What we’re looking for**

* You check a list before you act on it. This is the one we care about most. Automated reports are good, but any system that pulls from live data will occasionally produce a row that a person can see is wrong and a machine can’t — a staff member sitting in a customer list, one person appearing as two records, a date that doesn’t add up. Catching that before you act on it is the job, not an interruption to it.
* Accuracy under repetition — these processes run weekly and small errors compound
* Follow\-through: you chase until it closes, without reminders
* Comfortable working alongside AI agents, not just AI tools — and telling us exactly how they were wrong when they are
* Spreadsheet fluency and clear written English
* Discretion across payroll, financials and client data
* Nice to have: bookkeeping literacy, ops or founder’s\-office experience, no\-code automation exposure, interest in martial arts

**How you’ll be measured**

No hours tracked. These are the commitments:

* Client issue acknowledged — within 2 working hours
* Client issue closed, or a written reason why not — 5 working days
* Payment discrepancy chased — same day
* Payroll variances resolved and voucher prepared — by the 3rd
* Expiring and lapsed members contacted — weekly
* Qualified prospects added to pipeline — 10 a month

***One honest caveat on “no fixed schedule”***

Clients get a response within 2 working hours, so this needs you to check Telegram twice on weekdays — once morning, once mid\-afternoon. Between and around those, your time is yours. Nothing is expected evenings or weekends. We’d rather say that up front than let you find out in week two.

We also meet in person once or twice a month, and you’ll occasionally join client sessions with the founder. Dates are agreed in advance around your availability, never dropped on you.

**What this can become**

Scoped tight to start, and priced for that scope. For the right person it expands into automation operations and broader portfolio work, with hours and pay reset at the 6\-month mark. If you’re looking to grow into an operations lead role as the group scales, say so.

description:
