2026\-08\-14**Country:**


Singapore
**Location:**


SG\-01\-SINGAPORE\-083 \~ 83 Clemenceau Ave \~ UE SQAURE
**Position Role Type:**


Onsite
At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.


Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


Senior System Deployment Engineer  

Role Overview  

We are seeking an experienced Senior System Deployment to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the deployment, configuration, testing, recovery, and ongoing support of mission\-critical airline and airport applications across Windows and Linux environments.


The role covers the complete lifecycle of application infrastructure, including server staging, OS installation, VM provisioning, application deployment, database configuration, high\-availability and failover testing, disaster recovery, and production transition.


A key responsibility is providing critical second\-level/third\-level technical support for major incidents, including the ability to recover and rebuild corrupted virtual machines, operating systems, databases, and application environments from scratch using available backups, recovery media, infrastructure templates, and documented recovery procedures.


The engineer will work across Windows Server, Red Hat Linux, VMware, Hyper\-V, AWS Cloud, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Kafka, MongoDB, OpenShift, and related infrastructure technologies, supporting highly available and operationally critical airport systems.


Key Responsibilities  

1\. Server Staging, Build \& Deployment  

* Stage, provision, and prepare Windows and Linux servers for application deployment.
* Perform OS installation, hardening, patching, configuration, and baseline validation.
* Deploy and configure airline and airport applications across physical and virtual environments.
* Configure application services, ports, certificates, connectivity, service accounts, and system dependencies.
* Ensure servers meet required performance, security, availability, and operational standards.
* Prepare production, DR, test, FAT, UAT, and staging environments.


2\. Critical Incident Support \& Infrastructure Recovery  

* Provide second\-level/third\-level technical support for mission\-critical airport and airline systems.
* Participate in major incident, problem management, and ITSM processes.
* Troubleshoot critical failures involving servers, VMs, operating systems, databases, applications, storage, and infrastructure services.
* Lead or support full infrastructure recovery when systems become corrupted or unrecoverable.
* Restore and rebuild VMs from scratch, including:


o Recreating virtual machines.


o Reinstalling operating systems.


o Applying required OS configuration and security hardening.


o Restoring application components and services.


o Reconfiguring network, storage, DNS, certificates, and connectivity.


o Restoring application configuration and validating dependencies.

* Recover corrupted or failed servers using available VM backups, snapshots, images, templates, backup repositories, or DR infrastructure.
* Perform complete application environment restoration when the original server/VM cannot be recovered.
* Work with infrastructure, backup, network, database, security, and application teams during major recovery activities.
* Conduct post\-recovery validation and ensure systems are returned to operational readiness.


3\. Database Recovery \& Restoration  

* Support SQL Server and PostgreSQL environments supporting mission\-critical applications.
* Troubleshoot database corruption, service failures, connectivity issues, performance issues, and abnormal database behavior.
* Perform or coordinate database restoration from backup following database corruption or infrastructure failure.
* Restore databases from full, differential, transaction\-log, WAL, or other applicable backup mechanisms.
* Rebuild database servers when required, including:


o OS and VM restoration.


o Database software installation.


o Database configuration.


o Storage and permissions configuration.


o Database restoration.


o User, role, service account, and connectivity configuration.


o Application reconnection and validation.

* Validate database integrity following restoration.
* Support database failover, recovery, replication, and DR testing.
* Coordinate with DBA teams for complex database recovery and corruption scenarios.
* Ensure appropriate RPO/RTO requirements are achieved during recovery.


4\. Virtualization \& Infrastructure Management  

* Manage and troubleshoot VMware and Hyper\-V virtual environments.
* Provision, configure, resize, clone, restore, and recover virtual machines.
* Troubleshoot VM, host, datastore, virtual network, resource allocation, and performance issues.
* Perform VM recovery from backup or rebuild VMs from scratch when required.
* Support VMware HA, clustering, snapshots, templates, and DR\-related activities.
* Investigate virtualization\-related failures affecting critical applications.
* Support data center infrastructure troubleshooting involving compute, storage, virtualization, and server connectivity.


5\. High Availability, Failover \& Disaster Recovery  

* Design, execute, and document server, application, database, and VM failover testing.
* Conduct planned and unplanned failover exercises.
* Validate application recovery following infrastructure or database failures.
* Perform DR restoration and recovery testing.
* Validate RPO and RTO against operational requirements.
* Test recovery procedures for complete server/VM loss and database corruption scenarios.
* Identify recovery gaps and recommend improvements to HA/DR architecture.
* Maintain detailed recovery procedures and runbooks.


6\. FAT, UAT \& Production Validation  

* Plan and execute Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Perform technical validation before applications are transitioned into production.
* Validate server, application, database, network, security, and infrastructure dependencies.
* Conduct failover, recovery, performance, and resilience testing.
* Support application cutover and go\-live activities.
* Ensure production handover is completed with appropriate documentation and support procedures.


7\. Database \& Middleware Services  

* Configure and support:

o Microsoft SQL Server


o PostgreSQL


o Kafka


o MongoDB


o OpenShift


o Related application middleware and services

* Troubleshoot application\-to\-database connectivity and service dependencies.
* Support Kafka brokers, topics, connectivity, and service availability.
* Support MongoDB configuration, availability, and recovery activities.
* Work with development and application teams to resolve middleware and database\-related incidents.


8\. AWS Cloud \& Hybrid Infrastructure  

* Support applications deployed across on\-premises data centers and AWS Cloud.
* Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure, connectivity, compute, storage, and application dependencies.
* Support VM/server recovery and application restoration in hybrid environments.
* Assist with cloud DR and backup/recovery activities.
* Understand connectivity between on\-premises infrastructure and AWS environments.


9\. Monitoring, Troubleshooting \& Operational Support  

* Monitor system health, availability, capacity, and performance.
* Analyze server, application, database, and infrastructure logs.
* Troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk, network, service, database, and application failures.
* Work with monitoring and ITSM tools to identify and resolve recurring incidents.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) and problem management.
* Identify opportunities for automation and proactive monitoring.


10\. Scripting \& Automation  

* Develop scripts and automation to reduce manual deployment and recovery activities.
* Use PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar scripting technologies where appropriate.
* Automate server health checks, service validation, deployment activities, backup validation, and recovery procedures.
* Develop automated health\-check and auto\-healing capabilities for critical services where feasible.


11\. Documentation \& Knowledge Management  

* Create and maintain:

o Server build documents


o VM configuration documents


o Application deployment procedures


o Database recovery procedures


o VM recovery procedures


o Disaster recovery runbooks


o Failover test procedures


o FAT/UAT test cases


o Troubleshooting guides


o Operational handover documents

* Maintain accurate recovery procedures to enable complete rebuild and restoration from a failed/corrupted environment.
* Ensure documentation is regularly tested and updated following system changes or incidents.


12\. Collaboration  

* Collaborate with application development, DBA, network, security, cloud, infrastructure, service desk, and operations teams.
* Coordinate with vendors and technology partners during critical incidents.
* Participate in technical reviews, change management, CAB activities, and production implementation.
* Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and operations teams.


Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in system deployment, infrastructure support, system recovery, or mission\-critical IT environments.
* Strong experience with Windows Server and Red Hat Linux.
* Strong experience in server staging, OS build, configuration, deployment, troubleshooting, and recovery.
* Hands\-on experience with VMware and/or Hyper\-V.
* Strong experience with VM restoration, rebuilding, and disaster recovery.
* Experience recovering databases and application environments following corruption or infrastructure failure.
* Experience with SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
* Working knowledge of Kafka, MongoDB, and OpenShift.
* Experience with high\-availability systems, failover, backup, restore, and DR.
* Experience conducting FAT, UAT, failover, recovery, and production validation testing.
* Working knowledge of AWS Cloud and hybrid infrastructure.
* Experience with ITSM, incident management, change management, and problem management.
* Basic networking knowledge including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewall rules, routing, VLANs, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience with scripting/automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or equivalent.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Red Hat, AWS, or other senior infrastructure certifications are desirable.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.


Preferred Skills  

* Prior experience supporting mission\-critical airline, airport, transportation, other 24x7 environments.
* Experience supporting systems with strict availability, RTO, and RPO requirements.
* Hands\-on experience with complete infrastructure recovery from bare/clean VM or server build through application restoration and production validation.
* Experience with VMware HA, clustering, snapshots, templates, and backup/restore solutions.

description:

Reporting to the Programme Director, this role owns the Capital and Regulatory Reporting workstream and ensures regulatory compliance across capital, liquidity and regulatory reporting change.

  

Success means delivering against migration plans with strong cutover execution, transparent reporting and sustainable change adoption. You’ll help translate business goals into future\-state operating models aligned to architecture and technology strategy. The outcome is measurable improvement in automation and readiness for customers, colleagues and the business

 **What you'll be doing**

  

* Owning the Technology workstream scope, plan, milestones and critical path for Project Sirena
* Establishing operational readiness and automation efficiencies in partnership with Business and Operations teams
* Developing detailed execution plans and managing delivery against migration plans with clear programme reporting
* Governing steering forums and executive updates, setting decision pathways and escalating risks, issues and trade\-offs
* Coordinating integrated plans across workstreams, including dependencies, RAID, delivery assurance and financial controls
* Running cross\-functional workshops to translate business drivers into future\-state operating models aligned to technology strategy
* Managing budget, headcount planning and vendor performance against commercial, risk and delivery expectations
* Embedding change adoption, benefits tracking and hypercare approaches to ensure sustainable implementation

 **What we're looking for**

  

* Bringing substantial years of experience delivering end\-to\-end large\-scale transformation programmes in a global or regional banking context.
* Demonstrating proven ownership of a core banking migration or equivalent mission\-critical platform transformation
* Showing experience delivering technology change in a merger or integration, carve\-out or complex multi\-entity environment

* Demonstrating working knowledge of core banking domains such as accounts, payments, lending, GL and customer master

* Holding PMP, Change Management, Six Sigma or equivalent certification, or bringing equivalent demonstrable experience are highly preferred

 **Deliver Project Sirena Technology**

  

If you want to own a technology workstream at the centre of a complex transformation this role offers real scope and visibility. You’ll work across senior stakeholders and regulators to bring clarity to decisions and momentum to delivery. The programme spans technology, operating model and regulatory change so the impact is tangible and lasting. **Location:** Singapore
  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time
  

**Reporting To:** Managing Director / Group Finance Director
  

**Industry:** Oil \& Petroleum Distribution / Trading


**About the Company**
---------------------

We are an established oil distribution and trading company involved in the supply and distribution of petroleum products to commercial and industrial customers. As part of our continued growth, we are seeking an experienced and commercially minded **Financial Controller** to oversee the company’s financial management, accounting operations, financial reporting and internal controls.


This is a key management position suited to a hands\-on finance professional who is comfortable working in a fast\-paced trading and distribution environment and who can provide management with meaningful financial and commercial insights.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. Financial Management \& Reporting**

* Take overall responsibility for the company’s accounting and financial management functions.
* Prepare accurate and timely monthly, quarterly and annual management accounts.
* Prepare financial statements, cash\-flow reports, budgets and financial forecasts.
* Provide management with financial analysis, business performance reports and recommendations.
* Monitor profitability by product, customer, supplier and business segment.
* Analyse gross margins, operating costs, working capital and overall business performance.

### **2\. Oil Trading \& Distribution Finance**

* Monitor the financial performance of oil and petroleum product trading activities.
* Review purchase costs, selling prices, margins, transportation costs and other related expenses.
* Monitor inventory valuation and stock movements and reconcile physical inventory with accounting records.
* Analyse trading margins and identify significant price or margin variances.
* Work closely with the operations and sales teams to ensure proper financial controls over purchases, sales and deliveries.
* Monitor customer credit exposure and outstanding receivables.

### **3\. Cash Flow \& Working Capital Management**

* Take responsibility for short\- and medium\-term cash\-flow planning.
* Monitor daily cash positions and anticipated funding requirements.
* Manage working capital, including trade receivables, trade payables and inventory.
* Monitor customer collections and payment performance.
* Work with banks on banking facilities, trade financing, overdrafts and other credit facilities where required.
* Ensure sufficient liquidity to support day\-to\-day trading operations.

### **4\. Budgeting \& Business Planning**

* Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process.
* Prepare financial models and cash\-flow projections for management decision\-making.
* Compare actual performance against budget and provide variance analysis.
* Identify areas for cost reduction and improvement in operating efficiency.
* Assist management in evaluating new business opportunities, investments and expansion plans.

### **5\. Accounting \& Compliance**

* Oversee the full set of accounts and ensure proper accounting records are maintained.
* Ensure timely closing of monthly accounts.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Singapore Financial Reporting Standards, tax requirements and statutory obligations.
* Liaise with external auditors, tax advisors, banks and other professional advisors.
* Ensure GST reporting and other statutory submissions are properly managed.
* Establish and maintain appropriate accounting policies and procedures.

### **6\. Internal Controls \& Risk Management**

* Develop and strengthen financial controls and approval procedures.
* Review purchasing, sales, credit, payment and inventory controls.
* Identify potential financial, credit, operational and fraud risks.
* Implement appropriate segregation of duties and authorisation controls.
* Ensure proper documentation and audit trails for significant transactions.
* Monitor compliance with company policies and delegated authority limits.

### **7\. Credit Control**

* Establish and monitor customer credit limits and payment terms.
* Review customer creditworthiness and outstanding exposures.
* Monitor overdue accounts and work with the sales team on collection matters.
* Recommend appropriate credit controls where customers exceed approved limits.
* Highlight significant credit risks to management.

### **8\. Management \& Business Support**

* Act as a strategic finance partner to the Managing Director and management team.
* Provide timely financial information to support commercial decisions.
* Translate financial data into practical business recommendations.
* Challenge assumptions and highlight areas requiring management attention.
* Participate in business planning, negotiations and commercial discussions where financial input is required.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Education \& Experience**

* Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related discipline.
* Professional accounting qualification such as **CA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent** would be advantageous.
* Minimum **5 years of relevant finance/accounting experience** , preferably with experience in oil, petroleum, commodity trading, logistics, distribution or related industries.
* Experience in a Financial Controller, Finance Manager, Finance Director or similar senior finance position.
* Strong understanding of management accounting, financial reporting, cash\-flow management and internal controls.
* Experience managing full sets of accounts and working with external auditors and tax advisors.

**Industry Experience**  

Experience in one or more of the following will be highly advantageous:


* Oil and petroleum distribution
* Fuel trading
* Commodity trading
* Energy or logistics
* Wholesale distribution
* Inventory\-intensive businesses
* Trade financing and banking facilities

**Key Skills**
--------------

description:
Group Overview


The TP ICAP Group is a world leading provider of market infrastructure.


Our purpose is to provide clients with access to global financial and commodities markets, improving price discovery, liquidity, and distribution of data, through responsible and innovative solutions.


Through our people and technology, we connect clients to superior liquidity and data solutions.


The Group is home to a stable of premium brands. Collectively, TP ICAP is the largest interdealer broker in the world by revenue, the number one Energy \& Commodities broker in the world, the world’s leading provider of OTC data, and an award winning all\-to\-all trading platform.


Founded in London in 1866, the Group operates from more than 60 offices in 27 countries. We are 5,200 people strong. We work as one to achieve our vision of being the world’s most trusted, innovative, liquidity and data solutions specialist.


**About Parameta**

Parameta Solutions is the Data \& Analytics division of TP ICAP Group. The business provides clients with unbiased OTC content and proprietary data, in\-depth insights across price discovery, risk management, benchmark and indices, and pre and post\-trade analytics. Its post\-trade solutions offering helps market participants control their counterparty and regulatory risks through a growing range of tools that manage balance\-sheet exposure, as well as compression and optimisation services. The Data \& Analytics division includes the following brands: Tullett Prebon Information, PVM Data Services, ICAP Information and Burton\-Taylor Consulting.


**Role Overview**

The Capital Markets Product team within Parameta Solutions is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead the strategy, development, commercialization and lifecycle management of Indicative Pricing and Market Data products across global capital markets, with a particular focus on driving growth and market leadership across Asia\-Pacific.


Based in Singapore, this role is responsible for defining and executing the strategic vision for a broad portfolio of pricing and market data products derived from TP ICAP's global broking franchise. The successful candidate will work closely with senior stakeholders across Broking, Sales, Technology, Analytics, Data Science, Operations and Compliance to identify, develop and commercialize differentiated data and analytics solutions.


The role combines strategic product leadership, commercial management and market expertise, requiring a deep understanding of fixed income and derivatives markets, pricing methodologies, market structure, client workflows and the evolving data requirements of institutional market participants.


The Director will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding data monetization opportunities, developing strategic partnerships, and strengthening Parameta Solutions' position as a leading provider of pricing and market intelligence solutions globally, while ensuring strong representation of Asian market requirements and opportunities within the broader product strategy.


Role Responsibilities


* Define and execute the product strategy, vision and multi\-year roadmap for Indicative Pricing and Market Data products globally, with particular emphasis on agreed asset classes and driving growth across Asia\-Pacific, including product business cases, commercial positioning and P\&L performance.
* Own the commercial success and lifecycle management of the product portfolio, encompassing product definition, requirements, development, testing, operational readiness, client adoption, revenue growth and ongoing optimization.
* Partner with Global Broking leadership, Desk Heads and regional stakeholders to source new datasets, enhance data capture and maximize the commercial value of broker\-generated information.
* Lead cross\-functional product development initiatives, working closely with Engineering, Quantitative Research, Analytics, Data Science, Product Proposition and Implementation teams to deliver innovative data and analytics solutions that address evolving client needs.
* Maintain and enhance existing product offerings, ensuring methodologies, pricing models, benchmarks, analytics and data standards remain aligned with evolving market structures, trading conventions, regulatory requirements and client workflows.
* Apply deep cross\-asset market expertise to assess pricing methodologies, valuation approaches, market conventions and model outputs, supporting the development of robust, transparent and commercially relevant products.
* Establish and maintain strong product governance, including methodology oversight, data quality standards, operational processes, documentation and client transparency.
* Represent the voice of the client by engaging with buy\-side, sell\-side and market infrastructure participants to understand market developments, gather feedback and identify opportunities for product innovation and expansion.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing and Client Success teams to develop and execute Go\-To\-Market strategies, sales enablement, client use cases, product collateral, thought leadership and training initiatives that support commercial growth.
* Build and manage strategic relationships with internal stakeholders, third\-party data providers and industry partners to strengthen the competitiveness and reach of the Capital Markets Data product portfolio.
* Provide leadership and mentorship across the Product organization, fostering collaboration, innovation and best practices while operating effectively in a fast\-paced global environment and representing Parameta Solutions with clients and stakeholders across key financial markets.
* Work with Analytics and Implementation specialists to support the design, development and execution of new Product ideas

**Experience / Competences**

Essential


* Extensive experience in financial market data, indicative pricing, pricing services, valuations, trading or related capital markets products.
* Deep understanding of fixed income and derivatives markets, including market structure, liquidity dynamics, valuation approaches and trading workflows.
* Proven track record of developing, commercializing and managing revenue\-generating market data products.
* Strong understanding of institutional client workflows across trading, portfolio management, risk management, valuation, IPV and regulatory functions.
* Experience working closely with broking, trading, quantitative, technology and commercial teams.
* Demonstrated ability to define product strategy, build business cases and deliver commercial outcomes. Strong commercial acumen, including P\&L responsibility, pricing strategy and revenue growth management.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with experience influencing senior business leaders and decision\-makers. Strong communication and presentation skills, including direct engagement with clients, executives and industry stakeholders.
* Technical proficiency in Excel and SQL.
* Willingness and ability to travel across Asia and internationally as required
* High level of professional integrity, analytical rigor, attention to detail, and problem\-solving capability

Desired


* Strong knowledge of Asian fixed income and derivatives markets.
* Experience with pricing and valuation methodologies across Rates, Credit, FX, Inflation, Emerging Markets and Structured Products.
* Familiarity with Bloomberg, LSEG Workspace, Numerix, Yield Book, ICE Data Services and other market data or valuation platforms.
* Programming experience in Python, VBA or similar analytical tools.
* Strong client focus: ability to build relationships, communicate effectively, and manage diverse stakeholders
* Demonstrated innovation mindset, including identifying improvements and developing new approaches

Technology Group
  
We experiment, design, and lead a 24×7 global business where we support core capabilities in asset management, trading, investment operations, and risk management. We deliver secure, reliable, and integrated solutions, and provide insights on new, and emerging technologies.
  
  

Infrastructure \& Cybersecurity Resilience (ICR)
  
We design, build, and secure the technology foundations that power GIC’s global investment operations. We aim to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure infrastructure that empowers our people and businesses to perform securely, efficiently, and effectively.
  
  

What will you do as a SVP, Network Engineering \& Data Center Lead?
  
  

The SVP, Network Engineering \& Data Centre Lead provides leadership for GIC’s global connectivity and secure infrastructure portfolio. The role is accountable for the architecture, engineering, and security compliance of all network and data\-centre assets—on\-premise, co\-location, and multi\-cloud—ensuring world\-class availability, security, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.
  
  

As part of the Infrastructure and Cybersecurity Resilience senior leadership team, this executive will shape the our Network strategy, establish the design authority, and lead a distributed engineering organization delivering an AI\-enabled, Zero\-Trust network platform that underpins all GIC business workloads.
  
  

Strategic Leadership
  
  

Define and execute the multi\-year our Network strategy aligned with enterprise technology and business strategies.
  
Represent ICR at enterprise\-level committees, translating technical strategy into risk\-adjusted value outcomes.
  
Influence long\-term investment, sustainability, and innovation priorities for the infrastructure domain.
  
Focus on building security and stability within the engineered builds rather than as an afterthought. Work closely with the Global Command Centre (GCC) and SRE teams to enhance the security and stability posture for the Networks and Data Centre teams in GIC.
  
  

Architecture \& Engineering
  
  

Chair the Network Design Authority; standardize architectures across SD\-WAN, SASE/SSE, IPv6, ZTNA, private 5G edge, and other technologies.
  
Establish automation frameworks using Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, GitHub, Ansible) and enforce policy\-as\-code for security and compliance.
  
Embed observability (AIOps, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and quantum\-safe crypto standards.
  
Architect a "Secure by Design" and "Reliable by Design" global platform, incorporating Zero\-Trust principles and SLO\-based management.
  
Establish the technical vision for the future of end\-user computing (Next\-Gen Wi\-Fi, Zero\-Touch Deployment, Secure Access Service Edge \- SASE).
  
  

Data Centre \& Hybrid Cloud Fabric Engineering
  
  

**Oversee global data\-centre lifecycle:** capacity, sustainability, colocation partnerships, and interconnect topology.
  
Deliver low\-latency, high\-availability connectivity for trading, analytics, and enterprise systems.
  
**Develop Blueprints \& Engineered Packages:** Create standardized, version\-controlled blueprints (using IaC) for all infrastructure components, with embedded security, compliance, and observability baselines.
  
**Engineer for Self\-Service:** Build a golden\-path platform that enables development teams to consume infrastructure through automated, self\-service workflows, reducing friction and time\-to\-market.
  
  

Operations \& Resilience
  
  

Deploy AIOps for predictive fault detection and closed\-loop remediation, working closely with ITCC and SRE teams. Design systems where telemetry data from production automatically triggers improvements in the engineering blueprints and deployment pipelines (e.g., automatic capacity scaling, security patch deployment).
  
  

Risk \& Compliance
  
  

Integrate security engineering into delivery pipelines; maintain zero regulatory findings and aim for zero audit points.
  
Ensure full compliance with MAS TRM, NIST CSF, PCI\-DSS v4\.0, SOX, GDPR.
  
Maintain the Network RCSA and publish monthly KRI dashboards to the Board Risk Committee.
  
  

People Leadership
  
  

Build and scale a global team of engineers, cultivating inclusion, performance discipline, and continuous learning.
  
Coach emerging leaders; embed SLOs, post\-mortems, and innovation sprints as team rituals.
  
  

What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role?
  
  

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science / Engineering (required); Master’s preferred.
  
Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in global network engineering.
  
Proven track record as Global Head / Director
  
Advanced knowledge of SD\-WAN, SASE, BGP, IPv6, Zero Trust architecture, and multi\-cloud interconnects.
  
Experience in Infrastructure\-as\-Code and automation tools will be advantageous. (Terraform, Ansible, Python, GitLab CI).

The role sits at the intersection of strategy, planning, operations, and execution. You will partner closely with senior leaders across AGS, Field Tech, Partner, Professional Services, Finance, Marketing, and APJ teams to define, land, and scale strategic priorities that accelerate customer adoption and business growth.  

A core part of this role is managing AWS' strategic mechanism framework, including Operating Plan cycles (OP1 and OP2\) for AGS across ASEAN. You will help translate customer insights, business performance, field capacity, investment priorities, and GTM trade\-offs into clear strategic recommendations and executable plans. This role will also be responsible in translating the strategies into investment asks, including headcount and will be responsible in prioritizing headcount deployment and headcount related reporting.  

The ideal candidate combines strong sales strategy experience, analytical depth, operational discipline, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority. They must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels, from framing complex business questions to building mechanisms, inspecting KPIs, and driving cross\-functional action.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

  

* Own and drive ASEAN\-wide GTM strategy priorities for AGS, ensuring alignment between APJC strategy and ASEAB business needs.
* Lead annual planning mechanisms, including OP1 and OP2, across AGS in ASEAN, translating business goals into investment priorities and execution plans, working closely with the APJC and ASEAN Country teams across various functions.
* Conduct strategic analysis on customer trends, sales productivity, coverage capacity, pipeline health, partner contribution, migration and modernization, AI, and other priority growth initiatives.
* Develop data\-driven recommendations to support senior leadership decisions on sales investment, resource allocation, GTM design, and operating model improvements.

  

Manage highly visible, cross\-functional strategic initiatives from problem definition through execution, inspection, and scale.  

* Author clear, concise, and compelling narratives, proposals, and strategic documents for senior executive review.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to ASEAN senior leadership on complex business decisions requiring strategic judgment, analytical rigor, and strong stakeholder alignment.

**What this job involves:**  

The Facilities Manager is responsible for overseeing the maintenance, safety, and operational efficiency of all school facilities and grounds. This role ensures that the physical environment supports effective teaching and learning while maintaining compliance with health, safety, and regulatory standards. The Facilities Manager leads maintenance teams, manages vendor relationships, and implements preventive maintenance programs to create a safe, clean, and welcoming environment for students, staff, and visitors.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**Facilities Operations \& Maintenance:** Oversee daily operations of all school buildings, grounds, and infrastructure including HVAC systems, electrical, plumbing, and structural components. Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules to minimize equipment downtime and extend asset lifecycles. Coordinate and supervise maintenance, custodial, and groundskeeping staff to ensure facilities are maintained to high standards. Respond promptly to emergency maintenance issues and coordinate repairs with minimal disruption to educational activities.
  
**Health, Safety \& Compliance:** Ensure all facilities comply with local, state, and federal health and safety regulations including fire codes, ADA requirements, and building codes. Conduct regular safety inspections and risk assessments, implementing corrective actions as needed. Maintain accurate records of safety inspections, incident reports, and compliance documentation. Coordinate emergency preparedness plans including fire drills, lockdown procedures, and crisis response protocols.
  
**Vendor \& Contract Management:** Source, negotiate, and manage contracts with external vendors and service providers for specialized maintenance, repairs, and projects. Monitor vendor performance to ensure quality standards and contract compliance. Obtain competitive bids for major projects and capital improvements. Build and maintain strong relationships with contractors, suppliers, and service providers.
  
**Budget \& Financial Management:** Develop and manage the annual facilities budget, tracking expenditures and identifying cost\-saving opportunities. Prepare budget forecasts and variance reports for leadership review. Authorize purchases within approved budget parameters and ensure proper procurement procedures. Evaluate cost\-effectiveness of repair versus replacement decisions for equipment and systems.
  
**Capital Projects \& Improvements:** Plan, coordinate, and oversee renovation projects, capital improvements, and facility upgrades. Collaborate with architects, engineers, and contractors on construction and renovation projects. Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and with minimal disruption to school operations. Conduct post\-project evaluations to assess outcomes and identify lessons learned.
  
**Space Planning \& Utilization:** Manage space allocation and furniture arrangements to optimize facility use and support educational programs. Coordinate room setups for special events, assemblies, and extracurricular activities. Maintain inventory of furniture, fixtures, and equipment across all school facilities.
  
**Sustainability \& Energy Management:** Implement energy conservation initiatives and sustainable facilities practices. Monitor utility consumption and identify opportunities for efficiency improvements. Support the school's environmental stewardship goals through green cleaning practices and waste reduction programs.
  
**Team Leadership \& Development:** Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate facilities and custodial staff. Foster a culture of service excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. Conduct regular team meetings and provide ongoing professional development opportunities. Ensure adequate staffing levels to meet operational demands.
  
**Required Qualifications:** Education: Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field, OR equivalent combination of education and experience.
  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 years of facilities management experience, preferably in an educational or institutional setting. Demonstrated experience managing maintenance teams and overseeing multi\-building operations. Proven track record managing budgets and vendor relationships.
  
**Technical Knowledge:** Strong understanding of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical systems. Knowledge of health, safety, and environmental regulations applicable to educational facilities. Familiarity with computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)
  
**Certifications (Preferred):** Certified Facility Manager (CFM) or Facilities Management Professional (FMP). OSHA safety certification. First Aid/CPR certification.

**Problem\-Solving:** Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and implement effective solutions quickly.
  
**Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with students, staff, parents, contractors, and leadership.
  
**Organization \& Planning:** Superior organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.
  
**Technical Aptitude:** Hands\-on knowledge of building trades and systems with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve maintenance issues.
  
**Customer Service Orientation:** Commitment to providing responsive, high\-quality service to the school community.
  
**Financial Acumen:** Ability to develop budgets, analyze costs, and make sound financial decisions.
  
**Flexibility:** Willingness to work occasional evenings, weekends, or respond to emergency situations outside regular business hours.

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Senior Executive - HR
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and hands\-on **HR professional** to manage and support the full spectrum of HR functions. This role will work closely with department managers and management to ensure effective manpower planning, employee engagement, performance management, HR operations, compliance, and reporting.

The ideal candidate should be organised, analytical, people\-oriented, and able to work independently while partnering closely with different departments.

Key Responsibilities1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning

* Collaborate with department managers to identify current and future manpower requirements.
* Manage the full recruitment cycle, including job postings, candidate sourcing, screening, interviews, selection, and onboarding.
* Develop and maintain manpower plans based on business requirements and operational needs.
* Conduct **manpower forecasting** to anticipate future hiring requirements based on business growth, turnover, workload, and operational demands.
* Monitor headcount against approved manpower budgets and identify manpower gaps or excesses.
* Work with department heads to review staffing requirements and optimise workforce allocation.
* Track recruitment progress, vacancies, time\-to\-hire, and hiring costs.

2\. Employee Relations \& Engagement

* Act as the first point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, workplace conflicts, and HR\-related matters.
* Support conflict resolution and conduct formal investigations when required.
* Advise managers on employee relations matters and appropriate HR practices.
* Develop and coordinate employee engagement initiatives, company activities, and staff welfare programmes.
* Monitor employee morale, retention, absenteeism, and turnover trends.
* Identify areas for improvement to strengthen employee engagement, workplace culture, and productivity.

3\. Performance \& Talent Management

* Manage annual and mid\-year performance review cycles, including timelines, KPIs, documentation, and follow\-up.
* Partner with managers to establish clear performance objectives and KPIs.
* Monitor completion and quality of performance appraisals.
* Support managers in managing underperformance and developing **Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs)**.
* Track employee performance and identify high\-potential employees and development opportunities.
* Support succession planning and internal talent development initiatives.

4\. Compensation, Benefits \& HR Operations

* Support the review and benchmarking of salary structures, benefits, incentive schemes, bonuses, allowances, and leave policies.
* Assist management in reviewing compensation trends and making recommendations where appropriate.
* Coordinate with payroll teams to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing.
* Review payroll\-related information and identify discrepancies or irregularities.
* Manage and maintain employee records, HR documentation, and personnel information.
* Ensure HR processes and employee information are accurate and up to date.

5\. HRIS \& Systems Management

* Oversee and maintain the company's **Human Resources Information System (HRIS)** and other HR\-related platforms.
* Ensure employee information, attendance, leave, claims, payroll, and other HR data are accurately maintained.
* Work with HRIS vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve system issues and improve HR processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate and streamline manual HR processes.
* Ensure HR systems are effectively utilised by employees and managers.

6\. HR Reporting, Analytics \& Management Information

* Prepare regular **HR reports and dashboards** for management review.
* Track and report key HR metrics including:
* Headcount and manpower utilisation
* Recruitment and vacancies
* Employee turnover and retention
* Absenteeism and attendance
* Overtime and manpower costs
* Leave utilisation
* Payroll and compensation trends
* Performance review completion
* Training and development
* Analyse HR data and identify trends, issues, and areas for improvement.
* Provide management with insights and recommendations based on HR data.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual HR reports as required.
* Maintain accurate HR records and ensure reports are supported by reliable data.

7\. Manpower Costing \& Forecasting

* Prepare and maintain **manpower budgets and workforce cost forecasts**.
* Analyse current manpower costs against approved budgets.
* Forecast manpower costs based on headcount plans, salary adjustments, new hires, resignations, overtime, and business expansion.
* Work closely with Finance and department heads to monitor manpower expenditure.
* Highlight potential manpower cost increases and recommend cost\-effective staffing solutions.
* Support management in workforce planning and budgeting exercises.

8\. Compliance, Policies \& Employee Documentation

* Ensure HR practices comply with applicable employment laws, regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Stay updated on changes in employment legislation and advise management on relevant HR implications.
* Conduct periodic HR compliance checks and audits.
* Develop, review, and update HR policies, procedures, employee handbooks, and employment documentation.
* Ensure proper documentation of employee disciplinary matters, grievances, performance issues, and other HR cases.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure employee information is handled appropriately.

9\. Learning \& Development

* Identify skills and competency gaps across departments.
* Work with managers to identify training and development needs.
* Coordinate internal and external training programmes.
* Maintain training records and monitor employee participation.
* Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements.
* Support career development and employee growth initiatives.

10\. HR Process Improvement \& Business Partnership

* Review existing HR processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and implement efficient HR workflows, SOPs, and policies.
* Partner with department managers to understand operational challenges and provide practical HR solutions.
* Support management in HR\-related projects, organisational changes, and business initiatives.
* Provide HR advice and guidance to managers on employee\-related matters.
* Take ownership of HR projects and ensure timely completion.

Core Qualifications \& SkillsExperience

* **3–6 years of experience** in HR Generalist, HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, or a similar HR role.
* Experience managing multiple HR functions and working closely with department managers.
* Experience in manpower planning, HR reporting, or workforce analytics will be an advantage.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in **Human Resources, Business Administration, Management**, or a related field.

Technical Skills

* Proficient in HRIS and HR management platforms.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets and HR reporting.
* Comfortable working with HR data, reports, manpower costing, and forecasting.
* Experience with payroll, attendance, leave, recruitment, and employee management systems.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.

Soft Skills

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent active listening and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong negotiation and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Good leadership, coaching, and stakeholder\-management abilities.
* Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
* Proactive and able to work independently.
* Able to handle confidential and sensitive employee matters professionally.
* Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance **employee needs, operational requirements, and business objectives**.

Key Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Timely and effective recruitment and manpower planning.
* Accuracy of HR records, payroll coordination, and HR reporting.
* Effective management of employee relations and performance matters.
* Improved employee engagement and retention.
* Accurate manpower budgeting and forecasting.
* HR compliance and timely implementation of policies.
* Effective utilisation of HR systems and process improvements.
* Quality and timeliness of HR insights and recommendations provided to management.

Pay: $3,500\.00 \- $4,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Professional development
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

* Process maps for the selected manufacturing processes.

Candidates should be available for the internship attachment as part of their academic programme.

title: Ship Manager (Heavy Lift)
description:
**Role Purpose**

The Ship Manager for the Heavy Lift Vessels is responsible for representing the owner’s interests for heavy lift vessels managed by third\-party Ship Management. The role ensures that vessels are safely operated, correctly maintained, cost effectively managed, and commercially fit to support Swire Shipping’s breakbulk and heavy lift business. Swire Shipping is both Owner and Operator/Charterer of the vessels.


This role requires strong technical understanding and ownership of Heavy Lift vessel performance, with particular focus on vessels equipped with high\-capacity cargo cranes, typically two cranes of 150MT or above, and either two\-stroke or four\-stroke main engine configurations. The role acts as the key interface between Swire Shipping, third\-party ship managers, charterers/operations, class, flag and insurance/legal teams.


Although this is an Owner Representative role, it requires a strong understanding of operational, technical and budgetary requirements. The ideal candidate has both sea\-going experience and shore\-based ship management experience, such as Ship Manager or Technical Superintendent. Regular vessel visits are required to ensure the vessels are properly maintained and meet the required standards.  

  



**Role Accountabilities**

1\. Vessel Ownership and Ship Manager Oversight


* Act as Owner’s Representative for assigned heavy lift vessels managed by third\-party ship management companies.
* Ensure assigned vessels are safely operated, correctly maintained, kept within approved budgets and maintained to a standard that satisfies operational and commercial needs.
* Monitor agreed KPIs for vessel and manager performance, including safety, technical reliability, maintenance, cost, crewing, class status, drydock performance and operational readiness.
* Meet regularly with ship managers, normally monthly, to review vessel condition, performance, KPIs, outstanding defects, budget status, crewing matters and planned maintenance performance.
* Maintain open cooperation and communication between Swire Shipping and ship managers to ensure lessons learnt, technical knowledge and best practices are shared.
Escalate any matters to Swire Shipping’s Fleet Manager  
* 

2\. Heavy Lift Technical and Operational Capability


* Provide technical oversight specific to heavy lift vessels, including cargo crane reliability, crane maintenance strategy, structural condition, lifting appliance certification, cargo gear readiness and safe heavy lift operational capability. As well as Cargo Hold and hatch cover maintenance and structural integrity.
* Ensure ship managers understand and support the commercial requirements of breakbulk and heavy lift operations, including cargo sensitivity, project cargo requirements, port constraints, lifting plans, deck strength limitations, lashing/securing arrangements and schedule reliability.
* Work closely with commercial, operations, marine assurance, cargo, QA and technical stakeholders to ensure vessels are suitable and prepared for heavy lift and breakbulk employment.
* Review technical risks affecting heavy lift operations, including crane downtime, hydraulic and electrical crane systems, cargo hold condition, hatch cover integrity, ballast capability, stability considerations, lifting gear condition and main engine reliability.
Provide guidance to ship managers and internal stakeholders on carriage requirements for breakbulk, project cargo and heavy lift cargoes.  
* 

3\. Vessel Condition, Class and Compliance


* Monitor each vessel’s class status and ensure ship managers plan and complete surveys in a timely manner.
* Ensure statutory, class, flag and lifting appliance requirements are properly understood, planned and executed by ship managers.
* Inspect each vessel “officially” at least once per 6 months and submit a written condition report. Poorly performing vessels, or vessels with repeat technical or crane reliability issues, should receive more frequent inspections.
* Review vessel condition with particular attention to main propulsion, auxiliary machinery, cargo cranes, deck equipment, hatch covers, ballast systems, hull structure, cargo holds, lifting gear and heavy lift readiness.

4\. Drydockings, Repairs and Technical Projects


* Attend drydockings and major repair periods to protect the owner’s interests, review scope, monitor quality, control cost and approve major expenditure where authorized.
* Review and challenge drydock specifications, especially for crane overhaul, steel repairs, cargo hold preparation, hatch cover work, main engine and auxiliary engine overhauls, ballast systems and statutory survey items.
* Collaborate with ship managers and relevant internal stakeholders on upgrades, modifications or special projects required for heavy lift and breakbulk trading.
* Ensure lessons learnt from drydockings, breakdowns, crane failures, cargo\-related incidents and off\-hire events are captured and shared with relevant managers and internal teams.

5\. Budget, Cost and Performance Management


* Review, challenge and monitor vessel operating budgets, drydock budgets and unbudgeted expenditure requests, ensuring owner’s funds are spent responsibly and aligned with operational needs.
* Consider and approve unbudgeted expenditure requests from ship managers within delegated authority, maintaining accurate records for management review.
* Monitor vessel speed, consumption and technical performance, and instruct ship managers to take corrective action where performance becomes excessive or inefficient.
* Assess the cost and operational impact of crane defects, machinery issues, off\-hire, cargo delay, port delay and drydock overruns.
* Support initiatives that improve vessel reliability, fuel performance, maintenance effectiveness and commercial availability.

6\. Crewing, Sea Staff and Manager Performance


* Monitor technical and operational performance of ship managers and provide guidance where agreed standards or KPIs are not met.
* Maintain a practical record of sea staff performance and provide feedback to managers so strong performers are retained and underperforming personnel are developed or replaced where appropriate.
* Ensure vessels are crewed with personnel who understand heavy lift, breakbulk, project cargo and cargo crane operations.
* Promote strong onboard safety culture, technical discipline and operational ownership among senior officers and ship managers.

7\. Commercial


* Ensure charterer, customer and internal commercial requirements are properly collated, understood and conveyed to ship managers for appropriate action.
* Act as a technically credible partner to commercial and operations teams when assessing vessel suitability for heavy lift cargoes, project cargoes, breakbulk parcels and special cargo requirements.
* Provide timely input on technical limitations, crane capability, cargo gear readiness, vessel performance, drydock timing, defect risk and operational constraints.
* Handle insurance and technical claims by collating costs, reports, invoices and supporting documentation for submission to the claims department.
* Support investigation and follow\-up of machinery damage, crane failures, cargo gear incidents, cargo damage, off\-hire events, safety incidents and operational claims.
Ensure corrective and preventive actions are followed through with ship managers and relevant stakeholders.  
* 

  

8\. Reporting and Escalation


* Report regularly on assigned vessels’ technical, crewing, QA, cargo\-readiness and operational matters to the Fleet Manager
* Provide clear summaries of vessel performance, risks, costs, condition, drydock status, class matters, crane reliability and key operational issues.
* Escalate high\-risk issues promptly, especially those affecting safety, heavy lift capability, commercial commitments, class/statutory compliance, budget exposure or vessel availability.

9\. Safety


* Take responsibility for personal safety and the safety of those around them by demonstrating safety leadership principles.
* Challenge and stop unsafe acts, unsafe behaviours or unsafe conditions.
* Comply with applicable Global and company Safety Standards, policies and operating procedures.
* Promote a strong onboard and shore\-based safety culture for heavy lift and breakbulk operations, with particular focus on lifting operations, working at height, suspended loads, cargo securing, machinery safety, permit\-to\-work discipline and contractor management.

**Key Qualifications \& Skills**

Essential Qualifications


* Class 1 Motor Certificate of Competency, or equivalent senior marine engineering qualification.
* Significant sea\-going experience as Chief Engineer on international trading vessels
* Shore\-based experience as Ship Manager, Technical Superintendent, Fleet Manager or Owner’s Representative.

Heavy Lift and Breakbulk Experience


* Demonstrated Chief Engineer experience on heavy lift, multipurpose, project cargo or breakbulk vessels, preferably with vessels fitted with two heavy lift cranes of 150 tonnes or above.
* Strong understanding of cargo crane systems, lifting appliance maintenance, crane structural integrity, hydraulic/electrical crane systems, certification requirements and heavy lift operational risks.
* Strong affinity with the breakbulk and heavy lift business, including appreciation of customer requirements, project cargo sensitivity, schedule reliability, cargo readiness and the commercial consequences of technical downtime.
* Experience with both two\-stroke and four\-stroke main engine configurations is preferred.
* Practical knowledge of heavy lift vessel drydockings, crane overhauls, cargo hold preparation, deck strength considerations, hatch cover maintenance and project / breakbulk cargo.

Technical Skills


* Strong understanding of ship management, drydocking, newbuilding or modification projects, class rules and flag requirements.
* Strong technical knowledge of marine engineering systems, planned maintenance, machinery reliability, defect management and condition\-based decision making.
* Ability to review budgets, drydock specifications, technical proposals, repair quotations and unbudgeted expenditure requests.
* Ability to assess vessel condition and translate technical findings into practical commercial and operational risk language.
* Familiarity with performance monitoring systems and the ability to act on speed, consumption and vessel performance concerns.

Professional Skills


* Strong ship manager governance and stakeholder management skills.
* Credible communication style with ship managers, vessel senior officers, class, flag, insurers, internal technical teams, commercial teams and customers.
* Strong judgement in balancing safety, cost, commercial urgency and long\-term asset integrity.
* Ability to challenge constructively and drive corrective action when ship manager performance, vessel condition or heavy lift readiness falls below expectations.
* Experience in ship repairs, drydocking and ship management.
Experience managing or influencing technical teams, ship managers or owner\-side stakeholders is desirable.

description:

Pro Bono SG (PBSG) is a registered charity and Institution of a Public Character committed to our vision of Justice For All. We work with the legal profession, community partners and volunteers to improve access to justice for vulnerable and disadvantaged individuals and communities.

We are looking for a people\-oriented and proactive HR Executive Officer / Senior Executive Officer to join our Human Resources team.

**Learning, Engagement \& Employee Experience**

* Coordinate training administration, including course arrangements, registrations, attendance records, evaluations and related documentation.
* Support employee engagement, wellness, team\-building and staff activities, including planning, logistics and post\-event evaluation.

**HR Projects \& Process Improvement**

* Support and, where appropriate, take ownership of HR projects and initiatives, including the rollout of practical interventions and creative people\-related initiatives.

Pro Bono SG is a Singapore\-registered charity dedicated to improving access to justice for the vulnerable. **Client Relations and Experience** is a client\-centric function that is instrumental in driving client development and unlocking commercial opportunities through exceptional experiences across in\-store, out\-of\-store, and international events touchpoints.  



As **Louis Vuitton’s Senior Manager, Client Relations and Experience, South Asia** , you will spearhead client engagement strategies for High\-End activations, with a particular emphasis on cultivating, retaining, and growing our top client segments. This role will work across South Asia zone (Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, and Philippines) and closely with the Client Development resources in the local markets and Client Experience resources in Central.

**High End Clientelling Leadership \& Strategic Planning**  

Define and lead the High\-End Clientelling strategy in setting clear priorities, targets, and developing tailored client strategies to enhance loyalty, engagement, and lifetime value within High\-End categories

**Work Experience/Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Fashion, or a related field

**Other requirements:**

This role requires international travel approximately once per month


***LOUIS VUITTON***
**MAISON**
------------------------------

Founded in Paris in 1854, Louis Vuitton perpetuates the ambitious vision of its namesake. From his origins as a master trunk maker, manufacturing boxes used to pack both everyday objects as well as voluminous wardrobes, Louis Vuitton and his successors introduced numerous innovations including the advent of the flat\-top trunk, lightweight canvas, signature patterns, and the tumbler lock. Today, Louis Vuitton’s legacy is expressed through its rigorous spirit of innovation, the boldness of its creations and an uncompromising demand for excellence.

* Support customs clearance activities by providing accurate documentation and responding to requests from logistics providers or customs authorities.
* Resolve shipping discrepancies, documentation issues, and customer inquiries in a timely manner.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance shipping efficiency, documentation accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
* Assist in the development and implementation of written export transportation procedures and filing maintenance
* Conduct systematic controls to ensure adherence to local and international transport and customs regulations as well as Company policies and procedures
* Perform other logistics and shipping\-related duties as assigned.

 **Main Qualifications:**

* Diploma in Logistics or relevant field of studies
* Minimum 2–5 years of experience in shipping, export logistics, or international trade.
* Experience preparing shipping documentation and Letter of Credit (LC) documentation.
* Familiarity with Incoterms, international shipping practices, and export/import regulations.
* Experience using ERP systems such as SAP and Microsoft Office applications.

**Competencies:**

* Good knowledge of the transportation supplier landscape
* Good knowledge of local and international material/product safety, security, norms, and regulations
* Strong understanding of supply chain processes and dependencies
* Strong knowledge of Incoterms, Dangerous Goods (DG), customs and trade laws, and local transportation compliance requirements
* Effective communication and problem solving skills

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**You're the brains behind our work.**
  

You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long\-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when.

  

  

**What is Services?**  

Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting\-edge technology, and client\-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world.
  

In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI\-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio.  



  

**We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.**  

The Services Analyst Program is a 2\.5\-year rotational program designed to help you build a broad skill set and accelerate your career growth by gaining exposure to multiple areas within the Services business. The program begins in July and starts with an intensive training and orientation to give you a strong foundation in both the business and Citi's culture. You will then rotate across two different roles within Services based on your interests and the needs of the business, gaining meaningful experience through hands\-on projects and exposure to senior leaders.  



  

**Your time here will look something like this:**

* Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors.
* Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth, identifying opportunities where data\-driven insights and AI capabilities can add value. This may involve contributing to business cases for new AI\-driven product features or improvements to existing services.
* Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk, potentially exploring how AI/ML tools can automate tasks or improve decision\-making. Evaluate the effectiveness of AI\-powered automation in improving operational workflows and reducing manual effort.
* Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings, leveraging various analytical techniques, including interpreting insights derived from advanced analytical models. You will be exposed to how AI models are used to segment clients, predict behaviors, and personalize service delivery.
* Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership, effectively communicating complex data analysis and potentially insights from AI\-driven tools. Clearly articulate the implications and benefits of AI\-generated insights for business strategies.
* Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development.

**We want to hear from you if…**

* You are in your final year of college, graduating between December 2026 and June 2027\.
* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., data analysis, lookups, basic modeling) and have working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook. Exposure to analytical platforms or an eagerness to learn about AI\-specific tools (e.g., natural language processing applications, machine learning dashboards) will be beneficial.
* You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn how technology, including AI, is transforming the industry. Demonstrated curiosity about how AI is being leveraged for efficiency, client experience, and risk management is key.

**Who we think will be a great fit…**  

We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone—not just those with business degrees—can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for:


* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent communication skills.
* A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail, including a proactive interest in understanding AI methodologies and their application in real\-world business scenarios.
* Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously – self\-starter.
* A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn.
* Resilience to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently.

**Your future at Citi**  

During the program, you will have access to mentorship, career development sessions, and networking opportunities with senior leaders and professionals across Citi. This experience is designed to provide you with a strong foundation to launch a long\-term career within the firm, preparing you for a future where technology and AI play an increasingly central role. You will develop skills that are not only relevant today but are also essential for navigating the evolving landscape of AI\-driven financial services.

  

  

Join us and take the first step toward shaping the future of Citi!
