Job Summary
  
  

Within Technology \& Operations (T\&O), the Information \& Cyber Security (ICS) function is delivering a Target Operating Model within the ICS 1st line of defence to drive more accountability across our services, to optimise operations as well as to accelerate the delivery of risk reduction across the Bank. This will enable the ICS organisation to invest in new capabilities to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and ensure the delivery of the Group ICS Strategy.
  
  

The CISO for WRB \& Markets will lead the Wealth and Retail Banking (WRB) business alignment to the Group ICS Strategy, risk mitigation and remediation including maturing the 1st line ICS operating model. In addition, this role will assume responsibility for the ICS risk for the clusters / regions except for Europe \& Americas. This will involve providing oversight over the relevant cluster CISOs and ensuring that the applicable markets are adhering to the risk management framework and associated processes in order to facilitate appropriate risk management.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Strategy
  
* Defining WRB \& Markets / Countries Information and Cyber Security strategy and socialize to enhance awareness within WRB \& Markets, working closely with WRB \& Markets CIO and COO’s and countries CEOs
* Determining key ICS threats and risks to WRB business and their mitigation plans
* Supporting the business achieving its outcome considering ICS journey
* Track and align ICS adoption and execution to the ICS risk reduction initiatives with key enterprise programmes (Obsolescence remediation, Cloud Adoption, etc.)
* Identify and independently drive strategic change initiatives to deliver on the ICS agenda with a forward\-looking view to support business growth areas
* Develop insightful strategies for engaging WRB \& Markets on information security matters, ensure investments are prioritised and funding is approved.


Business
  
* Support the WRB business to autonomously dynamically manage the ICS PRT within appetite
* Heading the WRB ICS Program supporting WRB in risk remediation
* Identify and manage ICS risk within the WRB business and represent ICS risk to WRB Risk Committee, Regional/Country Risk Forums/Committees and key in scope regulators/ industry bodies (as required)
* Supporting WRB \& Markets in ICS risk remediation
* Supporting other Group Businesses (CIB \- Corporate and Investment Banking) and Functions from a cluster / Markets perspective in meeting their risk reduction targets
* Establish communication channels and information flows with Business, Regional and Country MTs, various first and second\-line teams mobilised to deliver ICS risk reduction for WRB \& Markets
* Educate Senior executives regarding ICS Risks to drive accountability across the business
* Accountability for operation of the ongoing risk framework including new and ongoing ICS obligations including regulatory requirements


Processes
  
* Accountable for WRB ICS and PCD program governance and assurance, including finance oversight
* Focal Point for OTCR, GIA and external audit engagements regarding WRB \& Markets ICS matters


People \& Talent
  
* Excellent organisation and leadership skills with ability to manage multiple deadlines and effectively prioritise
* Exceptional engagement skills with ability to motivate and influence other leaders towards a collective positive outcome for the Business.
* Excellent communication skills
* Employ, retain, and develop WRB \& Markets ICS talent with succession plans
* Mature the 1st line ICS Operating Model for WRB \& Markets. Ensure the right talent and skill sets are in place
* Provide leadership, management and coaching to direct reports to ensure they are highly engaged and performing to their potential.
* Ensure the 1st line ICS organisation is adequately resourced and staffed by competent staff to ensure successful delivery
* Maintain strong stakeholder engagement with Group, Cluster and Country IT, Function, COO, OCTR, Risk \& Control stakeholders to bring alignment across stakeholder groups in conjunction with ICS risk management.


Risk Management
  
* Responsible for ICS risk end\-to\-end on behalf of Group CISO.
* Support CEO, WRB to dynamically manage the ICS PRT
* Direct accountability and responsibility for ICS Risk and its management within appetite for the region and countries on behalf of Group CISO
* Identity and assess ICS risks, including controls mitigation across NIST domain and SCB ICS Framework and prioritise remediation actions.
* Deliver ICS risk reduction and mitigation working with OTCR, CISO and ICS domains.
* Drive compliance of Group policies and standards across WRB and ensure that business take into consideration ICS regulatory requirements.
* Recommend additions/enhancements/changes to the ICS policy, procedures, and RTF (Risk Type Framework)
* Understand and assess the impact of changes in the policy or procedures on the respective Business / Cluster and engage with the respective Business / Cluster Heads to ensure the impact is understood.
* Provide oversight over ICS control adoption and execution to the ICS risk reduction initiatives with key enterprise programmes (Obsolescence remediation, Cloud Adoption, Azure DevOPS, etc.)
* Provide deep consulting expertise on complex projects, delivering workable and risk/threat\-driven solutions
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies and how they can be secured


Governance
  
* Establish and drive ICS Risk Governance Forums for WRB \& Markets
* Ensure key risk and issues are monitored and appropriately addressed by key stakeholders
* Govern ICS across WRB and report on progress to various committees
* Lead 1st line ICS representation to Risk Committees, key regulators and industry bodies.


Regulatory \& Business Conduct
  
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across the Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead WRB \& Markets to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
* Engage external agencies / third parties to understand the threat environment and reported events; assess impact for the WRB domain


Key stakeholders
  
* Group CISO
* WRB / Clusters / Countries CEO
* WRB / Clusters / Countries Risk Committee Members (Legal, Audit, Compliance, Conduct, Op Risk, Business Heads etc.)
* OTCR
* WRB / Clusters COO
* WRB Global Head, Business Risk Management
* WRB / Cluster CIO and LT
* WRB / Cluster and Countries CIOs
* WRB / Cluster and Countries COOs
* WRB OTCR
* ICS MT
* T\&O MT
* CTOO Clusters


Our Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Degree in Engineering, Computer Science/Information Technology, or equivalent
* Understanding of the Cyber landscape and ICS Controls
* Proven ability to lead highly complex, global, pan\-bank, multi\-year programmes by driving collaboration and participation by functions, Regions and countries.
* Extensive change and programme management experience, ideally gained in the financial industry
* Strong knowledge of the underlying technologies supporting Cyber Security capabilities
* Experience in Information Security and Banking and Financial Services
* Strong knowledge of ICS products and operations will be preferred
* Strong knowledge of cyber security frameworks, information security principles, architecture, and cryptography
* Exposure or hands\-on experience in infrastructure / web application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments is preferred
* Ability to articulate gross and residual risk with specific ability to clearly, concisely and accurately communicate complex technology and process risk to non\-technical stakeholders in a lucid way
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, across various levels in the organisation including senior leadership teams, in influencing key decisions taken in the business and in support teams.
* Strong communications – oral, written and presentation. Sound knowledge of MS Office Suite.
* Must be a self\-starter who is able to initiate and successfully drive programs and projects to completion with little or no management supervision
* Strong analytical skills and ability to prioritise, make decisions, and work to tight timeframes.
* Strong business acumen and deep knowledge and experience in the ICS field
* Proven ability to lead complex, global activities through influence and credibility rather the command and control
* Ability to both access strategic priorities and to focus on details aspects of a function in order to drive effective delivery.
* Strong integrity, independence and resilience.


Certifications
  
* One or more of the following certifications will be preferred:


o Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
  
o Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  
o SANS Global Information Assurance Certifications (GIAC)
  
o Certified in Risk \& Information Systems Control (CRISC)
  
o Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)

title: Director, Site Start Up
description:
Precision for Medicine is a Clinical Research Organization. Precision's uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry\-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas.



Due to our continued growth we are seeking a **Director, Site Start Up**



Position Summary: Provides leadership to the Site Start\-up (SSU) department. Contributes to the strategy and direction of the implementation and expansion of the SSU department in terms of people, processes and systems. Collaborates with other functions to secure SSU delivery and client satisfaction on SSU activities (typically, these include activities such as Informed Consent Form review and adaptation, Regulatory Document collection and quality review, Support to Regulatory and sites on IRB/EC/CA submissions and support to Site Contracts group in budget and contract negotiation). Works closely with the Head of Site Start Up on the ongoing development of SSU . Ensures the conduct and delivery of clinical trials in compliance with Regulatory requirements (local and regional), ICH Guidelines, Good Clinical Practices (ICH) and SOPs.



Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:  

* Provides SSU team with guidance, leadership and overall support relating to SSU project delivery, communication, human resources, revenue enhancement, procedures, systems and processes to meet client and departmental targets.

* Supports the overall management of site start up delivery either by direct management and/or cross functional oversight of the depts involved in the different areas of site start\-up (Local/Central IRB/Ethics Committee (EC) submissions, Competent Authorities (CA) submissions, other related governing organizations/bodies, site contracts and budget negotiations and any other start up requirements).


* Works closely with the Head of Site Start Up to establish the Precision for Medicine (PFM) SSU framework to ensure project execution and delivery including SSU intelligence, tools and methodology, risk evaluations and mitigations.


* Supports SSU collaboration with Clinical Operations team, project management and other relevant cross functional departments in the planning, execution and governance of SSU activities globally and/or regionally


* Works with the Head of Site Start Up to support defined corporate and departmental business strategies for PfM


* Acts as an ambassador for change management for evolution of global structure for PFM growth and expansion


* Provide leadership and oversight on SSU programs including large programs or programs that are increasingly complex (in scope, revenue contribution, volume and design)


* Manage escalations and remediation of SSU concerns timely and effectively


* Supports optimization of processes and delivery with the goal of contributing to the profitability of the SSU teams to meet or exceed budget targets


* Partner with Global Resourcing teams for assessment and management of team members (SSU leads, SSU Specialist and Site Contract Management staff) to ensure that established cost, time, and quality goals are met


* Supports SSU team career development, growth and succession planning activities. Ensures compliance with company policies and procedures and other applicable regulatory guidelines


* Supports coordination of SSU Lead's participation in current and prospective client meetings and presentations to ensure PfM customer service is well represented


* Collaborates with Business Development in opportunity development, proposals and budgeting, bid defense preparation and attendance for any SSU participants


* Works with global/regional functional leaders to support SSU project strategy and SSU delivery


* Supports SSU evaluations and implements required changes for all projects


* Develop, measure and report SSU KPIs and lead continuous improvement


* Recognize, exemplify, and adhere to PFM's values that center on our commitment to quality, our people, clients and performance


* Leverage communication skills and experience to reinforce PfM culture and values to motivate, maintain engagement and drive retention for SSU team

  

Requirement :  

* Bachelors degree in life sciences or related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years in clinical research including extensive experience of Site Start\-up
* Extensive leadership experience or proven competencies for this position.
* Expert knowledge of GCP/ICH guidelines and the clinical development process.


Other Required:  

* Demonstrated leadership track record
* Experience working in team environment with resource management experience
* Experience with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and clinical software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC etc)
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with others in a team setting
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer service demeanor
* Proven experience in strategic planning, risk management and change management
* Fluency in English.


Any data provided as a part of this application will be stored in accordance with our Privacy Policy. For CA applicants, please also refer to our CA Privacy Notice.



Precision Medicine Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.



If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Precision Medicine Group at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com.


**Recruitment Fraud Warning:** Please be aware that fraudulent individuals and websites may impersonate Precision Medicine Group or its affiliates and attempt to obtain personal, financial, or banking information through fake job postings or employment offers. Precision Medicine Group will never request payment, banking details, or other sensitive financial information as part of the recruitment process. If you believe you have been targeted by a recruitment scam, we encourage you to report the incident to your local law enforcement authorities, consumer protection agency, or relevant cybercrime reporting organization in your country. Please also notify us at myHR@precisionmedicinegrp.com so we can investigate and take appropriate action.

title: Technical Services Executive - Asia
description:
Join our dynamic corporate team and become part of Aman Group. With offices strategically located around the world (Zug, London, Dubai, Singapore, Bangkok, Miami and New York), our corporate colleagues are at the forefront of driving innovation and excellence for our ultra\-luxury brand.


**Role**  

Join Aman Group’s dynamic corporate team and play a key role in shaping the design excellence behind one of the world’s leading ultra\-luxury hospitality brands. Reporting to the Director of Design \& Technical Services \- Asia, the Technical Services Executive, based in the Singapore Corporate Office supports the development, coordination, and delivery of projects across the region, ensuring Aman’s exacting standards and brand objectives are consistently upheld.


This role offers exposure across multiple projects and disciplines, working closely with internal stakeholders, consultants, and project teams to deliver thoughtful, refined, and technically robust design solutions.  



**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate design activities across internal teams and external consultants to support seamless project delivery.
* Prepare meeting agendas, record minutes, and follow up on actions to ensure alignment and accountability.
* Develop, monitor, and update project and design program schedules, tracking key milestones and deliverables.
* Collaborate with corporate teams and external project teams to manage information flow and data exchange efficiently.
* Assist in the preparation of project presentations, reports, and internal documentation.
* Organise and maintain comprehensive project records, including drawing logs, review comments, and approval trackers.
* Track project schedules, Aman Standards checklists, design briefs, and deliverables across multiple projects.
* Review and monitor consultant submissions, including drawings, reports, and material boards, ensuring timely responses.
* Participate in project and coordination meetings, supporting design and technical guidance in line with Aman brand standards.
Manage and update the Technical Services team’s Smartsheet project management tools, coordinating inputs across teams.  
* 

  

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in architecture, Interior Design, or a related design discipline.
* Eligibility to work in Singapore.
* Minimum of 3 years’ professional experience as an architect, interior designer, design coordinator, or in a related role.
* Experience with luxury hotel, resort, or branded residential project delivery; operator\-side experience is an advantage.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to liaise confidently with multiple stakeholders.
* Fluency in written and spoken English; additional languages are desirable.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with Bluebeam Revu or similar tools is an advantage.
* Strong work ethic, discretion, and cultural sensitivity, with the ability to work independently under pressure.
Willingness to travel as required to support regional projects.  
* 

**Benefits**

At Aman Group, we believe our colleagues are at the core of our success. We offer competitive benefits, including exciting global career opportunities within a rapidly expanding company. We prioritize and support your professional journey, ensuring you feel valued, included, and at home.

* Support AI and advanced analytics initiatives that improve production effectiveness, predictive maintenance, yield optimization, and supply chain performance.

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing complexity, improving user experience, and increasing operational efficiency.
* Partner with regional and plant leadership teams to ensure operational priorities are aligned with available Digital resources.
* Oversee vendor relationships, contracts, licensing, and support agreements for manufacturing technologies.

* Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, robotics, machine learning, advanced analytics, and Industry 4\.0 technologies.
* Lead proofs\-of\-concept and pilot programs to validate new manufacturing technologies.
* Establish frameworks to scale successful innovations across Molex's global manufacturing network.
* Promote adoption of smart factory principles and connected manufacturing capabilities.
* Drive measurable business outcomes through digital transformation initiatives.
* Champion a culture of experimentation, learning, and operational innovation.

* Develop a deep understanding of Molex manufacturing processes, operational strategies, and business objectives.
* Support digital capabilities across diverse manufacturing environments and product portfolios.
* Enable technology solutions that improve production efficiency, quality performance, asset utilization, and workforce productivity.
* Partner with engineering, quality, and operations leaders to ensure digital investments drive measurable business value.
* Align manufacturing technology strategies with Molex's culture of operational excellence, continuous improvement, and innovation.

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

* Strong knowledge of MES, QMS, WMS/MMS, ERP platforms (SAP preferred), Industrial IoT, Manufacturing Analytics, and Industry 4\.0 technologies.
* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale digital transformation and cross\-functional initiatives.
* Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and collaborate across global organizations.

* Experience in electronics manufacturing, industrial manufacturing, or highly engineered product environments.

description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Team Summary:


The Global \& Regional Tech Partnerships team is responsible for developing, launching and scaling new solutions with Bigtechs and Regional Platforms. Working closely with Visa’s Product and Solutions teams and other teams to identify and pursue opportunities to deliver value propositions that leverage Visa and Tech platforms’ combined scale and reach. The team will focus on both, card\-based and non\-card solutions.

  

The role is based in the Singapore Market Support Centre and will report to the Senior Director, Tech Partnerships, Asia Pacific.


What a Director – Regional Tech Partnerships does at Visa:

* Identify and execute partnership opportunities with Regional Technology platform companies to drive growth across card and non\-card commerce.
* Develop and execute partner roadmaps that address customer needs, solve business challenges, and support Visa's growth objectives.
* Collaborate with Product, Technology, Client Services, Sales, Legal, and Risk teams to deliver new solutions from concept through commercialization.
* Lead the delivery and scaling of Visa products and capabilities with Regional Technology platform partners.
* Support Market teams in achieving revenue, payment volume, and product adoption targets through effective partner execution.
* Develop and articulate compelling business cases and value propositions to internal and external stakeholders.
* Manage a portfolio of strategic technology partners and build trusted relationships across business, product, and engineering teams.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment to accelerate implementation, commercialization, and market expansion initiatives.
* Support commercial negotiations, renewals, and expansion opportunities with key technology partners.
* Stay current on developments in the technology, fintech, and payments ecosystem, including new products, industry trends, and regulatory changes.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**


What you will need:

* 10\+ years of relevant industry experience within technology partnerships, business development, consulting, product management and/or commercial roles.
* Strong expertise in the payments industry across card\-based payments, A2A payments, local payment methods, and emerging digital payment solutions.
* Demonstrated experience managing strategic client or partner relationships within the technology, fintech, or payments ecosystem.
* Proven track record of leading complex cross\-functional initiatives from concept through implementation in a digital or fintech environment.
* Strong program management capabilities, with experience driving solution development and delivery end\-to\-end with internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience developing business cases and articulating compelling value propositions across a broad portfolio of products and solutions.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience evaluating partnership opportunities, commercial structures, and growth strategies.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong ability to lead both business and technical discussions with technology\-first companies.
* Experience working across multiple markets in the Asia Pacific region.
* Strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities and a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and drive business outcomes.
* Structured and analytical approach, with strong attention to detail and a focus on delivering high\-quality results.
* Understanding of Visa's business, products, and organization is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus.
* Hands\-on and entrepreneurial, with the ability to operate effectively in a highly matrixed global organization.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Vice President, Global Corporate Sales, Transaction Banking Office for Asia
description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long\-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.


With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.


Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.


**Purpose of role:**

We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic candidate with a proven track record in Regional Transaction Banking Sales to add to our existing team’s expertise across Cash \& Liquidity Management and Trade \& Supply Chain Finance. This role will provide an opportunity for strategic thinking and leadership as the candidate will work in close partnership with Regional Coverage teams to identify and develop business opportunities and drive sales initiatives for their focus client portfolio. Reporting to the Head of Department (Director), the successful candidate will contribute to the delivery of regional sales targets through proactive pitching and execution of regional cash and trade solutions to the Bank’s multinational clients.


The individual must be able to demonstrate excellent communication and presentation skills as well as a strong sales mindset. He/she must have direct experience leading conversations with large multinational corporates, preferably at a top global transaction bank.


**Job Responsibilities:**

**Strategic:**

* Contribute to the delivery of Regional Transaction Banking revenue targets \& Sales KPIs
* Deepen the Bank’s transaction banking wallet share across Cash \& Liquidity Management and Trade Finance solutions with identified customers

**Financial**

* Delivery of team’s revenue targets for assigned client portfolio

**Customer**

* Lead and develop strong effective relationships with key customers to capture new business and to deliver a high quality of sales service
* Continuous proactive client engagement to understand their changing Working Capital and Liquidity need and find solutions to support these treasury objectives
* Anticipate as well as be sensitive to shifting customer expectations and consider appropriate measures to ensure the Bank stays ahead of competitors
* Develop and maintain strong stakeholder management with internal and external parties
* Work in partnership with various teams in the Bank (including Coverage, Product, Operations etc.) to support in delivering a seamless experience to our clients
* Work in partnership with colleagues in Transaction Banking Product Development to provide feedback and guidance on customer requirements and market trends

**People**

* Be an effective partner with Regional Coverage, Transaction Banking and Global Markets colleagues
* Proactively collaborate with Bank’s global and regional stakeholders to drive opportunity identification and revenue realization

**Other/ Control**

* Prepare presentation material for senior level customers
* Review all deal proposals to ensure pricing, product offerings and the structuring of the deal is aligned to business strategy, delivers a high quality of service and mitigates risk for the Bank
* Understand Transaction Banking issues raised by customers and seek commercial solutions to solve the issues
* Proactively review the performance of the solutions implemented to ensure they meet customer’s expectations
* Manage the risk profile of the department's portfolio by contributing to pipelining/account planning discussions to select financially healthy customers
* Develop and lead departmental initiatives to deliver increase revenue opportunities and deliver a high quality of service
* Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and limits
* Maintain good working knowledge of industry trends, products, relevant laws and regulations
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert in Cash Management and/or Trade Finance Product Sales to management

**Job Requirements**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a similar field.
* Minimum 8 years of banking experience 4 of which in Transaction Banking
* Experience working in or supporting transaction banking business alongside knowledge and experience working in Cash \& Liquidity Manager or Trade \& Supply Finance
* In depth knowledge in structuring Transaction Banking deals
* Strong understanding of the Transaction Banking landscape and market trends
* Strong verbal \& written communication skills with the ability to influence others and build client relationships
* Ability to work independently and as part of a tight team
* Ability to multi\-task and work under competing project deadlines
* Sharp analytical skills for strategic thinking and problem solving
* Collaborative and capability to work efficiently with internal stakeholders
* Solution\-oriented mindset
* Experienced in driving deals including regional RFPs \& multi\-country client pitches

*We regret to inform that only shortlisted applicants will be notified.*

Rakuten International is a division of Rakuten Group, Inc., a Japanese global technology leader in services that empower individuals, communities, businesses and society. Situated in the heart of Singapore's Central Business District, Rakuten Asia Pte. Ltd. is Rakuten's Asia Regional headquarters. Established in August 2012 as part of Rakuten's global expansion strategy, Rakuten Asia comprises various businesses that provide essential value\-added services to Rakuten's global ecosystem. Through advertisement product development, product strategy, and data management, among others, Rakuten Asia is strengthening Rakuten Group's core competencies to take the lead in an increasingly digitalized world.


The division you will be working for is Rakuten Advertising. Rakuten Advertising leads the industry in delivering performance\-driven, brand\-driven and people\-driven ad solutions. We help the world’s top brands connect with unique, highly engaged audiences – from first impression to final sale. At Rakuten Advertising, our calling card is outthinking the competition and outperforming your expectations. Our experienced and award\-winning full\-service teams work to create the best ad experiences for brands, audiences and affiliates alike – one where people get the right message at the right time to drive attention, action, loyalty and value.

 **Job Summary:**  

In this role, you will be responsible for relationship management with an assigned portfolio of clients. You will serve as a client liaison throughout the delivery of client service engagements or outsourced solutions. You will be strategically focused and responsible for maintaining client satisfaction by ensuring consistent and proactive communications with clients while completing tasks that support the overall performance of the clients’ affiliate programs.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinates somewhat complex client interactions, ensuring timely responses and resolution of moderately challenging requests or issues.
* Analyzes somewhat complex client feedback and data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement, informing strategic decisions.
* Develop somewhat complex client engagement plans, tailoring approaches to meet specific client needs and align with business objectives.
* Implements client management best practices and processes to enhance satisfaction and streamline workflows.
* Identifies opportunities to strengthen client relationships through proactive communication and value\-added solutions.
* Communicates key insights, updates, and recommendations to direct manager, internal stakeholders, facilitating alignment and collaboration.
* Evaluates the effectiveness of client relationship strategies, recommending adjustments to improve outcomes.
* Documents client interactions and outcomes in CRM systems, ensuring accurate and up\-to\-date records for reference and reporting.
* Take the lead on developing affiliate program strategies for your priority clients. Take ownership of your Key Accounts’ affiliate programs. Plan and execute campaigns to drive sales with affiliate publishers that leads to the increase of Rakuten Advertising revenue. Owning revenue and forecasting for own client portfolio.
* Establish and maintain regular and appropriate communication with the key contact(s) for the client through meetings, emails, calls and support tickets. Agree milestones to track improvement in relationships and revenue. Constantly align goals and direction with the clients and help the clients meet their targets.
* Bring a solution mindset to your day\-to\-day work. Where problems exist, collaborate with others to identify ways to improve performance or efficiency
* A commercial mindset to your day\-to\-day account management, proactively identifying new business opportunities including expanding into new markets, upgrading Rakuten Advertising service level with the clients. By asking questions during your client calls, as well as reading news about your clients and their industries.
* Demonstrate a high attention to detail. No errors in campaign strategy, planning or execution
* Demonstrate a fast learning and adapting capability, quickly adjust to the fast\-changing technologies and industry trends.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Minimum 2\-3 years of experience in account management (client\-facing)
* Bachelor's Degree Required
* Having Japanese language capabilities (JPLT N1 / Business level) or Korean language capabilities (Business level) will be highly advantageous
* Experience in performance marketing, preferably affiliate marketing experience preferred
* Understanding performance marketing tracking technology preferred
* Experience in Asia cross border e\-commerce, or travel industry highly preferred
* Experience in strong client relationships, reinforced by building trust, advising and upselling preferred
* Exemplary written and oral presentation skills and a talent for presenting

*Rakuten is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications regardless of sex, marital status, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, religious belief, or age.*

description:
**Who are we?**
===============


Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no\-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like\-minded people driving change at Howden.

**Role:** **Alternative Risk Transfer (ART) \& Captive Solutions Analyst**

**Who Are We?**


Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. We help clients navigate risk in an increasingly complex world through innovative insurance, risk management, and capital solutions. Our collaborative culture, entrepreneurial mindset, and commitment to client advocacy enable us to deliver differentiated outcomes for organizations across a wide range of industries.

**Position Summary**


The Alternative Risk Transfer (ART) \& Captive Analyst will support the design, analysis, implementation, and ongoing optimization of captive insurance programs and other alternative risk financing solutions for clients. This role is ideal for an analytically minded professional interested in the intersection of insurance, finance, actuarial analysis, and risk management.


Working closely with brokers, consultants, actuaries, captive managers, underwriters, and clients, the Analyst will assist in evaluating risk financing alternatives, conducting financial analyses, preparing client deliverables, and supporting captive feasibility studies.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Captive \& Alternative Risk Analysis**

* Support captive feasibility studies, including loss data analysis, financial modeling, and benchmarking.
* Assist in evaluating existing captive programs and identifying optimization opportunities.
* Analyze client loss history, exposure data, and program structures to support alternative risk financing recommendations.
* Prepare financial comparisons between traditional insurance placements and alternative risk transfer solutions.

**Financial Modeling \& Data Analytics**

* Build and maintain financial models to evaluate captive performance and potential returns.
* Analyze underwriting results, claims trends, retained risk costs, and total cost of risk.
* Support actuarial reviews and interpretation of loss projections.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and presentations that translate complex data into actionable insights.

**Client \& Market Support**

* Assist in the preparation of client presentations, proposals, and renewal strategies.
* Coordinate with captive managers, fronting carriers, reinsurers, and other service providers.
* Research market trends, captive domiciles, and emerging alternative risk solutions.
* Participate in client meetings and support project execution.

**Program Implementation \& Administration**

* Support the implementation of new captive programs.
* Assist with documentation, governance requirements, and project management activities.
* Coordinate data collection and information requests across internal and external stakeholders.
* Monitor program results and assist with stewardship reporting.

**Qualifications:**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Risk Management, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, Actuarial Science, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, including financial modeling and data analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred**

* 5\-8 years of experience in insurance brokerage, risk consulting, actuarial analysis, finance, accounting, captive management, or a related field.
* Exposure to captive insurance, alternative risk transfer, self\-insurance, or reinsurance concepts.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, or other analytical tools.
* Progress toward or interest in professional designations such as ARM, CPCU, ARe, or actuarial credentials.

**What We're Looking For**

**Successful candidates will demonstrate:**

* Intellectual curiosity and a strong desire to learn complex risk financing concepts.
* Critical thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills.
* Comfort working with large data sets and financial information.
* Interest in insurance innovation, alternative risk financing, and capital management strategies.

**Compensation and Benefits**


The expected base salary range for this role is $170,000 \- $180,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).


In addition to a competitive base salary, employees are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave
* Life and Disability insurance

**Our sustainability promise**


We’re on a life\-long journey to become an ever\-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here.

**What do we offer in return?**
===============================


A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

* Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
* We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
* We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

**Reasonable adjustments**
==========================


We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours\* or hybrid working\*.


If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

* Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

**About NUS Development Office**
--------------------------------

This is a strategic communications role. You will work to shape how philanthropy is understood and valued across the NUS community, donors and the pubic – helping to influence perceptions, shift mindsets and build a stronger culture of giving, participation and shared ownership of the University’s mission.


**The Role**

NUS Giving connects people with opportunities to shape lives, advance knowledge and create lasting impact through philanthropy.


We are looking for a versatile and creative communications professional who can turn complex institutional and fundraising priorities into clear, compelling narratives and content. Based within the Strategic Communications team, you will help shape how NUS Giving presents its priorities, impact and stories to different audiences.


You will work closely with fundraising teams, faculties and partners across NUS to understand their objectives, clarify the message and determine the most effective way to communicate it. Your work will help shape how philanthropy is understood and valued across the NUS community, donors and the public — influencing perceptions, shifting mindsets and building a stronger culture of giving, participation and shared ownership of the University’s mission.


This is both a strategic and hands\-on role. You may be developing the narrative and key messages for a major fundraising initiative one day, interviewing a donor or beneficiary for an impact story the next, and producing a speech, video, campaign asset or social media post after that.


The ideal candidate combines strong editorial judgement and institutional awareness with the ability to create engaging content across written, visual and digital formats.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------

You will shape narratives, messages and communications approaches for fundraising priorities, institutional initiatives and key audiences, translating complex university, research and philanthropic priorities into accessible and persuasive communications. This includes developing cases for support, campaign narratives, messaging frameworks and other strategic communications materials.


You will advise stakeholders on positioning, messaging, tone and communications approaches, and partner with fundraising teams and faculties from the early stages of projects to shape narrative and content direction. You will ensure communications are accurate, consistent and aligned with the NUS Giving brand and wider institutional context, while identifying and managing potential communications sensitivities.


You will source and conduct interviews with donors, beneficiaries, faculty members, staff and partners, turning interviews, research and source materials into engaging written, visual and multimedia content. This may include donor stories, web content, campaign copy, speeches, reports, proposals and email communications.


You will adapt strategic narratives across digital, social, email, print, video and in\-person channels; create or adapt visual and multimedia content such as social media assets, short\-form videos, presentations, infographics and simple animations; and repurpose strong content to extend its reach and value. Audience insights and content performance data should inform future communications.


You will also help strengthen the team’s creative and editorial capability by managing projects from briefing and research through concept development, production, review and delivery. This includes developing templates and editorial resources, working with external partners when specialist expertise is required, and thoughtfully applying AI and emerging tools to research, drafting, editing and content production while critically reviewing outputs for accuracy and authenticity.


**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

You should have a recognised degree and approximately six to 10 years of relevant experience in strategic communications, content, journalism, publishing, marketing communications, creative services or a related field.


You will bring exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear, engaging and persuasive, together with strong editorial judgement and an understanding of institutional, stakeholder and reputational considerations.


You should have experience developing narratives, messages and content for different audiences and communications channels, as well as strong creative judgement and the ability to work across written, visual and digital formats. Hands\-on proficiency with content creation and design tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, CapCut or similar platforms is expected. Experience producing digital, social or multimedia content is important, while video creation and editing capabilities would be an advantage.


You should understand audience needs, digital communications and content performance, and be able to balance strategic thinking, creative execution, accuracy and deadlines. Strong interpersonal and presentation skills are essential, including the confidence to advise stakeholders and build alignment.


You May Be a Good Fit If You
* instinctively look for the clearest and most compelling way to frame a story;
* are comfortable shaping communications strategy and producing the final content;
* can see the broader institutional context behind an individual campaign or request;
* enjoy turning complex material into accessible and engaging communications;
* are able to move confidently across written, visual and digital formats;
* exercise sound judgement when handling sensitive stories and stakeholders; and
* want to use your skills to support education, research and positive social impact.
  

Applicants are encouraged to submit a portfolio or examples of written, visual, digital or multimedia work.

* Experience working with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.

* Familiarity with PMO governance standards and enterprise delivery frameworks.

* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* High level of judgement, accountability, and attention to detail.

* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

title: Controls Engineer , AWS Control, Deployment and Service Team
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia\-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems which monitor and ensure the health of our data centers. APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers six disciplines of deployments, projects, service, colo, on\-call support, and management.  

  

Controls Deployment \& Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade collocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.  

  

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.  

  

To be successful in this team, you will also have:  

  

* Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
* Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
* Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand\-Off (PFHO)
* Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
* Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
* Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

  

A day in the life  

* Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom\-designed processors and chips.
* Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission\-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
* Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
* Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
* Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry\-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
* Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
* Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
* Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
* Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
* Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. **About the Role**
------------------

We are a lean, high\-conviction investment firm focused on the global AI hardware and infrastructure ecosystem — investing across US technology leaders, Taiwanese foundries and packaging houses, Japanese semiconductor equipment suppliers, and South Korean memory manufacturers.


We're hiring an AI Equities Analyst to be our in\-house technical expert — someone who can sit through an earnings call and immediately spot what matters, and who can translate a research paper or a fab capacity announcement into an investment thesis.


**No prior finance or investment experience is required.**

We'll teach you financial modeling, valuation, and how buy\-side research actually works. What we cannot teach as quickly is genuine technical fluency — that's what you bring on day one.


**Why This Role Is Different**
------------------------------

* **Direct access, real ownership.** You'll work side\-by\-side with the Portfolio Manager, not buried in a large research team. Your read on a technology shift can move the portfolio the same week.
* **A built\-for\-you path into buy\-side investing.** Most technical experts who want to move into investing take a pay cut, go back for an MBA, or spend years in a generalist analyst pool first. This role skips all three.
* **Small firm, real scope.** You'll cover the full AI hardware value chain — from silicon to systems to model architecture — across four markets, not a narrow sub\-sector.

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------

2–3 years of hands\-on industry experience in at least one of:


* Silicon \& Hardware Systems Engineering
* Data Center \& Infrastructure Engineering
* AI Model Architecture \& Algorithmic Research
* Technology Evaluation \& Market Intelligence (e.g., technical product management, competitive intelligence, developer relations)

If you've spent your career close to the technology — writing the code, designing the silicon, running the infrastructure, or evaluating vendors — and you're curious what that expertise is worth on the buy\-side, this role is written for you.


**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Decode the technology.** Be the team's go\-to translator for hardware announcements, model architecture papers, product roadmaps, and trade press across the AI value chain.
* **Separate signal from hype.** Assess shifts like advanced node transitions, packaging constraints, liquid vs. air cooling, custom ASICs vs. GPUs, Mixture\-of\-Experts, quantization, and inference optimization — and judge what's technically real and economically meaningful.
* **Track the ecosystem.** Follow industry research, trade publications, AI lab and software updates, and earnings transcripts to map supply\-demand trends, component lead times, and software lock\-in dynamics.
* **Shape portfolio decisions.** Partner directly with the Portfolio Manager to explain why a shift matters, which companies hold durable technical moats, and where bottlenecks will redirect industry revenue.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Materials Science, Data Science, or a related STEM field.
* **Experience:** 2–3 years of hands\-on work in semiconductors, hardware engineering, data center infrastructure, AI model development/research, or technical market research.
* **Curiosity \& Communication:** A genuine passion for AI hardware and software, and the ability to explain technical concepts in plain, intuitive language.
* **Nice to have:** Ability to read technical materials or trade press in Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean — useful for tracking APAC supply chain news firsthand.

**Compensation\& Growth**
-------------------------

* **Base salary from S$8,000/month** — with flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional depth or a rare skill match —plus performance\-linked annual bonus.
* **A funded, direct transition** into buy\-side equity research. No pay cut, no MBA required.
* **Flat structure.** You'll work directly with the Portfolio Manager from day one, with your analysis feeding real investment decisions — not a research queue.

Submit your CV along with a one\-page write\-up on *one* technical trend in AI hardware, data center infrastructure, or AI model architecture from the past 12 months that you find genuinely interesting — and why. No cover letter or finance resume needed. Email to hr@luminousam.com.sg

title: Junior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**

OCO Info Comm Pte Ltd is a Singapore\-based technology solutions provider specializing in IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, network integration, AI infrastructure, IoT systems, and enterprise communication solutions.


We design, implement, secure, and maintain technology environments for customers across Singapore and Southeast Asia. Our projects cover on\-premises data centers, AWS and Microsoft Azure cloud platforms, Linux and Windows servers, networking, cybersecurity hardening, monitoring systems, container platforms, and AI computing infrastructure.


We are looking for Junior Infrastructure Engineers to support our daily infrastructure operations and customer implementation projects.


**Position Overview**

As a Junior Infrastructure Engineer, you will work with senior engineers and project managers to maintain internal and customer IT infrastructure, troubleshoot technical issues, and implement new systems.


This is a hands\-on position suitable for fresh graduates or junior engineers who want broad exposure to enterprise infrastructure, cloud computing, networking, cybersecurity, and system integration.


Training and guidance will be provided. However, candidates should be willing to learn independently, perform technical research, document their work, and take ownership of assigned tasks.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure Operations and Maintenance**

* Perform daily health checks on servers, network devices, applications, backups, and monitoring systems.
* Monitor infrastructure alerts and service availability using tools such as CloudWatch, or equivalent platforms.
* Carry out routine Linux and Windows server administration.
* Perform operating system patching, software updates, account administration, log reviews, and capacity checks.
* Check backup jobs and assist with backup restoration and recovery testing.
* Investigate infrastructure alerts and resolve basic incidents according to established procedures.
* Escalate complex incidents to senior engineers while providing clear diagnostic information.
* Maintain incident records and follow assigned cases through to resolution.
* Assist with preventive maintenance and infrastructure housekeeping.

**Project Implementation**

* Assist with the installation and configuration of physical and virtual servers.
* Support the deployment of systems in AWS, Microsoft Azure, customer data centers, and office environments.
* Assist with network implementation, including switches, firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, routing, and IP addressing.
* Support the deployment of monitoring, logging, backup, security, and infrastructure management solutions.
* Assist with Linux and Windows server migrations, upgrades, and system replacements.
* Support cloud, container, Kubernetes, IoT, AI infrastructure, and cybersecurity implementation projects.
* Participate in system testing, user acceptance testing, commissioning, and project handover.
* Attend customer sites when physical installation, troubleshooting, or testing is required.
* Work with vendors, customers, software developers, and other project stakeholders.

**Security and Compliance**

* Assist with operating system hardening based on CIS Benchmarks and company security standards.
* Perform basic vulnerability remediation and verify the implementation of security patches.
* Review system and security logs for unusual activities.
* Support firewall rules, access controls, VPN connectivity, antivirus, endpoint protection, and security monitoring.
* Follow change\-management, access\-control, data\-protection, and information\-security procedures.
* Assist with the collection of technical evidence for security reviews, audits, and compliance activities.

**Documentation and Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain system configuration documents, network diagrams, asset records, and implementation checklists.
* Record commands, configuration changes, test results, and troubleshooting actions clearly.
* Create and update standard operating procedures and technical knowledge\-base articles.
* Prepare maintenance reports, incident summaries, and project implementation records.
* Ensure customer credentials, configurations, and confidential information are handled securely.
* Provide clear progress updates and promptly report technical risks or delays.

**Technical Skills**

Candidates should have foundational knowledge in some of the following areas. Training will be provided for technologies in which the candidate has limited experience.


* Linux administration, such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CentOS Linux, Ubuntu, or Amazon Linux.
* Microsoft Windows Server and basic Active Directory administration.
* TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, routing, VLANs, VPNs, and firewall concepts.
* Virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper\-V, or KVM.
* AWS or Microsoft Azure cloud fundamentals.
* Server hardware, storage, RAID, backup, and recovery concepts.
* Infrastructure monitoring and log\-management concepts.
* Basic cybersecurity principles, operating\-system hardening, patching, and access control.
* Basic scripting using Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
* Containers, Docker, Kubernetes, databases, or web servers would be advantageous.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with one to two years of experience in IT support, system administration, cloud operations, network support, or infrastructure implementation are preferred.
* Relevant certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, CCNA, CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Security\+, Red Hat, or Linux certifications would be advantageous but are not mandatory.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong interest in infrastructure, cloud computing, networking, and cybersecurity.
* Willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and perform technical research.
* Systematic and patient approach to troubleshooting.
* Able to follow technical procedures while understanding when escalation is required.
* Responsible and able to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Careful when working with production systems and customer information.
* Able to communicate clearly with colleagues, customers, and vendors.
* Good documentation and organizational skills.
* Able to work independently after receiving appropriate guidance.
* Comfortable working in a project\-based environment with changing technical requirements.
* Willing to travel to customer sites when required.
* Willing to participate in scheduled maintenance or after\-hours implementation work when necessary.

**Working Arrangements**

* Location: Singapore
* Employment type: Full\-time
* Work may be performed from the company office, customer sites, data centers, or remotely, depending on project requirements.
* Occasional evening or weekend work may be required for planned maintenance and production implementation.
* Any on\-call or after\-hours support arrangement will be communicated separately.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunities to work with Linux, Windows, AWS, Azure, networking, cybersecurity, containers, AI infrastructure, and IoT platforms.
* Guidance and mentoring from experienced infrastructure and system\-integration professionals.
* Technical training and opportunities to pursue relevant industry certifications.

Candidates with home labs, cloud projects, Linux experience, scripting samples, technical certifications, or other hands\-on learning experience are encouraged to include them in their applications.

Speedcargo is a Physical AI company building the technology stack that air cargo has been waiting for. Our core platform — **Cargo Eye** , **Assemble Planner** , **Assemble Builder** and **Cargo Arm** — is built on AI, Computer Vision, Complex Non\-Linear Optimisation, Combinatorics, Computational Geometry, and Large\-Scale Robotics, solving genuinely NP\-hard problems at the core of how air cargo is planned, built, and moved. We digitize and optimize one of the world's most under\-digitized industries: a $150B market where up to half of every plane still flies empty and 100% of cargo build\-up is still done by hand.


This isn't off\-the\-shelf software. Every deployment means adapting these systems to how a specific airline actually operates, and working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with their teams to change decades\-old physical processes on the warehouse floor. We're not a software house selling a standardized product — we're a deep\-tech company whose engineers own the full stack, from the hard mathematics at the core to the operational rollout.


**We're now in the middle of a company\-defining, multi\-year engagement** : deploying our full platform across the global network of one of the largest and oldest air cargo airlines in the world, endorsed and directly backed by the client's C\-level leadership. It's rolling out in phases — **Asia first, then the US, then Europe** — and is expected to anchor Speedcargo's global expansion for the next five years. This is the project that will define Speedcargo's next chapter, and the person in this role will be one of the people who defines it.

* Get close to the customer: work directly with airline engineering and operations teams during deployment, testing, and go\-live — not just shipping code, but helping redesign how cargo build\-up actually happens on the ground
* Shape how our products adapt to real airline operations — feeding field learnings back into the core platform rather than treating deployment as someone else's problem
* Interact directly with client leadership and stakeholders as a trusted technical voice on a C\-level\-backed transformation
* Drive sprint planning, code quality, and delivery timelines that balance fast iteration with the reliability mission\-critical airline operations demand
* Travel globally as needed to support deployments across Asia, the US, and Europe — this is a role that lives close to the deployment, not behind a screen
* Help lay the technical and operational groundwork for the next five years of Speedcargo's global scale\-up

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent coding ability with strong fundamentals in **software design patterns, data structures, and algorithms**
* Proven experience **leading or managing engineering teams** , ideally distributed across multiple locations
* Strong hands\-on experience with: **Golang, Python, C/C\+\+, React, Shell scripting, REST APIs, MongoDB, SQL**

* You're comfortable with the ambiguity and pace of an early\-stage startup — priorities shift, and you adapt

This is a rare moment: a senior technical leadership seat on a live, C\-level\-backed enterprise transformation with one of the largest and oldest air cargo airlines in the world — not a pilot, not a POC, an active five\-year global rollout expanding from Asia into the US and Europe. You'd be joining as we scale it, with direct exposure to customer leadership and real influence over both the platform's technical core and the team building it. title: Tier 2 SOC Analyst / Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Tier 2 SOC Analyst/Engineer to serve as the escalation point for our Tier 1 SOC team. This role owns in\-depth investigation of escalated alerts, performs root cause analysis, leads incident response activities, and drives detection engineering and threat hunting initiatives to continuously mature our security monitoring program. You will be a technical anchor for the SOC — turning raw alerts into confirmed incidents, confirmed incidents into lessons learned, and lessons learned into better detections.


Department: Security Operations Center (SOC)


Reports to: SOC Manager


Works closely with: Tier 1 SOC Analysts (escalation point), Detection Engineering, IT Infrastructure, Application Development


\#\# Key Responsibilities


\*\*Escalation \& Investigation\*\*


* Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Tier 1 analysts on alerts requiring deeper analysis
* Conduct in\-depth investigations across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and application telemetry
* Correlate data across multiple tools/log sources (SIEM, EDR, NDR, cloud logs, identity providers) to determine scope and impact
* Distinguish true positives from false positives and refine triage logic accordingly

\*\*Root Cause Analysis\*\*


* Perform root cause analysis on confirmed incidents to determine initial vector, method, and any control gaps
* Document attack timelines/kill chains and produce clear technical findings for stakeholders
* Identify systemic issues (misconfigurations, missing patches, process gaps) surfaced during investigations

\*\*Incident Response\*\*


* Lead or co\-lead containment, eradication, and recovery activities for security incidents
* Coordinate with IT, engineering, legal, and management during active incidents per the IR plan
* Author incident reports, timelines, and post\-incident/lessons\-learned reviews
* Support tabletop exercises and continuous improvement of IR playbooks and runbooks

\*\*Detection Engineering\*\*


* Design, build, test, and tune detection rules/use cases (SIEM correlation rules, EDR detections, Sigma rules, etc.)
* Translate threat intel, incident findings, and threat hunt results into new or improved detections
* Reduce alert fatigue by improving detection fidelity and eliminating noisy/low\-value alerts
* Map detections to a framework such as MITRE ATT\&CK to identify and close coverage gaps

\*\*Threat Hunting\*\*


* Conduct proactive, hypothesis\-driven threat hunts using threat intelligence, ATT\&CK TTPs, and anomaly analysis
* Identify indicators of compromise or adversary behavior not caught by existing detections
* Convert hunt findings into new detection logic and share findings with the broader team

\*\*Mentorship \& Process\*\*


* Mentor and provide technical guidance to Tier 1 analysts, including escalation reviews and knowledge transfer
* Contribute to and maintain SOC playbooks, runbooks, and standard operating procedures
* Support onboarding of new log sources, tools, and data feeds into the SOC's monitoring scope
* Participate in an on\-call/escalation rotation as needed

\#\# Required Qualifications


* 3\+ years of hands\-on SOC experience, with demonstrated progression into Tier 2/senior analyst responsibilities
* Strong understanding of the attack lifecycle, common TTPs, and the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
* Hands\-on experience with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, Elastic) — writing/tuning correlation rules and queries
* Experience with EDR/XDR tools (e.g., CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, TrendAI) for endpoint investigation
* Solid grasp of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, proxies) and ability to read packet captures
* Experience with incident response processes: containment, eradication, recovery, and post\-incident reporting
* Familiarity with cloud security monitoring (AWS/Azure/GCP logs, IAM, CloudTrail or equivalent)
* Scripting/automation skills (Python, PowerShell, or similar) for detection logic, parsing, or workflow automation
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical findings for non\-technical stakeholders
* Ability to remain calm and methodical under pressure during active incidents

\#\# Preferred Qualifications


* Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, CySA\+, OSCP, or equivalent
* Experience writing Sigma, YARA, or Snort/Suricata rules
* Experience with SOAR platforms for playbook automation
* Familiarity with digital forensics tools and techniques (memory/disk forensics)
* Experience with threat intelligence platforms and integrating IOC feeds
* Prior experience mentoring or training junior analysts

\#\# What Success Looks Like


* Reduced mean\-time\-to\-detect (MTTD) and mean\-time\-to\-respond (MTTR) for escalated incidents
