title: Tier 2 SOC Analyst / GRC Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Tier 2 SOC Analyst/Engineer to serve as the escalation point for our Tier 1 SOC team. This role owns in\-depth investigation of escalated alerts, performs root cause analysis, leads incident response activities, and provides Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) consultancy to clients pursuing ISO/IEC 27001 certification and the Singapore Cyber Trust Mark. You will be a technical anchor for the SOC — turning raw alerts into confirmed incidents and confirmed incidents into stronger, audit\-ready security postures for the clients we support.


Department: Security Operations Center (SOC) \& Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC) team


Reports to: SOC Manager (with parallel reporting to GRC Lead)


Works closely with: Tier 1 SOC Analysts (escalation point), Detection Engineering, IT Infrastructure, Application Development


\#\# Key Responsibilities


\*\*Escalation \& Investigation\*\*


* Serve as the primary technical escalation point for Tier 1 analysts on alerts requiring deeper analysis
* Conduct in\-depth investigations across endpoint, network, cloud, identity, and application telemetry
* Correlate data across multiple tools/log sources (SIEM, EDR, NDR, cloud logs, identity providers) to determine scope and impact
* Distinguish true positives from false positives and refine triage logic accordingly

\*\*Root Cause Analysis\*\*


* Perform root cause analysis on confirmed incidents to determine initial vector, method, and any control gaps
* Document attack timelines/kill chains and produce clear technical findings for stakeholders
* Identify systemic issues (misconfigurations, missing patches, process gaps) surfaced during investigations

\*\*Incident Response\*\*


* Lead or co\-lead containment, eradication, and recovery activities for security incidents
* Coordinate with IT, engineering, legal, and management during active incidents per the IR plan
* Author incident reports, timelines, and post\-incident/lessons\-learned reviews
* Support tabletop exercises and continuous improvement of IR playbooks and runbooks

\*\*Governance, Risk and Compliance (Client Consultancy)\*\*


* Provide consultancy services to clients pursuing ISO/IEC 27001 certification, including gap analysis, ISMS design/implementation guidance, and Statement of Applicability (SoA) support
* Advise and support clients through the Singapore Cyber Trust Mark certification process, including preparation, control implementation guidance, and readiness assessments
* Conduct risk assessments and help clients build/maintain risk registers and risk treatment plans
* Develop and review client\-facing security policies, standards, and procedures aligned to ISO 27001 Annex A and Cyber Trust Mark requirements
* Support clients through internal audits, certification audits, and surveillance audits, including evidence preparation and audit findings remediation
* Manage multiple client engagements concurrently, including scoping, timelines, and client communication

\*\*Mentorship \& Process\*\*


* Mentor and provide technical guidance to Tier 1 analysts, including escalation reviews and knowledge transfer
* Contribute to and maintain SOC playbooks, runbooks, and standard operating procedures
* Support onboarding of new log sources, tools, and data feeds into the SOC's monitoring scope
* Participate in an on\-call/escalation rotation as needed

title: Digital Marketing Intern
description:
**Our Team**
------------

Cintra Consultancy is a Singapore\-based business and creative consultancy that helps brands grow through strategy, content, media, and digital execution.


We work with businesses across different industries to develop social media content, digital campaigns, brand strategies, and marketing assets that support measurable business outcomes.


At Cintra, marketing is not just about generating views, clicks, or impressions. Our work must support the client’s wider business objectives, whether that means generating leads, increasing sales, building brand awareness, or improving customer acquisition.


Our team works in a fast\-paced agency environment where interns gain exposure to real client campaigns, paid media planning, campaign execution, performance reporting, creative testing, and day\-to\-day digital marketing operations.


**Your Role**
-------------

Cintra Consultancy is looking for a Performance Marketing Intern to support our performance and account teams across paid advertising campaigns, campaign reporting, market research, creative testing, and digital marketing execution.


This role is best suited for someone who is analytical, organised, curious about how digital advertising works, and interested in understanding how businesses use paid media to generate measurable results.


You do not need to be an experienced media buyer, but you should have a strong interest in digital marketing, paid advertising, data analysis, consumer behaviour, and campaign optimisation.


You will work closely with the performance marketing, creative, and account teams to support campaigns across platforms such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other relevant digital channels.


You may also support the team in reviewing campaign creatives, preparing reports, conducting competitor research, and identifying opportunities to improve campaign performance.


We are looking for someone who can start interning from July onwards, on a full\-time basis.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Paid Campaign Support**

Assist the performance marketing team with the setup, monitoring, and management of paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.


Support the preparation of campaign structures, audience targeting, budgets, placements, advertisements, and campaign timelines.


Assist with checking campaign links, forms, tracking parameters, landing pages, and advertising assets before campaigns go live.


Monitor active campaigns and flag unusual changes in spending, delivery, leads, conversions, or other performance indicators.


Help maintain accurate records of campaign budgets, spending, results, and deliverables.


### **Performance Reporting and Analysis**

Assist in collecting and organising campaign data from different advertising platforms.


Support the preparation of weekly, monthly, and campaign\-end performance reports.


Track key performance indicators such as reach, impressions, clicks, click\-through rates, cost per click, cost per lead, conversion rates, return on advertising spend, and other relevant metrics.


Help identify trends, performance issues, and possible areas for campaign improvement.


Translate campaign data into clear observations and actionable recommendations for the internal team and clients.


### **Research and Campaign Planning**

Conduct research on target audiences, competitors, industries, advertising trends, and digital marketing best practices.


Assist in developing audience profiles, campaign angles, messaging directions, and advertising strategies.


Review competitor advertisements through platforms such as the Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Google search results, and other available sources.


Support the team in preparing campaign proposals, media plans, performance forecasts, and internal campaign briefs.


Stay updated on changes to advertising platforms, digital trends, campaign formats, and consumer behaviour.


### **Creative Testing Support**

Work with the creative team to develop and organise advertising concepts, hooks, headlines, captions, calls to action, and visual references.


Assist in reviewing campaign creatives to ensure that they follow the approved strategy, platform requirements, and advertising objectives.


Support the development of creative testing plans involving different messages, formats, audiences, and campaign angles.


Help document the results of creative tests and identify which advertisements, hooks, visuals, or messages perform best.


Assist with coordinating advertising materials between the creative, performance, and account teams.


### **Campaign Operations and Account Support**

Support the coordination of campaign timelines, deliverables, approvals, and client requirements.


Assist in organising campaign files, reports, creative assets, tracking sheets, and project documentation.


Work with the account team to ensure that campaign updates and performance information are communicated clearly.


Support basic quality checks before advertisements, reports, and campaign materials are submitted internally or to clients.


Assist with other digital marketing, research, reporting, or campaign\-related tasks where required.


**Requirements**
----------------

A strong interest in performance marketing, digital advertising, analytics, consumer behaviour, or business growth.


Basic understanding of paid advertising platforms such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or LinkedIn Ads is preferred.


Experience with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Microsoft Excel, or Google Sheets is an advantage but not required.


Comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, campaign data, and performance reports.


Able to interpret basic marketing metrics and explain what they mean in a clear and practical manner.


Strong research, analytical, problem\-solving, and organisational skills.


Good written and verbal communication skills.


Able to work in a fast\-paced agency environment involving multiple clients, campaigns, deliverables, and timelines.


Detail\-oriented, proactive, responsible, and willing to learn.


Able to work independently while also collaborating closely with the performance, creative, and account teams.


Relevant coursework, personal projects, certifications, campaign experience, case studies, or a digital marketing portfolio are strongly encouraged.


While we value all submissions, we regret that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our team.


  
Cintra Consultancy is a creative and strategic content agency helping brands turn ideas into impact. We specialise in content strategy, social media, and storytelling that drives real engagement and ROI. Whether it’s a full campaign rollout or a scroll\-stopping piece of content, we help businesses show up with clarity, consistency, and character.

description:
### **Semiconductor Reverse Engineering Specialist, AI Domain Expert**


We are seeking an experienced Semiconductor Reverse Engineering Specialist to serve as the core domain anchor for our Eureka Materials AI Agent product. You will collaborate closely with Product Managers and AI Engineers to translate deep semiconductor industry expertise into structured knowledge systems, standardized analytical workflows, and domain\-specific AI capabilities.

  

This is a high\-leverage individual contributor role. You will spend approximately 70% of your time architecting domain knowledge systems, packaging professional workflows into reusable AI Skills, and defining industry\-grade standards for AI retrieval and reasoning. The remaining 30% focuses on high\-value reverse engineering analysis and technical validation to ensure authoritative, industry\-aligned AI outputs. No team management or hands\-on lab equipment operation (TEM/SEM/EDA) is required.

**Want to see the platform you'd be representing?**  

Check out this short overview:

*This is an in\-office position based in our Singapore office.*

#### **Who are we?**


Patsnap is a global, pre\-IPO company that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research \& Development productivity. Our platform revolutionizes how IP and R\&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle, using domain\-specific AI to accelerate the creation of market\-ready products. With over 12,000 customers worldwide, including some of the biggest names in innovation, Patsnap is at the forefront of technological advancement. Our $300M Series E funding round brings our valuation to a $1 billion unicorn status, and we still have a remarkable amount of growth ahead.

  

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in Singapore, Toronto, London, Shanghai and remote teams based in US. Our hyper\-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company\-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.


#### **What You'll Be Doing:**

* Domain Authority: Serve as the semiconductor domain expert for the Eureka Materials Agent, ensuring technical accuracy and industrial practicability for chip, device, and material reverse engineering scenarios.
* Workflow Definition: Partner with product teams to define real\-world use cases, standardized analytical workflows, and industry requirements aligned with professional field practices.
* Logic Transformation: Collaborate with AI engineers to translate reverse engineering expertise into structured domain logic, standardized prompts, technical frameworks, and evaluation benchmarks (including decapsulation protocols, material identification rules, and competitor technology mapping).
* Knowledge Base Architecture: Build and iterate on domain knowledge bases, codifying professional judgment criteria, standard analysis protocols, and industry know\-how into governable, reusable digital assets.
* AI Skill Packaging: Lead the design and packaging of semiconductor\-specific AI Skills, establishing professional standards for intelligent retrieval, technical reasoning, and automated technical report generation.
* Output Validation: Validate AI\-generated outputs to ensure analytical results are technically rigorous, industrially feasible, and consistent with global semiconductor technology trends.
* Optimization \& Iteration: Participate in model evaluation and Bad Case analysis, providing structured domain feedback to continuously improve the AI Agent’s inference accuracy and output reliability.
* Intelligence Tracking: Track global competitor roadmaps and industry evolution, converting technical intelligence into actionable guidance for product iteration and strategic roadmap planning.

#### **What You’ll Be Building:**

* You will help build the Eureka Materials Agent into a trusted industrial AI expert for semiconductor reverse engineering. By bridging authoritative domain knowledge and artificial intelligence, you will shape a next\-generation digital assistant for chip analysis, technical intelligence, and materials R\&D.
* Your exclusive industry expertise will be directly structured into scalable product capabilities and long\-term digital assets.

#### **Core Requirements:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Microelectronics, Semiconductor Science, Materials Science, Electronic Engineering, or related fields, with solid foundational knowledge in device physics, process technology, or failure analysis.
* Experience: 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in semiconductor competitive analysis, process reverse engineering, device teardown, or industrial technology intelligence.
* Structural Thinking: Strong ability to synthesize complex technical experience into structured frameworks, reusable rules, and standardized judgment criteria.
* Soft Skills: Self\-driven, pragmatic, and transparent working style, with genuine curiosity for AI\-driven industrial innovation.
* Note on Coding: No programming, software engineering, or LLM training experience (e.g., Python, PyTorch) is required. Algorithms and engineering are handled by the AI team; your core value is serving as the 'domain brain' to define the strict logic frameworks our models must follow.

#### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Professional background from top\-tier industry intelligence firms (e.g., TechInsights, Yole Group, Lumenci, Sagacious IP) or semiconductor manufacturer technical analysis / FA teams is highly preferred.
* Hands\-on experience in knowledge base construction, business workflow mapping, and technical rule codification.
* Familiarity with semiconductor raw material databases, patent analytics tools, or industry technical data platforms.
* Prior experience partnering with cross\-functional teams to translate domain expertise into digital or AI\-powered product solutions.
* Strong interest in AI Agents, large language models, and industrial AI skill packaging.

* Proven ability to operate — and influence — inside complex or matrixed organizations, building alignment across global product, regional, and country stakeholders without formal authority over any of them.

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.


Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.


With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.


Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We're looking for a **Creative Strategist \& Content Producer** to shape how our health \& pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital \& offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling \& creative assets \- helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally.

The Creative Strategist \& Content Producer will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation \& drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing \& testing **high\-impact creative strategies** as well as **producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally**, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) \& drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee \& Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.

You'll work across multiple channels \& markets to plan, create \& optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships \& supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics \& brand strategy in the health supplement industry.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Creative Strategy**

* **Platform \& Channel Strategy:** Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C \& B2B audiences optimized for platform\-specific best practices \& formats that align with brand goals \& regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e\-commerce banner ads)
* **Hypothesis Generation \& A/B Testing:** Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls\-to\-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click\-Through Rate (CTR) \& Conversion Rate (CVR)
* **Audience Segmentation:** Translate target audience data \& segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)
* **Competitive Analysis:** Continuously keep up to date with competitors \& industry trends, identifying new \& successful creative formats, hooks \& messaging to finetune our strategy

**In\-House Content Production \& Execution** 

* **Performance Creative Development:** Lead the end\-to\-end creative concept development \& production for all organic \& paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand \& campaign goals, focusing on high\-volume, quick\-turnaround testing required for performance marketing
* **Hands\-on Asset Creation:** Directly produce \& edit native social content \& performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries \& internal resources. This includes:
* **Plan platform\-specific content calendars**: Cover educational, promotional \& corporate communications
* **Static/Image Editing:** Adapt product photography, create ad variations \& design simple graphics \& banner ads
* **Video Editing:** Fast\-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music \& effects for short\-form, vertical video (UGC\-style, product demos, testimonials)
* **Generative AI Production:** Utilize AI tools and prompt engineering to efficiently generate high\-quality video and static image assets for rapid content production and testing
* **Copywriting:** Develop high\-converting ad copy, landing page headlines \& social media captions that align with the creative strategy \& brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions \& strong CTAs
* **Asset Management:** Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived \& deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts \& advertising platforms)
* **Testing \& Optimization**: apply insights \& analytics to refine \& optimize content effectiveness across platforms

**Performance \& Reporting**

* **Data\-Driven Insights:** Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee \& Lazada traffic
* **Iteration \& Optimization:**
* Develop, adapt or review content \& formats to improve engagement \& performance
* Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets \& inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement \& optimization
* **Storefront Integration:** Integrate winning creative messages \& visuals onto the respective e\-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey

**Multi\-Channel Storytelling**

* **Content cohesion:** Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital \& print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, e\-commerce platforms, brochures \& trade materials
* **Tailor content:** To achieve relevance \& effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey, from brand awareness \& education to conversion
* **Storytelling \& visual consistency:** To strengthen brand trust \& recognition

**Compliance \& Brand Integrity**

* Uphold regulatory \& ethical communication standards across all marketing activities
* Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines \& marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language \& digital promotions
* Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual \& aligned with company values
* Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness \& compliance before publication

Pay: $3,000\.00 \- $3,500\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Additional leave

title: Technical Marketing Executive
description:
Technical Marketer

**Royal Albatross Singapore \| Full\-Time \| Singapore**

About the Role

Royal Albatross Singapore is looking for a **hands\-on Technical Marketer** who is equally comfortable with **code, digital advertising, data and AI**.

This is not a traditional marketing role, and we are **not looking for someone who simply manages agencies or vendors**.

We want a **builder, problem solver and experimenter** — someone who can identify a problem, find a solution, build it, test it and improve it.

You will work across our websites, paid advertising, analytics, tracking, AI tools and marketing automations to help us generate more leads, bookings and revenue.

What You'll Be Doing Website \& Development

* Build, maintain and improve company websites and landing pages
* Work confidently with **WordPress, HTML, CSS, PHP and JavaScript**
* Troubleshoot website, plugin, tracking and integration issues
* Improve website speed, usability and conversion performance
* Build landing pages and tools to support marketing campaigns

Performance Marketing

* Set up, manage and optimise **Google Ads and Meta Ads**
* Monitor campaign performance, conversions and ROAS
* Conduct A/B tests on ads, audiences, landing pages and offers
* Identify opportunities to improve lead generation, ticket sales and customer acquisition
* Work with the marketing team to turn campaign ideas into measurable results

Analytics \& Tracking

* Manage **Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) and Google Tag Manager (GTM)**
* Implement and troubleshoot conversion tracking, pixels and events
* Ensure marketing attribution and tracking are accurate
* Build useful reports and dashboards
* Use data to identify problems and opportunities throughout the customer journey

AI \& Automation

* Build practical **AI agents, workflows and automations**
* Work with tools such as **ChatGPT/OpenAI, n8n, Make and Zapier**
* Connect platforms using **APIs and webhooks**
* Automate repetitive marketing and operational processes
* Experiment with new AI tools and identify ways they can improve productivity, customer experience and revenue

What We're Looking For

You should be someone who:

* Can **actually code and troubleshoot**, not just brief a developer
* Has hands\-on experience running **Google Ads and/or Meta Ads**
* Understands **GA4, GTM, pixels, events and conversion tracking**
* Has experience with **WordPress and web development**
* Is comfortable working with APIs, integrations and automation tools
* Uses AI tools regularly and is excited about building with them
* Can research and learn new technologies independently
* Thinks commercially and understands that marketing should ultimately produce measurable business results
* Enjoys experimenting, testing and solving problems
* Takes ownership and gets things done

Technical Skills

Experience in several of the following would be highly valuable:

**Web:** WordPress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP  
**Advertising:** Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager  
**Analytics:** GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, conversion tracking  
**AI:** ChatGPT, OpenAI API, AI agents and LLM\-based workflows  
**Automation:** n8n, Make, Zapier  
**Integration:** REST APIs, webhooks and third\-party integrations  
**Other:** SEO, CRM systems, databases, reporting/dashboard tools

You don't need to be an expert in every tool listed above. **Strong technical fundamentals, curiosity and the ability to figure things out are more important.**

The Person We're Looking For

You might have previously worked as a:

* Technical Marketer
* Digital Marketing Specialist
* Performance Marketer with development skills
* Marketing Technologist
* Growth Marketer
* Web Developer with strong digital marketing experience

Your job title matters less to us than **what you can actually build and deliver**.

Why Join Royal Albatross?

Royal Albatross is one of Singapore's most distinctive hospitality and lifestyle experiences.

You'll have the opportunity to work on real commercial challenges across **digital marketing, e\-commerce, hospitality, events and customer experience**, with the freedom to test new technologies and ideas.

This role is ideal for someone who doesn't want to spend their day simply coordinating vendors. We want someone who enjoys **opening the laptop and building the solution themselves.**

How to Apply

Please send us your **CV** together with examples of things you have personally built or managed.

We'd especially like to see:

* Websites or landing pages you've built
* Google or Meta campaigns you've personally managed
* AI agents or automations you've created
* Examples of integrations or technical problems you've solved
* Measurable improvements you've achieved

**Bonus points:** Tell us about one AI automation or technical solution you've built that saved time, reduced costs or increased revenue.

**If you love code, data, marketing and AI — we'd like to hear from you.**

Pay: $4,500\.00 \- $5,500\.00 per month

We are seeking a senior payments Risk professional to establish and lead its risk management function as it prepares to obtain a payment\-services licence. The immediate mandate is to build a proportionate and operationally effective payments risk framework covering the end\-to\-end payment lifecycle, while giving management clear visibility of the risks arising from the company’s payment activities. The role may also provide functional support to other Group businesses while preserving local management accountability.  



  

**1\. Key responsibilities**

* Design, implement and maintain the payments risk framework, policies, standards and supporting procedures in preparation for its payment\-services licence.
* Map the end\-to\-end payment lifecycle and establish controls for merchant and customer onboarding, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation, refunds, chargebacks and operational incidents.
* Develop the risk taxonomy, risk appetite statement, key risk indicators, exposure limits and escalation thresholds for management approval.
* Establish risk governance, committee reporting and a regular risk\-reporting cycle for senior management and relevant governance bodies.
* Lead risk and control assessments across payment products, customer and merchant journeys, operations, technology and third parties, ensuring that owners and remediation dates are clear.
* Build and maintain risk registers, incident and loss\-event reporting, issue management, control testing and monitoring processes.
* Assess and monitor operational, fraud, merchant, counterparty, settlement, liquidity, safeguarding, technology, cyber, outsourcing and business\-continuity risks relevant to the payment business.
* Support the payment\-services licence application and regulatory readiness reviews by demonstrating that the payments risk framework is appropriately designed, documented and embedded.
* Provide independent risk challenge for new payment products, material changes, outsourcing, third parties and other significant decisions.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Finance, Technology, Information Security and business teams to ensure risks are managed consistently and without unnecessary duplication.
* Where agreed, provide functional oversight and support to other Group entities, including the Indonesian finance business, without displacing locally required responsibilities.
* Coordinate with external advisers, auditors and regulators on risk matters when required.

**2\. Requirements:**

* Substantial risk management experience in payments, acquiring, payment processing, e\-money, fintech or another regulated payment environment.
* Demonstrated experience building or materially enhancing a payments risk framework, preferably in connection with a payment\-services licence, regulatory remediation or business scale\-up.
* Strong knowledge of payment flows and associated operational, fraud, merchant, counterparty, settlement, liquidity, safeguarding, technology, cyber and third\-party risks.
* Able to move between framework design and hands\-on implementation, including writing policies, building registers and producing management reporting.
* Strong judgement, independence and stakeholder\-management skills, with the confidence to provide constructive challenge.
* Strong familiarity with Singapore regulatory expectations for payment\-service providers is preferred; relevant risk or payments qualifications are advantageous.

Desirable

What you’ll do


Deploy


* Run pre\-deployment site surveys: floor conditions, traffic, network coverage, charging locations, safety zones, and turn them into a deployment plan

Tune and support

* Diagnose field failures across the whole stack: software, sensors, wiring, network, mechanical, from logs, bag files and live debugging, through to root cause

Hand over and improve

* Genuinely hands\-on with hardware: mounting and aligning sensors, reading wiring and mechanical drawings, using a multimeter, tracing a fault from software symptom to loose connector

* Networking beyond the basics, industrial WiFi surveys, roaming, VLANs
* Docker and CI exposure
* Prior customer\-facing or field engineering experience

**Why this role**
-----------------

* You own deployments end to end, survey to handover, rather than one slice of them
* Travel to customer sites across Asia
* Small team: your fixes ship, and you see them running in production within weeks

**How to apply**
----------------

Send your CV to careers@movel.ai with a short note on one robot or automation system you deployed or debugged in the field, and what went wrong. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: IT Operations Executive
description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

**Open Government Products (OGP)** operates like a startup within the government; We are a fast\-paced, dynamic team of engineers, designers, and product managers dedicated to public good. We autonomously identify opportunities to solve public problems using tech, rapidly prototype, and launch solutions—from citizen apps to automating public agency operations. Embracing an open\-sourced and flat hierarchy, we cut through bureaucracy to focus on real\-world, user\-centric innovations that drive change.

**About the Role**


We're hiring an IT Operations hire to own the execution layer: service desk, device management, onboarding and off\-boarding, and documentation. You will report to the IT Manager and work closely with the Workplace team. This is a hands\-on, on\-the\-ground role. You'll be the first point of contact for IT requests across OGP — the person who makes sure officers can get set up and get unstuck.


On a day\-to\-day basis, this means:

**Service Desk**

* Be the first point of contact for all IT requests via ticketing system, Slack, and email — triaging, responding, and resolving.
* Handle password resets, MFA issues, and basic Okta troubleshooting (account unlocks, app assignments).
* Support staff with SaaS access — helping people get into the cloud tools OGP uses (Google Workspace, 1Password, Slack, Notion).
* Troubleshoot Mac issues: OS problems, software installs, connectivity, peripheral setup, hardware fixes.
* Provide first\-level support for meeting room AV and displays — resolving common issues and escalating where needed.

**Onboarding \& Offboarding**

* Execute the IT onboarding checklist for every new hire — device prep, account creation, and day\-one setup.
* Run IT offboarding — account suspension, device collection, and access revocation.
* Maintain and keep the onboarding/offboarding runbook up to date so the process is documented and repeatable.

**Asset Management**

* Maintain the hardware register — track procurement, assignment, return, and disposal for all devices.
* Monitor device lifecycle, warranty status, and stock levels; coordinate repairs and loaner assignments.
* Keep inventory records accurate after every movement; run quarterly stocktakes.

**Documentation**

* Create and maintain Knowledge Base (KB) articles — building a self\-service resource for staff and future reference.
* Maintain and update runbooks as processes are built and refined.
* Draft clear, staff\-friendly self\-serve guides for common faced issues.

**Preferred Skills and Qualifications**

* Proficient in supporting macOS hardware and common enterprise tools, including Okta, Google Workspace, 1Password, and Slack
* Demonstrate strong aptitude for learning and are comfortable investigating unfamiliar technical problems
* Communicate clearly and effectively — both with staff seeking support and with the IT manager, ensuring a clear and accurate picture of ongoing issues
* Organised and process\-oriented, with a habit of documenting work and identifying opportunities to improve repeatability and efficiency
* Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, reliability, and responsiveness

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with MDM/UEM tools (e.g. Jamf, Intune, Kandji)
* Prior experience in IT support, helpdesk operations, or systems administration
* Foundational knowledge of broader IT domains such as networking, security, or IT Service Management
* Relevant certifications, such as CompTIA A\+, ITIL Foundation, or CompTIA Network\+
* Familiarity with ITSM/ticketing platforms (e.g. Freshservice, Jira Service Management, Zendesk)
* Understanding of automation concepts and familiarity with building workflows to streamline repetitive tasks

**Working at OGP**
------------------

**Ownership and Autonomy** — Beyond technical tasks, this means having autonomy to voice opinions and suggest future directions. Building what you believe in drives the creation of great solutions.

**Rapid Prototyping** — We prioritize testing ideas over debating them, allowing us to identify problems quickly and convey possibilities to others. This fail\-fast approach accelerates innovation.

**Flexibility** — We provide flexible work arrangements based on what works best for our team and its members, fostering a productive and supportive environment.

**Continuous Learning** — Drive professional growth by exploring new architectures, frameworks, and technologies. With dedicated yearly learning months and hackathons, continuous learning is essential as we tackle innovative ideas and challenges.

**Mission\-Driven** — Our work is dedicated to the public good, aiming to improve the lives of Singapore citizens. We focus on creating impactful solutions that enhance the community and the place we call home.

**Projects OGP has worked on include:**

**ScamShield** — iOS and Android mobile apps, enhanced in August 2024, help users check and report suspicious communications. The apps automatically filter known scams using an AI\-powered machine learning classifier. An Admin Dashboard also allows police to verify reported scams.

**ParkingSG** — A mobile app alternative to parking coupons. It lets users pay, extend, and refund their parking sessions just using their phones.

**RedeemSG** — Helps the Singapore Government to create, send and track redemptions of digital vouchers easily.

**COVID\-19 Vaccination** — A suite of systems built to enable Singapore's national vaccination campaign for COVID\-19\. This includes informational sites, appointment booking systems, and records management systems.

**data.gov.sg** — An open repository of all the Singapore Government's public data. It helps people understand the data using visualizations and articles, and provides real\-time APIs for developers to use.

**Isomer** — Provides government agencies with an easy\-to\-deploy static website building and hosting service to create usable, secure and faster informational websites quickly.

**FormSG** — A form builder tool for agencies to self\-service and create online forms that capture classified data, with the goal of replacing paper forms.

**PaySG** — Was developed to enable digital payments for government services, and was initially used for payments for COVID\-19 swab tests and Stay\-Home Notices for incoming travellers to Singapore.


An overview of other OGP products can be found on our website https://open.gov.sg

* The role involves providing production application and system support, handling incident, problem, and change management, and ensuring that requests from front\-to\-back IWM users are managed effectively and efficiently.
* The successful candidate will identify the root causes of system issues, provide solutions or workarounds, and coordinate with vendors and development teams when required.
* Strong communication, analytical, and troubleshooting skills are essential.
* Knowledge of the Avaloq Banking System will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities::**

* Provide daily application and system support to the IWM business on rotational shifts (7:00 AM–4:00 PM / 9:00 AM–6:00 PM), including on\-call support and managing the IWM IT Helpdesk.
* Maintain the performance, stability, and availability of the production environment.
* Monitor critical system components, troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and provide appropriate solutions or workarounds.
* Work closely with business users to ensure production incidents are resolved promptly and appropriate remedial actions are implemented.
* Coordinate with infrastructure teams, development teams, and vendors on system upgrades, release management, and change implementation.
* Manage and track production issues and conduct incident post\-mortem reviews to mitigate root causes.
* Provide UAT support and manage production rollouts for both BAU changes and projects.
* Collaborate with regional IT teams and cross\-functional IT business units to maintain effective upstream and downstream processing.
* Participate in business continuity planning, exercises, and regional or global projects.

**Requirements**

* University degree with a minimum of 3 years of application support experience within a banking or financial institution.
* Experience supporting Wealth Management, Order Management (OMS), or Execution Management Systems (EMS).
* Hands\-on experience with Oracle 19c, MSSQL, UNIX, and Windows operating environments.
* Strong experience supporting UNIX\-based applications, including shell scripting and automation.
* Experience with job scheduling systems, preferably AutoSys.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one of the following: Avaloq, MarginMan, or AWS.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work effectively under pressure.
* Self\-motivated, responsible, reliable, adaptable, and willing to learn new technologies.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across all organizational levels.

**Preferred Qualifications \& Skills::**

* Completed Avaloq Certification or Training.
* ITIL v3 certification or equivalent qualification.
* Knowledge of market data, financial models, and the FIX Protocol.
* Understanding of cloud operations, microservices, Python/Perl scripting, and Microsoft Excel.
* Basic financial knowledge of Foreign Exchange (FX), Money Markets (MM), Equities, Derivatives, and associated front\-to\-back operational workflows."
